༄ga /'phags pa don dam pa'i chos kyis rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄tshon /rgya gar skad du/ ārya7pa ra mārbatsadharma bi dza ya nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa don dam pa'i chos kyis rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas ring po ma lon par ga lnga'i phyiri la dge slong mngon par zhugs pa mngon par zhugs pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang thabs cig ⑦tu bzhugs te/lha bye ba phrag nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma brgyad khri drug stong dang / gyad drug khri dang /gcer bu pa bye ba phrag bcu gnyis dang / drang srong chen po mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa/ gdung ba lngas yan lag chog pa lnga brgya yan lag dkar ba/ sha 66—89

med cing rus mgo pags ①kyis yog ②pa/ lto zhar zhing skra'i khur khyer ba/lus rgyas rib/ g.yang bzhi dang shing shun gyon pa/ lag na ril ba thogs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong dang yang thabs cigasnyigo/ /rgal bar 'dun pa rnams dang yang thabs cig rigago/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ri nag po rnams kyi nang na ri'i rgyal po ri rab ltar drang srong rnams kyi nang na lham me/ lhan ne/ lhang nge ste / lug rnams kyi nang na glang po che'i rgyal po mche ba drug pa 'dra la/ srin bu me khyer gyi drung na nyi yizla dang mtshungs shing / rsāsheka shi'i me tog gi nang na man dā ra ba'i yal ga dang 'dra la/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po bya rog gis bskor ba dang 'dra bar bcom ldan 'das drang〈khusrong rnams kyi nang na nyis 'gyur du mdzes sol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rin po che'i gtong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dpag tu med par mdzad cing glo tsa)g.yas g.yon gnyis nas 'od zer phyung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba dpag tu med pa phyung / byang chub sems dpa' bye ba dpag tu med pa dang /brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dpag tu med pa phyung /dgra bcom pa brgya stong dpag tu med pa phyung / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang glu/ dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma brgyarwa)stong dpag tu med pa phyung /'khor los sgyurasngogeb dang / stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur7ba dang / khamasasakyi rgyal po dang / rig5nyesngags 'chang dpag tu med pa phyung / rgya dang / ri brags pa dang / 'gro lding ba dang / lho phyogs pa dang / nags khrod pa dpag tu med pa phyung / rgyal rigs shing sā7la chen po lta bu dang / bram ze dang khyim bdag shing sā 3)la chen po lta bu dang / mi gzugs dang / cha byad 66wa 90

dang ske/ mdog dang / smra ba'i skad sna tshogs pa ji snyed pa dang / lha'i ris ji snyed pa de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku las phyung ngo / /de nas 'khor chen po de the tshom ①du gyur nas phan tshun gdong du lta'o②/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams rab tu dga' ste/ rin po che'i〈char 'bebs pa nas rgyan thams cad kyi bar gyi char 'bebs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rin po che gtong ba'i ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs te/ seng ge bsgyings ④pas phyogs bcur rnam par gzigs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis phyogs bcur gzigs ma thag tu de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ji snyed sangs rgyas kyi spyan la snang ba de dag thams cad lag mthil du bzhag pa bzhin du mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su kun tu snang ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas ji ltar phyung rjob de 'dra ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul phyung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sprul pa phyung ba ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su dong ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor gyi nang du 'dus par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dag kyang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma gang gā'i bye ma snyed dag dang lhan cig tu de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa chen po dpe med pa thogs te 'dir lhags so/ /de bzhin du lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa du ma de dag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul de mthong nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der 66—91

dong ngo / /de nas gang dag phyogs bcu nas lhags ①pa'i byang chub sems dpas de dag gis mchod pa bla na med pas bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen bkur byas te/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis yongs su bsgrubs pa'i stan ②dag la 'khod do/ /mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar du yang gci rigs pa'i stan dag la 'khod do/ /gang dag bcom ldan 'das kyis sprul pa phyung ba de dag kyang mnar med pa yan chad 'og min gyi gnas man chad du mngon par byung ④ste slar yang log go/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyishesprul pa phyung57ba ji snyed pa de dag thams cad ni bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i spu'i khung bu thams cad du nub bo/ /gang dag bcom ldan 'das kyisakyisprul pa phyung ba de dag ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rnams su nub bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal ba'i phung po zhes bya ba stanamadulas langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha zhung sa la btsugs〈nye te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 11logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'di kyi dag gis mngon par bstodatshwanyedo/ /kye ma mi rnams kyi ni 'dren pa yis/ /sngon chad ma byung mdzad pa sna tshogs 'di/ /skye dgutsokun la myur du kun bstan pa/ /de yis bdud sde 8thams cad mog mog bgyis/ /phan tshun dag tu tshig tu smra bgyid pa/ /kye ma'o 8shin tu ngo mtshar che zhes mchi/ /bdag cag ci zhig phyir ni 'dir lhags kye/ /bdag cag bcomatshwanyemo bdag cag (snyebacom zhes mchi/ /dka' nyurtethub can bdag dka' thub can min gyur0 / /nyam (1chung lus la pags ni pa tsam zhig las/ /bdag 'khogs bdag skams bde ba zhunyernams las nyams/ /bdag cag rdzu 'phrul thob par gyur ma du steyin/ /66—92

yi ge ma mchis rdzu 'phrul gsum rnams kyis/ /bstan pa'i dgra rnams mog mog gyur par mdzad/ /bstan pa'i 'dren0)pa khyod kyis de ring ni/ /sangs rgyas sras la dus ston chen po mdzad/ /'khor 'di thams cad the tshoms②'tshal bar gyur②ske/ /dga' ba skyes shing sems kyang rab dga' ste/ /gang zhig gnas nas lha tshogs bdag cag kyang / /'jig rten mgon po sangs rgyas gyur cig mchi/ /'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas mang po bsnyen bkur bgyis/ /sangs rgyas sras po mtha' yas rnams kyis bskor/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni 'khor gyi nang na mchis//cho 'phrul rnam par phye ste bstan du gsol/ /'di dag chos ni gang gi〈peltas shig lags⑤ / /thub pa chos ni gang zhig gsung bar bzhed(6ri/ /'khor 'di thams cad 'bod cing mchis lags na/ /sems can thugs brtse'i slad du bdag la gsungs / /de nas sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs7kyis 'khor de'i nang nas drang srong chen po me sgron zhes bya ba gcig gis byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i phung po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye hu )gzhon nu re shig 31kha rog shigatshwa)kho bos dri ba dri bar bya'o/ /gal te kho bo'i dri ba khong du chud par byed na ni de thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya ba'i hunyeming dang yang 'thun mino/ /'on te sred med kyi bu dang /dbang phyug chen pos phyung ba'i 'gro lding ba rnams kyis sprul pa byed du bcug na 'dir ngo mtshar yang mi che ste/ skyes bu ngan pa dang / sgyu ma mkhan rnams kyis 'di 'grub bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa'i zhal gyis drang srong gi 8tshogs la kun tu gzigs nas drang srong chen po me sgron la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /tshe dang ldan pa drang78srong chen po ci rmus kyis dri ba dris shig dang rnam par sbyar 3nyebar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la drang srong chen po 66—93

me sgron gyis 'di skad ces 37gsol to/ /kye gi ta mashesems can gyi skye ba gang nas byung / ci'i slad du bskal pas sreg par 'gyur/ sems can rnams gnas gang du 'du bar 'gyur/ nang na sems can phrasheb khru gang tsam mamanya/mtho gang tsam mam/ mdzub namo tsam mamakha/ mthe bo tsam mamanya/ nas dang /gro dang / mon sran sde'u dang / mon sran gre'u dang / til dang / yungs 'bru tsam mam no/ sems can ji tsam zhig nang na mchis bka' stsol cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis drang srong chen po me sgron la drang srong chen po legs so legs so/ /zhes bya ba byin no(rje )/ /drang srong chen po tshe bskal pa drug cu pa'i dri ba dri ba 11'di ni 'thun /rtepa'o/ /de nas drang srong chen po rnams ngo mtshar du gyur te/ drang srong chen po me sgron gyi che'i tshad ni ma brjod par bdag cag lhan cig gnas gnas nyusnyepa rnams kyis kyang ma shes na 'dis ji ltar shes snyam mo/ /bcom ldan 8'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ drang srong chen po de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung mashig dang bshad do/ /drang srong chen po gang nga la sems can gyi skye ba gang nas byung zhes smras pa de ni yi ges brjod pa ma yin pa'o//sems can zhes bya ba ni ma rig pa'i rkyen tshanas skye ba dang / rga shi'i bar du byung 1 tshoba'o/ /drang srong chen po yang rgyu rkyen las sems can skyes te rgyu rkyen ni pha ma'o / /drang srong chen po yang pha ma 'grogs pa ni de'i rgyu'o/ /gang gi tshe yongs su rtog pas kun nas bslang ba'i las kyi rlung rnams kyis bud med kyi grong (3du 'jug pa de ni rkyen no/ /drang srong chen po yang sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa hurtedang / sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba (2 dang / sdug bsngal 'gog pa dang /sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa ni sems can no/ /66wa 94

nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga dang khams bcwa ①brgyad ni sems can no/ /drang srong chen po sems can yang gzhan la las kyang gzhan ma yin/ las kyang gzhan la sems can yangashegazhan ma yin no/ /drang srong chen po sems can ni 'grib pa ma yin/ 'phel ba ma yin no/ /drang srong chen posalagasol pa/ kye gi ta ma gal te sems can 'grib pa ma mchis/ 'phel ba ma mchis na/ ci'i slad du sems can khyi'i skye gnas nas shi 'phos te dbang sgyur du 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ drang srong chen po de ni ji skad smras pa de bzhin du ma yin no/ /gal te dbangabasgyur dbang sgyur yin du zin na ni dbang med par 'chi bar mi rigs so/ /drang srong chen po gang rang gi lus kyi gtso bo ma yin pa de ji ltar dbang sgyur du 'gyur/ drang srong chen po 'di lta ste/ dper na srin bu me khyer 'di snyam du bdag gis 'dzam bu'i sagling snang bar bya'o/ /snyam du sems pa'i 0rkyen gyis srin bu me khyer gyis 'dzam bu'i lagling snang bar byed dam/sems ma dul ba'i dbang sgyur yang dag pa ma yin no/ /drang srong chen po yang gal te dbang sgyur nyon mongs pa 'bri bar gyur na ni khyi la nyon mongs pa shas che bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe dbang sgyur dang nyon mongs pa dag khyi la yangasnyeyod cing dbang sgyur la yang yod pa de'i tshe sems can 'grib pa yang mi dmigs0/'phel ba yang mi dmigs so/ /drang srong chen pos gsol pa/ gi ta mas77nyon mongs pa 'grib (7par mdzad dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/drang6srong chen po ngas phyin ci log dag bzlog pa yang med/ 'grib par byas pa yang med do/ /drang srong chen pos gsol pa/ gal te de ltar na khyod kyang dbang sgyur ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ drang srong 66—95

chen po de de bzhin te/ ma byung ba'i phyir ngatuyang dbang sgyur ma yin no/ /drang srong chen pos gsol pa/ gau ta ma bka' mchid 'di re zhig〈zhog /gau ta ma'i sras kyis pha ma 'grogs pa las sems can skye'o ①zhes gsungs na/sems can mang du 'grogs pa la sems can skye ba nyung bar gyur pa 'di ci lta bu/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyod la dpe bstan par bya'o/ /drang srong chen po 'di lta ste/ dper na sa bon gcig las shing skye bar 'gyur te/'bras bu gcig las kyang 'bras bu mtha' yas par 'gyur ⑧ro/ /de la res 'ga' ni gcig sa bon gyi 'os su 'gyur gyi lhag ma sa bon gyi 'os su mi 'gyur ba de ji 6)lta bu/ drang srong chen pos gsol pa/ kye gi ta ma rlung dang nyi mas shing tog rnams ma rung bar bgyis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/drang srong chen po de de bzhin te/ las kyi rlung gis kyang sems can gyi 'bras bu rnams ma rung bar byas so/ /drang srong chen po kha cig ni mngal na gnas pa nyid kyi tshe srin bu rnams kyis zos so/ /kha cig ni las kyi rlung rnams kyis phye mar byas so/ /drang srong chen po shing gi nyes pa ni nyung ngo / /sems can gyi nyes pa ni mang ngo / /drang srong chen po yang sems can gyi khams ni yongs su rtog pasashekun nas bslang ba ste/ drang srong chen po sems can rnams kyi sems dang sems las byung ba 'jug pa ji snyed pa de snyed du srid pa la dmigs te/ drang srong chen po de'i phyir sems can gyi khams ni yongs su rtog pas kun nas bslang ba'o zhes nga 4༄smra'o/ /drang srong chen pos gsol pa/ kye gi ta mnyede de bzhin te/ zhu ba brjod pa 'di boni rnam par dag go/ /ci'i slad du bskal pas sreg57par 'gyur ba bka' the stsol cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ drang srong 66wa 96

chen po chos kyi dbyings 'dus ma byas pa'i phyir bskal pas sreg par 'gyur ro/ /drang srong chen po gal te bskal pas sreg par mi 'gyur na chos kyi dbyings gnyis su 'gyur te/ la la mi rtag la/ la la rtag par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa bden pa smra bar mi 'gyur ro/ /drang srong chen po gang gi phyir 'di thams cad rtag pa ma yin/ brtan pa ma yin/ dbugs phyin pa ma yin pa de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya ba de'i ming thob bo/ /drang srong chen pos bram ze'i khye'u la smras pa/ 'di thams cad mkhyen par mtshan gsol pa ni 'thunatuno/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ drang srong chen po gal te bskal pas bsregs57par ma gyur na 'di ni dus bzang po'o/ /'di ni dusasnyengan pa'o zhes bya bar dus tha dad pa med par 'gyur ro/ /drangasresrong chen po gal te yang bskal pas bsregs par ma gyur na legs par byas pa dang ske/ nyes par byas pa'i las rnams kyipo)rnam par smin pa tha dad pa med par 'gyur ro/ /drang srong chen po yang 'di lta ste/ bskal pas sreg ④pa 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thabs mkhas pa ste/ drang srong chen po sems can ji snyedakyibaskal pas sreg⑧par 'gyur ba thos nas dad par 'gyur ba'i sems can de snyed de bzhin gshegs pas bsdu ba'i dngos pos sdud par 'gyur ro/ /drang srong chen po 'di lta ste/ dper na kha chu ldag pa'i sbrul ni mig gis kyang rngubasti/rna ba dang / sna dang / kha'i sgo nas kyang rngub bo/ /drang srong chen po de bzhin gshegs pa la yang de ltar blta ste/ sbyin pas kyang sdud/ snyan par smra bas kyang sdud/ don spyod huX pas kyang sdud/ don 'thun0)pas kyang sdud do/ /drang srong chen po 'di lta ste/ dper na gser la gnod par bya ba'i phyir mer 'jug 66—97

pa ma yin gyisasti/ gser dul ma ma yin pa 'di ji ltar na dul mar 'gyur snyam nas de'i phyir mer 'jug ste/ shin tu bsregs pa'i phyir rin po che'i 'os su 'gyur ro/ /rin po ches spras pa de'i rin thang med par 'gyur te/ drang srong chen po de'i phyir gser brdung ba dang bsreg pas rnam par sbyong ngo / /drang srong chen po de bzhin du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang rgyu med par sreg pa'i bskal pa mi 'byin te/ 'dir sems can gang la yang gnod par mi 'gyur rol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la drang srong chen po me sgron gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bskal pas sreg⑧pa'i me phyung yang sems can gang la yang gnod par mi 'gyur ba ni ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ drang srong chen po de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni sems can gang la yang gnod par mi mdzad do/ /drang srong chen po 'di lta ste/ dper na phyogs bcu rnams su char phra mo'i durgyun 'bab pa de bas ni drang srong chen po de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams nye bar gnas te/ rang gi lag gis sems can thar bar byed pa ni ches mang ngo / /drang srong chen po de'i tshe sems can de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi gzugs kyang ④mthong / kha dog mdzes pa yang mthong / bskal pas bsregasalgepa'i 'jigs pa las bdag nyid sgrol ba yang mthong nas dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba skyes te 'di skad ces bdag cag kyang 'di ⑥ltar sgrol ba por gyur cig⑦ /bdag cag kyang 'di ltar gzugs mdzes par gyur cig /bdag cag kyang 'di ltar kha dog mdzes par gyur cig ces 'dzer te/ kha cig ni yid byung nas sems rnam par grol te 66—98

rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras7bu mngon sum du byed/ kha cig ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byed/ kha cig ni dgra bcom pa nyid/ kha cig ni rang byang chub/ kha cig⑧ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa rab tu thob/ kha cig⑧ni phyir mi ldog pa'i sa gnon/ kha cig ni rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi nang du skye/ kha cig ni sum cu༄rtsa gsum du/ kha cig ni mtshe mar/ kha cig ni dga' ldan du/ kha cig ni 'phrul dgaradu / kha cig ni gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyi nang du skye'o/ /drang srong chen po rnam grangs 'di lta bur 'og min gyi bar gyi lha rnams kyi nang du skye'odu / /de bzhin du 'khor los sgyur7ba rnams dang / stobs kyi7'khor los sgyur ba rnams dang khams kyi rgyal po rnams su 'gyur te/ drang srong chen po rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams kyi bar du yang 'gyur rol/ /drang srong chen po rnam grangs 'di lta bus de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs kyi sku mthong zhing bdag nyid kyang 'jigs pa chen po las grol bar mthong nas/de bzhin gshegs pa la byas pa gzo zhing byas pa shes par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la 0chos nyid thos nas bslab pa'i gnas rnams la bag byed par 'gyur ro/ /thabs 'dis na ngan song du 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /drang srong chen po yang sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mig la sa'i khams ji snyed snang bar 'gyur ba de bas ni sems can tu)gyi khams gang 'khor bar 8chags pa'i skyon chags par shes nas phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar byed pa ches mang ste/drang srong chen po de'i phyir bskal pas sreg par 'gyur ro/ /de nas drang srong 66—99

chen po me sgron gyis rang gi yid kyis rnam par dpyad nas tshig tu smras pa/ kye ma'o gang bdag drang srong chen po zhes 'bod pa shākya'i sras 'di'i che ba nyid ni rgya che ba'o/ /bdag gis 'di la bgams pas7kyang chog⑧ste/ 'di ni thams cad mkhyen par mngon gyis / bdag gis kyang 'di la yang dag pa'i ming gis bod ④par bya'o zhes smras so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la drang srong chen po me sgron gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /yon tan gyi du'abyung gnas su gyur cing mkhyen pa dpag tu ma mchis pas thams cad mkhyen pa zhes mtshan gsol pa/sems can gnas gang du 'du bar 'gyur ba bdag la bka' stsol cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ drang srong chen po gnas med pa la sems can 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /mnyam yepa nyid la sems can 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /drang srong chen po theg pa gcig gis 'byung ba la sems can 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi snying po la sems can 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /drang srong chen po phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su sems can 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /drang srong chen po 'di lta ste/ dper na chu klung chen poshetha dad pa dang / klung phran dang / klung chen po dag rgya mtsho chen por babasnyenas ro gcig tu 'gyur ro//drang srong chen po de bzhin du sems can gyi khams ji snyed zag pa zad parashebyed pa de dag thams cad nyu) rnam par grol ba'i ngang du gyur pas 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /drang srong chen po 'khor bar 'du bsarwaskyesems can 'du bar 'gyur ba ni 'du ba ma yin pa'o zhes nga smra'o/ /drang srong chen po 'di lta ste/ dper na rlung gis bdas hurtenas phye ma leb phyi phyi /nyezha la 'du bar 'gyur te/ rlung med na so sor 'gyes so/ /drang srong chen po de bzhin du sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 66—100

'gyur bas7phan tshun las ②'brel pa'i sems can gyi khams de dag kyang der 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /drang srong chen po rnamasagrangs 'di lta bur phan tshun las kyis 'brel ba dag yi dgas7su skye bar 'gyur/ dud 'gror skye bar 'gyur te/der de dag 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /drang srong chen po lha dang mi rnams su de dag 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /drang srong chen pos gsol pa/ thams cad zil gyis gnon pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa/ mir skyes pa 'di sems can che ge mo zhes bgyi ba zhig dang 'dus par gyur to/ /dud 'gror skyes pa 'di zhes bgyi ba nas yi dgas7su skyes pa 'di 'dus par gyur to zhes bgyi ba'i bar du ji ltar 'tshal bar bgyi ba bka' stsol cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ drang srong chen po sems can gang zhig sems can gang dang lhan cig tu sems can dmyal bar skyes nyanas 'dus par gyur pa des de mthong na yid mi bde bar 'gyur / zhe snang bar 'gyur/ des de mthong nas gal te na de klad ga pa na bar yang 'gyur/ bshang ba dang / gci ba 'byung bar yang 'gyur te/ drang srong chen7po 'di ni sems can dmyal bar skyes pa rnams kyi 'du ba'i mtshan nyid do//gang la la de ltar gyur pa des kyang bdag dang 'di lhan cig botu sems can dmyal ba rnams na gnas gnas par mngon no zhes de ltar khong du chud par bya'o//drang srong chen pos gsol pa/ rigs gsal bar mdzad pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa / dud 'gro dang lhan cig gnas gnas pa rnams kyi mtshan mar 'gyur ba ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mir skyes pa'i sems can rnams gang gi tshe phan tshun mthong ba na khon hu )du mdud par 'dzin cing /'di las bdag gis skyon ji ltar rnyed snyam du skyon tshol ba 'di ni drang srong chen 66—101

po dud 'gror skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi 'du ba'i mtshan nyid de/ bdag dang 'di lhan cig tu dud 'gro'i nang na gnas gnas par mngon no zhes de ltar shes par bya'o/ /drang srong chen po yi dgas7su skyes pa rnams ni dri nga ba 'dod cing kha zas la shin tu sred par 'gyur ro/ /pha rol la sbyin par bsams kyangashechags pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gang dang de yi dgasashes skyes nas lhan cig 'dus par gyur pa de'i dbang phyug mthong nas phrag dog skye bar 'gyur/ gzhan gyi nor la 'dod par 'gyur te/ 'di ni yi dgas su skyes pa rnams kyi 'du ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /de la bdag dang 'di lhan cig tu yi dgasasnyikyi nang na gnas gnas par mngon no zhes de ltar shes par bya'o/ /drang srong chen po mir skyes pa gang la la zhig tshe rabs gzhan dag nas 'dus par gyur pa ni des de mthong na 'dod chags kyi sems skye bar 'gyur te/ drang srong chen po 'di ni mir skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi 'du ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /de la bdag dang 'di mi rnams kyi nang na gnas gnas par mngon no/ /zhes de ltar shes par bya'o / /drang srong chen pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang dag lhar skyes te 'dus par gyur pa las mir skyes pa de dag gi ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ drang srong chen po gang dag lhar skyes te/ 'dus par gyur pa de dag ni/ phan tshun mthong na lta ⑦ba la 'jug par 'gyur te/des na bdag dang 'di lhar skyes te lhan cig 'dusalgepar gyur to zhes shes par bya'o / /drang srong chen po rnam pa de lta bu dag tu sems can 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas drang srong chen po me sgron dga' mgu ste yisherangs nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang dag thams cad mkhyen pa 66—102

nyid du smon pa mi bgyid pa'i sems can de dag ni bslus pa'o zhes bdag 'chad do / /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis drang srong chen po me sgron la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /drang srong chen po gang na sems can zhes bya ba phra ba ji tsam zhig yod ces nga la de skad zer ba ni drang srong chen po gang sems can du dmigasalgepa de sems can phra mor rnam par 'byed do/ /drang srong chen po 'di lta ste/ dper na la la zhig gis dmus long zhig la 'di skad du/ kye skyes bu kha dog dkar po zhes bya ba ci 'dra zhes smras na/ drang srong chen po 'di ji snyam du sems/ ma mthong ba'i phyir kha dog dkar po 'di 'dra'o zhes de smra bar nus sam / drang srong chen pos gsol pa/ 'brel pa ga la mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ drang srong chen po de bzhin dusangs kyang dmus long ltar ma mthong ba'i phyir sems can zhes bya ba ni phra mo 'di lta bu zhig go zhes ②sems can brjod par mi nus so/ /drang srong chen po yang mig la sems can zhes bya ba mi rnyed deX/ rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang /yid la sems can zhes bya ba mi rnyed do/ /drang srong chen po nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po dag la sems can zhes bya ba mi rnyed do/ /drang srong chen po khams bcwa dubargyad dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yan lag bcu gnyis pa dang ske/ nang stong pa nyid la sems can zhes bya ba mi rnyed/ phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid la sems can zhes bya ba mi rnyed do/ /drang srong chen po mig ni ngan pa'o/ /'jig pa'o/ /skad cig kyang mi gnas pa'o/ /de bzhin du rna ba dang / sna'udang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyang ngan pa'o / /'jig pa'o/ /skad cig kyang mi gnas pa'o/ /drang srong chen po nye 66—103

bar len pa'i phung po lnga yang ngan pa'o/ /'jig pa'o/ /skad cig kyang mi gnas pa'o/ /drang srong chen po mi gtsang ba'i rdzas7sum cu'urtsa drug kyang ngan pa'ol/ /'jig pa'o/ /skad cig kyang mi gnas pa'o/ /sems can zhes bya ba yang med/ gzugs kyang med de/ drang srong chen po rdzas 'dus pa ni sems can zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /yongs su rtog pa pasagang dag rdzas rnams rnam par 'byed ripa de dag ni/ srog dang / gso ba dang / skyes bu dang /gang zag dang / shed las skyes dang / shed bu mi dmigasam⑤so/ /drang srong chen po gal te sems can yod du zin na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po dag gis shin tu chos ston par mi 'gyur ba zhig na drang srong chen po gang gi phyir sems can med pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa nyid 'thob ste/de'i phyir ji lta ji ltar yang dag par〈masgrub par byed pa de lta57de ltar yang dag par 'grub bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la drang srong chen po me sgron gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das deng slan chad drang srong chen po me sgron bdag thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du smon par bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te bdag bskal pa dpag tu ma mchis par sems can dmyal ba'i zhugs kyi 'obs su gnas par 'gyur ba'am/ ri rab 'og min gyi gnas tsam du gyur pa mthon po'i kha de nas bdag gis bdag 'dor bar 'gyur ba'am/ gdung ba lnga bskal pas bsreg 8)pa lta bur 'gyur ba'am/ nyi ma bskal par gnas par 'gyur ba'am/ bskal pa sum cu'i 6zla ba gcig tu smyung bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i dka' ba spyad par 1 rini bcom ldan 'das bdag spro ste 'dun gyi/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi slad du ni brtson 'grus nyams par mi bgyi'o/ /drang srong 66wa 104

chen po mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa ji snyed bcom ldan 'das kyi gan7du lhags pa de dag kyang stan las langs te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang deng slad〈khuchad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon par bgyi'o/ / rngo ci thogs kyis brtson 'grus7brtsamasnyipar bgyi'o/ /drang srong rnamasam⑤kyis sre)tshig de dag smras ma thag tu/ bcom ldan 'das kyi9)smin mtshams nas 'dul ba can zhes bya ba'i 'od zer phyung / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang smin mtshams nas 'dul ba can zhes bya ba'i 'od zeras3)phyung ste/ 'od zer de dag gi⑥mthus sa chen po 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ 'gul/ rab tu 'gul / ldeg rab tu ldeg ste/ shar phyogs mtho na lho phyogs dma'/ nub phyogs dma' na byang phyogs mtho/ shar phyogs dma' na lho phyogs mtho/ nub phyogs mtho na byang phyogs skya dma'o/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i steng du me tog gi char phab/ rnga bo che rnams brdungs so/ /dri za'i bdag po yid du 'ong ba rnams kyis kyang yan lag lnga pa'i sil snyan gyis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ /lha'i bdug pa dri rab tu zhim po dag kyang rlung gis ngad bslang ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gan du ngad ldang bar byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams rab tu dga' ste mchog tu bde ba'i sems kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i steng du do shal dang / se mo do rnams 'thor zhing rin po che'i char yang 'bebs/ me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / gos dang ske/ gdugasarwaskyedang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag hu gis kyang mchod 66—105

par7byed do/ /lha'i tshogs rnams kyang rab tu dga' nas me tog man dā ra ba dang ske/ man dā ra ba chen po'i char 'bebs so/ /thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de yangasadaga' mgu yi rangs te / ji ltar gyon gyon pa'i gos rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la gsol to/ /de nas 'dul ba can zhes bya ba'i 'od zer des 'og min gyi gnas man chad/ sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med pa yanadzad)chad snang bar byas te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la bskor ba byas tephyo)/ slar log ste bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tu nub bo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis 'di skad ces gsol to//rgyu ma mchis par shāka rtso)thub de ring 'dir/ /phyogs bcu dag tu 'od zer mi gtong ste/ /'khor 'di thams cad the tshom gyur lags na/ /thub pas rgyu dang byed de bdag lung ston/ / mi yishe'adren pa'i rnam par 'phrul mthong nas/ /dga' bar gyur nyu chicing spro ba che gyur te/ /rab tu dga' bas legs par bstod bgyid 37nas/ /kha cig4)'di na bcom ldan legs zhesalgemachi/ /brgya byin tshangs pa 'jig rten skyong ba rnams/ /nam mkha'i chaganas nas 'byung po'i tshogs kyang bstodabo/ /mkha'atsolas lha yi me tog char du 'bebs/ /ma brdungs rnga chen dag ni sgra yang 'byin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor khyod kyis drang srong chen po me sgron mthong ngam/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor drang srong chen po me sgron 'di ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sangs rgyas stong 'das pa'i 'og tu bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la zla ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su de 66wa 106

bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs zhes7bya bar 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs kyi ming yang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rnam par dag pa'i bya ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor drang srong chen po brgyad khri bzhi stong gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos ma thag tu phyir mi ldog pa'i sa rjes su thob ste/ rab 'byor de dag thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa'i gsung rab las sa bcu la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa sum brgya'i 'og tu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdag bka'akhublo bde ba zhes bya b.rashe'ajig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' tshad med pa dag gis kyang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos ma thag tu dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob ste/ skad dang skad ma yin par dushes pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rgyal ba dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sgyu ma lta bu'irnyuting nge 'dzin dang / khams rnam par 'byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / blo gros rgyal po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rgya mtsho snying po'i ting nge 'dzin dang /mnyen pa'i sa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bsam pa'i snying po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'od gsal0ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thobashebo/ /rab 'byor lha bye ba phrag gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag gis mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob bo/ /dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma stong phrag tshad med pa dag gis dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /rab 'byor lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phyetshwarmechen po 8dang / mi dang / mi 66—107

ma yin pa0)gang gā'i bye ma snyed dag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pas don gyi dbang de mthong nas 'dul ba can zhes bya ba'i 'od zer rnams phyung ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis nyid kyi ljags kyi dbang pos zhal khebs par mdzad de/ljags kyi dbang po de las kha dog du ma/ kha dog tha dad pa'i 'od zer〈'di lta ste / sngon po dang / seram po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / le brganar dang / shel dang / dngul gyi kha dog lta bu dag byung ste/ de dag 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag tu mngon par byung nas slar log ste / bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskoradzageb byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis su nub bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros mi zad pa stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rgyu ma mchis par 'dzum pa mi mdzad naX/bcom ldan 'das 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mi zad pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to④/ /rigs kyi7bu ma dad pa rnams kyi don du ljags 'di lta bu ni brdzun tshemi gsung ngo snyam du bya ba'i phyir ljags kyi dbang pos 'dzum 7pa mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' blo gros mi zad pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las tha na tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam (kyelung 66—108

'brogasatun rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag bsod nams kyi phung po ji tsam skyedakhupar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyisam bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis byasangs rgyas kyi spyan la snang bar 'gyur ba ji snyed pa de dag la yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das kyi bar du gang zhig gis bde bar sbyar ba thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byas te/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod rten byed pa de bas gang zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las tha na tshigs su bcad pa gcigasnyitsam yang lung 'bogs7na/ 'dis bsod nams ches mang du skyed do/ /rigs kyi bu chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chad zhu)pa na gang zhig dad pa'i ༄7sems kyis legs so/ /zhes bya ba sbyin pa de la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bstod par 'gyur ro/ /gang gis 'di la rim gro 7byas pa des nga la rim gro byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de la rnam par gzigs nas/ 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag nga ni bden pa〈nyesmra ba ste/ sa phyogs gang na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di grags7)pa'i sa phyogs de la/ sangs rgyas thams cad dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni 'dzam bu'i nyunyegling pa'i sems can rnams kyi sman du gyur par 'gyur ro/ /gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lan gsum brjod dam/brjod du bcug na/ des ston pa la chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar mibaskul bar 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor gang zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yi ger 'dri 'kho/ yi ger 'drir skya'ajug pa de bde ba dang bcas shing / yid bde ba dang bcas bzhin du/ byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 66—109

'gyur ro/ /des sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzod kyang bzungatubar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi ②gu dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba'i sems can rnams kyi rna lam du grag par mi 'gyur ro/ /gang dag mi'i skye gnas nas shi 'phos te/ yongs su dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su skye ba de dag gi rna lam du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di grag par 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor gang gis sangs rgyas stong la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa de'i rna lam du/ chos ③kyi rnam grangs 'di grag par 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas dad dmakha/ 'chang ngam/ klog gam/kun chub par byed dam/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston par 'gyur ba de'i lag tu byang chub song ngo zhes bshad dog/ /des mig lnga thob par 'gyur/ dbang po ma tshang bar mi 'gyur/ dran pa brjed pa med par 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad sgrubalgepa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur/ rnam par snang mdzad rnam par sprul pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang /gzungs kyi snying po'i ting nge 'dzin dang / gtsug gi nor bu'i phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dbang bskur ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob par 'gyur/ yi ge med pa'i za ma tog gi gzungs thob par 'gyur/ chos thams cad la rnam par rgyal ba thob pa'i gzungs dang / the tsom ga rnam par sbyong ba'i gzungasasnyedang / don dam pa'i rnam par nges pa'i gzungs thob par 'gyur te/ de la sogs pa gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo brgya stong mtha' yas pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /bsams ⑨bzhin du 'chi 'pho dang skye ba 66—110

yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa khyod la chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yongs su gtad kyis ①yang dang yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu shod cig /'jam dpal khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa ji snyed cig la bstekustang byas pa dang / btsun par byas pa dang /rim gror byas pa dang / mchod pa byas pa de ji snyam du sems/ 'jam dpal dge ba'i rtsa ba de la mtha' 'am mu yod dam/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dephudapag par nus sam/ 'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal gang gis snyigs ma lnga'i dus na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir rgyas par byed par 'gyur ba de dag de las dge ba'i rtsa ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gal te khyod de bzhin gshegs pa mang po de snyed cig la na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims cha dang / snyun gsos kyi sman dang / yo byad rnams kyis bsnyen bkur byed kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ston par mi byed na/ khyod da dung du ⑤yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la nyes pa dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gal te khyod de bzhin gshegs pa gcig la'ang phyag mi byed kyi/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rgyas par byed na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la khyod kyis mchod pa'i bar du byas par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / drang srong chen po me sgron dang / dge slong de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 66—111

jug /'phags pa chos dang don rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ārya ladharma arsha bi :sngo rig nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra / bod skad du/ 'phags pa chos dang don rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig 5tu bzhugs te/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyodage 'dun chen po dang yang thabs cig 67go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal bas dga' la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus bskal pa grangs med pa'i yang ches grangs med cing tshad med par gyur pa de'i tshe de'i dus na 'jig rten gyi khams me tog gi 'byung gnas zhes ༷7bya ba 'byor pa rgyas pa/66—117

bde ba lo legs pa nyams dga' ba skye bo mang po dang mi rnams kyisashegang ba lagashemathil ltar mnyam par dugyur pa zhig byung ngo / /rigs kyi bu 'jig rten gyi khams me tog gi 'byung gnas de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas me tog las byung ba zhes bya ba da ltar yang bzhugs te/'tsho zhing gzhes la 'khor bzhi dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / sto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams la chos kyang ston to/ /rigs kyi bu da 'jig rten gyi khams me tog gi 'byung gnas de na mi'i dbang po 'khor los sgyur 3skaba'i rgyal po stong gsum gyi stong yichen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams la dbang byed pa rgyal ba thob pa zhes bya ba zhig byung ngo / /rigs kyi bu rgyal po rgyal ba thob pa de'i ⑦tshig rab la sems can de dag bde zhing yid bde ba skyes la/dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan zhing bdagashegi chung mas mngon par dga'o/ /sems can de dag thams cad kyang theg pa gcig la yang dag par zhugs pa sha stag ste/ 'di lta ste/ theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa/ theg pa mchog la yang dag par zhugs pa/ theg pa gtso bo la yang dag par zhugs pa/theg pa dam pa la yang dag par zhugs pa/ theg pa khyad7par du 'phags pa dang ske/ rab dang / phul dang / bla ma dang / bla ma'i yang bla ma dang / bla na med pa la yang dag par zhugs pa/ theg pa mnyam pa med pa la yang dag par zhugs pa/ theg pa mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa la yang dag par zhugs pa/theg pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la yang dag par zhugs pa/ theg pa gzhal du med pa la yang dag par zhugs pa sha stag go/ /rigs kyi bu rgyal po rgyal ba thob pa 66—118

de'i tshe tshig rab la theg pa chen po ma gtogs par theg pa gzhan gyi ming yang mi grag poX/ /rigs kyi bu rgyal po rgyal ba thob pa de'i btsun mo'i 'khor ni dgu khri dgu stong yod de/ de dag thams cad kyang theg pa gzhan ma yin pa la yang dag par zhugs pa/ theg pa chen po'i khongs su 'dus pa/ nyin mtshan du chos 'dod cing chos la dga' ba sha stag go/ /rigs kyi bu de nas rgyal po de'i btsun mo dam pa rin po che dpal zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' sdud pa/ sangs rgyas pa'i〈chos dang dge 'dun la yang dag par zhugs pa/ theg pa chen po'i khongs su 'dus pa/ nyin mtshan du chos 'dod pa/ chos kyi kun dga' la dga' ba zhig yod de/ rigs kyi bu rin chen dpal de chen po la 'os pa'i seng ge'i khri la 'dug pa dang / de'i pangaphunas bu rin chen 'byung gnas zhesarnyubya ba lha'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ lha'i gos bgos pa lus mtshan dang dpe byad ⑤bzang pos legs par brgyan pa zhig skyil mo krung ⑥bcas te byung nas gzhon nu de byung ma thag tu gzhon nu des ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /yum de bzhin gshegs pa me tog las byung ba de 'tsho'am/ de nas rgyal mo rin chen dpal des gzhon nu de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu gcig ⑦kun mkhyen 'jig rten mgon/ /bla na med pa dga' mdzad pa/ /lha dang mi dang bcas pa yi/ /'jig rten na ni de 'tsho'o/ /de nas rgyal bu rin chen 'byung gnas kyis pha ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /yab yum tshur gshegs de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas me tog las byung ba de la blta ba dang / phyag bgyi ba dang / mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur bgyi ba dang /chos mnyan pa'i slad du gshegs so/ /de ci'i slad du zhesnyin/ yab yum de 66—119

bzhin gshegs pa de ni lha dang mir bcas pa'i 'jig rten na dka' ba mdzad pa ste / ma grol ba rnams grol mdzad mgon/ /ldongs pa rnams la mig sbyin mdzad / /chos la dpa' zhing cher dpa' ba/ /lhun po lta bur mi g.yos so/ /de nas rgyal po rgyal ba thob pa skyedang / rgyal mo rin chen dpal gyis bu de blangs te / btsun mo'i 'khor dang g.yog tu bcas par bcom ldan 'das de'i zhabs kyi drung du phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la lan bdun ②bskor ba byas te/ brgya stong ri ba'i mu tig gi se mo do phul lo/ /phul nas kyang 'khor de nyid du 'dug par gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu de nas rgyal bu des rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs bskyed pa byas nas shing ta la bdun srid tsam gyi bar snang gi nam mkha' la 'dug ste/ bcom ldan 'das me tog las byung ba de la rin po che'i char dang / me tog gi char dang ske/ spos chosakyi char rnams kyis gtor mngon parasnyigator to(snye/ /gtor nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /ston pa rgal nas sems can rnams / /sdug bsngal chu bo che las sgrol/ /bdag ni thams cad mkhyen pa khyod/ /blta ba'i slad du 'dir mchis so/ /'jig rten mgon po bla na med/ /lha dang mi yi rdzoga'ajig rten na/ /khyod kyis yon tan gang bstan dang / /khyod 'dra ba ni yong ma mchis/ /sems can shul ngan lhung gyur cing / /'dod chags zhe sdang dbang mchis rnams/ /theg pa dman la gzhag 7rimadzad nas/ /theg pa chen po brjod 58)par mdzad/ /thabs la mkhas shing dpa' ba ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i dbang du gyur/ /chos ni don te chos kyis ngoms/ /chos rtsom yon tan 'byung gnas posti/ /gang dag skye ba ma mchis pa/ /chos de snying po med mkhyen nas/ /chos nyid kyang ni khyod kyis mkhyen/ /des na /tsho )khyod kyis dka'atshwanyeb mdzad/ /de 66—120

nas gzhon nu des tshig 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das de la bstod nas yang bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi drung du 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis pad ma'i 'dab ma ltar yangs pa'i spyan gyis phyogs thams cad dushegazigs te/ 'khor bzhi po de dag gi sems dang sems las byung ba mkhyen nas/ rgyal po rgyal ba thob pa de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po phung po lnga po de dag ni snying po med pa yin na byis pa ②so so'i skye bo rnams ni snying por 'du shes so/ /rgyal po chen po phung po rnams ni kha dog ngan pa/ dri nga ba/ khrag dang rnag⑧'byung ba/ shing dang / bong ba dang /lam dang mtshungs pa/ snying po med pa/ g.yo ba med pa dang / dga' ba dang mi dga' bar 'brel ba/ sred7pa'i lu gu rgyud kyis phanasnyitsan sbrel ba/ nyon mongs pa mang bdu/ smad pa yin na snying po med pa la snying por 'du shes/ mi rtag pa la rtag par 'du shes/ mi sdug pa la sdug par 'du shes/ mi gtsang ba la gtsang bar 'du shes/ bden pa ma yin pa la bden par 'du shes so/ /rgyal po chen po phung po lnga ni rang gi las kyis rnam par bris pa ste rgyal po chen po dper na rma bya'i mjug tshogs tshon sna lnga pa de la ri mo mkhan gyis bris pa yangaphumed/ tshon kyang ci yang7med de/ de ni rang gi las kyis rnam par bris pa nyid do/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhin du byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams kyang rang gi las kyis rnam par bris pa phan tshun gyi rkyen las byung ba dag go/ /de nas 'khor de'i nang nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mi pham dbang phyug ces bya ba de stan7telas langs te/ bcom ldan 'das la bskor ba byas nas/bla gos phrag pa gcigashetu gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la〈nyebatsugs 66—121

nas lus btud lus smad de sor mo bcu thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das phung po 'di dag ni kha dog ngan pa dri nga ba/ khrag dang rnag 'byung ba/ shing dang / bong btudang / rtsig⑧pa dang / lam dang 'dra ba/ snying po ma mchis pa/ g.yo ba ma mchis pa lags na byis pa so so'i〈skye bo rnams ni snying por 'du shes te/ yang dag pa ma lags pa ldongs pa/ rmongs pa dang 'dra ba/ gti mug la gzhol ba/ mun pa dang rab rib dang / ling tog gis kun nas khebs pa/ lta ba thams cad kyi tshang tshing thibs pos gtibs pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi phung po bzhi po 'di dag ni zab ste/ nam mkha' dang mtshungs shing 'dra ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang dag 'di lta bu'i mdo sde'i tshig bshad pa 'di dag la yang dag pa'i 'du shes skyed pa'i sems can de dag 'byung bar 'gyur lags sam/de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das me tog las byung ba des byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu gang gi yitshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'byung ba de'i tshe sems can rnams sbyang ba'i phyir 'byung ste/ mos pa ji lta bshebazhin du sems can rnams la chos kyang ston to/ /sred pas nyamanyethag pa rnams kyi sred pa gcod do/ /sdug bsngal gyis7nyam thag pa rnams kyi mya ngan sel to/ /chos thams cad snying po med par shes te nam mkha' dang mtshungs shing 'dra bar shes nas sems can rnams chos nyid la rab tu 'god〈nye de/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can sbyong7)bar byed pa zhes bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas me tog 66—122

las byung ba des7sems can bstan pa 'di bshad pa na rgyal po rgyal ba thob pa bu dang bcas pa dang / rgyal mo rin chen dpal de dang / btsun mo'i 'khor dang / g.yog 'khor du bcas pa thams cad skra dang kha spu bregs te bcom ldan 'das de las rab tu byung ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag rgyal bu gzhon nu 'di la ltos/rigs kyi bu dag skyes bu dam pa 'dis sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed de/ thams cad du yang7chos smra bar gyur to/ /'di ni rtag tu skyes bu dam pa 'di'i phar gyur te/ rtag tu skyes bu dam pa 'dis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la yongs su smin par byas so/ /sdogs kyi bu dag rgyal bu gzhon nu rin chen 'byung gnas 'di ni nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das ma thag tu sangs rgyas su 'gyur te/ rin po che du ma bkod pa'i byang chub kyi shing drung du 'dug nas/ de byang chub thob pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyuraphub/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od zer kun nas mngon 'phags dpal brtsegs rgyal po zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi khams ni kun nas rin po ches yang dag par bris pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ni tshad med par 'gyur ro/ /de'i che'i tshad ni bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug thub par 'gyur ro/ /de'i dam pa'i chos kyi gzugs brnyan ni lo 'bum phrag bdun cukhutsa lngar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de nas byang 66—123

chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lung bstan pa brjod pa bshad7pa na srog chags brgyad khri bzhi stong mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu de'i tshe de'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa de gzhan7zhig yin pa snyam du khyod dogs shing the tshom za'am yid gnyis su gyur na de ltar mi blta'o④/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med ces bya ba 'di de'i tshe de'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa me tog las byung ba ④zhes bya bar gyur te/ 'jig rten gyi khams der chos bstan par gyur to/ /rigs kyi0bu de'i tshe de'i dus na gzhon nu rin chen 'byung gnas zhes ni)bya ba de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du khyod dogs shing the tsom 7)za'am yid gnyis su gyur na de ltar mi blta'oni/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'di de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po rgyal ba thob pa zhes bya ba de'i bur gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa des nga mtsholas 'tshad rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /de nas 'khor de'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal bas dga' zhes bya bas bcom ldan 'das la sor mo bcu'i thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni sems can dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa rnams kyi rna lam du grag par yang mi 'gyur na(lha/gang dag yi ger 'dri hu ba dang / yi ger 'drir hu)stsol ba dang / 'dzin pa dang ske/ kha ton 8bgyid pa dang / me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos rnams kyis mchod par 'gyur ba lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal bas dga' la 'di 66—124

skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu gang dag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i7klung gi ②bye ma snyed la bsnyen bkur byas pa de dag gis mdo sde 'di rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu chos kyi rnam grangs 'di dag gang gi rna lam du grag par gyur la the tshomasami za ba'i sems can de dag 'di nas shi 'phos nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu gang na mdo sde 'di lta bu dag 'dzin pa'i sa phyogs de dag phyag bya ba'i 'os su 'gyur ro//rigs kyi bu phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus na bud med gang la la zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chang ngam/ klog na de bud med kyi lus rjes ④nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur te/ de nyid de'i bud med kyi lus kyi tha ma yin no//'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe na yang rigede bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal bas dga' ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / dge slong de dag dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te⑦/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bston⑧do// //'phags pa chos dang don rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs (〈pe// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi min mi tra dang / dā na shī 3rtol dang / zhu chen gyi lo67)ba ban de 3 ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pas// //66—125
