༄ga /'phags pa bzhi pa sgrub pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ārya tsa turko ni ra hā ra nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa bzhi pa sgrub lapa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na/ dge slong lnga brgya tsam gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' brgya stong thams cad kyang go cha chen po bgos pa sha stag dang / 'dod pa na spyod pa dang /gzugs na spyod pa'i lha'i bu rnams dang thabs cig⑧ku bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor ④cing mdun gyis bltas nas chos ston to/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las kyi phyir rin po che'i gdugs dpag tshad bcu'i tshad 66—172

tsam thogs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tu 'dzin to/ /de nas 'khor de nyid du dga' ldan gyi7ris kyi lha'i bu dpal bzangs ldan⑧zhes bya ba bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa g.yog dang bcas tekhu'akhor de nyid du 'dus par gyur nas 'dug pa de stan⑧las langs te gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugasapo)te/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal khyod da dung de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i las mdzad pas ma tshim mam /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu 'di ji snyam du sems/ rgya mtsho chen po chu thams cad len pas gzhar yang chog shes sam/ lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal de ni ma lags so/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i busade bzhin du rgya mtsho chen po7mtsho gting dpag dka' ba de lta bu'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes tshad med dpag tu med pa btsal bar bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa'ashide bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i las kyis gzhar yang tshim par mitshwanyebya'o/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpas ci la dmigs72te de bzhin gshegs pa la7mchod par bgyi/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpas dmigs 8pa bzhis de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod par bya'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la dmigs 8pa dang /sems can thams cad rab tu dgrol ba la dmigs 39pa dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung mi 'chad par bya ba la dmigs hu dīpa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa yongs su gzung ba la dmigs 〉snyepa ste/ lha'i bu byang chub 66—173

sems dpas dmigs pa bzhi po de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod par7bya'o / /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal khyod kyis tshangs pa'i ris kyi lha'i bu'i nang du tshangs pa gtsug phud can la byang chub sems dpa'i lam bzhi pa sgrubalgepa zhes bgyi ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs bshad pa de/ 'jam dpal legs par bshad du gsol/ de la ni bdag dang thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor 'di yangakhunyan par 'tshal lo/ /'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' rnams la chos kyi ser sna ma mchis/ slob dpon gyi chos kyi dpe mkhyud kyang ma mchis/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shigatudang ske/ bzhi pa sgrub0pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs de ngas khyod la bshad do / /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa'i sems bskyed par rigashepar bya'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ lha'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems can dpag tu med pa bsdu ba'i phyir sems bskyed pa dang / sems can dpag tu med pa yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir sems bskyed pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba dpag tu med pa bsagasalgepa'i phyir sems bskyed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos dpag tu med pa mngon par rdzogs par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir sems bskyed pa ste/ lha'i bu bzhi po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa'i sems bskyed par rig par bya'o/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems bskyed pa brag lta bu yin no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ slong ba rnams la khong khro ba med pa'i sems dang /log par zhugs pa rnams la snying rje ba'i sems dang / shes rab las ma nyams pa'i sems dang / rtsom pa nyams 'og tu chud par byed pa'i sems te/ lha'i 66—174

bu bzhi po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems bskyed pa brag lta bu yin no/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems bskyed pa mngon par 'phags pa yin no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ tshul khrims mngon par 'phags pa dang / thos pa mngon par 'phags pa dang / byams pa chen po mngon par 'phags pa dang / snying rje chen po mngon par 'phags pa ste/bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems bskyed pa brtan pa/ snying po can/ mi phyed pa/ rdo rje lta bu'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ bsam pa las mi phyed pa dang / mdza'atub las mi phyed pa dang /nan tan las mi phyed pa dang / theg pa chen po las mi phyed pa ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyisnyesems bskyed pa bsnyen dka' ba yin no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ nyon mongs pa dang ma 'dres pa dang / rnyed pa dang / bkur sti dang / tshigs su bcad pa thams cad dang ma 'dres pa dang / theg pa dman pa dang ma 'dres pa dang / skye bo mi bsrungs pa thams cad dang ma 'dres pa ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems bskyed pa bla na med pa'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ phongasalgepa'i dngos po thams cad yongs su gtong ba'i sems dang / byin nas 'gyod pa med pa'i sems dang / rnam par smin pa la re ba med pa'i sems dang / byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba'i sems te/bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyi bor phyin pa'i chos so/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa dang /66—175

sems can yongs su smin par byed pa ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub kyi lam ston par byed pa'o//bzhi gang zhe na/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnams la brtson pa dang / bsdutuba'i dngos po rnams kyi rjes su 'thun⑧pa dang / tshangs pa'i gnas sgrub pa dang /mngon par shes pas rnamasapar rtse ba ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi chos gya rnam pa dam pa mchog yin no / /bzhi gang zhe na/ sems can thams cad la khong khro ba med pa dang /gang dag de dang 'gal bar byed pa de dag nyid ④la rab tu thar bar bya bar sems bskyed sa)pa dang / ji ༅tsam gyi yul rgya chen po zhig 'byor kyang de la bag yod pa dang / ci tsam du dbul bas phongs par gyur kyang chos spyod pa ste/bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di 7dag ni byang chub sems dpa' ⑧rnams kyi mos pa'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ khyim par gyur na bdag gi longs spyod kyis chog shes pa dang / gzhan gyi nor la mngon par 'dod pa med pa dang /rab tu byung nas7)'phags pa'i rigs kyis chog shes pa dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang / yo byad bsnyungs pa ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' pho )rnams kyi sbyin pa'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ chos sbyin pa dang / zang zing sbyin pa dang / shog shog dang / snag tsha dang / smyu gu dang / glegs bam sbyin pa dang / chos smra ba la bsam pa thag pa nas legs so zhes bya ba sbyin pa ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying po nyid do/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ thos pa las nan tan snying po nyid dang / longs spyod rnams las gtong ba hunyesnying po nyid 66—176

dang rka/ lus las bla ma las bsnyenatubakur bya ba snying po nyid dang / srog las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa7snyingakhupo nyid de/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ④yongs su gtang ⑤bar mi bya ba'o / /bzhi gang zhe na/ byang chub kyi sems yongs su gtang bar mi bya ba dang /dam pa'i chos yongs su gtang bar mi bya ba dang / sems can yongs su gtang bar mi bya ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i chos thams cad yongs su btsal ba yongs su gtang bar mi bya ba ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi skyedapo)mos tshal lo/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ dgon pa la gnas pa dang / dben pa la mngon par dga' ba dang / dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa dang / thabs mkhas pas sems can yongs su smin ⑦/par byed pa ste / bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gzhal med khang ngo / /bzhi gang zhe na/ tshangs pa'i gnas dang /'belaphuba'i gtam gyi chos mnyan pa la dga' ba myong bar byed pa dang / stong pa nyid la nges par sems pa dang / skye bo ris 'thun tu)pa dang 'du ba ste/bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nor mi zad pa'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ thos pa'i nor dang / chos ston pa'i nor dang / sems can dbul po sdud pa'i nor dang / byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba'i nor te/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gter ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ gzungs kyi gter dang /spobs pa'i gter dang / chos kyi gter dang / longs spyod zad mi shes par yongs su bsngo ba'i gter te/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni 66—177

byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mngon par 'byung ba'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/'du 'dzi las 'byung ba dang / yul thams cad las 'byung ba dang / 'phags pa ma yin pa'i bsam pa las 'byung ba dang / khams gsum thams cad lasanye'abyung ba ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa'akhurnams kyi bde ba'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ dngos po thams cad la mi lta ba'i phyir bdag gi ba med cing yongs su 'dzin pa med pa'i bde ba dang / yul spangs pas dben pa'i bde ba dang / nyon mongs pa med pa'i phyir zhi ba'i bde ba dang / sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong ba'i phyir mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde bsreste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mchog tu dga' ba'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bas mchog tu dga' ba dang / chos thos pas mchog tu dga' ba dang / sbyin pa la 'gyodakyipa medasapas mchog tu dga' ba dang / sems can thams cad la bde ba skyed pas mchog tu dga' ba ste/ bzhi po de dag go//lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa'ashernams kyi bden pa'o⑧/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ byang chub kyi sems mi gtong ba dang / yi dam las mi nyams pa dang / skyabs su song ba dag yongs su mi gtong7ba dang / ngag bsdams pas tshig thams cad bden pa ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i chos so/ /bzhi gang zhe na/dge ba'i chos thams cad la lhag pa'i bsam pas sbyor ba dang / ma bslabs pa thams cad la mi brnyas pa dang / gsol ba ma btab tho)par sems can thams cad la bshes gnyen du gyur pa dang / yon tan thams cad sgrub pa la 66—178

phyir bya ba'i re ba med pas lan la mi re ba ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'dishedag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa rnam par dag pa'o//bzhi gang zhe na/ bdag med pa'i phyir tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang /sems can med pa'i phyir ting nge 'dzin rnam par dag pa dang / srog med pa'i phyir shes rab rnam par dag pa dang / gang zag med pa'i phyir rnam par grol ba rnam par dag pa ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rkang pa'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ chos kyi rkang pa dang /don gyi rkang pa dang / sbyangs pa'ikhuyon tan dang / yo byad bsnyungasalgepas 'jug pa'i rkang pa dang / byang chub kyi lam gyi tshogs sogs pa'i rkang pa ste/bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lag pa'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ dad pa'i lag pa dang / tshul khrims kyi lag pa dang / thos pa'i lag pa dang / shes rab kyi lag pa ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mig go/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ las legs pa7byas pa'i phyir sha'i mig dang / mngon par shes pa las mi nyams pa'i phyir lha'i mig dang / shin tu thos pa'i stobs dang ldan pa'i phyir shes rab kyi mig dang / chos thams cad la nges par sems pa'irnyuphyir chos kyi mig ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mi ngoms pa'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ sbyin pas mi ngoms pa dang /dgon pa la gnas pas mi ngoms pa dang / chos nyan pas mi ngoms pa dang /dge ba'i chos kyi tshogs thams cad kyis mi ngoms pa ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dka' ba byed pa'o/ /66—179

bzhi gang zhe na/ sems can mthu chung ba rnams la bzod cing dang du blang ba dka' ba byed pa dang / dbul po la bdogatupa thams cad yongs su btangakhubar bsam pa dka' ba byed pa dang / yan lag gi mchog mgo slong ba la khong khro ba med pa'i sems dka' ba byed kyi steng du dge ba'i bshes gnyen du sems bskyed pa gudang / skye ba la mi rtog pas bsams byabazhin du skye bar byed pa'i dka' ba byed pa ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nad med pa'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ khams mnyamasnyipas nad med pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba med pas nad med pa dang /sems can thams cad bde bar gzhogachu)pas nad med pa dang / chos thams cad la the tsomatshamamed pas nad med pa ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bdag gi phyogs so/ /bzhi gang zhe na / pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyogs dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos kyi phyogs dang ske/ dge ba'i bshes ༄8)gnyen yang dag pa'i phyogs dang / sdig pa thams cad mi bya ba'i phyogs te/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mi bskyod ⑨pa'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ byang chub kyi sems mi bskyod pa dang / yi 13 dam mi bskyod77pa dang / ji skad smras 8pa de bzhin du byed pa las mi bskyod pa dang / yang dag pa'i nan tan las mi bskyod hu pa ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshogs so/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ zhi gnas kyi tshogs dang /lhag mthong gi tshogs dang / thos pa'i tshogs dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi tshogs te/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub 66—180

sems dpa' rnams kyi chos zung du 'brel bar 'gyur ba'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/bsam pa dang sbyor ba zung du 'brel pa dang / gtong ba dang bsngo ba zung du 'brel ba dang / byams pa dang snying rje zung du 'brel pa dang / thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel pa ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sgrib pa'i rgyu 'thunashepa'i rmi lam mo bzhi gang zhe na/ khron pa rdul can mthong zhingam de'i gting na yang7zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba dang / mtshe'u 'am/ rdzing bu'am/ khron pa rnyog pa can mthong zhing / de'i gting na yang7zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba dang / bar snang la sprin chen pos yog cing de la yang ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba dang /bar snang la rlung dang / rdul dang / du bas 'khrigs par mthong zhing / de la yang7zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi las kyi sgrib pa'i rgyu 'thunam pa'i rmi lam mo/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ g.yang sa chen po nas bdag g.yang du lhung bar mthong ba dang / lam mtho dma' 8)can du mthong ba dang / bdag lam srang dog par zhugs par mthong ba dang / rmi lam na phyogs bslad cing 'jigs pa mang po mthong ba ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i rgyu 'thun7pa'i rmi lam mo/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ dug drag pos 'khrugs par mthong ba dang / gcan gzanatshwa snagatum po phal po che'i sgra thos pa dang / bdag g.yon hu1can gyi nang na gnas par mthong ba dang / bdag gi lus dri ma can dang gos dri ma can du mthong ba ste / bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' 11—181

rnams kyi gzungs 'thob ①pa'i rgyu 'thun ②pa'i mi lam mo/ /bzhi gang zhe na/gter chen po rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang ba mthong ba dang / rdzing bu me tog pad ma rgyas pas yongs su gang ba mthong ba dang / bdag gos dkar po'i phrugs rnyed par mthong ba dang / lha zhig spyi bo'i gtsug na gdugs 'dzin par mthong ba ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i rgyu 'thun⑧pa'i rmi lam mo/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ bu mo bzang mo rgyan bzang pos brgyan pa me tog sil ma 'bul bar mthong ba dang / nam mkha' la bya ngang pa dkar po thal kurabagyi khyu skad 'byin cing 'gro bar mthong ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mang pos brgyan pa'i phyag spyi bor 'jog pa mthong ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa me tog pad ma la bzhugs shing bsam gtan mdzad par mthong ba ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba'i rgyu 'thun pa'i mi0lam mo/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'char bar mthong ba dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char bar mthong ba dang ske/ me tog pad ma7kha 'bus par mthong ba dang / tshangs pa'i dbang po rab tu zhi ba'i spyod lam mthong ba ste/ lha'i bu bzhi po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba'i rgyu 'thun⑧pa'i mi lam mo /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rang gi mtshan nyid kyi rgyu 'thun7pa'i mi lam mo/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ shing sā la chen po'i7'dab ma dang ske/ me tog dang / 'bras bu sna tshogs kyis gang bar mthong ba dang /khar ba'i snod gser gyis gang bar mthong ba dang / nam mkha'i ngos gdugs 66—182

dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan gyis gang bar mthong ba dang / 'khor los sgyuratuba'i rgyal po chen po mthong ba ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bdud 'dul ba'i rgyu 'thun⑧pa'i mi lam mo/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ gyad chen pos gyad thams cad mnan nas ba dan thogs te 'gro bar mthong ba dang / dpa' bo chen pos g.yul las 'das te 'gro bar mthong dub dang / rgyal po dbang bskur bar mthong ba dang /bdag nyid byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug cing bdud 'dul bar mthong ba ste/bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyisaphyir mi ldog pa'i rtags kyi rgyu 'thun pa'i rmi lam mo/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ mgo la thod dkar pos bcings par ⑦mthong ba dang / bdag gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin byed par mthong ba dang / bdag chos kyi stan chen po la 'dug par mthong ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs shing chos ston par mthong ba ste/ bzhi po de dag go/ /lha'i bu bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub kyi snying po 'thobasnyepa'i rgyu 'thun 1)pa'i rmi lam mo/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ bum pa mthong ba dang / bya tsa shas bskor 1 bar mthong ba dang / gang dang gang du 'gro ba de dang de nyid du shing thams cad ldang zhing 'dud la phyag 'tshal bar byed pa dang / gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i snang ba chen po mthong ba ste/ 8lha'i bu bzhi po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub kyi snying po 'thobartso pa'i rgyu 'thun skupa'i rmi lam mo/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bzhi pa sgrub 37pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa dang /lha'i bu dpal bzangs 0ldan dga' mgu yi phonyerangs te/ rab tu dga' zhing 66—183

dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas/ 'khor dang bcas pas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la mchod pa'i las bya ba'i phyir lha'i me tog man dā ①ra ba dang ske/ ud pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po dag gis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor la gtor to/ /me tog de dag gtor ma thag tu de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus steng gi bar snang la me tog pad ma shing rta'i 'phang ②lo tsam gyi tshad blta srin sdug pa bsung ④dang ldan pa yid du 'ong ba dag byung bar gyur to/ /me tog de dag gi dbus kyi snying po la byang chub sems dpa'55)lus skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu7rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa dag byung bar gyur to/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la lha'i bu dpal bzangs ldan gyis 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag gang nas lhags/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu me tog 'di dag ga las 'ongs pa nyid nas so/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ 'jam dpal me tog 'di dag ni sprul pa ste/ bdag gis khyod la mchod pa'i las bgyi ba'i slad du gtor to/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu ji ltar me tog 'di dag sprul pa yin pa ltar byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi lus la'ang de bzhin du blta'o0//de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i chos nyid de/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo dunas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs kha dog du ma 'di lta ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / le brgan dang / shel gyi kha dog lta bu dag byung ngo / /de dag gis kyang 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa snang bas khyab par byas nas/ steng du 66—184

tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du mngon par byung ste/ gzi brjid kyis nyi ma dang zla ba'i ①gzi brjid zil gyis mnan ②nas slar log ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tu nub bo/ /de nas lha'i bu dpal bzangasalaldan stan de las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pas bstod pa/ gser bzang dri ma med pa'i 'od kyis gzi brjid ldan/ /skyes chen mtshan mchog sum cu rtsa gnyis sna tshogs mnga'/ /yon tan khrag khrig yon tan gzhal yas gzi brjid can/ /mgon po ci yi slad du 'dzum pa ston pa mdzad/ /sgra snyan 'byin par mdzad cing rab tu gsung 'brel ba/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs su gsung zhing 'jam pa'i tshig gsung ba/ /nor bdun 'od zer rgya chen bde gshegs blo gros ldan / /ka la ping ku'i gsung can ci slad 'dzum pa gsungs/ /mi mchog skyes bu dam pa ngan pa'i tshogs can 'dul/ /bdud kyi stobs ni rtag par mtha'alamar 'byin par mdzad/ /lha dang lha min nam mkha' lding gis rtag mchod pa/ /stobs bcu ldan pas ci slad 'dzum pa bstan/ /dri med dri bral dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /zla ba nya ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bur zhal rgyas pa/ /mun pa rab rib sgrib pa'i rdul gyi nyes gcod pa/ /bde dang bde ldan sbyin par mdzad pa 'dzumatsodon gsungasal/ /bde bar gshegs pa sa dang lha yul phan pa mchog /bde dang bde ldan sbyin mdzad yon tan mtha' yas pa/ /mtshungs shing 'brel la legs gsungs gsal ba'i gsung ldan pa/ /'dzum bstan 'di yi 7don ni ji ltar rtogs par bgyi/ /ling tog stug ⑨ po mun pa rab rib rnam bsal 31ba/ /66—185

shes rab sgron ma 'od kyi gzi brjid ldan pa po/ /glang chen khyu mchog stobs dang seng ge'i stabasanyeltar brjid/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad 'dzum pa'i don ni bstan du gsol/ / mi yishedam pa mi ngan tshogs can 'dul mdzad pa/ /zab cing mthong bar dka'aphul gting tshod dpag dka' ba/ /srid pa'i chu ni skomasakyimadzad mnyam pa med pa can/ /sgyu med stobs bcu ldan gyis 'dzum pa ci slad bstan / /rga shi zhi bar bgyi ba'i bdud rtsi'i don stsol ba/ /zhabs ni 'jam zhing dra ba dag dang 'khor lor ldan/ /blun pa sbyong mdzad srid pa gsum na mnyam med pa/ /ye shes chen po mnga' bas 'dzum don bstan du gsol/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i bu dpal bzangs ldan la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /lha'i bu khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa' steng gi bar snang la seng ge'i khri la pad ma'i snying po la 'khod pa 'di dag mthong ngam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mthong lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i bu byangatswachub sems dpa' phyogs bcu nas 'dus pa 'di dag thams cad ni 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i drung du chos mnyan pa dang /bzhi pa sgrubashepa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan pa'i phyir lhags so/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag thams cad ni 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas yongs su smin⑧par byas pa yin no/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag thams cad ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu skye ba gcig gis thogs pa yin te/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams ming sna tshogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan dang gzhan dag tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bus gsol 66—186

pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag gi grangs rtogs par rngo mi thogasatun ji snyed cig mchis/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ②ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ shā ①ri'i bu khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag gi grangs rtogs par nus sam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na gang skar ma'i gzugs de dag thams cad ni skad cig /thang cigadu /yud tsam gcigakyigis bgrang bar spro'i/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag ni lo brgyar yang bgrang bar spro ba ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu gal te 'dzam bu'i7gling 'di rdul phra rab kyi rdul gyis gang bar gyur kyang / rdul phra rab de ⑦bgrang ba'i tshul gyis mtha' rtogs par nus kyi/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag ni bgrang ba'i tshul gyis mtha' rtogs par mi nus te/ byang chub sems dpa' 'dus pa 'di dag ni de tsam du tshad med do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag gang du byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de snyed mchis par ga la 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/shā ri'i bu kha rog 'dug de skad ma smra zhigadu /shā ri'i bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med pa dag de bzhin gshegs pas stong ngo / /shā ri'i bu yongs su brtags pa bzungashen/ gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i che'i tshad bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du gyur la/ nyi ma re re thams cad la'ang chos bshad pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'jug par gyur cing chos bshad pa thams cad la'ang byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed lung bstan par gyur la/ gang gis 66—187

shar phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das ①nas/byang chub sems dpa' gcig mtshan mar bzhag7kyang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams de bzhin gshegs pa dag gis de tsam du stong na/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sha'i spyan tha mal pas gzigs par 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag du skyes pa'i sems can de dag gi sems de bzhin gshegs pas mkhyen pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis stong pasalta ci smos / de nas nyan thos chen po de dag dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de ngo mtshar du gyur nas/ tshig 'di skad du bdag cag gi ston pa de dag de ltar rdzu 'phrul che/ de ltar mthu che ba④/ de ltar ye shes gzigs pa chen po dang ldan te/ bdag cagasregis rnyed pa legs par rnyed do/ /zhes smras so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' gang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa steng gi bar snang la 'khod pa de dag bar snang de las babs nas/ bcom ldan 'das dang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te / bskor nas phyogs bcur dong ngo / /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la lha'i bu dpal bzangs ldan gyis 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal khyod kyis mdzad pa mdzad cing sems can tshad med pa byang chub tu yongs su smin par mdzad pa legs so legs so/ /'jam dpal khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub yongs su smin par bgyid pa'i chos las brtsams te spobs par mdzod cig /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub yongs su smin par byed pa'i chos ni sum cushertsa lnga'o/ /sum cushertsa lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dus su skul brwatedang / tshod la skul 66—188

ba dang / ran par7skul ba dang / dbang po la skul ba dang / brtan⑧par skul ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa la skul ba dang / thabs la skul ba dang /lhag pa'i bsam pa la skul ba dang / byams pa chen po la skul ba dang / snying rje chen po la skul ba dang / theg pa chen po la skul ba dang / theg pa dman pa la skul ba dang / bden pa la skul ba dang / de bya ba la skul ba dang / chos srungaphubar skul ba dang / thos pa bstan par skul ba dang / sems can sna tshogs su mi dbye bar skul ba dang / tshul khrims 'chal pa dang / tshul khrims dang ldan pa la sbyin pa'i gnas su mtshungs par skul ba dang / bdud kyi las bstan par skul ba dang / dam bcas pa nyams 'og tu chud par skul ba dang /'khor bas yongs su mi skyo bar skul ba dang / bdud gdul bar skul ba dang /byas pa shes pa dang / byas pa gzotubar skul ba dang / rgyu zad pa la 'jug par skul ba dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo la mi 'jigs par skul ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang / rim gro bya bar skul ba dang / sems can thams cad la ci bya snyam pa la spro bar skul ba dang / 'jig rten gyi chos dang nim 'dres par skul ba dang / dgon pa la dga' bar skul ba dang /'dod pa chung zhing chog shes par skul ba dang / 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa ma grol ba dgrol ba dang / dbugasalgem phyin pa dbugs dbyung ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa yongs su mya ngan las bzla tu)bar skul ba dang /dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung mi 'chad par skul ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa yongs su dag par blang bar skul ba ste/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub yongs su smin (nyepar byed pa'i chos ni sum cu766—189

rtsa lnga po de dag go/ /lha'i bu de ltar byang chub sems dpa' yongs su smin par byas pa ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las bskyod du med pa yin te/ de ni phas kyi rgol ba thams cad kyis thul bar mi nus so/ /de ni phyin chad kyang byang chub sems dpa'i dregs pa bcus dregs7par mi 'gyur ro/ /bcu gang zhe na/ tshul khrims kyis dregs pa dang / thos pas dregs pa dang /spobs pas dregs pa dang / rnyed pa dang / bkur ste dang / tshigs su bcad pas dregs pa dang / dgon par gnas pas dregs pa dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang / yo byadakhubasnyungs pas dregs pa dang / gzugs dang / longs spyod dang / dbang phyug dang / g.yog 'khor7gyis dregs pa dang / brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang 'jig rten skyong ba bsnyen bkur byed pas dregs pa dang /bsam gtan dang / mngon par shes pas dregs pa dang / sangs rgyas dang /chos dang / dge 'dun la dad pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dag 'dod pa dang bstod pa dang bsngags par byed pa des kyang snyems pa med pa yin te/ lha'i bu byang chub sems dpa'i dregs pa bcu po de dag gis mi snyems rab tu mi snyems so/ /de nas7'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la lha'i bu dpal bzangs ①ldan gyis 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal khyod phyogs gang na gnas pa dang / chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gang na spyod pa der ni sangs rgyas 'byung bar blta'o/ / de na7ni chos kyi 'khor lo skorashebar blta'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de de bzhin no/ /lha'i bu de de bzhin te/ ji skad smras pa bzhin no/ /phyogs gang na 'jam dpal 66—190

gzhon nur gyur pa gnas pa de ni stong pa ma yin par mngon no/ /gang na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di spyod par 'gyur ba de ni de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi bdag po nyid brtson par mdzad do/ /gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la nyan par byed/mos par byed pa'i sems can de dag ni nga'i yin par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs ①'di nyan pa dang / mos pa'i sems can de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas 'dul bar blta'o/ /gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa dang / de bzhin nyid du nan tan byed pa de dag ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang / gnas brtan5ge'od srungashechen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ skyes bu dam pa dag ji tsam du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di blang ba dang / gzung ba dang / bshad pa dang / kun chub par byed pa'i phyir khyed la gtad do/ /nga ni ring por mi thogs par yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar ④'gyur gyisa'/ de'i phyir khyed kyis sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'dis gnas par gyis shig /byams pas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gzung ⑥lags na/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ 'di ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byams pa de'i phyir khyod kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bzhishepa sgrub pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang / byang chub sems dpa' yongs su smin par byed pa zhes bya bar zung shig⑧ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang / tshe dang 66wa 191

༄ga /chos gsum pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/①༄pha /rgya gar skad du/ tri dharmasaka nā ma sru tra/ bod skad du/chos gsum pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig⑧ku bzhugs te / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di na mi blun po la la dam pa'i chos ma yin pa gsum dang ldan na sbyin pa dag mi sbyin zhing bsod nams dag mi byed la/ tshul khrims yang dag par blangasakyinas gnas par mi byed do/ /gsum gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'dod chags dang / ser sna dang / bag med pa ste/ dge slong dag 'di na mi blun po la la dam pa'i chos ma yin pa gsum po de dag dang ldan pas sbyin pa dag ma 66—195

byin zhing bsod nams dag ma byas la/ tshul khrims yang dag par blangs te gnas par ma byas pas/ lus zhig ste shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag skyes bu dam pa dam pa'i chos gsum dang ldan pa ni sbyin pa dag sbyin zhing bsod nams dag byed la/ tshul khrims yang dag par blangs te gnas par byed do/ /gsum po gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ ma chags pa dang / ser sna med pa dang /bag yod pa'o/ /dge slong dag dam pa'i chos gsum po de dag dang ldan na skyes bu dam pa sbyin pa dag byin7zhing bsod nams dag byed la tshul khrims yang dag par blangs te gnas par byas pas lus zhig ste shi ba'i 'og tu bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal te/ bde bar gshegs pas de skad gsungs nas/ ston pas gzhan yang 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gang phyir ser sna bag med pas//sbyin pa sbyin par mi byed de/ /de phyir bsod nams 'dod pa yi/ /mkhas pas sbyin pa sbyin par bya/ /ser sna can gyis 'jigs pa ni/ /bkres dang skomakhupa 'di yin na/ /gang gis 'jigs pas 'dir ma byin/ /de nyid mi yi ②'jigs pa yin/ /gang gis ser sna'i dbang gis na/ /yod ma byin pa 'jigs pa ste/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du/ /de yis byis pa bgos par 'gyur / /gang dag ser sna spangs nas kyang / /dus su sbyin pa sbyin byed na/ /shi yang de ni shi ma yin/ /rgyags bzang po yi 'gron po bzhin/ /gang dag shin tu gtang7dka' ba/ /nyung ngu'am mang po gtong byed na/ / gtang dka'5kyegatong ba de dag ni/ /dka' ba'i las dag byed pa yin/ /dam pa 66—196

min pas mi rtogs te/ /dam pa chos las 'da' mi byed/ /de phyir dam pa dam pa min①/ /'di nas shi bar 'gyur ba na/ /dam pa min pa dmyal bar 'gro/ /dam pa dag ni mtho ris 'gro/ /rga bas gtses pa la ni skyabs med de/ /tshe thung bas ni srog khyer dus kyang nye/ /'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'di mthong rnams kyis ni/ /bsod nams bde sbyor dag ni bya ba'i rigs/ /bud med spangs 'dir sbyor bas 'tsho ba gang / /dka' bas byin pa nyung ngu byin na yang / /stong gi mchod sbyin brgya stong byed pa ni/ / de yi7bcu drug char yang mi phod do//ci phyir mchod sbyin yangs shing rgya che ba/ /mchod sbyin 'thun⑧pa de yi lam mi 'grol/ /ji ltar stong gi mchod sbyin che rnams kyang / /de yi bcu drug char mi 'gyur zhe na/ /byis pa la la gsod cing 'chingasabyed 'dir/ /gzhan nor ma byin len byed brlag par 'gyur/ /mchi ma'isnyigadong bcas chad par bcas pa yi / /yon de'i mchod sbyin 'thun7pa'i lam mi 'gro/ /de ltar mchod sbyin yangs shing rgya che ba/ /mchod sbyin 'thun⑧pa'i lam du mi 'gro la/ /de ltar stong gi mchod sbyin stong rnams kyang / /de yi bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /la la gang dag gzu lumasalgem yin pa/ /chos bzhin nor rnams thob pa gtong byed pa/ /de dag gtang dka' de rnams btang bas na/ /rang gi bsod nams kyis ni lha gnas 'gro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas / dge slong de dag yi rangs te(te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //chos gsum pa zhes bya ba'i mdo rdzogs jo9// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzirwarten mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lo6kheb ban delade ba 66—197

༄ga /'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi mdo theg pa chen po'o//①༄༄na /rgya gar skad du/ ārya dharmasnyi ka tusam hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi mdo theg pa chen po'o⑤/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe 'khor derarnyubyang chub sems dpa' chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhesashebya ba 'dug pa〈stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chos du dang ldan na myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' chos bcu dang ldan na myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'dir 66—200

༄ga /theg pa chen po'i mdo chos rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/①༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ dharma sa mu dra na ②nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/bod skad du/ theg pa chen po'i mdo chos rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pasnyedus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgya mtsho'i gling phran po takhul ku'i ri la rgyal ba'i sras mi ldog pa phal po ches bskor cing mdun du byas te bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten gyi dbang po byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la bka' stsal pa/ skyes bu dam pa chos kyi gtam ci 'dod pa dri bar gyis shig /ces pa dang / brtse ba la bsgribs pa med pas rnam par grol ba thob pa/ 'jig rten gyi dbang po byang chub sems dpas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ btsun pa ji ltar na gzhon nur gyur pas bdud las rgyal ba lags/ gang gis byang chub kyi sems bskyed ma thag pasakyi'adod pa la rtoganyecing mi sten7pa dang / mi 'chang ba dang / nga rgyal med pa 66—203

dang ske/ shes rab dang / thabs la mkhas pa dang / stong pa nyid la shin tu mos pa dang ldan te/ yod pa dang med pa spangs pa dang / yang dag pa ma yin pa la brtags ha pas grangs med par yangaphu'akhor bar 'gyur / ji ltar na dge bar gsungs pa'i chos dang 'dul ba la rab tu byung zhing yang dag par rdzogs pa'i bsnyen par rdzogs pa lags/ 'gro ba tha dad pa'i chos rnams las 'das pa dang ske/ gnas ngan len la rten cing 'jug pa'i sems dang / yid dang /yid kyi rnam par shes pa las rgya'adas te/ mi gnyis pa'i chos thos pa ni shin tu rab tu byung ba'o/ /sems can gang tha dad pa 'di༄lta bus rab tu byung ba de ni yang dag par rab tu byung ba'o/ /gang rab tu byung yang tshul khrims dang /spyod yul dang / 'tsho ba dang / lta ba dang / bsam pa nyams pa ste/ de ni mgo dang / kha spu bregs kyang don med pa ste/ rtog pa 'chang bas na rnyog pa des ngan song du gzhol ba yin no/ /ngas dad pas byin pa spyod du gnang ba ni rigs pas grol ba ste/ dge slong gang brtson pas kyemi 'dor ba des gzugs mi 'dor / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa mi 'dor/ phung po lnga tha dad pa dang / ril gyis brtags pa'i rang bzhin bas na/ mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med par lta ba de dag kyang mi dmigs gepa'i tshul gyis khams dang / skye mched kyi lha rnams ma yin par spro ba dam par byed pas rtag tu sgomatsha/nyamo/ /snying po med pa dang ske/ 'brum pa can/ zug rngu can dang ldan patunye/ skyon can/ pha rol po slu ba'i chos nyid ces sun 'byin pa de dag kyang mi dmigs 8pa'i tshul du sbyor bas / gang lus kyis lus la sred 8pa dang / lus la byams pa dang / lus la 66—204

bdag yid ches0)pa dang / lus la zhen pa de dag rab tu spong ngo / /gang 'di lta bu'i dge slong ni dge bar gsungs pa'i chos dang 'dul ba la rab tu byung bar gyur / dad pas bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i yang dag par rdzogs pa yin te/ 'di lta bu'i dge slong ni lha dang 'jig rten du bcas pa rnams kyi sbyin gnas su gyur pa'o / /de nas byams pa byang chub sems dpas 'jig rten gyi dbang po byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ci las dgongs te 'gro ba tha dad pa'i chos rnams lasa'adas shing 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnams thob rjopa de ni dge bar gsungs pa'i chos dang ⑤'dul ba la rab tu byung bar gyur / bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i yang dag par rdzogs pa zhes gsungs/ gzhan gang zhig rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs kyang bdag bslus pa ste/ pha bong7ltar byi ba yang9)ma yin/ bya yangane1)ma yin pa bzhin du de ni khyim pa yangaphrom yin / rab tu byung ba yang 7ma yin pas na glen pa'i skyes bu de de lta bu'i tshul du zung shig(rte /skyes bu dam pa 'gro ba tha dad pa'i chos de dag ni sgyu ma lta bu ste/de las 'da' bar yang mi nus/ 'gro ba tha dad pa'i chos ni yongs su ma rdzogs pas na de las 'da' bar yang dka'aphonye/ sems can gyi khams ni phyi na yang〈nyemed / nangasan yang7med de/ gnyis kur77yang dmigs7)su med pas na/gang sems can gyi khams kyi dngos po de ni 'gro ba tha dad pa'i chos kyi dngos po ste / de las 'da' bar yang dka'aphanyeb de la kye7)rgyal ba'i sras bcom ldan 'das kyisakhu 'gro ba tha dad pa'i chos las 'das shing 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos thob pa'i dge slong de ni rab tu byung bar gyur/ bsnyen par rdzogs par yang dag par rdzogs pa ste/ de ni dad pas byin pa spyod pa'i mchod gnas su 66wa 205

gyur pa'o zhes gsungs pa yang0)kye rgyal ba'i sras rten pa'i gnas med na/ de la 'thob gyipa gang ci ste 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnams 'thob par 'gyur na de ni dmigs par gyur pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid ni mi dmigs ②pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang 'di ltar dgongs genas 'gro ba tha dad pa'i chos las 'das shing 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos thob pa de ni dge slong yang dag par gyur pa steji/dad pas byin pa spyod pa'i mchod gnas so/ /de nas byams pa byang chub sems dpas 'jig rten gyi dbang po byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ci las dgongs te/ brtson pa mi 'dor ba'i dge slong gang gis gzugs mi 'dor/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa ri mi 'dor ba de ni rab tu byung ba'i dge slong ste/ de ni dge bar gsungs pa'i chos kyis 'dul ba la shin tu rab tu byung bar gyur pas na 'di lta bu'i dge slong ni dad pas byin pa spyod pa'i mchod gnas su gyur pa'o zhes gsungs / 'jig rten gyi dbang pos smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcom ldan 'das kyis chos nyid la dgongs te chos kyi dbyings nang na yang5nyemed/ phyi na yang nyu)med de/ gnyi gar yang dmigs nyu )su med pas na nad med par btags pa dang / mi skye bar btags pa dang / mi 'gag par btags tunyepa rnams gdags su med pa ste/ sems can gyi khams mnyam pa bzhin du chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa nyid/ chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa bzhin du sems can gyi khams mnyam pa nyid de(rte/ sems can gyi khams mnyam pa nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa nyid du mi gnyis tenyuge/ gnyis su med do/ /de mi gnyis te gnyis su 66—206

med pas na de la dor ba yangatumed/ mi dor ba yang7med/ gang dor ba yangashemed/ mi dor ba yangasnyimed pas na de la 'da'asnyib dang / thob par mi nus te bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang 'di ltar dgongs nas gdags su med pa'i dge slong btags pa la mi 'jug go/ /gang yi ge med pa'i dge slong yi ge las 'das pa ste/ de la grangs kyis bstan par yang mi rung ste/ de ni mi 'ong mi 'gro mi gnas mi 'dug nyal bar yang mi rtog go/ /zhi ba dang nye bar zhi ba rnams mi dmigs ①pa'i dge slong la brtags pa ste/ spyod pa rnams kyang brtags pa'o/ /log pa la rnam pa mang du rtog pa'i dge slong spyod pa ni ma brtags pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di ltar dgongs nas 'di lta bu'i dge slong ni dad pas sbyin pa spyod pa'i sbyin gnas su gyur pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis spyan ras gzigs 6)dbang po byang chub sems dpa' la dge ba byin te ngas dgongs te bshad pa bzhin du skyes bu dam pa khyod kyis bstan pa ni dge'o dge'o/ /dge bar gsungs pa'i chos kyi 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba 'di bla na med pa dam pa'i chos kyi phyag rgya ste/ 'di tshul khrims nyams pa dang / ma dul ba dang / nga rgyal mngon par byed pa rnams kyi mdun du mi bshad par gyis shig /de lta bu de dag rnams kyi snyems pa spang ba'i phyir phyag rgya 'di la gang gis yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes rab kyis bltas shing mi dmigs ⑨pa'i lus mngon du byas na/ des yid kyi lus myur du 'thob bo/ /gang gi yid kyi lus des grangs med pa'i sems can rnams byang chub tu smin par byed do/ /de nas chos kyi gzhung 'di bshad pa'i tshe dge slong bdun stong zag pa med par mi skye ba'i sems rnam par grol bar gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' stong phrag bcu mi skye ba'i 66—207

chos la bzod pa thob par gyur/ dmigs pa can gyi dge slong lnga brgya chos kyi gzhung 'di mi sgrub cing mi 'jug pa dang / ma dad pas7)na stanarka las langs te dong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das ngas dgongs te'ugasungs pa 'di dag 'jig rten thams cad yid mi ches ④pa'i gnyen po yin pas na chos kyi gzhung 'di dmigs pa dang bcas pa rnams mi 'thun ⑤pa'o/ /yod pa ma yin pa la brten pa rnams dang mi 'gal te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bzungakhub rnams dang /zab mo'i chos la mos pa rnams dang / skyo zhing chog shes pas bsnyungs gte dben pa la mngon par dga' ba rnams dang / sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa rnams kyis nga'i chos kyi gzhung 'di la ston par shes so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste/ dper na skyes bu gang zhig gnyid kyis log pa'i rmi7lam na 'gro ba mang po'i mdun na smra zhing chos 'chad kyang chos de 'jig rten thams cad las ma 3 )grags na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras ci 'gro ba mang po de rnams yod de/ gang des sangs rgyas kyi chos bshad pa dang mi 'gal ba snyam du sems sam / byams pas smras pa/ mi5nyalam ni yang dag par ma mchis pa ste/'khrul pa tsam zhing nyirtemachis par bas na de ngan 'gro phal po che la chos 'chad par gyur pa lta ga la zhig mchis/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar de bzhin du chos thams cad ni rmi nyanyelam dang mtshungs te/ yang dag pa ma yin par 'byung bar byung nas kyang med par gyur pa ste/ kun rdzob kyang 'khrul pa tsam zhig yod kyi don dam par ni ma yin no/ /'phags pa'i shes rab kyis ji lta ba mngon du byas na bsam gtan sems pa'i bsam gtan pa yang /stemi dmigs mapa ste/ de la chos kyi tshul tsam zhig yod kyi kun tu brtags pa dang / gzhan gyi dbang las kyi 66—208

rnams ni yod pa ma yin no/ /de ltar de bzhin du chos 'di ni0)'jig rten pa thams cad dang mi 'thun⑧pa'o/ /chos 'di dag la dmigs pa rnams kyis ni don dam par 'dzin gyi 'phags pa'i rnams ni mi dmigs5kyeso/ /byis pa rnams mi shes pas de la mngon par zhen pas na dmyal ba dang / yi dgasatshung)rnams kyisasdug bsngal7gyis nyon mongs pa myong bar 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi gzhung 'di ji lta ba de ni dmigs pa'o/ /ji ltar dmigs pa de ni chos thams cad do/ /de ltar dus gsum gyi chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid de/ mi dmigs pas na gang dmigs pa de ni rtogs pa'o/ /gang rtogs pa de ni thob pa/ gang thob pa de ni byang chub/ gang byang chub pa de ni de bzhin nyid/ gang de bzhin nyid pa de ni yang dag pa'i mtha'/ gang yang dag pa'i mtha' de ni stong pa nyid/ gang stong pa nyid de ni mtshan ma med pa/ gang mtshan ma med pa de ni smon pa med pa/gang smon pa med pa de ni don dam pa/ gang don dam pa de ni chos kyi dbyings/gang chos kyi dbyings de ni gnyis su med pa'i mtha'/ gang gnyis su med pa'i mtha' de ni dbu mar sgrub pa/ gang dbu mar sgrub pa de ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku rtag pa/ brtan pa/ mi 'gyur ba ste/ rtag pa yang7ma yin/ mi rtag pa yang 3 )ma yin te/ de ni gdags pa yang 3nyam yin/mi gdags pa yangarwarnyem yin/ gang gdags pa yang hunyem yin/ mi gdags pa yang 0ma yin pa 8de ni 'jig rten pa yang tsom yin/ 'jig rten las 'das pa yang tho snam yin/ gang 'jig rten pa yang 3nyem yin/ 'jig rten las 'das pa yang7ma yin pa de ni brjod du med pa/ gang brjod du med pa de ni chunga' )zad kyang med pa/ gang chung 21zad kyang med pa de ni sems can rnams kyi 66wa 209

bsod nams kyi zhing / gang sems can rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing de ni ston pa/ gang ston pa de ni rnam par mi rtog pa/ gang rnam par mi rtog pa de ni dmigs ①pa med pa/ gang dmigs pa med pa de ni mi 'gyur ba grub pa/gang mi 'gyur ba grub pa de ni yid bzhin gyisanor bu rin po che ste/ 'dul ba'i sems can rnams kyi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir ji ltar mos pa thams cad byed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' mang po de dag gis tshig 'thun⑧par smras pa/ chos kyi gzhung 'di gang na spyod pa'i sa phyogs de rdo rje lta bu ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams bzhugs pas na sems can de myur du mngon par shes pa dang / dbang po rnon por 'gyur bar rig par bya'o/ /gang zhig chos kyi gzhung 'di la brjodakyidam/ 'dzin tam / klog gam/ ⑤chub par byed dam/ kha ton⑧du byed dam/ tshul bzhin du yid la byed na de bdud kyi dbang du mi 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa 'di bshad nas 'jig rten gyi dbang po dang / byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / nyan thos chen po rnams dang /lha dang mir bcas pa dang / lha ma yin dang / dri za'i 'jig rten rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa la mngon par dga'o/ /theg pa chen po'i mdo chos rgya mtsho zhes bya ba rdzogs soge // // rgya las 'gyur ba skad gsar chad kyis gtan la phab pa'o ⑨66—210
