༄tshon /chos kyi rgya stob/ sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyis byang chub sems dpa'i sems kyi gnas bshad pa le'u bcu ste/ bam po dang po/sangs rgyas kyi bu thams cad thal mo sbyor la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul khrims chen po bshad pa sems thag pa nas nyon cig /mang po tshogs pa yid bsdus te nyon cig /bdag la kun tu lhung ba yod par shes na mthol tshangs byos shig /mthol tshangs byas na bde bar 'gyur ro/ /mthol tshangs ma byas na sdig phyir zhing zab gtu skye'o/ /kun tu lhung ba med na ma smra bar 'khod cig dang dngha/kun kyang gtsang mar mngon no/ /legs pa chen po yod pa'i rnams dang /dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma la sogs pa brtag dusapar nyon cig /sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyir na mchod rten las chos byed pa'i tshe so sor thar pa la btsud7cing lci ba dang / gus shing rin cher byos shig /so sor thar pa 66—213

zhes bya ba'i tshul khrims ni 'di yin no/ /tshul khrims 'di bzung na mun pa las snang bar phrad pa dang mtshungs so/ /mi dbul po las nor chen po thob pa dang mtshungs so/ /nad pa sman rnyed pa dang mtshungs so/ /btson khri mun nas phyung ba dang mtshungs so/ /lam ring por song bshelas slar 'khor ba dang mtshungs te / 'di ni kun gyi mkhan po chen po yin par mngon pasashesangs rgyas 'jig rten na bzhugs pas dang mi mtshungs pa med do/ /'jigs pa'i sems ni skye dka' / dge ba'i sems ni g.yo dka' bas na kha na ma tho ba las brnyas7te med snyam du byas na chu'i thigs pa chung mod kyi rgyun gyis na snod chen po 'gang ngo //yud tsam gyi bar du sdig byas pas na bster med pa'i sems can dmyal bar ltung ngo ske/ /re zhigs5gemi lus stor na bskal pa khri'i bar du yangashonaslar mi lus mi thob bo / /dar ba'i tshe mi sdod do/ /dper na ni rta rgyugs pa dang 'dra/ mi'i tshe yang rtag pa med de/ dba' rigargal gyi chu 'bab pa bas kyang myur te/ de ring gson rineramod kyi/ sang gi gnya' yang dka'o/ /da dus kho na la bab kyisalgemang po'i rnams so so 3 nonas sems gcig tu 'grus shing 'bogs pa btsal ba'i rigs sol/ /bag byas la le lo bla khyad hunyedang / nyal ba dang / gnyid kyis log cing rang nyams kyi yid tu mi bya'o/ /mtshan zhing ni sems bsdus la rtag par dkon mchog gsum gzungs su bzung la phyal ba don med pa la nyon mongs ngal chad cing tshe phyi ma la yang rab tu 'gyod pa mthar ji'ang thob pa med par7mi bya'o/ /mang po'i rnams gcig nas gcig tu tshul khrims 'di bzhin legs par byos shig /de'i tshe nachasangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyis mang po'i phyir chu bo gang gā'i brgya stong gi bye ma snyed kyis brjod du med pa'i chos kyi sgo mo'i mdo phye ste/66—214

de'i nang nas sems kyisasheganas spu nyag ma'i mgo rnyed do/ /snga ma 'das pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la yang bshad do/ /da ltar gyi sangs rgyas la yang de bzhin 'chad do/ /ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la yang de bzhin duphu'achad par 'gyur ro/ /dus gsum gyi byang chub sems dpa' lobs pa dang / slob pa dang / slob par 'gyur ro/ /ngas bskal pa brgya'i bar du sems kyi gnas 'di byas pas na nga'i mkhan po rdzogs longs spyod pa'i sku zhes bya'o/ /khyed sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ngas bshad do cog gcig nas gcig tu sems can thams cad la sems kyi gnas lam phye shig /de nas pad mo'i snying po'i snod kyi khams na gnam gyi 'od lham me lhang nge ba'i seng ge'ishegadan gyi steng nas sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyis 'od btang ste/ 'og gi me tog stong gi thog gi sangs rgyas la sbran te/ nga'i sems kyi gnas kyi chos kyi sgo mo'i le'u gzungs su zung la dengasnyishig /yang gcig nas gcig tu 'bum phrag brgya'i yang phrag stong gi shākya thub pas sems can thams cad la mthar gyis nga'i yan chad kyi sems kyi gnas kyi chos kyi sgo mo'i le'u shod de/ khyod rgyal sogs pa sems gcig tu gzungs su zung la byos shig /de nas me tog stong gi thog gi sangs rgyas 'bum phrag brgya'i yang phrag stong ⑦gi shākya thub pa pad mo'i snod kyi khams na lham me lhang nge ba'i seng nige'i khri las langs 0te/ so so nas mchi phyag 'tshal te/ phyir nur nas lus kun gyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'od btang ste / kun 'od kyi nang nas grangs med pa'i sangs rgyas phyung7ste/ cigatshwanyecar grangs med pa'i me tog sngonarmānyepo/ ser po/ dmar po/ dkar pos rdzogs longs spyod pa'i sku sangs rgyas la yon du gsol nas yan chad sems kyi phyi mo'i 66—215

le'u bshad pa yang khong du chud nas so sor pad mo'i snod kyi khams kyi nang du nub ste/ rang bzhin gyisatubaskal pa stong pa nyid kyi nang du nub nas me tog 'od kyi ting nge 'dzin thog mar byung ba'i gnas su slar song ste/ 'dzam bu'i⑧gling byang chub kyi shing drung du phyin nas/ rang bzhin gyi bskal pa me tog 'od kyi ting nge 'dzin las byung ste/ gdod rdo rje'i rgyal po'i gdan dang / 'od shin tu bzang po'i khang par 'dug nas phyogs bcu'i chos rgya mtsho dang mtshungs paraphubashad do/ /de nas yang seng ge'i khri las langs te sum cubartsa gsum gnam gyi pho brang du phyin nas gral bcu'i chos bshad do/ /de nas zung ma'isnyiganam du phyin te las su bya ba bcu bshad do/ /de nas yang khri7las langs te rgyal chen ris bzhi'i gnam du phyin nas phyogs shing lta ba bcu bshad do/ /de nas yang 'dug pa'i sa nas langs te/ 'phrul dga'i gnam du phyin nas bsam gtan mi 'gyur ba bcu bshad/ de nas yang 'dug pa'i sa nas langs te gnam bden gnam du phyin nas sa bcu'i chos bshad/ de nas yang bsam gtan gcig gi nang du phyin nas rdo rje bcu bshad/ de nas yang bsam gtan gnyis kyi nang du phyin nas bzod pa bcu'i chos bshad/ de nas yang bsam gtan gsum gyi nang du phyin nas smon lam bcu bshad/ de nas yang bsam gtan bzhi pa'i nang chen po che ba dbang mchog 'du mched gnam gyi7rgyal po'i pho brang du phyin te/ nga'i thog ma'i phyi mo'i pad mo me tog sna tshogs kyi khams rdzogs longs spyod pa'i sku'i sangs rgyas kyis sems kyisnyeganas kyi chos kyi phyi mo'i le'u bshad pa bshad do/ /gzhan 'bum phrag brgya'i yang phrag stong gi shākya thub pa yang de bzhin te/ gnyis su med do/ /tha dad pa yang med do/ /bsam gtan bskal pa'i le'u'i nang 66—216

nas kyang zhib tu bshad do/ /de'i tshe shākya thub pa pad mo'i me tog snod kyi khams kyi shar phyogs nas byung nas lding ba'i khang bu'i nang du zhugs nas bdud kyis chos mnos pa bzhin du bshad zin nas/ yas babs te 'dzam bu'i0)gling gi ka pikhular skyes nas yum gyi mtshan ni lha mdzes chen mo/ yab kyi mtshan ni zas gtsang ma/ nga bdag gi ming ni sintarsham zhes bya ste/ lo bdun na rab tu byung /lo sum cu ④nas sangs rgyas su phyin nas nga'i mtshan ni shākya thub pa zhes bya ste/mi 'gyur ba'i gtsang ma'i sar rdo rje'i me tog gi khri la 'dug nas/ dbang po chen po'i gnam gyi rgyal po'i pho brang du phyinasate/ de'i nang gi 'dug pa bcu'i gnasalgemathar gyis bshad/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyis rus gtsang ma chen po'i gnam gyi rgyal po dra ba'i rgyal mtshan mthong ba'i phyir grangs med pa'i khams dper na dra ba'i bu gu dang mtshungs par bshad na/ khams gcig nas gcig so so ⑦mi 'thun ⑤te tha dad pa'i grangs med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sgo mo bshad pa'ang de dang 'dra'o/ /ngas khams 'dir lan brgyad 1)stong phyin te/khams 'dzam bu'i 7gling 'di'i phyir rdo rje'i khri steng du 'dug ste/ dbang po chen po'i gnam gyi rgyal po'i pho brang du phyin nas de'i nang gi mang po thams cad sems kyi gnas kyi mdo che'o/ /de nas gnam gyi pho brang nas mar babs te 'dzam bu'i 11gling byang chub kyi shing drung du phyin nas de'i sa'i steng gi sems can blun po ma rabs rnams kyi phyir thog ma phyi mo rdzogs longs spyod pa'i sku sangs rgyas kyis sems kyi gnas kyi nang bshad do/ /sems thog ma g.yos pa ni rtag par 'od snang ba'i tshul khrims gcig kha ton〈rtedu klog go/ /rdo rje rin po che'i tshul khrims ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thog ma'i phyi mo yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' 66—217

thams cad kyi ni thog ma'i phyi mo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid kyi sa bon no//sems can thams cad la yang sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid kyi skal ba yod do/ /thams cad kyi shes pa dang / kha dog dang / sems dang / yid dang /sems so cog thams cad kun kyang sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid kyi nang du 'dus so/ /tshul khrims kyi nang na rtag pa yun du rtag par bsod nams yod do/ /rtag pa yun du rtag par chos kyi lus yod do/ /so sor thar pa 'di rnams bcu ni sangs rgyas kyi dbyings nas byung nas chos kyi tshul khrims byas te/ dus gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyis gzungs su 'dzin to/ / ngas datumang po 'di'i phyir zad pa'i mtha' med pa'i tshul khrims kyi le'u bcu bslabs te bshad do/ /rdzogs longs spyod pa ngaphubadag ste/ /pad mo'i dbus su gdod bzhugs nas/ /mtha' bzhi'i me tog stong gi steng / /shākya thub pa stong du bzhugs/ /me tog gcig khams 'bum phrag brgya/ /khams de gcig kyang sprul pa gcig /kun kyang byang chub shing drung bzhugs/ /mnyam par sangs rgyas gnas su son/ /de yang 'bum phrag brgya pa stong / /rdzogs longs spyod pa rang bzhin lus/ /sprul pa 'bum phrag brgya stong po/ /kun kyang rdulasaphran mang por 'dren/ / cig car nga yi sniganas su 'ongasre)/ /sangs rgyas nga yi〈tshul khrims nyon/ /zil dngarapo)sgo mo de nas bye/ /'ung nas 'bum phrag brgya stong po/ /slad du gtsang ma'i gnas su phyin/ /kun kyang byang chub shing drung bzhugs/ / nga yi7mkhan po tshul khrims kha ton lhogasayi/ /tshul khrims chen po rtogs par lnga bcu brgyad/ /tshul khrims snang khyad nyi hu)zla bzhin/ /gcig tu nor bu yang nyo 'dra/ /byang chub sems dpa' rdul phran bzhin/ / 'di yi7yon gyis yang dag 'grub/ /66—218

gdod ma7rdzogs longs spyod ga⑧nyid kyis blags/ /ngas kyang de bzhin kha ton blags/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsar slob pa/ /kladakyil khyer zhing khrims bzung bzhin/ /thub bzhin gcig tu sems can ston/ / nga yi bde blagatso)rtag par nyon/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams tshul khrims snod/ /so sor thar pa shes rab bzhin/ /mang po yid kun brtags par ches/ /khyed rnams sangs rgyas phyin par 'ong / / nga yikyisangs rgyas phyin zin kyang / /rtag par 'di bzhin yid ches byed/ /tshul khrims le'u kun chog gtsang zin/ /yid sems yod pa thams cad ni/ /kun kyang sangs rgyas khrims kyis bsdu/ /sems can sangs rgyas khrims mnod pa/ /de nas sangs rgyas sa ru phyin/ /tshor chen sa dang mtshungs zin te/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bu yang dag /mang po kun gyis gus par byas/ /sems gcig brtul te nga klog nyon/ /de'i tshe na shākya thub pa'i sangs rgyas thog ma byang chub shing drung bzhugs bla na med pa'i g.yung drung rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i thog ma so sor thar pa'i 'dud pa ni pha ma dang / dge 'dun dang / dkon mchog gsum la sri zhu dang /yid dang mi 'gal bar bya'o/ /sri zhu byas te bla ma'i yid dang mi 'gal ba ni chos zab mor thob pa'i gzhung ste/ sri zhu'i ming ni tshul khrims so/ /ming gcig tu ni sdom pa dang gtong ba'o/ /de nas 'od snang ba grangs med pa 'byung ngoshe/ /de'i tshe 'bum phrag brgya stong mang po tshogs pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / gzugs yod pa'i khams kyi gnam bcwatubargyad dang / 'dod pa'i khams kyi gnam rim pa drug gi lha dang / rgyal po chen po rnams thal mo sbyar te / sems gcig tu mnyan nas sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims chen po blags77te/66—219

byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bka' stsal pa/ ngashed ltar zla ba phyed phyed cing bdag gis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul khrims kha ton du klog go/ /khyed la sogs pa thog ma sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis kyang kha ton du lhogs shig /sems g.yos te phyogs pa7bcu dang / g.yo zhing bskyed pa bcu dang / rdo rje bcu pashedang / sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang kha pa)ton du lhogs shig /lung na tshul khrims kyi 'od kha nas byung ste rgyu yod/ rkyen med pa'i 'od ma yin te/ 'od sngon po dang / dmar po dang ge/ ser po/ dkar7po/ nag po yang ma yin/ kha dogashekyang ma yin / sems kyang ma yin/ yod pa yang ma yin/ med pa yang ma yin/ rgyu rkyen gyi chos kyang ma yin te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ni gdod ma phyi mo byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ni lam gyi rtsa ba bas na mang po thams cad dang /sangs rgyas kyi bu rnams kyi rtsa ba'i phyi mo zhes bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bu rnams kyis kyangasalagazungs su gzung spuba'i rigs so/ /legs par bslabs pa'i rigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu rnams brtags (skyepar nyon cig /sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims nod na ni rgyal po dang / rgyal bu dang / blon po che phra dang /dge slong pho smos lho dang / gzugs kyi khams kyi gnam bcwa tunyebargyad dang /'dod pa'i khams gnam drug dang / gdol pa dngasnye/ nying grum dang / pho g.yem 8dang / mo g.yem 8dang / bran pho smos dang / lha ma srin sde brgyad dang ske/ phyag brnyan tshedang / byol song dang / 'phrul zhing 'gyur ba'i mi la sogs te chos kyi mkhan po'i tshig brda phrad pa'i rnams thams cad tshul khrims mnod tsodu rung ste/ kun kyang ming rab tu gtsang ma zhes bya'o/ /sangs rgyas 66—220

kyis sangs rgyas kyi bu rnams la bka' stsal pa/ so sor thar pa la phas pham pa bcu yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims mnos pa ni tshul khrims 'di kha ton du ma blags na byang chub sems dpa' yang ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi sa bon yang ma yin/ nga yang 'di bzhin du kha ton du klog go/ /lobs zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / phyis slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / da0)ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la ngas so sor thar pa'i gzungs kyi mdo tsam zhig bshad kyis dugebaslab cing gzungs su gzung ba'i rigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyis sangs rgyas kyi bu rnams la bka' stsal pa / bdag gis bsad pa dang / mi gzhan gsod du bcug pa dang / thams cad kyis gsod ①pa gsod pa la sdod pa gsod pa mthong na dga' bar sems pa/sngags dang / rngad mo byas te bsad pa/ gsad pa'i rgyu/ gsad pa'i rkyen/gsad pa'i chos byed pa/ gsodasapa'i las byed pa la sogs te/ sems yod do cog la ched kur gsad du mi rung / 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' de ni rtag par snying rje ba dang / sri zhu che zhing mi 'gal ⑧ba'i sems rtag par g.yos te bags kyis sems can thams cad kyi ra mda' dang / 'or ba bya ba'i rigs so/ /bdag gis rang nyams byasalate snying tshim par sems can bsad na/de ni byang chub sems dpa'i phas pham pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu bdag gis ma byin par blangs sam/ pha log7po ma byin par len du bcug gam/ thabs kyis ma byin par blangs sam/ ma byin par len pa'i rgyu/ ma byin par len pa'i rkyen/ ma byin par len pa'i las byed pa/ sngags sgyu ma byas te nor khyer ba chal sogs te/ lha ma srin dang / bdag po yod pa dang / yang blo'i nor 66—221

rdzas dang / nor rdzas so cog la khab dang / rtswa nyag ma gcig la ngas7ched kur ma byin par blangs sumagemi rung ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' ni sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin skyed la/ sri shezhu'i yid dang mi 'galasnyizhing / byams zhingasnyisnying rje bar byas te rtag par sems can no cog gi yon tan dang bsod nams bskyed pa'i rigs so/ /de la slar log par mi'i nor rdzas ma byin par blangs na byang chub sems dpa'i phas pham pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu bdag mi tshangs par spyod dam/ gzhan mi tshangs par spyod par bstan nam/ bud med do cog la mi tshangs par spyod par byed pa dang / gzhan la mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa'i rgyu dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa'i rkyen dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa'i chos byed pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa'i las byed pa dang /byol song dang / lha dang / lha ma srin gyi bu mo la mi tshangs par spyod pa dang /chos dang 'gal ba'i mi tshangs par spyod na byang chub sems dpa' ni sri zhu dang mi 'gal ba'i sems kyis sems can thams cad thar pa'i ra mda' bya zhing chos gtsang ma gzhan la sbyin pa'i rigs so/ /de la slar mi 'o cog la mi tshangs par spyod pa bskyed de/ byol song dang / ma dang / bu mo dang / sring mo la sogs te gnyen pa drus la mi tshangs par spyod pa byas te/ byams shing snying rje ba med na de ni byang chub sems dpa'i phas pham pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu bdag gis brdzun rdzo)byas sam/ pha rol po brdzun7zer bar bstan tamanya/ thabs kyis brdzun spubyas pa dang / brdzun7 gyi rgyu byas pa dang / brdzun 1gyi rkyen byas pa dang / brdzunatshwa gyi chos byed pa dang / brdzun gyi las byed pa dang /mthong ba la ma mthong zhes zer ba dang / ma mthong ba la mthong zhes zer ba 66—222

dang / lus dang sems kyis brdzun7byas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' ni rtag par tshig drang po skye zhing gcig tu na sems can gyi tshig drang po bskyed pa yin na/ de la slar log par sems can thams cad kyi tshig mi drangakhub dang /yon po la lta ba dang / yon po'i las byed par bskyod na de ni byang chub sems dpa'i phas pham pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu smyo ba'i khu ba bdag 'tshong gungam pha log po smyo ba'i khu ba 'tshong7bar bstan tam/ thabs kyis smyo ba'i khu ba 'tshong7)ngam / smyo ba'i khu ba 'tshongasheba'i rgyu byed dam/ smyo ba'i khu ba 'tshong gyiba'i rkyen byed dam/ smyo ba'i khu ba 'tshong ba'i chos byed dam/ smyo ba'i khu ba 'tshong ④ba'i las byed pa la sogs te/ smyo ba'i khu ba 'o cog 'tshong7du mi rung / smyo ba'i khu ba'i rkyen gyis kha na ma tho ba skye'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni sems can thams cad la snang zhing drang〈nyeba'i shes rab bskyed pa'i rigs na(rte/ slar log par sems can thams cad kyi phyin ci log gi 8sems bskyed na byang chub sems dpa'i phas pham pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu rab tu byung ba dang / ma byung ba dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' dang mi/ dge slong dang / dge slong ma'i nyes pa bdag gis 'phyas su byas sam/ gzhan 'phyas byed par bstan tam/ 'phya ba'i rgyu byas sam/ 'phya ba'i rkyen byas sam/ 'phya ba'i chos dang / 'phya ba'i las byed na byang chub sems dpa' ni mur 'dug dang / theg pa chung ngu rnam gnyis byed pa'i mi sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi nang na chos ma yin/ tshul khrims ma yin zhes zer na/ rtag par snying rje bskyed de ngan pa'i hunyernams theg pa chen po la yid dga'/ yid ches par bstan cing bslab pa'i rigs na/ de la byang chub sems dpa' slar log par sangs rgyas kyi chos la nges shes bshad na/ de 66—223

ni byang chub sems dpa'i pas pham pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu la la zhig bdag gis bdag bstod7)cing phar smod pa dang / gzhan la bdag bstod②/ phar smod par ston pa/ smod pa'i rgyu/ smod7pa'i rkyen byed pa/ smod pa'i chos dang ske/ smod pa'i las byed na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni sems can thams cad kyi skyin par slabadabab cing ngan sems pasnyeni bdag gis blangs te/ dge zhing legs pa ni gzhan la sbyin pa'i rigs na la la zhig gis bdag gi⑩legs pa ni bsnyad/ gzhan gyi legs pa ni bcabs te/ gzhan la smakhudabab par byas na de ni byang chub sems dpa'i phas pham pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu bdag ser sna che'am / gzhan ser sna che bar ston tam/ ser sna che ba'i rgyu byed dam/ ser sna che ba'i rkyen byed dam/(kye ser sna'i chos byed dam/ ser sna'i las byed na/byang chub sems dpa' ni dbul po 'ongs so cog dang / gzhan ji 'dod pa bzhin dgos so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems la ngan du sems shing sems la gshe ba dang / dong tshe gcig gam/ khab gcig tshigam/ rtswa nyag ma gcigatshwanyemi ster ram/ chos 'dod pa zhig 'ongs na tshig gcig le'u gcig /rdul tsam gyi chos kyang ma bshad la/ slar ngag ngan pas spyos te smal)phab na de ni byang chub sems dpa'i phas pham pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu bdag khro'am/ mi pha log po khro bar ston tam/ khro ba'i rgyu byed dam/ khro ba'i rkyen byed dam/ khro ba'i chos byed dam/ khro ba'i las byed na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni thams cad kyi nang na dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed cing 'thab cing rtsod pa med par byas la rtag par snying rje bskyed cing bya ba'i nyunyerigs kyi/ phyir log par sems can thams cad kyi nang na sems can ma yin pa la kha ngan pas gshe zhing lag pas 'tshog pa dang / ral 66—224

gri dang / dbyig pas gdab cing brdegs7kyang snying brtse ma bri ste/ pha log⑧po 'gyod cing tshig 'jam pos 'chags shing gnong bskurashekyang khro ba'i mdud pa ma bkrol na de ni byang chub sems dpa'i phas pham pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu la la zhig gis dkon mchog gsum la ma yin zhes zer ram/ gzhan dkon mchog gsum la ma yin zhes zer bar bstan tamanya/ ma yin zhes zer ba'i rgyu dang /rkyen byed dam/ ma yin pa'i chos byed dam/ ma yin pa'i las byed na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni mur 'dug dang ma rabs kyi ngan tshig gcig sangs rgyas kyi sgra skad ma yin zhes zer ba zhig mthong ngam thos na mdung rtse kha gsum pa sum brgyas snying la zug pa dang mtshungs na/ bdag gi kha nas ma yin zhes zer ba lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ yid ches pa'i sems sri zhu dang mi 'gal ba'i sems bskyed pa'i rigs na/ slar log par ma rabs log pa la lta zhing ma yin zhes zer ba'i grogs byed na de ni byang chub sems dpa'i pas pham pa'o/ /dge zhugs spyod pa'i rnams ni byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa 'di bslabs slopa'i rigs so/ /'di'i nang nas rdul phra mo tsam yang gzhig7tu mi rung na tshul khrims bcu tshang b.rakhubashig pa7lta smos kyang ci dgos/ la la zhig gis tshul khrims bshig pa zhig na da ltar gyi lus la byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed pa'i las ma nus te/ rgyal po'i gral yang stor/ 'khor lo bskor ba'i rgyal po'i gral yang stor/ dge slong dang / dge slong ma'i gral yang stor/ g.yos shing phyogs pa bcu dang / bskyed cing gsol ba bcu dang / chos rdo rje dang mtshungs pa bcu dang / sa bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid rtag pa'o9)/ /yon tan zab mo la sogs pa zad par stor nas ngan song gsum du lhung ⑩ste/ bskal pa 66—225

gnyis gsum7gyi bar du pha ma dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi ming mkhanakhukyang mi thos te/ de bas na gcig kyang gzhig tu mi rung ngo / /khyed la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' lobs pa dang / slobasnyepa dang / slob par 'gyur ba'i rnams tshul khrims 'di bcu bslabs la gus par byos te rtag par gzungs su gzung ba'i rigs so/ /gsal bar ni le'u brgyad khri pa'i nang nas rgya cher bshad do/ /sangs rgyas kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bka' stsal pa/pas pham pa bcu ni bshad zin to/ /ltung ba bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad ni sangs rgyas kyi bu rgyal po'i gral thob pa'i tshe dang / 'khor los bskor ba'i rgyal po'i gral thob pa'i tshe dang / blon po'i gral thob pa'i tshe dang / sngar byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims mnod pa'i rigs so/ /lung tang lha ma srin thams cad kyang rgyal po'i lus dang / blon po'i lus kyi rim gro dang skyabs byed do/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyang dgyes so/ /tshul khrims thob zin na sri zhu dang mi 'gal ba'i sems dang / sems la gus par byas pa'i semasasnyibaskyed de/ gral mthon po na 'dug pa'i mkhan po dang / slob dpon dang / theg pa chen po la tshangs par spyod du mtshungs pa dang / mtshungs par mthong ba dang / las 'thun par byed pa mthong na langs te bsu la phyag 'tshal te nad dri5nyeba'i rigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' slar dregs pa'i sems dang / le lo'i sems dang / glen pa'i sems bskyed de/ ma langs/ ma bsu/ phyag ma byas te/ ji0la'ang chos bzhin du zhe sa dang / ri mo dang / bdag gi lus dang / yul mkharashedang ske/ pho smos dudang / nor rin po che bdun la sogs te nor ro cog btsongs la dgos so cog ma sbyar te/ de ltar ma nus na ltung ba'o/ /sangs 66—226

rgyas kyi bu la la ched kur chang 'thung na chang gi nyes pa skyes te/ dge ba'i bsod nams grangs med pa stor to/ /la la zhig gis bdag gis0)lus dang lag gis chang snod blangs te mi pha rol po la byin te blud na tshe rabs lnga brgya'i bar du lag pa med par 'ong na②/ bdag 'thung ba lta smos kyang ci dgos/ 'di lta ste/mi 'o cog thams cad dang / sems can thams cad la chang 'thung bar bstan du mi rung ngo / /bdag rang 'thung ba lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ bdag ched kur 'thungs pasadang / pha rol po la bdar ba ni ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu sha ched kur zos pa dang / sha 'o cog bzar mi rung ste/ zos na snying rje zhing byams pa'i rang bzhin gyi sa bon chad pas sems can thams cad kyis mthong nas 'jigs nas spong ngo / /de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa'atso)sems can gyi sha bzar mi rung ngo / /sha zos pa ni sdig grangs med de sha zos na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu dku ba rnam lnga bzar ༄7mi rung ngo / /sgog pa dang ske/ btsong dang / rgya sgog dang / ri sgog rnams dang / shing kun dang /'di rnamasalnga kha zas so cog gi nang du bzar7mi rung ngo / /la la zhig ched kur zos na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu sems can thams cad kyis tshul khrims brgyad dang / tshul khrims lnga dang / tshul khrims bcu dang / rtsa ba rnam pa bzhi bshig pa dang / log pa bdun dang / gnod pa brgyad kyi tshul khrims bshig pa'i sdig byed pa mthong na mthol tshangs byed du gzhug pa'i rigs so/ /de las byang chub sems dpa' ma bstan te mthol tshangs byed du ma bcug na/lhan cig 'dug 'dug cing tshangs par spyod du mtshungs pa'i dge 'dun gyi hu 3rnams gcig tu tshogs te tshul khrims bshad pa'i tshe sdig dngos su byung gis51nyes 66—227

pa mthol tshangs byed du chug shig /ma bcug na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu mkhan po theg pa chen po la lhan cigaspyitu lta ba lhan cig⑧ku las byed pa/ dge 'dun gyi khang khyim dang / mkhar du 'ongs pa mthong na rgyang grags stong gi lam na tshur 'ongs na ni bsu/ 'gro ba ni bskyal cing phyag 'tshal te/ bkur ste dang ske/ ri mo dang / nyin gcig cing dus gsum du ri mo bya/ nyi ma gcig gi zan du gser srang gsum gyi kha zas dang / khri stanamadudang / chos kyi mkhan po ci 'dod do cog dgos kyang kun sbyor te byin la rtag par chos kyi mkhan po gnyer te / dus gsum du chos bshad de/ nyin gcigarnyucing dus gsum du phyag gus par 'tshal la khro ba'i sems dang / mya ngan gyi sems mi skye bar bgyis so/ /chos kyi phyir lus dang bsngos te chos gsol lo/ /de ltar ma byas na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu gang la yang rung ste/ tshul khrims dang mdo sde 'chang ba'ikhukhang khyim chen po'i nang na chos 'chad pa yod na byang chub sems dpa' gsar du slob pa tshul khrims kyi glegs bam khyer tekhyeno/ chos kyi mkhan po'i gnas su song la gsol te/ dri zhing mnod pa'i rigs so/ /la la zhig ri dang / tshal dang /shing gi drung dang / dge 'dun gyi sa dang / khyim gyi nang dang / chos 'chad do cog gi sar byin rigipar byas te/ mnyan cing 'dod do/ /de'iphuganas su song ste ma mnyan/ ma mnos na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu sems ni theg pa chen po dang 'gal zhing rtag par sangs rgyas kyi yi ge dang / tshul khrims la 'dug kyang khar smra na sangs rgyas kyis spubashad pa ma yin zhes zer na/ rtag par theg pa chung ngu rnam 3 noganyis dang / mur 'dug gi chos la lta zhing log par lta ba 'o huXcog gi tshul khrims dang / chos kyi yi ge gzungs su bzung na ltung ba'o/ /66—228

sangs rgyas kyi bu mi nad kyis btab bo cog rtag par rim gro byas te/ gsosatul sangs rgyas dang mtshungs par byas na dge ba'i bsod nams rnam pa brgyad kyi nang na nad paphul lta zhing gsos pa'i dge ba'i bsod nams ni bsod nams kyi dam pa'o/ /pha ma dang / mkhan po dang / dge 'dun dang / slob ma'am/dbang po ma tshang ba nad do cog gis btab cing nyon mongs na kun kyang gsos ②te sos par bya'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems can la lta gshe zhing ngan sems kyis dge 'dun gyi khyim dang / yul mkhar du ma phyin pa/ dbye dang /ri lung dang / mkhar0dang / tshal na nad pa 'dug pa mthong ste ra mda' dang ske/ rim gro ma byas na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi ①bu ral gri dang /mda' gzhu dang / mdung dang / sta re yel sogs te thabashemo'i spyad mtshon cha dang ske/ sems can gsod pa'i spyad dang 'dra ba rgya rgya mo la sogs pa 'chang du mi rung ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' ni pha ma gzhan gyis bsad kyang sha mi glan na/sems can thams cad gsad ⑧pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ mtshon cha ched kur 'chang ba ⑨na ltung ba'o/ /'di lta bu'i tshul khrims rnam bcu ni bslabs te/rtag par gzungs su gzung7) ba'i rigs so/ /'og ma le'u drug gi nang na rgya cher bshad do/ /sangs rgyas kyis sangs rgyas kyi bu rnams la bka' stsal pa/sangs rgyas kyi bu khe 'dod pa'i phyir sems ngan pa bsams te9/nya/ nyi 'og gi yul du pho nyar 'drul ba hunyedamag gi g.yul bshams te/ dmag bskyod nas 'thabs te sems can mang po bsad na byang chub sems dpa' dmag gi nang du song zhing phan tshun du 'drul (nyeyang mi rung na ched kur 3steyul gyi dgra byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de la ched mar7byed pa ni ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu 66—229

bla 'bangs dang / bran pho smos dang / phyugs bdag sna drug dang / gshin sgrom ro gzhug ①pa'i snod la sogs pa khe dang tshong spogs bdag gis kyang bgyi ba'i mi rigs na gzhan la byed par bstan pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de la ched kurakhubyed pa ni ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi busasangan sems bskyed de pha logashepo dag pasnyinges57pa/ chos kyi mkhan po/ dge 'dun rgyal po/ ya rabs btsun pa la ma nyes par log pa bdun dang / tshupham pa bcu dang / pha ma dang / phu bo nu bo dang / gnyen pa rnam drug gi tshul khrims bshig go zhes skur dun sri zhu dang mi 'gal zhing byams shing snying rje ba'i sems bskyed pa'i rigs kyi/ de la slar log pa'i gnod pa bskyedakyin mi bde7ba'i gnas su lhung na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu ngan sems bskyed de/ ched kur5)me chen po btang la ri dang tshal dbye dang / ri lung dbyar zla ra ba man chad/ ston zla tha chungs hu yan chad bsregs sam/ la la zhig gis me btang ste/ gzhan gyi khang khyim dang / mkhar dang / grong dang / dge 'dun gyi khyim dang / zhing dang /bskyed 32shing dang / lha ma srin dang / bla'i dkor la sogs te bdag po yod do cog gi norasardzas bsreg tu mi rung ngo / /la la zhig gis ched kur bsregs na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi slob ma bdag dang / mur 'dug dang / gnyen rnam drug la sogs te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen no cog kun kyang ci yang theg pa chen po'i yi ge dang / tshul khrims nod cing gzungs su〈she'adzin par bstan pa'i rigs so/ /gzhung dang lugs shes shing byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed pa dang / bskyed cing gsol ba'i sems bcu dang /rdo rje'i chos kyi sems g.yo bar bstan te/ gcig nas gcig tu go rims (she66—230

dang rka/ chos kyis cho ga shes par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' la byang chub sems dpas ngan sems dang / zhe snang bskyed de①/ gzhan nyan thos kyi theg pa chung ngu rnamakhuganyis kyi tshul khrims dang / yi ge dang / mur 'dug dang /log par lta ba'i bshad pa bstan pa na lhung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu legs pa'i sems kyis sngar theg pa chen po'i go cha dang / tshul khrims dang / yi ge bslabs nas rgya cher phye nas gzhung dugi ro ci bro ba shes nas byang chub sems dpa' gsar du slob pa rgyang grags brgya stong gi lam nas theg pa chen po'i yi ge dang ske/ tshul khrims 'dod cing 'ong ba mthong na chos kyi phyir dka' thub spyod pa chos bzhin bshad pa'i rigs so/ /dka' thub ces bya ba ni lus bsregs pa/lag ngar bsregs pa sor mo bsregs pa'o/ /de la lus dang / lag ngar dang /sor mo bsregs te/ sangs rgyas thams cad la yon du ma gsol na/ de'i rab tu byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' ma yin no/ /stag dang / spyang kyiphudang /seng ge ltogs pa la sogs pa dang / 'dre ltogs pa la sogs pa thams cad la lus kyi sha dang / rkang lag gtong phod par byas te/ byin la de nas gcig nas gcig tu mthar gyis yang dag pa'i chos bshad de/ sems ni phye/ yid ni gol bar bya'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' de dag gsosnyiba'i khe 'dod pa'i phyir lan blan7pa'i rigs pa ni ma blan5bgyi/ yi ge dang / tshul khrims ri mo dang ske/ 'bru phyin ci log tu bshad nas snga phyi med par dkon mchog gsum la 'phya zhing 'chad pa ni ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu bdag kha zas dang / nor rdzas dang / gso ba'i khe dang / ming snyan pa'i phyir rgyal po dang / rgyal bu dang / blon po chen po la sogs pa gnyen zhes zer te/ snyems shing nan gyisapo)66—231

nor slong la/ btsan ngag gis bsdigs te nan gyis nor dang / khe tshol lo cog gi ming ni ngan pa mang po tshol zhes bya'o/ /gzhan la yang snying rje med cing sri zhu dang mi 'gal ba'i sems yong med par bstan pa ni ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu tshul khrims kha ton du klog pa slob pa na7nyin gcigakhucing dus drug tu byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims bzung la/ de'i gzhung dang / don sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid shes par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims kyi yon tan tshig gcig le'u gcig kyang mi shes par sgyu ma'i tshig tu nus zhes7zer ba ni bdag la brnyas shing bslus/ gzhan la yang brnyas te chos so cog rnam pa gcig kyang mi shes par gzhan la mkhan po byed cing tshul khrims ston pa ni ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu ngan sems bskyed de/ tshul khrims 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i lag na pog snod khyer te/ byang chub sems dpa'i las byed pa la mthong nas phan tshun gnyis kyis bubar du bar gebacug ste/ 'phags pa'i mi la brnyas ma shin byed cing ngan mi byed pa7med do zhes skur te/ de lta bu ched kur byas na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu snying rje spyad de ci'ang mi gsad par btang ba'i las byed cing pho'o cog ni bdag gi pha yin/ mo'o cog ni bdag gi ma yin/ bdag sngan chad kyi tshe rabs la gar skyes so cog na yang de dag las ma skyes pa med pas na 'gro ba drug gi sems can bdag gi pha ma yin te/ de bsad cing zos na bdag gi pha ma bsad do/ /gcig tu na bdag gi lus rnying7pa bsad do/ /sa dang chu thams cad ni bdag gi lus snga ma yin no/ /me dang rlung ngo cog ni bdag gi gzugs kyi phyi mo yin pas rtag par gson por btang ba'i las byed/ gar skyes gar skyes kyang sems can gsodam pa mthong na thabs spyad de/ bdag gis 'or 66—232

ba dang ra mda' byas te/ nyon mongs shing phongs pa thar bar bya'o/ /rtag par byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims bshad de/ bstan bslabs nas sems can thar pa'i ra mda' bya'o/ /pha ma dang / bu phom3)dang / nu bo zhig shi na de nyin par chos kyi mkhan po gnyer te/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims bshad na de'i bsod nams kyis shi ba de sangs rgyas thams cad dang phrad de mtho ris su skye'o/ /de ltar ma byas na lhung ba'o// //chos kyi rgya mo/ bam po gnyis pa ste tha mjuge/ 'di lta ste/ tshul khrims 'di bcu bslabs na sems gus par gzungs su gzung snoba'i rigs so/ /sdig bkru ba'i le'u'i nang nas kyang tshul khrims gcig pu gcig nas rgya che zhing gsal ④bar bshad do/ /sangs rgyas kyis sangs rgyas kyi bu la bka' stsal pa/ khros pa'i lan khrosalgepas mi blan/ brdegashepa'i lan brdeg 7)pas mi bland)/ pha ma dang / phu nu bo7gnyen rnam drug bsad kyang sha blan nya )du mi rung ngo / /gzhan zhig gisarwatebadag gi rgyal po gsad72kyang sha blanatshwa du mi rung ngo / /srog gcod cingasasha blanatshwanyen sri zhu'i chos dang 'gal lo/ /bran pho smos la ngag ngan pas spyos shing brdegs la nyin gcig cing las ngan pa rnam gsum spyodatshwanyepa la yang sdig grangs med na ched kur log pa sna bdun gyi sdig byas pa lta smos kyang ci dgosatshwanyete/ rab tu byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' la snying rje med/ gnyen rnam drug la sogs pa'i sha blan 3)pa ched kur byed na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu gdod ma dang po rab tu byung ste/ ji'angaphu )mi shes par bdag dbang po rno la mdzangs du nyepar rlom zhing la la ni lo grangs rgan zhing phyug btsan snyems te/ la la rus che zhing thabs〈rtematho ba dang / mang du shes pa dang / dbang che ba dang /66wa 233

nor rin po che sna bdun mang du bdoganyepas rgyags dregs snganasachad chos shes pa'i mkhan po la yi ge dang / tshul khrims mi gsol/ mi nodakhru/ chos kyi mkhan po la la ni rung chung / la la ni nas gzhon/ la la ni thabs chung / la la ni dbul/ la la ni dbang po ma tshang yang legs pa'i chos dben pa yod de/chos kyi yi ge dang / tshul khrims so cog zad par shes na byang chub sems dpa' gsar du slob bo/ /chos kyi slob dpon ma rig pa dang / thabs la 'phral gang du bltas shing chos kyi mkhan po la yang dag pa'i bden pa gzhung ngo cog gsol zhing nod du ma 'ongs na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu sangs rgyas 'das pa'i phyi na sems dge bas sangs rgyas kyi tshul dukhrims 'dod cing nod na sangs rgyas dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs kyi spyan sngar bdag gi sems la yi dam bcas te/ zhag bdun gyi bar du sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar mthol tshangs byas la/ltas bzang po mthong ba ni tshul khrims thob bo/ /ltas bzang po ma mthong ba ni zhag bdun gnyis/ bdun gsum/ lo gcig gi bar du ltas bzang po mthong ba'i drod kyis gzung ngo / /ltas bzang po mthong nas sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs kyi spyan sngar tshul khrims mnod dodu/ /ltas bzang po ma mthong na sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs kyi spyan sngar tshul khrims mnod (gekyang ming nitshul khrims thob pa zhes mi bya'o/ /la la zhig gis sngon chad byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims mnos pa'i mdun du nod na ltas bzang po mi dgos so/ /desheci'i phyir zhe na/ chos kyi mkhan po gcig nas gcig tu bstan pas na ltas bzang po mi dgos te⑩/ chos kyi mkhan po de'i mdun du tshul khrims mnos na tshul khrims kyang thob ste/ gus pa'i sems skye'o/ /rgyang 66—234

grags stong lamashetshun chad tshul khrims sbyin nus pa'i mkhan po med la sangs rgyas dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs kyi spyan sngar tshul khrims nod na ltas bzang po mthong b.rashedagos so/ /chos kyi mkhan po la la zhig bdag theg pa chen po'i yi ge dang / tshul khrims shes pa dang / rgyal po dang / rgyal bu dang /blon po rnams byams shing mdza' ba snyems te/ byang chub sems dpa' gsaralo du slob pa chos kyi yi ge'i lugs dang / tshul khrims kyi gzhung 'drir ba)'ongs pa la brnyas pa'i sems dang / ngan sems dang / le lo'i sems kyis gcig pu gcig pu nas 'dri ba'i lan ma blan5snyen ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / tshul khrims kyi yi ge dang / theg pa chen po'i drang po'i chos/drang por mthong ba/ drang po'i ngo bo sne)nyid/ drang po'i chos kyi lus kyis 'grus tsho7par slob cing spyod sgom mi nus pa rnams ni dkon mchog bdun bdun btang ste/slar log par bltas te nitheg pa chung ngu rnam gnyis dang / mur 'dug gi chos dang ske/ ma rabs kyi gzhung la bstenaposapa dang / a bhi dharma bshad pa slob pa dang ske/ theg pa chung ngu'i yi ge dang / 'dug par slob na de ni sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid kyi sa bon chad pas lam 'gog pas bsgribs pa'i rgyu rkyen gyis byang chub sems dpa'i lam ma yin no/ /de lta na ched kur byas pa ni ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu sangs rgyas 'das pa'i phyi na chos 'chad pa bdag po byed pa dang /dge 'dun gyi khyim bdag po dang / ston cing 'phrul pa'i bdag po dang /bsam gtan du 'jug pa'i bdag po dang / 'gro zhing 'ongs pa'i bdag po dang / de lta bu byed na byams pa'i sems bskyed la mi mdza' ste/ 'thab cing rtsod pa yang dge bar bsdum pa'i rigs so/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi nor yang 66—235

dge bar bsrungs te ma 'os par mi spyad/ bdag gis bdag gi sgor bab pa dang mtshungs par bya'o/ /de la las log par mang po 'grub cing 'bad pa dang /rang nyams kyi sems kyis dkon mchog gsum gyi nor spyad na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu sngan 51chad dge 'dun gyi khyim gyi nang na 'dug la byang chub sems dpa' dang / dge slong 'dron pa bzhig phyis dge 'dun gyi khang khyim dang /mkhar dang / grong dang / rgyal po'i khyim dang / dbyar tshul du zhugs pa'i tshe dang ske/ 'khor gyi nang du 'ongs pa mthong na snga na57'dug pa'i dge 'dun5gegyis 'ong na ni bsu/ 'gro na ni bskyal te/ zas kyi bsti ④stang dang / khang khyim dang ri / nyal ba'i mal cha dang / khri dang / sna sna nas sbyar te sbyin no/ /la la zhig bdag la nor med na bdag gi lus dang / bu pho dang / bu mo dgakhubatsongs te/ ci 'dod pa kun chosasbyar te sbyin dgos so/ /sbyin bdag la la zhig 'ongs te/ dge 'dun phal dang / dge 'dun gyi 'dron7pa zhig gnyer te/yon gyi nor skal ba yod pa'i sar dge 'dun khyim bdag pos dge 'dun 'dron lku pa'i rnams rim gyis 11gnyer ba btang ste/ de las dge 'dun snga nas 'dug pas bdag 'ba' zhig gnyer bar song ste/ dge 'dun 'dron pa 1nyam btang na dge 'dun gyi khyim gyi bdag po sdig grangs med par thob ste byol song dang mtshungs so/ /dge sbyong ma yin shākya'i rigs kyi sa bon yang ma yin te/ de ltar byas pa ni lhung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu ci yang go rimasatshwa su ma bab par logs shig tu yon blangs shing bdag gir bkur du mi rung ngo / /de lta bu'i yon gyi nor rdzas ni phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun dbang ste/ de la logs shig tu mnos shing khyer na phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun gyi nor bdag gi sgor khyer na bsod nams 66—236

rnam pa brgyad dang / sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa rnams dang / mkhan po dang / dge 'dun dang / pha ma dang / nad pa'i rdzas bdag gis spyad kyis lhung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi 3)bu byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung ba dang /rab tu ma byung ba'i sbyin bdag gis dge 'dun gnyer te/ bsod nams bskyed cing smon lam gsol na dge 'dun gyi nang du song na dge skosamachi la dris te/ de ring go rims migang la bab pa gnyer na phyogs bcu'i 'phrul gyi dge 'dun 'thob 4bol/ /gud nas dgra bcom pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / dge 'dun lnga bcu gnyer ba bas go rims ltabu bab pa'i dge 'dun tha mal pa gcig snyoganyer ba bsod nams che'o/ /de las dge 'dun gzhan gnyer ba ni mur 'dug ngan pa'i chos so/ /sangs rgyas bdun la ni gud nas gnyer ba'i chos med do/ /sri zhu'i lam dang 'gal bas gud nas dge 'dun gnyer ba ni lhung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu ngan sems spyad de gso ba'i khe'i phyir pho smos kyi rtso)g.yem pa 'tshong 3)ba'i bdag dar cing zan byed pa dang / bdag rdung ba/ bdag 'du ba pho smos kyi ⑨mtshan lta/ rmi lam bzang ngan 'gro la pho zhes zer/ mo zhes zer / log pa'i chos kyi sngags sgyu ma rang bzor zer/ dgra bslab pa'i chos byed / dug go cog sbyor zhing byed la dug rtsi rnam pa brgya 1 7stong byed de sbrul dug /gser dngul ma btul ba'i dug dang / byad stems 31la sogs pa snying rje yong med pa lta bu ched kur byas na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu ngan sems bskyed de/bdag gi lus kyis dkon mchog gsum la skur 12ba byas te gzhan la gnyen sgyu ma smos te/ kha ni stong pa 'chad/ las ni yod pa'i las byed la/ tha mal pa'i bud med dang / skyes pa'i spyan byed cing mi tshangs par spyod par sbyor te/ ci 66—237

la'ang nyu1mi 'jigs shing chags pa med/ dus drug tu mchod ston byed pa'i nyi ma dang ske/ lo gcig la zla ba gsum gsum mchod ston rtag tu byed pa'i tshe sems can gsod/ rkun po dang / chom po byed cing mchod ston gyi tshul khrimasashebashig pa ni ltung ba'o/ /tshul khrims 'di bcu bslabs la rtag⑧par gzungs su gzung gi ba'i rigs so/ /khrims gzung ⑤ba'i le'u'i nang nas kyang rgya cher mngon par bshad do/ /sangs rgyas kyis bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas kyi burnyusangs rgyas 'das pa'i phyi na ngan pa'i dus la mur 'dug dang / mi ngan pa'o cog dang / rkun po chen pos sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' pha ma dang mtshungs pa'i gzugs 'tshong rtso)ba mthong ngam/ chos dang / tshul khrims kyi yi ge 'tshong sa)ba mthong ngam/ dge slong dang / dge slong ma 'tshong gungam/gcig tu sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'tshong spub dang / la la zhig snying rje'i las la mngags pa'i 'brang nas/ bran pho5)bran mor byas pa zhig byang chub sems dpas lha de lta bu mthong na byams pa'i sems bskyed de/ thabs kyis ra mda' dang / skyabs byas te gnas gnas na 'khod do cog kyang slar slob cing ston cig /sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs dang /dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / chos dang / tshul khrims kyi yi ge thams cad nor yod na nor gyis slus hu shig /de ltar ma slusalgen ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu 'chang du mi gnang cib la mtshon cha dang / mda' gzhu 'chang ba dang /tshong spogs byed pa dang / sung dang / bre che chung 'chang ba dang / rtsa lag snyems shing mi gzhan la nor len pa dang / sems can la phrag dog byed de/pha log po bcings tedrags byas pa dang / ngo so don du yod pa zhig btang byi la 66—238

dang / sel byi dang / khyi dang / phag dang / bya 'chang zhing gsor mi rung ngo / /de lta bu7ched kur gsos na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu ngan sems bskyed de/ pho smos la sogs pa 'thab52bo cog la lta ba dmag gi g.yul dang dgra chenashepo byed pa la sogs pa la bltar mi rung ngo / /yang gcig tu dung 'bud pa dang / rnga gling dang / gyim shing545dang / dzengs5)dang / gling bu dang ske/ kong hi'u dang / gtsolen pa dang / rol mo'i sgra la mnyan du mi rung ngo / /cho lo dang / mig mangs medang / par sig gi rtsed mo dang / ra 'bri lug gi dmag gi rtsed mo dang / pho long rdob pa bodang / rdo 'phen gyis rtse ba dang / bum bu la rde'u (1'phen pa dang / khras byed pa dang / me long brud parwanyebyar mi rung ngo / /rtsa tsi /3tsha'u dang / rgya cang tshadang / phor butshamakha rub dang / mi'i thod pa dang / de rnams la mo gdab tu mi rung ngo / /rkun7po'i than gyi pho nya la sogs pa gcig kyang byar mi rung ngo / /de ltar ched kur byas na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu tshul khrims thub par bzung ba'i rim gro byas na 'gro nyal 'dug langs dngasto/ sna/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu tshul khrims kha ton blags〈nyen rdo rje dang mtshungs so/ / rkyal pa 37thogs pa mtsho chen po brgal〈 3ba dang mtshungs so/ /gcig tu na dge slong rtswas (1bcings pa dang mtshungs te/theg pa chen po la dge zhing yid ches pa'i sems rtag par bskyed la bdag gis shes par bsam5nyepa nga ni da rung tsho nyesangs rgyas su ma phyin pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu (sternams ni sangs rgyas su phyin pa'i sangs rgyas so snyam du byang chub tu sems bskyed de bar mi chad par sems la bsams 2snyel de skad cig gcig theg pa chung ngu gnyis dang / mur 'dug la sems kyis bsams 39na ltung 66wa 239

ba'o / /sangs rgyas kyi bu rtag par smon lam thams cad gsol la/ pha ma dang /mkhan po dang / dge 'dun dang / dkon mchog gsum la sri zhu che zhing yid dang mi 'gal bar smon/ rtag par mkhan po mkhas pa dang / tshangs par spyod du mtshungs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad de rtag par bdag theg pa chen po'i yi ge 1)dang / khrims dang / g.yo zhing phyogs pa bcu dang / bskyed cing gso gsodza ba bcu dang / chos rdo rje dang mtshungs pa bcu dang / sa bcu la sogs pa bdag byed cing shes la chos bzhin du las byed par smon to/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu tshul khrims bzung la sran thub par bya ba ni lus dang srog kyang bor te sems la sems pa'i5gebar mi gcad5gepar sems bsam mo/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'di lta bu'i smon lam ma bskyed na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu smon lam chen po bcu smon pa'i 'og tu sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims gzungs su bzung ste/ smon lam 'di bzhin du gdab bo/ /bdag gi lus 'di me chen po'i nang du tshig kyang rung khung zab mo dang / ral gri'i ri la song yang rung ste/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi dam pa'i chos kyi yi ge dang / tshul khrims mthar mi zhig pa dang / nam du yang mi zhig pa bud med thams cad sogs risnyepa mi byed par smon to/ /gcig tu smon lam 'di ltar smon to/ /lcags bsregs pa'i rinadra ba dang / de lta bu rgya mo rim pa stong gis bskor te lus dkris kyang mthar yun du tshul khrims draladzaleba'i lus kyis dad pa'i sbyin bdag gipogos thams cad mi bgo bar smon to/ /yang gcig tu smon lam 'di ltar smon to//kha 'di'i nang du lcags kyi thu lum bsregs pa dang / me chu bzhin du bab ste 'ong ba shesal/ bskal pa brgya stong gi bar du lon kyang tshul khrims bshig pa'i 66—240

khas dad pa'i sbyin bdag gi zas thams cad mi za bar smon to/ /yang gcig tu smon lam 'di ltar smon to/ /lus 'di me chen pos bsregs pa'i lcags kyi dra ba dang ske/ lcags bsregs pa'i tsha ba'i steng du bsnyal kyang tshul khrims dral ba'i lus kyis dad pa'i ①sbyin bdag gi khri'o lacog gi steng du mi 'dug par smon to/ /yang gcig tu smon lam 'di ltar smon to/ /lus 'di bskal pa gcig gnyis kyi bar du mdung rtse kha gsum pa sum brgyas gtsags kyang rung ste/ mthar tshul khrims bshig pa'i lus kyis ga④ dad pa'i cigasbyin bdag gi rtsi sman thams cad mi za bar smon to/ /yang gcig tu smon lam 'di ltar smon to/ /lus 'dis bskal pa dustong gi bar du lcags kyi zangs po che tsha ba'i nang du bcug kyang rung ste/mthar tshul khrims dral rtso)ba'i lus kyis dad pa'i 8sbyin bdag gi khang khyim mo cog dang ske/ ldum ra dang / skyedamu shing dang / zhing gi steng du mi 'dug par smon to / /yang gcig tu smon lam 'di ltar smon to/ /lus 'di mgo nas rkang pa'i bar du lcags kyi gtun bus brdungs te rdul phra mo bzhin du song yang khrims dral ba'i lus sems yid ches pa'i sbyin bdag gis 'grus shing gus par phyag mi 'tshal bar smon to/ /yang gcig tu smon lam 'di ltar smon to/ /stong phrag brgya'i lcags bsregs pa'i ral gri dang / mdung rtses mig gnyis brus shing gtsags7 kyang tshul khrims bshig pa'i sems kyis pha logs kyi nyurtokha dog bzang po la mi lta bar smon to/ /yang gcig tu smon lam 'di ltar smon to/ /lcags kyi sgyung bu stong phrag brgyas /)bskal pa gcig gnyis kyi bar du lus kyi chu ba dang /rna ba'i rtsa bar btsugs hu kyang tha mar khrims dral ba'i sems kyis rol mo snyan pa la mi mnyanasapar smon to/ /yang gcig tu smon lam 'di ltar nyi smon to/ /66—241

bskal pa stong phrag brgya'i bar du ral gris sna bcad cing gzhogs kyang khrims dral ba'i sems kyis spos so cog la mi snom par smon to/ /yang gcig tu smon lam 'di ltar smon to/ /bskal pa brgya stong gi bar du lce ral gris bcad gtubs 3)kyang khrims dral ba'i sems kyis mi'o cog gi kha zas gtsang ma'o cog la mi bza' bar smon to/ /yang gcig tu smon lam 'di ltar smon to/ /sta re'urnon pos lus bcad gtubs kyang mthar khrims dral ba'i sems kyis reg pa'i bzang po la mi brkam ri mi chags par smon to/ /yang gcig tu smon lam 'di ltar smon to/ /sems can no cog sangs rgyas su yod par smon to/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'di lta bu'i smon lam ma bskyedasnyen ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu rtag par dus gnyis su sbyangs pa'i yon tan pa dgun dang / dbyar bsam gtan du 'jug pa dang / tshul khrims su 'jug pa so shing dang / sran phye dang /chos gos gsum dang / ril ba dang / lhung bzedamaphyedang / gding ba dang /gsil byed dang / pog 46)phor dang / chu tshags dang / lag phyis dang / gri dang ske/ gtsub 47)shing dang / gtsub stan dang / smang0tsher dang / tha gu'i khri dang / dar ma dang / khrims dang / sangs rgyas kyi bu sbyangs pa'i yon tan spyad pa'i cha rtenagrong rgyu ba'i tshe 'gro zhing 'ongs na rgyang grags brgya stong du 'gro na yo byad bcwa / ribargyad rtag par lus dang mi 'bral te/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan pa ni dpyid zla ra ba tshes bco tsho/1lnga nas dpyid zla tha chungs tshes btsotsolnga'i bar du'o / /ston zla 'bring po'i hu tshes bco 8lnga nas dgun zla ra ba nya'i bar du dus gnyis su yo byad bcwa 8brgyad lus dang mi 'bral/ dper na bya'i 'dab ma dang 'dra'o/ /de ste gso sbyin gyi 3 nyi ma la gsar du slob pa'i byang chub sems 66wa 242

dpa' rnams zla ba phyed phyed cing kha ton du phas pham pa bcu dang / ltung ba bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad kyi khrims kha ton du lhogs shig /de ste khrims klog pa'i tshe sangs rgyas thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gzugs kyi spyan sngar gzugs dang / gzugs brnyan ①gyi spyan sngar mi ②gcig gis kha ton blagasashel gcig gis mthol7tshangs bya ste/ gcig gam gnyis sam gang yang rung ste/ stong brgya de yang mi gcig gis kha ton klogasnyigo/ /kha ton klog9)pa ni sa mthon po la 'dug la nyan pa ni dma' ba la 'dug go/ /so so nas chos gos tshal bu dgu pa dang / lnga pa dang / bdun pa bgos te tshul du 'jug pa ni gcig nas gcig tu chos bzhin du'o/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan spyod pa'i tshe bgegs yod cing mi bde ba'i nang du ma 'gro cig /yul gyi bgegs dang /rgyal po mi srun pa dang / sa mtho dma'akhudang / rtsi shing zab mo dang /dbyar seng ge dang / stag dudang / spyang ki dang / chu ste rlung gi bgegs dang ske/ rkun po chom po dang / sbrul gdug pa'i lam la sogs te/ bgegs yod do cog thams cad du7sbyangs pa'i yon tan pa 'gror mi rung ngo / /de la ched kur song na ni ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu chos 'di bzhin du rim pas78'khod cig /tshul khrims sngar nos pa ni sngar (1'dug shig /tshul khrims phyis nod7pa ni phyi nas 'dug shig /rgan gzhon mi dzorte/ dge slong pho dang /dge slong mo dang / ya rabs dang / btsun pa dang / rgyal po 0rgyal bu dang /nyung rum 8dang / bran pho smos la sogs pa tshul khrims sngar nos pa ni sngar 'dug shig /phyis nos pa ni phyis go rimasasnyibazhin du 'dug shig /mur 'dug ngan pa dang / mi glen po ⑩bzhin du rgan yang rung / gzhon yang rung /66wa 243

snga med phyi med pa'i go rims 17med pa ni g.yung po bran gyi chos so/ /nga sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi nang na ni rinasnga ma ni steng du 'dug /phyi ma ni 'og tu 'dug go/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni chos bzhin du go rimasabasu ma 'khod na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu rtag par sems can no cog bstan cing bcos te/ dge 'dun gyi khang khyim byed cing ri dang / tshal dang / ra ba dang / zhing la sangs rgyas kyi rten gyi khang pa byas la dbyar dgun du tshul dang / bsam gtan du 'jug pa'i gnas dang / gtsang ma'i 'chags 'dzugs su gzhug⑧pa'i rigs so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems can no cog gi phyir theg pa chen po'i chos dang ske/ tshul khrims kyi yi ge bgrol bshad na nam na tsha byung ba dang / yul gyi bgegs dang / dgra'i bgegs 46nodang / pha ma dang / phu nu bo dang /mkhan po la sogs pa thog ma shi ba'i dus dang / bdun gsum gyi nyi ma dang /bdun bzhi'i nyi ma dang / bdun lnga'i nyi ma dang / bdun bdun gyi nyi ma la de'i phyir theg pa chen po'i yi ge dang / tshul khrims bkrolas bshad de/ mchod ston nabyas te dge ba'i bsod nams thob par gsol cig /'gro 'ongs kyang gson po'i tsamatsho bsod nams byed pa la me chen pos bsregs3 )/ chu chen pos khyer / rlung nag po chen pos gru bus pa dang / gtsang 31po dang mtsho 3)chen po'i dgra'i bgegs la sogs te/ sdig go cog bgegs dang lanatshwanyegyis na mtshams med pa bdun/ bgegs brgyad/ lag sgril/ rkang 8sgril ltung dang / lcags dang lus bcings drags mate/ g.yem zhing khro ba mang po dang / blun zhing glen pa mang po dang / na tsha'i mang po'i dgra zus na kun gyis kyang theg pa chen po'i chos kyi yi ge dang / tshul khrims kha ton blags 8te dgrol hu tshobashad do/ /byang 66wa 244

chub sems dpa' gsar du slob pa 'di bzhin ma byas na ltung ba'o/ /tshul khrims 'di dgu bslabs 0skal gus par rtag par gzungs su zung ༷geshig /snyoms pa'i chos kyi le'u las kyang ③rgya che zhing mngon par bshad do/ /sangs rgyas kyis sangs rgyas kyi bu la bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bu mi la tshul khrims shig sbyin na bye brag dbye zhing gdam ④du mi rung / rgyal po dang / rgyal bu dang /blon po chen po dang / blon po phal dang / dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang /dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / pho gnam gemo g.yem dang /gzugs kyi gnam bcwakhebargyad dang / 'dod pa'i khams kyi gnam drug dang /dbang po med pa dang / dbang po rnam ri:)gnyis yod pa dang / nyung rum dang /bran pho 2)smosashedang / lha ma srin la sogs te/ thams cad kun khrims mnod du rung ngo / /lus la chos kyi gos bgo ba rnams ni kha dog bsgyur bar ston la chos dang 'thun par gyis shig /kha dog ser po sngon po nag po dmar po/mal gos yan chad kha dog bsgyur ro/ /lus la gos bgo'o cog nyi ritshos te kha dog sgyur 31cig /yul lo cog gi nang na mi'i gos su bgo ba la/ dge slong ngo cog gi gos ni tha mal pa'i gos dang mi 'thun no/ /thog ma tshulas32khrims sbyin pa'i tshe mkhan pos dri ba khyed tshe 'di la log pa bdun gyi sdig byas sam zhes dris shig /chos kyi mkhan po byang chub sems dpa' ni log pa bdun byas pa la tshul khrims sbyin du mi rung ngo / /log pa bdun zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas kyi lus la khrag phyung ba dang / pha ma dang mkhan po dang slob dpon bsad pa dang / lus kyi tshul khrims gtsangatshwanyem bshig pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba pa'i 8'phags pa gsodashepa yin te/ 'di rnam bdun tshang bar 3)byas te bsgribs pa'i tshul la 66wa 245

tshul khrims sbyin du mi rung ngo / /gzhan ni thams cad kyang tshul khrims sbyin dunyerung ngo / /rab tu byung ba'i chos ni rgyal po la yang phyag mi 'tshal pha ma la yang phyag mi 'tshal/ gnyen pa rnam pa drug la yang zhe sa mi bya/ lha ma srin la yang phyag mi 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi mkhan po skad shes pa zhig rgyang grags stong gi lam nas 'ongs te/ khrims gsol ba zhig yod na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi mkhan pos ngan sems dang khro ba'i sems bskyed de/ sems can no cog la tshul khrims ma byin na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu la bstan bcos te yid ches pa'i sems g.yo bar bya na byang chub sems dpas gzhan tshul khrims bstan pa'i chos kyi mkhan po byas te/ tshul khrims mnod gedu 'ong ba'i mi zhig mthong na sngar mkhan po slob dpon gnyer du thong geshig /mkhan po gnyis kyis kyang khyed la bdun gyis bsgribs pa'i sdig yod dam dris shig /de la yang tshe 'di la bdun gyis bsgribs pa'i sdig yod na mkhan pos tshul khrims sbyin pa mi rigs so/ /bdun gyis bsgribs pa'i sdig med na tshul khrims sbyin du rung ngo / /la la zhig gis tshul khrims bcu bshig pa zhig yod na mthol tshangs byed du chug⑧shig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i zhal sngar nyin mtshan drug tu pham pa bcu dang ske/ ltung ba bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad kyi tshul khrims kha ton du blags ⑤la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas la sems thag pa nas phyag 'tshal ba'i tshe ltas bzang por bya dgos so/ /de la nyi ma bdun dang / bdun gnyis dang / bdun gsum dang ske/ lo gcig tshun chad ltas bzang po mthong dgos so/ /ltas bzang po zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas gshegs te spyi bo la byugs te 'od mthong ba dang / me tog mthong ba dang / ltas ci yang rung ba bzang po mthong na mod la sdig 'byin 66—246

to0)/ /de la ltas bzang po med na mthol tshangs su zin kyang mi phan te/ de'i tshe lus kyis ni tshul khrims mi thob bo/ /lo dang nyi mas bstan te spogs te byas la / ltas 'od byung ba dag mthong na tshul khrims mnod du rung ngo / /la la zhig gis lhung ba bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad bshig pa ni mthol tshangs byas pa'i mod la 'byung ste / bdun gyis bsgribs pa dang mi mtshungs so/ /de bas na ri tshul khrims ston pa'i mkhan pos chos 'di'i nang nas kyang gcig nas gcig nas khrel na mkhan po bya'o/ /theg pa chen po'i yi ge dang / tshul khrims yang ba dang / lci ba dang ske/ yin pa dang ma yin pa'i gzugs dam pa mi shes na gzhung gi mchog bden pa dang / snga ma'i rang bzhin gyi gas bon dang / da7ltar bskyed cing gso ba'i rang bzhin dang / gtan mi rlag⑧pa'i rang bzhin dang / chos kyi sa bon gyi rang bzhin dang / drang po'i rang bzhin dang / de'i nang nas rtogasapo pa dang / dpyod pa'i rang bzhin dang / phyi nang gi bsam gtan bcu'i yal ga la sogs te chos kyis las bya'o/ /cho ga dang tshul khrims dang / chos kyi yi ge 'di gcig nas gcigashekhong du ma chud deni/ byang chub sems dpa' g.yo ba'i khe dang / ming snyan pa 'dod pa'i phyir slob ma la khe brkamapo)pas ngan pa btsal te mi shes pa la sgyu mar chos dang / tshul khrims kyi yi ge kun shes so zhes zer zhing yon len pa'i bdag la yang bslus shing brnyas/ gcig tu na gzhan la yang bslus ⑩shing brnyasapha/7te/ de lta bus mi la tshul khrims byin na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu gso ba'i khe 'dod pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims ma mnos pa'i mdun du mur 'dug dang / ma rabs kyi mdun du sangs rgyas stong gi tshul khrims chen po 'di bshad du mi rung ngo / /log par lta ba'i mdun 66—247

du mi rung ngo / /rgyal po ma gtogs pa gzhan su'i mdun du yang bshad du mi rung ngo / /mi ngan pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims ma mnos pa ni ming byol song zhes bya'o/ /gar skyes gar skyes kyang dkon mchog gsum mi mthong zhing rdo shing dang mtshungs/ sems med de ming chos log pa zhes bya'o/ /log pa la lta ba'i rnams ni shing dum ri1dang mtshungs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' de lta bu ngan pa'i mdun du sangs rgyas rab na bdun gyi tshul khrims bshad de bstan na nyung ba'ol/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu sems yid ches te rab tu byung na/ sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims dam po mnos la ched kur sems bskyed de/ 'phags pa'i tshul khrims bshig na sbyin bdag go cog gi 4yon blang du mi rung ngo / /gcig tu ni rgyal po'i khab kyis ris la yang 'gror mi rung / rgyal po'i chu la yang 'thung du mi rung ste/ 'dre chen po lnga stong gis rtag par de'i mdun phyorabacadakyinas 'dre na re dgra chen po khyim dang / mkhar dang / yul gyi nang du 'ongs so zhes zer te/de rnams kyis 7khor mor mi de'i rjes phyags naso/ /'jig rten na re yang sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi nang du 'gro'o zhes zer te mig gis tsosamathong du 'ong nyi )mi dga'o/ /tshul khrims bshig pa ni byol song dang mtshungs/ shing dum 31dang mtshungs te/drang po'i tshul khrims bshig na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu sems gcig tu brtul te rtag par gzungs su bzung ste kha ton du yang klog go snye/ /pags nyunyepa bshus te ni shog shog byas/ khrag phyung bas ni snag tshar byas/ rus pa bcag ste sbyig 14gur byas la sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims kyi yi ge /debri'o/ /shing gi shun pa dang ske/ thod mar la bris te rtag par rin po che sna bdun dang / rin med pa'i spos dang / me tog la sogs pa rin po che sna tshogs kyi gzeb dang snod byas te/66wa 248

nang du chos kyi yi ge tshul khrims kyi glegs bam gzhug go/ /de la chos kyi bzhin du ri mo ma byas na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu rtag par sems rgya cher bskyed de / yul mkhar dang khang khyim momagyo)cog tu phyin te/ sems can no cog ni mthong na khyedam la sogs pa sems can no cog thams cad dkon mchog gsum la phyogs shing tshul khrims bcu nos shig ces bsgo geba'i rigs so/ /byol song gi khams shig na'ang sems la bsam khar smras te/ khyod ni byol song na byang chub sems dpa'i sems skyed9)cig ces bsam zhing bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni ri lung dbye thang ga la gnas kyang rung ste/ sems can no cog kun byang chub sems dpa'i sems skye bar byos shig /byang chub sems dpa' sems can ma bstan ma bcos na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu rtag par bstan cing bcos pa'i snying rje chen po bskyed nas ri'uchos byed ⑥pa dang / ya rabs la sogs pa sbyin bdag dang / 'du ba mang po'i nang du 'greng la gos skyar bo gyon te chos bshad du mi rung ngo / /gos skya bo gyon du pa 'du ba mang po'i nang du chos bshad na chos kyi mkhan po ni sa mthon por 'dug la/ spos dang me tog gis yon gsol te/ mtha' bzhir nyan pa'i rnams dma' ba na 'khod la gus par mnyan to / /pha ma la sri zhu mi 'gal bar bya ba dang / slob mas mkhan po la bya ba bzhin chos la yang de bzhin gus par bya'o/ /bram ze me lha can chos byed pa bzhin gus par 1)bya'o/ /de bzhin ma byas te chos 'chad pa pa nyu rmechos bzhin du ma bshad na ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu kun kyang the tsom 37med pa'i yid kyis 32khrims nos shig /rgyal po dang rgyal bu dang slob ma sde bzhi dang / bdag mtho zhing btsan snyems te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / tshul khrims bshig la nan 66—249

tur gyis chos byas te/ nga'i slob ma rnam bzhi rab tu byung zhing chos byed par mi ster te/ bgegs gcig chatu na rigusangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang / mchod rten 'dzugs shing chos dang tshul khrims yi ger 'drirasami ster te/ dkon mchog 'jig cing de lta bur ched kur chos 'jig pa ni ltung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu dge ba'i sems spyod pa la rab tu phyung shig /legs pa'i ming snyan pa 'dod pa dang ske/ gso ba'i khe'i phyir rgyal po dang / blon po'i mdun du sangs rgyas bdun gyi tshul khrims bshad der/ dge slong dang dge slong ma la byang chub sems dpa'i khrims mi rigs par byin te/ slob ma rnams bcings btagasalgen seng ge'i lus la srin bu 'dug pas seng ge bdag gis sha zos pa dang mtshungs te/phyi'i srin bus sha zos pa ma yin no/ /de lta bas na sangs rgyas kyi bu mur 'dug dang ske/ bdud kyis 7 chos bshig pa ma yin no/ /bdag gis chos bshig pa yin no / /sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims mnos na/ sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims kyi rim gro bya ba ni pha mas pha ma bu gcig pu la bsam pa dang mtshungs so/ /pha ma la sri zhu bya ba dang 'dra'o/ /mur 'dug dang / mi ngan pa la ngag ngan⑧pa tshig ngan pas sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims la skur ba zer na mdung rtse kha gsum pa'i mdung rtse sum brgyas riḍa snying la btsugs pa dang / ral gri stong dbyig pa stong khris lus brdegs pa dang mtshungs par bya ste/ bdag gi lus bskal pa brgya'i bar du sems can dmyal bar song yang sla'i/ sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims la tshig gcig lhamangan du zer ba'i skad ni mi thos par smon to/ /bdag nyid kyis7)tshul khrims bshig pa gzhan la lan lon pa dang / zhar gyis zhar gyis tshul khrims bshig par bstan pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ sri zhu dang mi 'gal ba'i sems med do//66wa 250

de lta bu byas na nyung ba'o/ /tshul khrims 'di dgu bslabs la sems gus par gzungs su zung7shig /sangs rgyas kyi bu rnams tshul khrims yangasab bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad khyed zhul sogs pas rtag par gzungs su zung ④shig /sngar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni kha ton zin to/ /da ltar gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni da ltar kha ton byas so/ /sangs rgyas dngasabyang chub sems dpa' phyis 'ong ba'i rnams ni da〈pede'i khar kha ton byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi bu nyon cig /phas pham pa bcu dang / ltung ba bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad cig 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis kha ton zin/ da ltar gyi kha ton byas phyis kyang kha ton byed de/ nga'ang de bzhin da ltar kha ton byed do/ /de lta bas na khyed la sogs pas sems can phal mang po rgyal po dang rgyal bu dang /blon po dang / dge slong dang dge slong ma dang dge bsnyen dang dge bsnyen mas byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims nos na 'grusalgepar kha ton klogs7la bkrol bshad de/ yi ger bris la sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin gyis skal ba rtag par 'dug ste/ khrims kyi glegs bam dus gsum gyi bar du tshul bzhin 'bab cing thogs pa med par byas te/ sems can thams cad bstan cing bslab pa'i rgyun mi gcod cing / sangs rgyas mthong la sangs rgyas gcig gis gcig la gtad de/tshe rabs tshe rabs su yang ngan song dang / bgegs brgyad kyi nang du yang mi ltung zhing / rtag par mi'i lam dang / gnam gyi steng du skye'o/ /ngas da77ltar shing 'di'i drung du 'dug ste/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi chos kyi khrims mdo tsam zhig phye ba khyed la sogs pa snying gcig tu brtul te/ so sor thar pa la bslabs la dga' zhing / gus par gyis shig /gzugs med pa'i gnam gyi 66—251

rgyal po'i le'u slob pa'i blon 'debs pa'i nang nas gcig pu gcig pu nas rgya che zhing mngon par bshad do/ /de'i tshe 3slob ma mkhas pa sum stong 'dug cing nyan pas sangs rgyas kyis kha ton blags napa thos nas sems thag pa nas spyi bo la khyer te/ dga' gzha' nas rtag par gzungs su bzung ri ngo / /de ltar shākya thub pa sangs rgyas kyi sa yan chad pad mo'i me tog gi snod kyi khams kyi rdzogs longs spyod pa'i sku'i sems kyi gnas chos kyi sgo mo le'u'i minang na zag pa med pa'i tshul khrims bcu bshad zin to/ /stong phrag brgya 'bum gyi thub pa yang de bzhin no/ /dbang po chen po'i gnam gyi rgyal po'i pho brang nas 'di'i gtsang ma'i shing drung na 'dug pa bcu'i gnas na chos dang tshul khrims kyi le'u yang bshad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bsgo ba bshad kyis dunanami lang ngo ske/ /mang po phal rtag 6par gzungs su zungs7)la kha ton du lhogs shig /de'i gzhung bkrol bshad pa de yin no/ /stong phrag brgya yang 'bum gyi khams pad mo'i me tog snod kyi khams rdul phra mo snyed kyi khams kyi thams cad kyi sems kyi snod tshul khrims kyi snod grangs med pa'i smon lam gyi snod yon tan dang /sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin 'dug pa'i snod de sangs rgyas thams cad grangs med/chos kyi sgo mo yang bshad zin to/ /stong phrag brgya'i khams kyi nang na sems can thams cad kyis gzungs su bzung ste dga' zhings rigs par byed do/ /sems kyi gnas rgya cher phye ba'i gzungs ni sangs rgyas kyi me tog 'od kyi rgyal ba'i le'u'i ⑨nang nas bshad do/ /sangs rgyas bdun gyis tshig gi le'u bshad pa gcig ste/sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyis bstan pa'i tshul khrims bshad pa/ bzod pa'i dam pas dka' thub zhugs/ /bzod pa'i dam pas mya ngan 'da'/ /66—252

gzhan la gnod pa de ni byang chub ma yin no/ /gnyis te spyi tor sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa/ mig can mi bde yod las 41byol te 'grogu/ /mkhas pas 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten na/ /sdig pa kun kyang rnam par spongs/ /gsum stemachomithams cad skyob sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa/ gnod la mi smra mi〈gesems te/ /so sor thar pa bzhin du sdom/ /zas kyi tshod kyang rig par bya/ /gnas kyang dben par 'jug par bya/ /rab tu sems dang ldan pa ni/ /de ni sangs rgyas bstan pa'o//bzhi ste log par dad sel sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa/ ji ltar bung ba me tog gi//kha dog bsungasal mi gnod par/ /khu ba blangs te 'phur 6)ba bzhin/ /de bzhin byang chub grong du spyod/ /gzhan gyi rnams la mi blta 7bar/ /gzhan gyis legs pa byas la'o/ /bdag rang nyid la ltos/ legs nyes ci byas pa/ lnga ste gser thub sangs 2rgyas kyis bstan pa/ bsam gtan las spuni ma byol 3 bar/ /thub pa rnams kyis tshul thub slobs/ /mi bde bar yang mi 'gyur mgon/ /mngon par zhi bas rtag tu dran pa'i yid/ /drug ste bsod skyabs sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa/ thams cad sdig pa mi bya'o/ /dge'o cog ni rdzogs par bya/ /bdag gi sems kyang shin tu gdul/ /de ni sangs rgyas bstan pa'o/ /bdun te shākya thub pa sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa/ lus kyis su ni sdom pa dge/ /ngag gi sdom pa yang ni dge/ /yid kyi sdom pa yang ni dge/ /dge'o thams cad sdom pa ni/ /byang chub kun la mgon skyabs byed/ /nyon mongs thams cad kun las skyob31/ /byang chub dag bsrung 12yid kyang sdom/ /lus kyis mi dge mi bya zhing ske/ /'di nyartegasum las las rnam par skyongs/ /'thob bo drang srong gsungs pa'i lam/ /mi yis brdegs spyos sha mi blan34/ /sdig gi mi la sems mi 'khon/ /66—253

gshe ba'i mi la'ang rtag tu gtsang / /mi yis ngan byas bdag mi byed/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rabs btsun7)byas/ /'jig rten ra mda' pha skyabs nus/ /sangs rgyas 'dis tshul khrims bshad pa/ /ngas rgya cher bshad du kun rdzogs/ /sangs rgyas kun dang slob ma rnams/ /chos kyi tshul khrims gusalgepar 'dzin/ /gcig la gcig kyang gus par byos/ /chos la drin gzo chog tshang na/ /bya ba med pa'i chos thob nus/ nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba'i mdo/①thig /rgya gar skad du/ ārya srurya dugegarbha nā ma ma hā bai zhubu rmya bsru tra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i sde nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba'i mdol/ bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ④ka gnas pa na bzhugs te/gang dag phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan grangs med dpag tu med pa dag nas der lhags pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po grangs med/dpag tu med/ brjod du med pa dag gis yiyongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas so/ /de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan dang gzhan dag nas der 'dus te lhags pa'i nyan thos chen po grangs med/ dpag tu med/brjod du med pa dag gis kyang yongs su bskor cing mdun chogegyis bltas so/ /66wa 262

de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan dang gzhan dag nas 'dir lhags pa brgya byin dang / tshangs pa'i dbang po dang / lha'i dbang po dang /klu'i dbang po dang / gnod sbyin gyi dbang po dang / dri za'i dbang po dang /lha ma yin gyi dbang po dang / nam mkha' lding gi dbang po dang / mi'am ci'i dbang po dang / lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po grangs med/ dpag tu med/brjod du med pa dag gis kyang mi mjed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad sa dang nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i lam gang bar gyur to/ /de bzhin du 'dod pa na spyod pa dang ske/ gzugs na spyod pa'i lha gzhan dang gzhan dag dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gzhan dang / gzhan grangs med dpag tu med pa dag kyang lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das la gyen du lta zhing / bcom ldan 'das ring po mi thogs par mthar phyin pa/ nam mkha' ltar snang ba/byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rab tu 'byed pa/ dbugs rngub pa dang 6)/'byung ba dran pa 'chi ba med pa'i sgo/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa lung bstan pa ston pa na cang mi smra bar 'khod de thams cad dang ldan pa'i mi mjed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad sa dang nam mkha'i lam gang bar gyur cing / da ②dung bcom ldan 'das kyi chos kyi duchar gyi gi)ston pas tshim par ma gyur nas thal mo dag rab tu sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das kho na la bltasazhing 'khod pa ni dper na nad pa dag sman pa la lta ⑥bar byed pa bzhin dang / mun pas khebs pa dag snang ba la lta bar byed pa bzhin dang / chu bos khyer ba dag chu 'gram du lta bar byed pa bzhin dang / sdug bsngal bar gyur pa dag skyabs la lta bar byed pa 66—263

bzhin te/ de 17ltar mi mjed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad sa dang nam mkha'i lam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag dang / nyan thos dag dang / dbang po brgya byin dag nas lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po dag gi bar〈dang ske/ 'dod pa na spyod pa dang / gzugs na spyod pa'i lha gzhan dang gzhan dag nas mi dang mi skum yin pa rnams gzhan dang gzhan dag gi bar bcom ldan 'das chos dang ldan pa chos kyi rgyal po la lta zhing thal mo rab tu sbyar te cang mi smra bar 'khod par gyur to/ /de'i tshe tshangs pa chen po pad ma 'bar ba'i dpal zhes bya ba sangs rgyas mang po la lhag par bya ba byas pa dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs rtsopa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog⑧pa/ chos la dmigs ci ripa'i byams pa shin tu yongs su sbyang ba tsobyas par gyur to/ /de nas tshangs pa chen po pad ma 'bar ba'i dpal stanasalas langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar 9rinas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs ( )te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar /rtab btud nyurtenas/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa brjod pa 'dis chos bshad par gsol ba btab bo/ /ring du gshegs shing myur ba'i rgyun nyagedang ldan/ /zad pa lhur mdzad mi g.yo 'od gsal ba/ /rtogs pa thams cad skyed par mdzad pa po/ /khyod gsung rab zhi rgyu skar tshul mkhyen mkhas/ /dbugs rngub pa dang 'byung ba dran pa mkhyen/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi po dag dang ldan/ /srid pa gsum po ji 7ltar dag 'gyur bar/ /sems can 'gro ba spong bar mdzad pa po/ /tshul gcig ldan pa nyid kyi mkhyen mnga' ba/ /lha mi rnam pa mang po khri dag kyang //som nyi rgal mdzad dge brnyes chu bo rgal/ /bde 'gro'i mkhyen 8pa myur dang 66wa 264

ldan pa po/ /byang chub spyod dang sangs rgyas chos mngon sum(1)/ /sems g.yo sems can kha cig 'dod klung lhung / /mun pas khebs shing mig dang mi ldan pa'i / /sdug bsngal thams cad bcom par gyur lags pa/ /ma thos dge bral slob dpon mkhas ldan pa'i/ /skye bo bral la mi dbang thugs rje skyed/ /zhumanyam pa'i chos nyan skye ba'i pha rol mchi/ /sridasapa gcod pa bshad par mdzad du gsol / /skye klung byapha rol gshegs thub thugs rjes gsungs/ /blo 'chal skye mang sred pa'i dra ba'i lam/ /de dag thams cad nyon mongs rtsa ba can/ /der ni sems can 'khyamasamage'agyur gcad du gsol/ /gang du sdug ༄67bsngal rab zhi dbang drug dang / /yid kyang zhi 'gyur srid skyon rgyal ba gsung9)/ /sred pa bral ba sred rgyu mi mnga' ba/ /sems can gdung ba dpal kun 3)bral gyur pa/ /de slad thub pa thugs brtse ba yi pergyus/ /sred pa yi ni chu klung skems 7mdzad pa / /myur du bde zhing 'chi ba ma mchis pa'i/ /chos kyang sred pa gcod pa bshad par gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshangs pa pad ma 'bar ba'i dpal la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gang dag sngon chad pha rol phyin/ /spyod pa spyad lho1cing spyod 'gyur ba/ /de dag nyan thos chos rnams la/ /nam yang dga' bar mi bya ste/ /sangs rgyas chos las nyams 'gyur ba'i/ /ltung ba gnyis pa gzhan med de/ /de ni yang dang yang du yang / /gnyi gar sems ni 'jug pa yin/ /khro dang nyan thos chos rnams dang / /rkyen gyi byang chub 'jug pa yilha / /chos gsum rnam par spangs pas na/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams rdzogs par 'gyur/ /skye gnas bzhi ldan sems can 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing 'dir lhags pa dag(snye/ /thams cad 'dod pa rten mi byed/ /thams cad mi sdug thob 66—265

pa yin/ /'di na sems can mkhas pa gang / /byang chub mchog gi phyir zhugs shing ske/ /gang blo gzungs dang bzod pa la/ /brtson zhing legs par goms byas la/ /dbang po drug gi sgo bsdams shing / / skyil mo krunganyegis dran gzhagashenas / /rang gi spyod yul sa non pa/ /phyi ma'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs/ /nor bdun rab tu rdzogs pa'ang yin/ /'dir ni mi sdug tshul bshad na/ /kun gzhi ri cigang yin sems can gyi/ /'ching ba brtan pa 'dir bcadakhu'agyur/ /ngas ni chos kyi ser sna spangs/ /sems can srung phyir ma bshad de/ / 'di la byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /phyebyang chub phyir sems 'dir ma btang / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas de dag gis/ /chos 'di yun ring gnas bya zhes/ /sa 'di yongs su spyad mdzad cing / /sa 'di byin gyis brlabasalgepa yin/ /de bzhin du ni khyod kyis kyang / /zhing 'di la ni rtse ⑦bar byos/ /de bzhin bzod pa dag gis rtses/ /bsdams ra nas yun ring gnas par byos/ /nyan thos theg pa ngas bshad de/ /sems can chags las thar bya zhing / /phung po dag dang khams rnams dang / /skye mched stong pa ngas bshad de/ /zhi gnas rnam pa bcu gsum dang / /lhag mthong nga yis bshad bya ste/ /'dod pa'i 'ching bas dam bcings pa'i/ /sems can de yis rnam dag 'gyur/ /sems can rnams la snying brtse bas/ /nyan thos rnams kyi bden pa bzhi/ /chos rnams rtag tu yun gnas dang / /zag pa med phyir ngas bshad do/ /nyan thos bden pas 'dul ba ni/ /srid pa'i mtsho las ngas bsgral lo/ /byang chub spyod pa thams cad kyang ske/ /phyi nas khyed la bstan par bya'o/ /de nas de'i tshe thams cad dang ldan pa'i mi mjed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du gtogs pa'i sems can rnams 'di snyam 66—266

du sems te/ kye ma da ltar de bzhin gshegs pa 'di ni nyan thos kyi gtam yang dag par rab tu ston par mdzad kyi/ theg pa chen po'i gtam ni 1)mi mdzad do snyam mo/ /de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma da ltar de bzhin gshegs pa 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir sa yongs su spyad pa'i phyir dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na chos kyi tshul ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir dang / da ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir megang dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyun mi 'chad par bya ba'i phyir dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / lha ma yin dang —/ nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang ske/ mi mkhuyin pa ma dad pa rnams mngon par dad par bya ba'i phyir dang /dad pa rnams phyir zhing 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir dang / sems can chos la mngon par brtson pa dag dang / chos la gnas pa dag dang / yon tan gyis phyug pa dag dang / tshul khrims kyi dri dang yang dag par ldan pa rnams bde ba la reg pa dang / rnam par thosnyi'atsham pa med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang grol gyi bde ba yongs su rdzogs separ bya ba'i phyir dang / jipo)nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di shin tu yon tan dag gis bsgo bar bya ba'i phyir dang / phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan thams cad kyang bsgo ba'i 'os su gyur pa dang ske/ bla ma la gus pa dang / phyag bya ba'i 'os su gyur par bya ba'i phyir bdag cag nang du yang dag par 'jog par bzhed pas/ ma la bdag cag gis da7de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ bdag cag thams cad kyis sa'i steng du skyil mo krungatshun gis 'khod par bya zhing / rang rang 66—267

gi rnam pa sna tshogs kyi mchog thams cad dang ldan pa'i bzod pa dang /gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / rnal 'byor dag gis gnas pa dag tu bya gor ma chag 1snyam mo/ /de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag bskal pa brgyas nges par byung ba dag dang / gang dag sa bcu dag dang / gang dag mi skye ba'i chos kyi bzod pa la gnas pa'i bar dag dang /gang dag sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa ( brgyad la gzhan la rag ma las pa'i ye shes la mkhas pa dag dang / mi 'jigs pa thob pa dag gi bar de dag thams cad sa steng 'dir skyil mo krung snogis 'khod par gyur to/ /de bzhin du rang rang gi rnam pa sna tshogs kyi mchog thams cad ④kyi bzod pa dang /gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin dag la mnyam par gzhag pa dag tu gyur to/ /yang de'i tshe bsod nams kyi stobs ji lta ba bzhin du rgyu 'thun ④pa'i rgyu'i stobs kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mnyam par gzhog pa de dag dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' ri chen po bsam gtan byed pa de dag las kha cig 7gi lus las 'od 'di lta bu byung ste/ dper na mar me'i 'od lta bu'o/ /kha cig gi ni skar mda' dang mnyam pa dag go/ /kha cig gi ni brgya byin dang mnyam pa dag go/ /kha cig gi ni mi mjed 48kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang mnyam pa nas kha cig gi ni zla ba dang mnyam pa'i bar dag go/ /kha cig gi ni nyi ma dang mnyam pa dag go/ /kha cig gi ni nyi ma gnyis dang mnyam pa dag go/ /kha cig gi ni nyi ma gsum dang mnyam pa dag go/ /kha cig gi ni nyi ma lnga dang mnyam pa dag go/ /kha cig gi ni nyi ma stong dang mnyam pa'i bar dag go/ /kha cig gi thu ni lus las ni nyi ma bye ba brgya stong dang mnyam pa'i 'od dag byung ste/ mi mjed 66—268

kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di thams cad sngon ma mthong ma thos pa'i snang ba chen po rgya che ba de lta bus 'jig rten khyab par gyur to/ /de dag gi lus lasamanyu)mchog tu sems can gzhan dag gi lus dang sems kyi bde ba la reg pa dang / dga' ba dang / rab tu tshim par byed pa/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/lta ba ngan pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ lus kyi gnas ngan len thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ bkres pa dang skom pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ khro ba thams cad dang /'jigs5)pa thams cad dang / nyon mongs pa dang / 'ching ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i 'od byung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di na byu1srid pa gsum gyi btson gera'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs 55pa thams cad kyi bar rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di na 46sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la 'bab pa dag dang / chos la 'bab pa dag dang / dge 'dun gyi yon tan la dga' ba la mkhas pa dag 'khod par gyur to/ /yang de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di phyogs bcu'i gang gā'i ri77klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong pa dang / stong pa ma yin pa dag dang / yongs su dag pa dang /yongs su dag pa ma yin pa dag na kun nas lham me/ lhan ne/ lhang nger yang dag par snang ba ni 'di lta ste/ mtshan mo mun pa byung ba na zla ba dang / nyi ma brgya stong shar nas lham me/ lhan ne/ lhang nge ba bzhin te/ de ltar de'i tshe mi mjed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang phyogs bcu'i gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong pa dang / stong pa ma yin pa dag dang / yongs su dag pa dang / yongs su ma dag pa dag na kun nas na mchog tu lham me/ lhan ne/66—269
