dang ske/ sbyin bdag yongs su mi nyams pa'i chos can rnams nad dang dgra'i kun tu 'khrug pa'i 'jigs pa dang / 'byung po thams cad dang / dgra thams cad kyi 1)kun du 'khrugs pa'i 'jigasamanyapa las bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /dug gi kun tu 'khrug pa'i 'jigs pa dang / rgyal po'i kun tu 'khrug pa'i 'jigs pa dang /4)nang gi dmag tshogs dang / pha rol gyi dmag57tshogs dang / mu ge'i kun tu 'khrug pa'i 'jigs pa las yongs su bsrung bar bgyi ste/ kun tu 'khrug pa'i 'jigs pa bcwa lnga po de dag go/ /gang dag da57ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na dam pa'i chos ltar bcos pa la gnas pa'i bar gyi5medage slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen 48)dang / dge bsnyenalo)ma dang / dad pa dang ldan pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag dang / gang dag7mi sdug pa sngon du gtong ba'i tshul de lta bus zhes bgyi ba nas 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i bar gyi nyu1tshul gyis gnas par bgyid la/ ji skad sngar bshad pa bzhin nam gyi cha stod dang nam gyi cha smad la mi nyal bar sbyor ba la rjes su brtson par gnas par bgyid pa 'khor dang bcas pa de dag thams cad dang / gang du gnas pa'i yul 'khor dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / ri 'or7dang /grong dang / rgyal po'i pho 12brang 'khor de dag dang / dgon pa'i gnas de dag rang gi ris kyi khyim khol gyi khyim gyi bar bzhin du gzung tsobar bgyi'o/ /kun tu 'khrug pa'i 'jigs pa bcwa lnga po de dag las yongs su bsrung 3nyebar bgyi'o/ /slar bzlog par bgyi'o/ /gang du de lta bu'i dge ba la brtson pa tha na gang zag gcig cig 7gnas par bgyid kyang rung / der tha na nyin 7zhag gcig cigs3)gnas par bgyid 17kyang rung ste/ yul 'khor de dag rang gi tsoris kyi khyim khol 66wa 466

gyi khyim gyi7bar bzhin du gzung bar bgyi'o/ /kun tu 'khrug pa'i 'jigs pa bcwa lngasalas yongs su bsrung5gebar bgyi'o(ge/ /yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /sbyin pa po dang / sbyin bdag ⑥rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / rje'u rigs dang ske/ dmangs rigs dang / skyes pa nyadang / bud med dang / khye'u dang /bu mo de dag kyang rang gi ris lagasam42)par gzung bar bgyi'o/ /kun tu 'khrug pa'i 'jigs pa bcwa lnga po de dag las rjes su bsrung tho bar bgyi'omi/ /yongs su bskyang77bar bgyi'o/ /gang dag de lta bu'i dge ba'i phyogs la brtson pa'i gang zag rnams la gnas khang dang / gtsug lag khang dang / kun dga' ra ba dang ske/ gnas dang / chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / mal cha dang /na ba'i gsosalgeman dang / yo byad rnams kyis bkur //ste dang / mchod pa dang ske/ rim gro bgyid pa dag kyang kun tu 'khrug pa'i 'jigs pa de lta bu de dag las bsrung mibar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /gang yang bud med sbrum palagang zag de lta bu dag la bkur sti tshabagyid pa de la dus rtag tu rnam par mi 'tshe ba'i chos can dang / nad ma mchis pa dang / mchog tu dga' ba mang b.ratshwa snabadag cag gis bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyang bar /8bgyi'o//yang gang dang gang du de lta bur tshul bzhin yid la bgyid 16pa la brtson pa'i gang zag la snying brtse bar gsol ba 'debs par bgyid ni snapa dag dang / de'i ming brjod par bgyid pa dgas dang / skud pa (2btags pa'am/ kun tu bsrung ba bgyid pa'am/zhurte mi dge ba las slar bzlog pa'amasari/ dge ba la sbyor du stsal ba 'ang du nyerung ste/ sems can de dag kyang kun tu 'khrug pa'i 'jigs shrī 9pa bcwa lnga po de dag las bdag cag gis rjes su bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su 66wa 467

bskyang bar nya)bgyi'o/ /mi dang mi ma lags pa'i sems can gang dag de lta bu'i dge ba'i 5phyogs la tshul bzhin du yid la ( ribagyid par brtson pa'i gang zag rnams kyi tshig 45mi nyan zhing / mi bgyi bar sems pa phyedag dang / gang dag de dag la gshe bar bgyid pa'am na/ phan pa ma lags pa dang / don ma lags pa dang / bar du nyams pa dang / gnod sems su bgyi ba'i slad du rtul bar bgyid pa'i sems can de dag gi thad du bdag cag gis mi dang mi57ma yin pa dag gtang na bar bgyi'o/ /de la bzod par mi bgyi'o/ /gang dag de lta bu'i dge ba'i phyogs la tshul bzhin du yid poral bgyid par brtson pa'i gang zag rnams kyi 1 tshig mi mnyan (17zhing mi bgyi bar sems pa kyi dag dang / gang dag de dag la gshe bar bgyid pa'am/ don ma lags pa dang / phan pa ma lags pa 1 dang / gnod sems dang / bar du nyams par bgyi ba'i slad du rtul bar bgyi ba'i sems can de dag ni gnod pa bcwa lnga po 'di dag dang ldan par 'gyur lags so/ /bcwa lnga gang zhe na/ myur du nad kyi sdug bsngal dang /longs spyod kyi sdug bsngal dang / nye bar spyod pa las yongs su nyams pa'i sdug bsngal dang / yan lag dang nying lag gcod cipa'i sdug bsngal dang / 'khor sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal dang / dbang phyug las rgyad pa'i sdug bsngal dang ske/ gnas kyi sdug bsngal dang / dgras rdzi ba'i sdug bsngal dang / rtag tu sems kun tu 'khrug pa'i sdug bsngal dang / yul 'khor gyi sdug bsngal dang /rgyal rigs kyi kun 7tu 'khrug pa'i sdug bsngal dang / chom rkun 8gyi kun tu 'khrug pa'i sdug bsngal dang / bud med kyi kun tu 'khrug pa'i sdug bsngal dang /myur du tshe zad pa dang / 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal lags so/ /sems can de dag 66wa 468

ni gnod pa de dag dang myur du ldan par 'gyur lags so/ /sems can gang dag de lta bu'i tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa la brtson pa ga1rnams kyi tshig mi mnyan57zhing / mi bgyid par /chosems pa 4)dang / de dag la yang gshe 45bar bgyid pa'am/ don ma lags pa dang / phan pa ma lags pa dang / gnod sems dang / bar du nyams par bgyi ba'i 6slad du brtul mubar bgyid pa'i sems can de dag skrag nas 8bdag cag la skyabs su mchis kyang rung / gsang sngags sna tshogs sgrub (pa'i yo 1 3byad kyis rim gro bgyi bar brtson par 11bgyis su lags kyang de dag gi don du bdag cag gis nya rim gro'i bsnyen bkur 1lhablang bar mi bgyi'o/ /de dag gi skyabs mi bgyi'o/ /de dag gi bgyi ba mi sgrub po/ /don bsgrub sapar mi bgyi'om/ /phung grol 7gyi lha'am/ klu nas lus srul po'i bar snang ba snying brtse nyu ba ma mchis pa/ bgyis pa mi gzo 18ba/ 'jig rten pha rol la 'jigs par mi lta ba gang dag 'byung bar 'gyur ba de dag de lta bu'i dge ba'i phyogs la tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid par brtson pa dgon pa dang /nags dang / bas mtha' dang / ri khrod dang / dur khrod dang / shing drung dang ske/ kun dga'i ra ba dang / gtsug lag khang dang / gnas khang dang /'chag sa'i gnas na gnas pa'i gang zag rnams kyi tha dad du snang ba'i sems dang ldan pa dang / rnam par tho 'tsham nyi pa'i sems dang ldan pa dang nye bar mchi bar bgyid cing / de lta bu'i gang zag rnams kyi 21lus kun tu 'khrug pa'am sems kun tu 'khrug par bgyid la/ mdangs 'phrog 22par bgyid cing tha na de lta bu'i rusagang zag rnams kyi 2 rim gro pa 25dang / sbyin bdag gang dag lags pa de dag la yang lha'am/ klu nas lus srul po'i bar snang ba/ bgyis 66wa 469

pa mi gzos3)ba/ 'jig rten pha rol la 'jigs par mi lta ba dag gis lus kun du 'khrug pa dang / sems kun tu 'khrug par bgyid cing mdangs 'phrog par bgyid la/ sngon gyi las kyi rkyen ma gtogs lags te/ gal te lha dang / klu nas lus srul po'i bar de dag bdag cag gis so sor ma bzlog⑧gam/ slar ma bzlogs rigam/ nongs pa ci mchis pa'i chad pa la ma bkod par gyur na dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bdag cag gis bslus par gyur cig /bdag cag 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe de lta bu'i nyan thos kyi spyod yul lamakha/ rang rgyal ba'i spyod yul lamachib/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul gyi yang rung ste snod tsodu ma gyur cig /byang grol gyi bde ba thob par ma gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag 'di ltar yang khyed gedus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi0)chos kyi tshul 'bar bar byed pa dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyun hu3 mi gcad5tshe par bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa legs so legs so/ /khyed kyis de ltar byos shig /de ltar byas na dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la khyed kyis mchod pa dang / rim gro byas par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dag gang la la 12brtson pa dang brtulamatsho ba de lta bus legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba rjes su srung bobar byed pa dang / de ltar zhugs shing chos kyis gnas pa'i gang zag rnams la rjes su srung bar byed pa'i rigs kyi bu de 'khor bar 'khor ba na dpal dam pa la nye bar spyod par 'gyur ro/ /de 8la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na sdug bsngal 66—470

dang mi 'thun pa bde ba 'dod pa khyed kyis de ltar byos shig /'di ltar khyed77legs par byas pa'i las kyi mtha' la zhugs pa ni khyed yang legs so legs so/ /yang de'i tshe mi ma yin pa'i 'byung po mdangs dang khrag za ba'imigang dag yin pa grangs medasnyedapag tu med pa de dag gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni mi ma lags pa/ mdangs 'tshal ba/ sha khrag 'tshal ba dgashogelags te/ bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos rnams la rnam ④par tho btsam 6 par mi bgyi'o/ /btsun 3)pa bcom ldan 'das da ltar bcom ldan 'dasatshadakyis ji skad bstan pa tso bzhin nyan thos gang dag de lta bu'i mi sdug pa'i sbyor ba rnal 'byor yid la bgyid pas gnas pa'i gang zag de lta bu dag gal te bdag cag gis rnam par tho btsams par 7gyur na bdag cag dad pa can ma lags par gyur cig /dbang po thams cad kyi spyod yul rnams su mchi /tsho1bar mi nus 3 par gyur cig /gang zag de lta bu dag ni bdag cag gis kyang bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /de dag gi rim gro pa dang sbyin bdag gang dag lags pa de dag kyang bsrung 1lhabar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyanga'abar bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos chos kyis gnas pa mi besdug pa'i sbyor ba yid la bgyid pas gnas pa dag 7yang dag par 'dzin par bgyid pa gtsug lag khang dang ske/ gnas dang / kun dga'i ra ba dang / chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / mal stan dang / bro 'tshal ba'i gsos 1 sman gyi yo byad rnams kyis yang dag par 'dzin par bgyid pa gang dag lags pa de dag bdag cag gis bsrung /tshogeb dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzangs 17dag 66wa 471

legs so legs so/ /khyed kyis de ltar byos shig /yang de'i tshe sa'i lha mo brtan tshoms 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 5nyan thos chos kyis gnas pa de lta bu'i mi sdug pa'i sbyor bas rnal 'byor la brtson par gnas par bgyid pa gang dag lags pa de dag gi ri — lus la bdag gis rgya chen po'i sa'i bcud kyi mdangs gtangalogebar bgyi ste/ des chos kyis muganas pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la mngon par brtson pa de dag shin tu gzi brjid dang ldan pa dang / kha dog dang ldan pa dang / dran pa dang ldan pa dang ske/ brtson 'grus dang ldan pa dang / shes5yirab dang ldan par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sbyin pa chen po dang ldan ma 7gang khyod nga'i sras/ thugs kyi 8rims/ zhal nas skyes 7)pa/ chos dang ldan pa/ chos kyi sprul pa dag de lta bu'i nyi thobasod snyoms kyis yang dag par tshim par byed pa legs so legs so/ /sbyin pa chen po dang yang dag par ldan pa des khyod nya theg pa chen po yongs su rdzogs par byed par 'gyur ro/ /yang de'i hurtetshe dpal lha mo chen mos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang de lta bu'i chos kyis 1geganas pa rnams kyis 34sbyin pa po dang /sbyin bdag gang dag 1gelags pa'i sbyin pa po dang / sbyin bdag 7de dag gi dga' ston dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / shing tog nya dang / nye bar spyod pa dang / longs spyod rnams ma tshang ba ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /mi sdug pa'i sbyor bas zhes bgyi ba nas 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa yid la bgyid pa'i bar gyis nyin mtshan 'da' bar bgyid pa gang dag lags pa de dag gtsug lag khang dang / gzhi 18dang / gnas dang / chos gos dang / bsod snyoms 66wa 472

dang ske/ mal stan ti dang / bro 'tshal ba'i gsos sman gyi yo byad rnams kyis 'dzin par bgyid 2)pa dang / yang dag par 'dzin par bgyid 5)pa dang /yongs su skyong bar bgyid pa de dag gi yo byad thams cad phun sum ri /tshogs pa dang ske/ nye bar spyod pa dang / longs spyod pa dang / lus dang sems kyi bde ba dang / yid bde ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba mang bar bdag gis yang dag par gzung gebar bgyi'o/ /snod du gyur pa'i sbyin ri'u)gnas rnams dang ma bral zhing lhan cig 'grogs su stsal bar bgyi'o/ /chos la mngon par dga' ba'i sems dang ldan pa dang / snying brtsematsheba'i sems dang ldan pa dang / log rinapar mi ltung ba'i sems dang ldan pa dang / byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa dang /snying rje'i sems dang ldan pa dang / mi nyams pa'i chos can du yang dag par bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sbyin pa chen po la yang dag par rtenas3)pa legs so legs so/ /khyod brtson pa'i brtul ba des theg pa chen po rnam par 'phel bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /yang de'i tshe gsang ba 3 pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das 'dus pa chen po'i le'u 'di bshad pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan pa yang dag par 'dzin pa yongs su skyong ba /1dang / yo byad dang yang dag par ldan pa'i sbyin pa po dang / sbyin bdag mang po gang dag mchis pa'i rkyen des sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir chos kyi tshul la 12yun ring du 'bar zhing mi nyams pa'i chos can du 'gyur lags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas smras pa/ kye gsang ba pa'i bdag po ci nam mkha' yongs su nyams pa mngon nam/ smras pa/ gnas la sgro btags hunyepa med pa'i phyir ro/ /smras 66—473

pa / ci chos rnams 1)kyi yang dag par 'du ba mngon nam/ smras pa/ ci yang dag pa'i mthar thug pa'i phyir mi⑧mngon no/ /smras pa ci yang dag pa'i mtha' dang nam mkha' mi 'dra bar mngon nam/ smras pa/ 'di ni byatha mi dad pa nyid de4rka/ tha mi dad pa nyid kyi phyir mi 'dra ba'o/ /smras pa ci nam mkha' dang chos rnams mi 'dra'am/ smras pa ci mi g.yo ba dang mi skye ba'i chos kyi dbyings su 'jug pas mi 'dra ba med pa nyid do/ /smras pa rigs kyi bu ci 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams kyi tha dad pa nyid mi55)mngon nam/ smras pa/ ji ltar yang dag pa'i mtha' dang de bzhin nyid tha mi dad pa nyid yin pa de bzhin du 'dus byas kyi chos rnams nam mkhar sgro btagasaho7pa nyid kyi phyir tha mi dad pa nyid do/ /smras pa ci yang dag pa'i mtha' de bzhin mdu 'dus byas kyi chos rnams yin nam/ 'on te 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams yin/ smras pa/ stong pa nyid sgro btags 8)pa nyid kyi phyir yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / de bzhin nyid du 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas dang yang dag par ldan pa ma yin no/ /yang smras pa/ ci stong pa nyid du yang dag par 'du ba yin nam/ smras pa/ ther zug tu gnas pa ma yin pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / 'jigapo)pa med pa nyid kyi phyir chos thams cad yang dag par 'du ba stong pa nyid do/ /'di la gang stong pa nyid ces bya ba'i dngos po yang mi dmigs so/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar ngo bo nyid ngo bo nyid kyis nyu 3stong pa dang 31/ mtshan hurtegyi gzhi mtshan gyi gzhis 1 stong pa dang / mtshan gyi gzhi med pa mtshan gyi gzhis stong pa yin pa de bzhin du tshul des chos bothams cad shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ltar brjod du med pa'i phyir chos thams cad stong pa skonyid kyi phyir ro/ /'di 66wa 474

ltar chos thams cad kyi de'i ngo bo nyid nyan thos rnams kyis byas pa ma yin no/ /rang rgyal ba rnams kyis ma yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis mdzad pa ma yin te/ de ltar yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / de bzhin nyid dang / 'dus byas dang /spyi 'dus ma byas kyi chos nyid thams cad nam mkha' dang yang dag par ldan pa nyid kyi phyir mi 'dra ba med pa nyid ni tha mi dad pa yin par shes par bya'o / /bstan pa 'di bshad 5pa na sngon stong pa nyid kyi tshul la yongs su sbyang ba byas pa'i sems can dpag tu med pa ni sngon gyi mi dge ba'i las kyi sgrib pa zad cing chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba thob par gyur to//sems can khrag khrig phrag dgu bcu rtsa gnyis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems skyes shing phyir mi ldog pa'i chos rnams la gnas par gyur to / /'phags pa 'dus pa chen po theg pa chen po'i mdo/ nyi du ma'i snying po'i le'u bcu gcig pa las kun tu bsrung 4ba'i le'u ste lnga pa rdzogs sog// //yang de'i tshe rgyal po gzugs can snying po dga' ba dang mchog tu dga' ba dam pa skyes te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan la mngon par brtson pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed gtams 47zhing sngon ma rtsorimathong ma thos pa'i snang ba chen pos khyab pa de lta bu 48)ni ngo mtshar lags so/ /btsun pa bde bar gshegs pa mchog tu ngo mtshar lags te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di dang mtshams gzhan gyi khor yug chen po'i ri ma 9)gtogs par g.yar sngar gzhan ci yang gda' bar mi 'gyur lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gang byang chub 66—475

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ①snang bas sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed 'di thams cad mthong lags na de bzhin gshegs pa snyoms par zhugs pa'i snang ba ji lta bur 'gyur ba lags/ ci de bzhin gshegs pa'i snang bas bdag cag gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan gyi yon tan bkod pa mthong lags sam / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po de de bzhin te/de bzhin gshegs pa rang gi spyod yul na bzhugs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams chen po'i rgyan gyis mngon par brgyan ②pa/ sngon gyi tshogs bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i rgyu 'thun pa'i byang chub sems dpar gyur pa'i rgyu 'thun pa'i rang gi gnas sangs rgyas kyi rnam par smin pas mngon par grub pa mtha' yas par bstan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa ma chags pa'i spyod yul gyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ ye shes gsal ba bskyed par 'jug pa'i blo gros dang yang dag par ldan pa/ ye shes kyi pha rol tu gshegs pa las rab tu skyes pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal par yang dag par bsgrubs7pa/ sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul tshad med pa la gnas pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo shin tu bskor ba/ chos thams cad la dbang sgyur ba brnyes ④pa'i rgyu 'thun pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa mkhyen pa dang / yongs su smin parasnyemadzad pa la mkhas pa/bag chags yang dag par bcom pasashesangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa lhun gyis grub pa yang dag par bstan pa na bzhugs so/ /rgyal po chen po des na phyogs bcu kun tu 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa dpag tu med pa khyod kyis mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa grangs med pasnyedapag tu med pa 66—476

bzhugs shing gzhes ①pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / nyan thos kyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba dang bcas pa khyod kyis mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyal po gzugs can snying po dang srog (michags bye ba mang po gzhan dag gis kyang tshig 'thun par 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag cag la sangs rgyas kyi yul nyid kyi spyod yul bsod nams chen po'i rgyan gyi rgyu 'thun pa bstan du gsol/ bdag cag la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa lhun gyis grub pa'i bar yang dag par bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul yang dag par bstan pa gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun ①shes kau ḍi n+ya la bka' stsal pa/kau ḍi n+ya nyan thos chen po rnams dang / khyim na gnas pa dang / rab tu byung ba gang dag yin pa thams cad rang gi dge ba'i phyogs kyi nang du yang dag 'jog la gnas par byos shig /nga ④yang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul gyi nang du yang dag 'jog la gnas par mdzad do/ /yang de'i tshe lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin nas mi dang / mi ma yin pa'i bar gang dag yin5gepa dang / bden pa mthong ba gang dag yin pa dang / rjes su 'thun pa'i bzod pa thob pa gang dag yin pa dang / theg pa gsum las phyir mi ldog pa gang dag yin pa dang ske/ dkon mchog gsum la mngon par dad pa gang dag yin pa de dag thams cad skyil mo krung du 'khod nas snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul gyi spyod yul la shes rab kyis nam mkha' khyab par byed pa/ mkhas pa mang po thams cad yang dag par tshim par byed pa nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te9)/66—477

de ni nyan thos dang rang rgyal ba thams cad kyi spyod yul ma yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi spyod7)yul ma yin pa dang /sems can thams cad kyis shes pa'i spyod yul ma yin te/ de sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi spyod yul gyi zhuyul mkhyen pa ni ma gtogs (kyeso/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed 'di thams cad dang / gling bzhi pa bye ba phrag brgya dang / ri'i rgyal po ri rab bye ba phrag brgya (gyedang / nyi ma dang zla ba bye ba phrag brgya snyed dang /srid pa'i rtse mo'i ༄༄lha'i gnas bye ba phrag brgya snyed yod pa de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la chud par yang dag par snang ngo / /thams cad dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la gnas par yang dag par snang ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed 'dir gtogs pa'i sems can sems can dmyal ba'am/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas pa'am/gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'am/ lha'am/ mi gang dag yin pa de dag thams cad kyi lus dang sems kyi sdug bsngal gyi nyon mongs pa yang ⑥thams cad kyi thams cad du rgyun chad do/ /de dag thams cad kyis lus dang sems kyi bde ba 'di lta bu thob par gyur te/ dper na bsam gtan gnyis pa'i zhi gnas thob pa'i dge slong snyoms par zhugs pa bzhin rnam/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis ting nge 'dzin las langs te langs pa de dag thams cad kyi rang gi lus la gesnang ba nub par gyur to/ /nyan thos thams cad dang sems can gang su dag snyoms par zhugs pa de dag thams cad ting nge 'dzin las langs te/ de dag thams cad lus dang sems kyi bde ba de lta bu dang yang dag par ldan par 66—478

gyur to①/ /de dag thams cad ngo mtshar thob cing rmad du byung dubab thob steskye/dbang po tshim nas de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i nang du gnas shing 'khod nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ④sku'i ba spu'i khung bu la bltas mite/ de dag thams cad kyis 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig nas 'od zer 'di lta bu byung ba de lta bu mthong bar gyur te/ dper na nyi ma dang zla ba gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang / nor bu rin po che chen po gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi snang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu padza4)gang gā'i klungs tshogi bye ma snyed kyi 'od zer gyi snang ba bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi ba spu'i khung bu re re nas kyang 'od de lta bu byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku las 'od zer rab tu byung ba de dag gis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad snang ba chen pos rgyas par gang bar gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong pa ma yin pa gang dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs shing gzhes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dang de dag gis thams cad dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed thams cad 'di lta bu'i dbyangs brjod pas kun tu gang bar mdzad do/ /shākya seng ge mi yiXdamachog /byams dang thugs rje'i rgyu 'thun pa/ /sems can kun la phan mdzad pa/ /bsod nams las grub pa la ltos/ /sems can kun la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul ston par mdzad/ /thugs rjes 'od zer bkye bas ni/ /zhing rnams thams cad gsal bar gyur/ /re (9)res zhing ni rgyas gyur pa/ /gnas kun gsal ba mthong nas su/ /byang chub mchog ni yongs tshol zhing / /sems kyi mchog kyang skyed par byed/ /gang dag lus can rdzu 'phrul 'thob/ /de dag thams cad myur du lhags/ /shākya seng ge mi mchog 66—479

la / /khyed kyis bskor ba byas nas kyang / /gang dag rdzu 'phrul ma thob kun/ /rgyang ma nas ni phyag 'tshol lahu)/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed ②dang / /mi yi skyes mchog rnams su 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi ge rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas dbyangs kyis go bar mdzad nas/ thugs rje'i dbang gis sems can rnams yongs su smin par mdzad pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i dgongs pa dang smon lam yongs su bskang ba'i phyir dang ske/ de'i yon tan brjod pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa re re yang byang chub sems dpa' dang / de bzhin du nyan thos chen po gang gā'i〈klung gi bye ma snyed phrag du ma dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / dri za dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed phrag du mas mdun ri du bdar ①cing yongs su bskor57te/de dag rang rang kyegi sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams nas 7rdzu 'phrul gyis yang dag par zhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed 'dir gshegs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la lan gsum bskor ba mdzad nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi 'khor gyi sems can gang dag yin pa de dag bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la skor / )ba byed cing de lta bu'i mchod pa byed par gyur to / /yang rang rang 31gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag tu yang dong ngo / /de'i dus na sems can gang dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed rtedu bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la chud pa de dag thams cad kyis phyogs bcu kun gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mthong ngo ske/ /de dag thams cad kyis de nas yang dag par zhugs pa 'khor dang 66wa 480

bcas pa rnams dang / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la bskor ba mdzad cing gshegs pa dang / rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'jug cing rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs te chos ston pa mthong ngo / /ji ha)ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag tu rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs nas rang rang gi 'khor las brtsams te/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i bsngags pa dang / yon tan dang / grags pa dang / shes rab dang /bsod nams dang / brtson 'grus dang / thugs rje dang / sems can yongs su smin par mdzad pasko bstan pa bzhinastogeder sangs rgyas kyi zhing re rer yang sems can grangs med dpag tu med pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed ④par gyur to/ /rang rang gi lung bstan pa thob par gyur tsheto/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la yang de bzhin no/ /nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang de bzhin no/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la chud pa gang dag yin pa thams cad kyis kyang mthong ngo /lung bstan pa yang thams cad kyis thos so/ /snyigs ma lnga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong pa dag na sems can gang dag yod pa'i bde ba dang sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba ci 'dra ba myong ba dag kyang〈'dir bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la chud cing 'khod pa rnams kyis mthong ngo / /de'i tshe snyigs ma03 lnga'i 'jig rten gyi khams stong pa dag na sems can gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang snang ba de mthong nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa yang mthong ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bgrang 9/rnyeb las 'das pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa re re yang sems can bgrang5)ba las 'das pa dag dang thabs cig tu 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa 66wa 481

shākya thub pa la bskor (1ba mdzad pa mthong ngo / /de'i tshe sems can de dag thams cad rinanomachog tu dga' ba'i dam pa skyes te/ thams cadam sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba rgyun chad do/ /snyigasam rim lnga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong pa de dag na rigacibyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 6kyis bcu pa gang dag sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa'i byang chub masems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang na sangs rgyas kyis rin 'dul ba'i sems can dag yod pa der sangs rgyas kyi tso sku byad kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed thams cad dbyangs dang / ngag dang / sgra brjod pa gcig gis go bar mdzad do/ /dge ba'i don du zhing gcig tu/ /nged cag thams cad gshegs pa yin/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mi bzhugs na3 sku/ /sus kyang dpal chen mi 'thob 11bo/ /khyed cag gis ni byang chub tu/ /gcig tu sems ni gzhol byas na12ske/ /khyed cag phyin cad nyi 'khor bar ninya ri/ /sdug bsngal geskye bar mi 'gyur rol/ /shākya khyu mchog mchod pa dang / /de la bskor ba bya ba'i 7phyir/ /'di ltar khyed 1 ricag thams cad ni/ /nga dang thabs cig myur du 'deng 3 // //'phags pa shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i sna/sde nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba'i mdo/bam po dgu pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sku byad kyis re re zhing sems can rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa gang gā'i klung gcig 2 gi bye ma snyed dang lhan cig tu de nas chas 27te/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la sems can de dag gis rin po che sna tshogs nas rol mo'i sgra dang / gar dang glu 32sna tshogs pa'i bar gyis mchod pa ri ci byas nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs 66wa 482

pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab bo17/ / kha cig gis ni rkyen gyi theg par smon lam btab/② kha cig gis ni nyan thos kyi dkyitheg par smon lam btab ste④/thams cad kyang bsams 2pa ji lta ba bzhin du phyir mi ldog par gyur 25)to/ /de'i tshe de dag cho ga bzhin du ting nge 'dzin dang / bzod pa dang / gzungs thob ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam pa sna tshogs bsgrubs nas rang ri gi zhing du dong ste/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kha cig ni rang rgyal ba'i lus byad kyis zhes bya ba nas kha cig ni nyan thos kyi lus byad na kyis zhes bya ba'i bar dang /kha cig ni tshangs pa'i lus byad 9dang / kha cig ni brgya 1 skubyin gyi lus byad kyis 31zhes bya ba nas kha cig ni rgyal po chen po bzhi'i lus byad kyis zhes bya ba'i bar dang ske/ kha cig ni sred med kyi bu'i lus byad dang / kha cig ni dbang phyug chen po'i lus byad kyis zhes bya ba'i bar dang / kha cig ni klu'i lus byad 32kyis zhes bya ba'i bar dang / kha cig ni gnod sbyin gyi lus 12byad 1 kyis zhes bya ba'i bar dang ske/ kha cig ni lha ma boyin gyi lus byad kyis sazhes bya ba'i bar dang / kha cig ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i lus byad kyis zhes bya ba'i bar gyis sangs rgyas kyi 1 zhing gang dag na sems can nyan thos kyis 'dul ba'i bar du yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 32zhing de dag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa bcu pa rnams sems can yongs su smin 18par bya ba'i phyir zhugs te/ der nyan thos kyi lus byad kyi bar gyis sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing der yang sems can thams cad kyis snang ba de 7 tshomatshang ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa yang mthong nas sems can de dag shin tu dga' ba dang mchog tu dga' ba skyes shing dbang po rnams tshim ste / thams cad sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba 66wa 483

rgyun chad do/ /de dag la bde ba'i tshor ba yang byunganyengo / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing der gang nyan thos kyi lus byad kyis chos ston pa de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yin te/ des bsod nams chen po bsags ②pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas 'di pa lta bu'i dbyangs dang sgrasnyibarjod pas sangs rgyas kyi blazhing de thams cad go bar byed pa 'di skad ces smras so/ /sdigs0pa'i sems ni gzhom par byos/ /sdig pa'i lta ba spong bar byos/ /gang du 'jig rten mi 'jug pa'i//'khor ba'i pha rol 'dong bar tsa)byos/ /khyed cag sdig pa'i sems kyis〈su/ /nges par 'byung bar mi lta bas/ /rga ba dang ni 'chi ba'i lus/ /'khor bar ring por zhugs pa yin/ /ston pa mthong ba rnyedapo)par dka'/ /dal ba 'di 'dra rnyed tshapar dka'/ /chos thos pa yang rnyed (1par dka'/ /dge byed rab tu rnyedarwartepar dka'/ /de ltar khyed kyis gus byas te/ /byang chub tu ni 'dun pa skyed/ /sdug bsngal kun las thar gyis la/ /'jig rten 'dren par 'gyur bar byos/ /rtag pa dang ni chad pa'i blos/ /chos gnyis myur du spangs nas ni//'du byed thams cad bdag med la/ /tshul bzhin du ni rtag 8par byos/ /kun 'byung sred dang sdug bsngal yang spu/ /ye shes chu yis bkru nyugebar byos/ /shākya seng ge mchod pa'i phyir/ /thams cad lhan cig myur du 'dong / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag nyan thos kyi lus byad kyi bar gyis 7byang chub sems dpa' re re zhing byang chub sems dpa' dngasnyi/ sems can rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa gang gā'i klung gi bye nyukhem snyed tshad med pa dang lhan cig tu rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas chas shu 7te/ 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa 'khor dang bcas pa la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das shākya 66wa 484

thub pa la de dag gis rin po che sna tshogs dang / ras bcos bu sna tshogs dang ske/ chos gos sna tshogs dang / rgyan dang rgyan gyi lhab lhub sna tshogs dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan sna tshogs dang / me tog sna tshogs dang ske/ spos sna tshogs dang / rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs dang / bstod pa sna tshogs dang / glu sna tshogs dang / gar sna tshogs kyis mchod pa byas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du phyin nas rang rang gi stan 1dag la 'khod do/ /de bzhin du rang rang gi 'khor rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i bsngags pa dang grags pa nas sems can thams cad yongs su smin par mdzad pa'i yon tan gyi phan yon gyi bar57brjod par gyur ri te/ de nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na 'khor de'is sems can grangs med pa dpag tu med pa yod pa de dag 5gis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin du nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg par yang sems bskyed de/ thams cad kyang phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /de'i 46 tshe de dag gis 3ting nge 'dzin dang /gzungs rin dang / bzod pa sna tshogs thob nas dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed do/ /sems can thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed 'dir ༄9gang bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la chud par gyur pa'i bkod pa de lta bu yang mthong ngo / /de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rnams la ngo mtshar thob cing rmad du byung ba thob bo/ /de'i tshe gang dag sngon chad sems ma bskyed 3 )pa'i sems can gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed grangs med pa dpag tu med pa de dag ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par gyur to/ /de bzhin du 66wa 485

rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / de bzhin du nyan thos kyi theg par yang sems dag bskyed de7)/ de dag thams cad phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob par gyur to/ /de bzhin du 'khor los sgyur 2)ba'i lus byad kyis zhes bya ba'i bar chadang /phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob carapar gyur to zhes bya ba'i bar du yin te/ sems can yongs su smin par mdzad pa'i phyir ji ltar bcom ldan 'das cho 'phrul chen po sangs rgyas thams cad 45kyi yul gyi rgyu 'thun par 3)ting nge 'dzin de lta bu la snyoms par zhugs pa bzhin no/ /'dus pa chen po nyi ma'i snying po'i le'u bcu gcig pa las le'u drug pa'o// //de nas bdud sdig can gyis tso/de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa nyid kyi pho brang na de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbyings na bzhugs mipa mthong nas mchog tu yid mi bde 9ste lus thams cad nas rdul 'thon 3 )zhing mchi 37ma dag byung nas mi dga' bar gyur to/ /de nas bdud sdig can gyis nyanaganas thams cad du rgyu bar byed/ rnam par rgyu bar byed/ 'jug par byed/ 'byung bar byed/ldang bar byed/ rgyug par byed/ kun tu rgyug par byed/ glal bar byed/'dzum 1 par byed/ shugs ring du 'byin par byed/ kha la lces ldag par byed/mig 'dzums 14par byed/ lag pa gnyis rkyong 8zhing skum 8par byed/ mgo la lag pa gnyis kyis rdob par lha byed1snye/ mgrin pa dang nu ma la mnyed par byed de / de mthong bas //bdud kyi du dreganas na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad gnod pa dang / mngon par mi dga' ba dang / yid mi bde (1bar gyur to/ /de nas bdud shor ba nam mkha'i shing zhes bya ba des bdud sdig can la tshigs 66wa 486

su bcad7pas dris pa/ 'khrug ri sems yid rab mi bde bas / /ci slad de ltar khyod rgyug cingasnyi/ /kun la dga' bar mi dgongs pas/ /ganga'agadu yang ni dgyes mi mnga'/ /bdud sdig can gdong mchi ma dang bcas pas 'di skad ces smras so/ /gi tam stobs can mthong canas ni/ /nga yi snying ni rnam gas 47)nas/ /lus kun nas ni rdul 'thon lde)cing / /gdong yang mchi mas gang ba yin/ /sems can thams cad 'thun pa ru/ /ji ltar thos pa bzhin du der/ /tshogs chen ril0)gyis dong bas na/ /nga yi yul ni stongs par byas/ /nam mkha' dang ni mtshungs pa'i yul/ /phyogs bcu nas 1 snani lhags pa yis/ /de la bskor ba hunyebyas nas su/ /bye ba mang pos yongs su bskor/ /bdud rnams thams cad 'khor bcas te/ /de la yang ni skyabs song bas/ /nga yi〈rtedapung ni ma mthong ste/ /gang na'ang nga yi phyogs med do/ /de nas bdud sdig can la bdud shor ba nam mkha'i shing des hu 'di skad ces smras so/ /bdag cag thams cad 'khor bcas te/ /go cha sra hurib dag bgos nas/ /ral gri nyalha'akhor lo mda' bo ches/ /de yi 8lus ni phye mar rlaganyu sna /sdig can gyis smras pa/ de la yang ni skyabs song zhing / /der yang rang nyid song bas na18/ /de la dmag ni yang dag phul/ /nga ni bcing ba 17dam pos bcings/ /de nas bdud shor ba nam mkha'i shing des smras pa/ thabs rnams kun gyis ci bgyis sa 3kyang / /dgra ni dbang du mi 'gyur te/ /mdza' du 1bo'i gzugs kyis bslus bgyis na/ /de lta 22na ni gsad ge par nus/ /sdig can gyis smras pa/ mdza' thubo'i gzugs kyis der 'gro bar/ /'di ltar bdag gis de bsams nas lha/ /rang gi mgul 57na dri nga ba'i 7/ /ro myags ni/'jigs su rung ba mthong / /nam mkha'i shing gis 66wa 487

slar smras pa/ /bdud dang klu dang bsam gtanam7pa'i/ /yul7gsum dag tu bshad pa la/ /bdag cag gi /ni yul bcom yang / /klu rnams kyi ni ༅yul brtan nopar/ /klu de dag kyang gzi brjid che/ /dmag rnams mang zhing stobs kyang che/ /de dag gi ni yul mchis pa/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub lags/ /'dod pa'i khams na 5snyigang su dag / klu yi 3)bdag po gnas gyur pa/ /de dag rnams lamu gi ta ma/ /thal bar rlag 1 par myur du bsgo/ /sdig can gyis smras pa/ kye bsod nams 7shes rab chen po can/ / klu yirwalhaganas su nyid song la/ /gi ta ma dang dmag 'gyed par/ /thams cad la ni khyod kyis bsgothen / /des smras pa/ de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes nas dmag brgyal)stong go bgos pa de dag la/ lag pa bsgreng ste 1 rabasgrags pa ni/ / klu yi rten 8du bdag cag 'deng 9/ /gi ta ma dang dmag 'gyed cing / /srog dngatshwa)bral bar byed du gzhug /der ni bdag cag grogs bya bar/ /thams cad la ni bsgo bar bya/ /de na 'khod pa de dag kyang gang du yang / su yang 'gro bar ma nus pa dang / shor ba nam mkha'i shing de gdong mchi ma dang bcas shing spu zing zhes byed par gyur te12/ thal mo rab tu sbyar ba byas nas sdig can la smras pa/bdag cag gis ni gang du yang / /mchi bar bgyi nyurteba'i rngo ma thogs/ 3/ /sgyu5nye'aphrul brtan 32pa gi ta ma/ /drang srong gi ni sgyu lags so/ /bdag cag thams cad rkang pa bcings ge/ /lus rnams kun lam0rdul yang byung / /gang gis dgra las khyed rgyal bar/ /gzhan zhig kyang ni mdzad par gsol/ /bdud sdig can je (desdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde rducanas mya ngan du gyur pa de 'di tri 7lta bu'i blo skyes te / gang bdag gis klu'i rten thams cad du gang kun tu smra bar byed pa dang /66wa 488

mngon par mi dga' ba skyed0)par byed pa dang / klu thams cad kun du gshe bar byed pa'i bdud kyi stobasamu de lta bu yang dag par rjes su du /dran par bya gor ma chag snyam mo/ /de nas de'i tshe bdud sdig can gyisar /klu'i rten thams cad du sha sbrang dang / sbrang bu mchu rings gyedang / sbrang bu gdug pa rnams sprul to/ /thams cad dri nga bas bkang ngo / /rdul dbyung rine ba dang mngon par mi dga' bar byas so/ /de bzhin du klu dang / klu chen po skyes pa dang / bud med dang ske/ khye'u dang / bu mo thams cad mngon par mi dga' nas de dag thams cad kyis rnam par bltas te/ bdag cag la co 'dris77)bar byed pa su yin snyam na de dag gis ma shes shing ma mthong ngo / /gling bzhi pa 'di'i58)klu dang / klu chen po skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo gang dag yin pa de dag thams cad kyang khro bas zilas7gyis non nas de dag thams cad 7kyis kyang rang gi gnas bor/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye tsho/1dga' gnyis 'khor brgya stong phrag du mas kyang rang gi gnas bor nas ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi 'dab 12na ri kha la ti ya zhes bya ba yod de/ ri kha la ti ya de'i rtse mo na 32drang srong thub pa rnamasatshwastekyi gnas kyitshwanyetenatsokun rten ces bya ba rgyaramu modapag tshad bzhi khri pa lha 18rdzas kyi rin po che sna bdun gyis 1)brgyan pa bzhi yod pa/ drang srong thub pa'i gnas der skyabs kyi don du rten cing zhugs tri )so/ /der de dag zhugs tsho rtom thag tu 'di lta bu'i lus chung ngur gyur te/ dper na mig sman bsku ba'i thur ma bzhin no/ /de dag kyang rang khros pa'i mthus re re yang 'di lta bu'i lus ri rab tsam du yang dag par shes te/ de dag gis skad 'byin kyang ma 2rtenas so/ /de nas 'gro bar yang ma 2nyenus te rtse/ mya ngan chen po dang khros pas dgezil gyis non 66wa 489

nas der 'khod do/ /de bzhin du klu'i rgyal po chen po rgya mtsho 'khor bye ba brgya stong phrag du ma dang / de bzhin du 11sa srung gi bu zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du shin tu brtan tshonapa riXzhes bya ba'i 4)bar dang / de bzhin du 'jog po zhes bya ba'i bar nodang / de bzhin du ma dros pa zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du 6btang bzung 75zhes bya ba'i bar dang / ci de bzhin du rgya mtshos byin zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du chu lhas byin zhes bya ba'i 585bar dang / de bzhin du khyim bdag gis byin zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du chu bas byin zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du chu sog ma med kyis byin zhes bya ba'i bar dang glu/ de bzhin du ri bos byin zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du ba lang mgo zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du rgyan skyes zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du e la'i 'dab ma zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du lag pa'i tshigs mi mngon pa zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du sgra bsags zhes bya ba'i bar dang ske/ de bzhin du mtsho gyad ces bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du stobs kyis spurgyu zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du ti sna )se'i gangs mtho ba zhes bya ba'i bar dang ske/ de bzhin du chu'i shugs zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du gtsug phud sngon po zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du gser ser skya hu1zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du rtswa 12sngon po zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du gshe ba'i shing zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du nyu mig gsalatswazhes bya ba'i bar dang ske/ de bzhin du glang po zad ces bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du rnon 8pos byin zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du gnas na rgyu zhes bya ba'i bar dang ske/ de bzhin du gshol sangan zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du e la'i 66wa 490

gdong zhes bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du mig dmar zhes bya ba'i bar dang /de bzhin du yid 'phrog ces bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du rab mchog ces bya ba'i bar dang / de bzhin du 'dzam bu'i gling 'di na klu'i rgyal po lnga khri drug stong gang dag yin pa'i bar 1de dag thams cad klu'i rgyal po re re yang 'khor brgya stong phrag du ma drang srong thub pa'i gnas der skyabs kyi don du rten cing zhugs nisol/ /gling brgyad khri bzhi stong nas gling re re nas kyang klu chen po brgya ristong phrag du mas rang rang tsha)gi gnas bor nas gnas rten der skyabs kyi don du rten cing 5zhugs rdzo)so/ /de bzhin du byang gi 7skra mi snyan nas klu'i rgyal po lus 'bigs pa'i khab ces bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po rgyu ba chen po zhes bya ba de gnyis re re yang klu dang / klu chen po dang / klu'i rgyal po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu yongs su bskor cing 8drang srong thub pa'i gnas der skyabs kyi5rje)don du brten 1 snato/ /shar gyi lus 'phags kyi gling nas klu'i rgyal po zla ba srung zhes bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po dbyig gtong 11zhes bya ba de gnyis re re yang klu dang / klu chen po dang / klu'i rgyal po bye ba brgya stong phrag du mas lhan cig yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar 12te drang srong thub pa'i gnas rten der 1lhaskyabs kyi don du rten cing zhugs so/ /ba lang spyod kyi gling nas klu'i rgyal po rin po che'i phreng geb can zhes bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po ba lang gi 'od kyi phreng ba skacan zhes bya ba de gnyis re re yang klu dang / klu chen po dang / klu'i rgyal po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas lhan cig tu mdun sadu bdar 1 zhing drang srong thub pa'i gnas der skyabs kyi don du zhugs so/ /yang de'i tshe gling bzhi pa 'di dang gling gzhan brgya stong phrag brgyad cu 18na klu dang / klu chen po dang / klu'i 66wa 491

skye gnas pa klu sgo nga las skyes pa dang / klu mngal nas skyes pa dang / drod gsher las skyes pa dang / rdzus te skyes pa pho dang / mo dang / khye'u7dang /bu mo yang rung / gang su dag yod pa skad cig deshel gang der brten par ma gyur pa gcig55)kyang med dege/ drang srong thub pa'i gnas der skyabs kyi don du zhugs so/ /de dag thams cad zhugs ma thag tu re re yang 'di lta bu'i lus chung ngur gyur te/ dper na mig sman bsku geba'i thur ma bzhin no/ /de dag kyang rang khros pa'i mthus re re yang 'di lta bu'i lus ri rab tsam chen por yang dag par rjes su mthong ngo / /de nas de'i tshe bdud sdig can gyis gnas rten du klu'i skye gnas pa thams cad 'dus pa dang / thams cad lus chung ngur mthong ngo / /de mthong bas shas cher 'khrugasatswashing kun tu 'khrugs te skrag nas rang gi skye bo la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'byung po risachen po klu rnams thams cad g.yos/ /drang srong gnas pa der ni 'dus nas su/ /thams cad stobs dang gzugs dang dpal las nyurinyams/ /dge sbyong mdangs 1 rikyi stobs la blta bar byos/ /de nas bdud shor ba gzhan tshul khrims rten zhes bya ba des smras pa/ thugs mi dgyes 11pa ma hu mdzad bdag la gson/ /klu rnams bdag nyid rtse ba 'di lags te / /'di ltar shākya'i bu ni phyer rlog pa'ihunye/ /tshogs can 'dus pa la ni mngon brtag mdzod/ /sdig can gyis smras pa/ blom mchog der ni myur du 'gro bar byos/ /klu yi tshogs 8ni thams cad spro bar byos/ /ji ⑩ste shāka tsobu tshogs bcas gsad /snyenas na/ /klu rnams kyi ni yul yang mchog tu 'gyurahu'e/ /de nas bdud shor ba tshul khrims rten nu ride bdud kyi gnas de nas srog chags brgyadamu 7khri dang lhan cig chas so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa sngon gyi smon 66wa 492

lam mthar phyin pas drang srong thub pa thams cad dbang du mdzad/ sems can thams cad yongs su smin par mdzadami/ sangs rgyas kyi yul thams cad kyi cho 'phrul gyi byin gyi rlabs7kyi rgyu 'thun pa bshad pa yang dag par bstan na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad skyoms bar mdzad/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin zhes bya ba nas mi dang /pa mi ma yin sku )thams cad rab tu dga' bar mdzad/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di thams cad shin tu yongs su spyad pa ④mdzad/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa thams cad kyi nang na sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di mchog tu ches gzi brjid 8)dang ldan pa dang / ches skal btsodang ldan pa dang / ches bsod nams kyi sa bon byed pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi skomachod 17par 'os pa mdzad de/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pas rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa rgyun bcad do/ /de la sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di na 7sems can gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyi sku nyisal chud par gyur te/ de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyis khishes pa so sor sbyangs beso/ /de bzhin gshegs pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul gyi rgyu 'thun pa'i cho 'phrul gyi byin gyi rlabs kyi ting ngel 7'dzin gyi nyunyestobs rgyun bcad pa dang / de'i tshe sngon ji ltar bzhugs pa bzhin du yang dag par snang ste/ de de ltar shin tu lham me/ lhan ne / lhangatshwa)nger bzhugs so/ /de de'i bar du yang rang gi gzi brjid kyi 'od zer rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad snang bas khyab par mdzad nas bzhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni tshobargya stong phrag du ma de dag thams cad ngo mtshar thob cing rmad du byung ba thob ste/ bcom ldan 66wa 493

'das la me tog dang / dri dang / phye ma dang / rin po che dang / ras bcos bu dang / chos gos dang / phyang 'phrul dang / rgyan sna tshogs dang /rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs kyis mchod pa byas te/ bskor nyu)ba byas nas spyan sngar 'khod do/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyipha nyan thos rnams zhes bya ba nas de bzhin du lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' risalding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / grul bum dang /yi dgas dang / sha za dang / srul po dang / lus srul po dang / mi dang /mi ma yin pa thams cad kyi bar de dag thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das la me tog dang / dri dang / phye ma dang / rin po che sna tshogs dang / ras bcos bu dang / chos gos dang / phyang 'phrul dang / rgyan sna tshogs zhes bya ba nas mchod pa'i bar du byas te/ bskor ba byas nas chos nyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod do/ /bdud shor ba tshul khrims rten bdud kyi ris brgyad khri dang de nas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir babs nas/ dge sbyong gi ta mas sku yangs pa kun tu bstan pa ji ltar rgyun bcad pa mthong ste/ de yul ma ga dhā thun bzhugs par kun tu snang ngo / /de bdag cag gis skrag pas sgyu'i stobs las ma nyams sam snyam zhing / da 55lta na der ri'u'akhor dang bcas te 'dus pa'i nang du 3'dug na/ de bdag cag gi ga phyir 'dug nas sdig pa mi byed dam snyam ste/gang bdag cag gis riḍa der dang por song nas 'di la rgyu gang yin par 'gyur ba mnyan par bya gor ma chag snyam mo/ /de nas bdud shor ba tshul khrims rten 'khor dang bcas te de nas babs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug ste/ de'i tshe yang des 66wa 494

tshigs su0)bcad pa spobs par byas pa/ khyod kyis nad ni chen po dag /rga shi'i mtsho las ma rgal to/ /'di ltar sems can slu byed na/ /byang grol tu ni ji ltar zhugs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis naribadud shor ba tshul khrims 3rten la tshigs su bcad nas slar bka' stsal pa/ nga 4ni sems can chu bo rgal/ /nga dul yang sred ༄6)med pa yin/ /sems can rnams la thugs 7brtse'i naphyir/ /srog chags rnams la chos ston to/ /'khor bar yun rings brtsams nas su/ /khyod kyis byang chub phyir spyad de/ /mar me mdzad ni tshun chad du/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims kun tu bsgrubs9)/ /sangs rgyas bye ba phrag stong po/ /de dag khyod kyis ri mor byasakyi/ /theg pa mchog gi don du ni/ /nga yis khyod la lung bstan te / /sbyangs pa'i yon tan kun tu spyad/ /mtshan ma med par rnam par bsgoms / /nga yis tholhamig rnams 32dag pa sbyin12/ /sngon gyi tshe rabs dran par byos / /de nas bdudamugeshor ba tshul khrims rten sngon gyi tshe rabs dang / smon lam dang / sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyis bskul bas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rtswa bkram pa lta bur 'ongs par gyur te/ gdong mchi ma dang bcas pas thal mo rab tu sasbyar nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das byis pa ji lta tshab dang / myos pa ji lta ba dang / sems 'khrug pa ji lta ba bzhin du nongs pa 'chags nya tsholags so//btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nongs pa 'chags02so/ /'di ltar bdag gis dran lags te/ grangs ma mchis pa gcig rdzogs par bla na ma mchis pa 19yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu brtson pa chen pos pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi spyod tsho pa spyad lags so/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su sbyangs pa rinyamang du bgyis lags so/ /66wa 495

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'das pa mernams dang dzokyebazhugs pa brgya stong phrag bye ba la bdag gis bsnyen ribakur ba dang bkur sti rnam pa sna tshogs bgyis te chos kyang thos lags so/ /smon lam yang btab lags so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srung ca gi gsung rab gal dge slong la la nyan thos kyi gtam rjes su bskul 7ribar bgyid lags te/ de nas bdag gis ma bsams57par kye ma dge sbyong na gi lus byad kyis gang zag theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du nyan thos kyi gtam 'chad pa 'di ni bdud do zhes sdig pa thocan gyi nyu tshig brjod lags te/ der gal te bdag gis sdig pa 17can gyi tshig de ma smras par gyur na ni der bdag gis bla na ma mchis pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung 12bstan pa thob par 'gyur lags na/ sug las kyi lhag ma des bdag de nas shi 'phos nas bdud kyi gnas su skyes te/ dgung lo bye ba phrag lnga bcu rtsa bdun dang / dgung lo / brgya stong dag tu der bla na ma mchis pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bdag gi sems tshabaskyed pa gcig kyang ma byung lags na tshangs pa'i gnas pa rnams mal lta smos kyang ci 'tshal lags zhes de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa la lan gnyis kyi bar du bzod pa gsol to/ /ji srid du sngon gyi mtha'i 'khor bar 'khor ba de srid du slad kyis phyi ma'i mtha'i mur sems can dmyal bar miganas par spro lags kyi / bla na ma mchis pa yang dag par tsunardzogs pa'i byang chub las sems ldog par ni mi bgyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs sheshekyi bu legs so legs so/rje/ /gang la la snying rje'i sems kyis byang chub tu sems gzhol bar byed na/ 'di ni 'dren pa rnams la mchod pa mchog dang phul yin 66wa 496

te / 'dren pa'i spyan sngar la la mar ti me ri rab tsam du nano'abar bar rinabyed kyang bsod nams kyi phung po de snyed yongs su bzung ba ma yin gyis 4)khyod longs shig /nga la sdig pa'i las sra b.rapa'or cig6ci /phung po dang khams na'adi dag la spros pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / 'dus 8byas thams cad dran par byos shig dang rka/ khyod yon tan mchog tu kha lo sgyur khebar 'gyur ro/ /de nas de nyid kyi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims rten gyis 1 rjes su 'thun pa'i chos rnams la bzod pa thob par gyur to11/ /de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims rten stan las langs te/bcom ldan 'das la5)rin thang med pa'i mu tig gi rgyan phreng gis sku la g.yogs nas gsol pa/ gang bdag cag gis chos thams cad myur du rtogs nas dbu 1snyeb dang 'dra ba'i lta ba thams cad yang dag par 'joms par bgyid pa dang /byang chub tu ni bzod pa mchog thob par 'gyur ba dang / yun ring po mi thogs par sems can thams cad thar bar bgyid pa'i khochos ni gang lagasaska/ gang zhig ni byang chub sems dpas /7spang ba'i slad du bsgom nya par bgyid pa 18lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshul khrims rten mkhas pas chos bzhi myur du bskyedarwanyepar bya ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ sems can gyi phyir sdug bsngal tshad med pa thams cadadza )la spro bar bya ba yin/ sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi 21bslab 22pa dpag yas pa gzungamu bar bya ba yin/ ma nyams par gzung gijebar bya ba yin/sangs rgyas kyi chos dpag tu med pa thams cad myur du yongs su rdzogs par bya ba yin no/ /yang de'i tshe tshul khrims rten gyi 'khor bdud kyi sde brgyad khri 25bzhi stong po de dag ④gis lung bstan pa de thos nas de bzhin gshegs pa la dad pa 66wa 497

dang dang ba 1mchog skyes shing gus pa skyes nas/ bcom ldan 'das la lhag pa'i bsam pas bzod pa gsol bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe de dag gis kyang bla na med pa nayang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab ste/ de dag thams cad kyis byang chub kyi dasems mi brjed 4pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob bo/ /bcom ldan 'das la de dag gis rang rang gi lha rdzas kyi chos gos dag sku la gsol nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /bdud sdig can gyis mthong ste/ mthong nas kyang yang shas cher 'khrugs shing skrag nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge sbyong gi ni stor chud pas/ /'khor de dag dang bral bar gyur/ /'di nas gang du dong ba ni / /thams cad de yi 45dbang du song / /des 6su yang phyi rol du ma 'byung shig /bdud kyi spyod yul 'dir bdag cag gnas par bya'o zhes smras nas myur du grong khyer gyi sgo bcad de gab tu bcug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang ji ltar nam mkha'i spyan las gsungs pa bzhin du de dag la tshangs pa'i 8gnas pa rnam pa 9gsum po sems can la dmigs pa dang / chos la dmigs pa dang / dmigs pa med pa rgya cher bstan par yang dag par brtsam 〉pa mdzad do/ /ri kha la ti ya'i rtse mo drang srong thub pa'i gnas su klu gang dag rten 11cing 'dus pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang rang rang gi 1rtelus chung ngur mthong ste/dper na mig sman bsku 1 ba'i thur ma bzhin no/ /ji ltar sngon gyi lus bzhin du yang bzhag par ma nus so/ /slar 'byung bar yang ma nus te/ de dag thams cad 'jigs shing skrag la spu zing zhes byed pa'i 14ba spu'i khung bu byung nas/ de dag thams cad kyis dga' bo dang nye dga' la rab tu btud 1lhanas 'di skad ces smras so/ /gang gi 7tshe bdag cag gi grong du sha sbrang dang / sbrang bu mchu 66wa 498

rings ①dang / sbrang bu gdug pa rnams kun tu byung ba de'i tshe bdag cag gnas thams cad bor nas bskyab napa'i phyir 'dir zhugs nas 'di nas gang du yang mchi bar ma nus te/ lus dag kyang chung ngur gyur lags na gang gis bdag cag riganas su mchi bar bdag cag bskyab latu gsol/ mi 'jigs pa 5stsal bar gsol/ dga' bo dang nye dga' gnyis kyis kyang smras pa/ dge sbyong 'di ni g.yo sgyu can gyis 6 blo/ /shākya'i bu pho sgyu ma byed pa yin/ /sangs rgyas zhing 'dir zhugs par gyur nas su/ /lus kun la ni thams cad chud par gyur//des ni klu rnams kun gyi gnas dag tu/ /sha sbrang 7sbrang bu mchu rings 8sprang bu sbrul / /sa 'di bskyab phyir nged cag lhags gyur te/ /thams cad stobs rnams las ni nyams par gyur9 / /gi ta ma ni blo gros g.yon 1 can yang / /las des rdzu 'phrul de las nyams gyur cing / /de ni lus kyang chung ngur gyur nas su/ /stan gyi stengs tsho/nyan dmangs 32ni kun tu snang / /des ni bdag cag lus kyang chung ngur nyu byas/ / btson ra 'dir sani bcings par gyur nas su/ /nged cag ci yang byed par mi nus kyisabo/ /mi 'jigs lha tshal khyed cag phyag 'tshol cig /'dod pa'i nya dbang phyug bdud sdig can la klu de dag thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal te smras pa/ gang bdag cag btson ra de nas 'byer ba 1 dang rang rang gi 19gnas rnams su gnas par rngo thogs 2 par bdag cag bskyab tu gsol/ klu'i rgyal po sa srung gi bus de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bdud dpung bcas pa rang nyid skrag nas su/ /gau tam sgyu ma g.yo 21sgyu can la skyo/ /'khor dang lto gol 22rnams kyang g.yo yis su/ /des ni de yi /skye bo mang po phrogs / /bdud la mthu ni ci yang yod ma yin/ /'gro ba dang ni rdzu 'phrul de las 5nyams/ /66wa 499

gzhan la khyed cag myur du skyabs su dengamatsho)/ /lha rnams la ni kun gyis rjedashepar byos ri/ /de nas klu thams cad kyang kha cig ni rgyal po chen po bzhi la phyag 'tshal bar byed dol/ /kha cig ni brgya byin la phyag 'tshal bar byed doge/ /kha cig ni rab 'thab bral la phyag 'tshal bar byed do/ /kha cig ni yongs su dga' ldan la phyag 'tshal bar byed do/ /kha cig ni 'phrul dga'57la phyag 'tshal bar byed do / /kha cig ni lha'i bu gzhan 'phrul dbang byed la phyag 'tshal bar byed don / /kha cig ni tshangs pa chen po la rishe phyag 'tshal bar byed do/ /klu'i rgyal po thams cad la klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha dang lha dbang 'di kun 'khod nas su/ /mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa dang / /gau tam dmangs 1 la thams cad skyabs gnas pa/ /khyed cag gi ni ci yi (1phyir ma mthong ske/ /dka' nyu thub drag po drang srong chen po dganyusnye /gzhan rnams la ni grogs khudag khyed phyag 'tsholas/ /rtas bsrungs mthonas 'phur skar ma dga' ba dang / /ngan spong bu la ci //phyir phyag mi 'tshal/ /de nas klu lha/de dag thams cad kha cig ni drang srong rab tu dpal ldan la phyag 'tshal bar byed do/ /kha cig ni brten 3 po la phyag 'tshal bar byed do/ /kha cig ni rtas bsrungs (tel phyag 'tshal bar 2byed do/ /kha cig ni mthon por 'phur 4snyel phyag 'tshal bar byed dol/ /kha cig ni skar ma la zhu dga' ba la phyag 'tshal bar byed do/ /kha cig ni drang srong ngan spong gi bu la phyag 'tshal bar byed dog she/ /mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa de dag la skyabs su nye bar dong ngo / /yang de'i tshe/ drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa de dag gangs kyi nub phyogs kyi ngos la drang srong skar ma la dga' ba'i mdun na/ shākya khyu mchog gi rdunyeyon tan bsngags pa 66wa 500

nyan cing 'khod de17/ drang srong de dag gis klu thams cad 'o dod 'bod pa thos so/ /thos nas kyang drang srong lnga po de dag stan nalas langs te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skar ma la ridaga' ba la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das drang srong thub pa'i gnas rten du klu thams cad gnod par gyur cing bdag cag la skyabs su nye bar gnas pa gzigs sam/bzhengs te der bzhud la klu'i sde thams cad yongs su 4thar bar mdzod cig /des smras pa/ khyed deng 5shig /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin brgya stong phrag mang po 'di dag nga'i mdun 7du 'khod nas tshangs pa'i gnas pa dmigs pa med pa (yongs su 'dri bar byed de/ ngas 9de dag gi 1 sems yongs su mgu bar bya'o/ /de nas skar ma la dga' ba'i rkang pa gnyis la 11drang srong de dag thams cad mgo bos phyag 'tshal 12te/ lan gsum bskor nyi ba byas nas rdzu 'phrul gyis dong ste drang srong thub pa'i gnas kyi gzhi rten du 'khod do/ /de nas de dag la klu de dag mgo bos phyag 'tshal 1 te 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyed tshabasod nams can shes rab dang ldan pa thabs sathams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drang srong chen po lags na bdag cag yongs su bskyab par gsol/ btson ra'i 'jigs pa 'di las bdag cag yongs su dgrol bar gsol/ de nas drang srong de dag gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /nged 1 kyis ni khyed 'di nas yongs su grol 18bar byed par mi nus so/ /lag 'gro'i bdag po dag gangs kyi nub phyogs kyi ngos la drang srong thams cad kyi bla ma dbang che bar grags pa/ shes rab 19dang /thabs dang / gzi brjid rmechen pos 1rgyas pa skar ma la dga' ba zhes bya ba yod de/ des khyed 'di nas yongs su grol 22bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /de la 66wa 501

phyag 'tshol cig /de thos nas klu thams cad drang srong skaras3)ma ladza dga' ba la thal mo rab tu sbyar ba byas nas dbyangs gcig gis 'o dod bos so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' drang srong gi cha byad can drang srong skar ma la dga' bas (1lha dang / mi 'am ci dang / gnod sbyin brgya stong phrag mang pos mdun du bdar cacing yongs su bskor 5te/ de nas rdzu 'phrul gyis 6chas nas 7)drang srong thub pa'i gnas der yang phyin par gyur na te/ de la klu thams cad mgo bos phyag 'tshal 9te gus pa mchog skyes nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /gang bdag cag rang gi gnas su mchis 1 rinas dga' 31bar 'gyur bar bdag cag yongs su bskyab par gsol/ gnas 'di nas bdag cag yongs su dgrol bar gsol/dus shes pa/ dus la blta ba drang srong chen po des kyang rkyen gyi dbang gis de dag la rgyu skar gyi go rims kyi 12gtam brtsams 3 pa/ ji ltar thams cad thar 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin du ni bshad sapar bya/ /khyed la phan pa gzhan med kyisaskom/ /mthar gyis su ni mnyan 7par gyis/ /'dir ni nab nyu tshoso gang gnas pa / /de ni dbyar zla tha chungs te/she/ /de ni nyi ma lha yin zhing / /klu rnams kun dang 'brel pa yis/ /skar ma'i dpyad ni phongs 3)pa dang / /snying por drang srong sbyor bas bstan/ /gza' 2— ridang rgyu skar 27skar ma rnams/ /nam mkha' la ni su yis bzhag /mkhas pa rnams ni dga' bgyid pa/ /lo skor shes pa bshad du gsol/ /zla ba nyi ma rgyu skar dang / /gza' rnams 'gro ba ji ltar lags/ /zla ba rnams kyi dang por ni/ /rgyu skar ni gang zhig 'byung bar 'gyur / /zla ba'i yud tsam gang zhig lags/ /go rims kyang 9 —rteni ci 'dra lags / /lha ni ci lags rus ci 2 lags/ /lci ba ci lags yang ba gang / /66wa 502

phan pa ci lags gnod pa ci/ /stobs ci 1bdag la myur du gsungs/ /gang gis chosasu ni mtshan mo 'thob/ /nyi ma'i mdun na ci zhig lags/ /grib ma'i gom pa du zhig tu/ /nyi ma 'khor bar bgyid pa lags/ /zla ba gang la lho phyogs su/ /nyi ma byang du ji ltar gnas/ /drang srong khyod la kun zhu na/ /bdag cag la ni kun ston cig /shes rab chen pos 'jig rten mkhas/ /skar la dga' bas de skad smras/ /bskal pa bzang po zhugs pa na/ /sngon chad byung ba skye lags riba'agro/ /dpal ldan grong khyer lnga len du/ /'dod pa spangs shing chos dang ldan/ /gtsang ma 'dod cing rab mkhas pa'i/ /mi rgyal 'byor ba chen po byung / /de yi btsun mo dam pa ni/ /'dod pa rnams la 'chums gyur nas / /de tshe yul ni dben par yang / /gzu lums can dang lhan cig spyad/ /mngal ni smin par bya ba'i phyir/ /yang dang yang du spyad nas su/ /de tshe chos kyis sbrum par gyur/ /mi sdug pa yi khye'u zhig 4byung / /bung 5bu'i mgo la bong mgrin rigapo/ /bong rna po la bong gdong po/ /thams cad rtsub 7po ral pa can/ /mi yi lus ni phyed yod pa/ /de mthong 'jigs nas myur du ni/ /snam phyi sar ni de bor ro/ /reg btu mi rung mi gtsang ba9/ /de phyir srin mo bong mos 1 blangs / /gangs kyi gnas su song nas su/ /bu la chags pas gsos pa yin/ /bcud kyis len ni 'thungs 11pas na/ /de tshe lha dang lhan cig 'grogs/ /shes rab chen po skal ldan po/ /rab tu brtson ldan snying rje'i sems/ /gzi brjid chen po byams pa thob/ /sems can kun la phan byed pa'o1 / /lha yi tshogs kyang 'dus nas su/ /rnga bong la ni phyag 'tshal nas/ /de la yang ni snying brtse'i 1 phyir / /gangs kyi ri bo sprul pa byas/ /shing dang me tog 'bras bur ldan/ /dri 66wa 503

zhim dga' bar byed pa ste/ /sna tshogs rtsi ①yis khebs pa la/ /bya rnams sna tshogs rten dpa yin/ /der ni drang srong rnga bong de/ /rnam par dbenasapar rten cananas su/ /lo ni drug khri tham par yang / /rkang pa gcig gis dka'adzabathub gnas/ /brgya byin tshangs pas phyag byas te/ /lha rnams kun gyis mngon par bstod/ /gzugs rten lha rnams thams cad dang / /der ni tshangs pa nye bar 'ongs6/ /'dod rten lha rnams thams cad dang / /der ni brgya byin nye bar 'ongs/ /klu dang gnod sbyin grul dzopa/bum dag /thams cad der ni nye bar lhags / /'jig 2rten gang su mkhas pa ni/ /drang srong tshangs par spyod pa rnams / /'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs khams pa/ /thams cad der ni nye bar lhags/ /kun gyis ladrang srong rnga bong la/ /mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byas / /btud nas thal mo sbyar byas te/ /brgya byin tshangs pas 'di tshiskad smras / /skal ldan chen po kye khyod ni/ /ci phyir nged la mngon par dga'/ /re ba ci 'dra ci la bsams11/ /ci 'dod pa ni smra bar gyisahu / /drang srong rnga bong gis smras pa/ /gza' dang rgyu skar skar ma rnams/ /mkha' hu la ci 'drar 8byung gyur pa'i/ /sngon gyi bskal pa bdag gis dran/ /nyin zhag du ni rgyu skar rnams//re re nas ni rgyu bar byed/ /tshe rabs kun tu rgyu skar gyi/ /yon tan las rnams rnam par shes/ /bskal pa bzang po 'di la ni/ /'di ni ci yang mi snang na / /snying brtser gyis de 5khyod kyis ni/ /rgyu skar go rims tsokun zhog shigatso /ji ltar 'jig rten 'dir gnas bzhin/ /de yi las dang yon tan gsungs/ /yon tan rgya mtshos shod cig ces/ /lha yi tshogs lha rnams kun gyis smras/ /drang srong rnga bong gis smras 19pa/ /re zhig tsho dang por smin drug ces/ /rgyu skar dkyil 66wa 504

'khor thams cad la/ /nang gi dang por gzhag par bya/ /ji ltar smin drug bzhag pa 1bzhin/ /'di la su zhig 2dad pa 'bul/ /lha yi bu ni nyi ma yang / /skar ma drug po /ston par byed/ /smin drug rgyu skar de dag ni/ /mkha' la rtag tu rgyu bar shog /thams cad ldan pa'i 'khor dga' nas / /me lha zhig ni sprul pa byas/ / gzi brjid 5chen po drang srong lha/ /me bzhin 'jug gis 7bus smras pa/ /bdag gi sring mo'i 7bu 'di dag /gling bzhi par 8ni gnas par shog /drang srong rnga bong slar smras pa/ /dang por smin drug de dag yin/ /rgyu skar chu yi 1 skurus can 1 ni/ /gnyis pa yang ni yin par bya/ /skye dgu'i bdag gis 'di skad smras/ /bdag gis bu lnga dbul lags te/ /rus ni drang srong chen po chu/ /rab tu brtson ldan snar ma lags/ /chu yi rus kyi rgyu skar ni / /snar ma'i ming gis gnyis pa lags/ /zla ba'i bu pho gsum po ni/ /ming ni mgo zhes bgyi ba lags/ / ba ra dwa 1 dza'i rus su ni/ /mgo zhes bgyi ba bzhag pa lags/ /rab tu mi bzad 7lag ces bya/ /lha drag rnams kyis bstan pa lags/ /ljang sngo'i bu yi bu rus su/ /de ni bzhi par bzhag pa lags/ /drang srong bcas pa'i lha tshogs kyis/ /nyi ma'i bu ni bstan lags te/ /nab tshoso lags shing gnas 'jog sarus/ /phur bu'i bu ni gsum lags te/ /lag gi bu yi rus 1 lags shing / /rgyal zhes bgyi bar de dag bshad/ /sa srung gi ni bu lnga po/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa mkhas pa rnams/ /mdza' bo'i bu yi 9rus lags te/ /de ltar de dag rgyu skar bdun/ /shar phyogs kha 'dzin rnams su bzhag / de yi 2 las dang go rims 1dang / /sbyor ba kha 'dzin gzhung mu las bstan / /ngas kyang yang ni khyed cag la/ /gling bzhi ripa ni gnas byed cing / /66wa 505

las ni ci 'dra sgrub byed pa/ /mdor ni myur du bshad par bya/ /phur bu yi ni bu lnga po/ /byang grol brtul zhugs 'chang tshob dag /ser skya'i bu yi rus su ni// lho yis phyogs su ngas bzhag go/ /dbyangs can gyi ri ni bu gnyis po/ /ming gis kyang ni gre yin te/ /drang srong gi tam rus su ni/ / lho yi 4 phyogs su ngas bzhag go/ /lha mo yi ni bu gnyis po/ /ming gis kyang ni dbo 5yin te/ /kau ḍi n+ya yi rus su ni/ /lho phyogs kha 'dzin gsum pa bzhag /sdig pa yi ni bu bstan pa / /drang srong kā tā'i bu yis rus/ /lhar bcas drang srong rnams kyis der/ /me bzhi zhes ni bya bar bzhag /dri za'i 7bu ni nag pa ste/ /kā tā'i bu yi rusasngon)yin no/ /sa ri de ni ma yi 9bu/ /kā 1 tā'i bu chen rus yin no/ /'dir ni sa ga dpal gyi bu/ /kā tā'i bu rgan rus yin te/ /drang srong rnams kyis 11rgyu skar bdun/ /lho phyogs kha 'dzin rnams su bzhag /mdza' 12bo'i bu yi /sabu bzhi po/ /drag po'i bu yi rus yin te/ /ming gis lha mtshams zhes bya ba/ /nub phyogs su ni bzhag pa yin/ /dbang po yi ni bu gsum ste/ /zla ba kā tā'i bu yi rus/ /'jam pa'i las ni thams cad la1 / /gnyis pa snron ni bzhag pa yin / /sa yi lha mo'i bu gsum ste/ /snrubs 5ni lag pa'i bu yi rus/ /rgyal ba'i lha mo'i bu bzhi ste/ /kā tā'i bu yi tsharus yin no/ /thams cad lha zhes bya ba bzhi/ /mod gal bu yi rus yin no/ /snrubs dang chu stod chu smad 1 gnyis/ /rgyu skar gsum po bzhag pa yin/ /sred med bu yi bu gsum po/ /rgyu skar rnams ni byi bzhin 'khod/ /khyab 'jug gi ni bu gsum ste/ /kā tā'i bu pho 1rte dpal gyi rus/ /de ltar de dag rgyu skar bdun/ /nub phyogs kyi ni kha 'dzin yin / /nor lha'i 2 bu ni mon gru 2 ste/ /drang srong rna ba'i rus yin 22no/ /chu 66wa 506

lha'i 37bu ni gcig pu ste/ /debartsonartse'i bu yi rus yin zhing / /sman ma sprul gyi lha mo yiminee/ /rgyu skar mon gre gnas pa yin/ /sdig pa yi 4ni bu gnyis te/ /khrums stod ces ni bya bar bshad/ /chu yi rna ba'i rus su ni/ /gsum pa 'di ni bzhag pa yin/ / lha yi mu drang srong chu lha'i bu/ /khrums smad ces ni bya 5bar bshad / /bra nye drang srong rus yin par/ /bzhi pa 'di ni bzhag pa yin/ / lha yi du drang srong rgyal gyi bu/ /nam gru zhes bya de bstan te/ /drang srong dbang po'i rus su ni1/ /lnga pa 'di ni bzhag pa yin/ /dri za'i rgyal po'i bu gsum ste / /lnga len bu yi rus yin zhing / /rgyu skar tha skar zhes 9bya ba/ /'jig rten mkhas pa rnams kyis bzhag /drag po'i bu ni gsum yin te/ /bra nye ngan spong rus yin no/ /rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni/ /byang phyogs kha 'dzin rnams su bzhag /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad po/ /kha 'dzin bzhir ni gzhung las bshad/ /gtor ma las dang yon tan rnams/ /mdor 1ston nga yis bshad par bya/ /thams cad rab tu thal sbyar 'khod/ /lha dang shed las skyes rnams kyis/ /drang 32srong rnga bong la ni smras/ /mi dge sngon du 'gro ba'i las/ /gang byas khyod ni mi sdug skyes32/ /gang du thams cad myur zad 'gyur/ /'di ni 1 lha dang mi rnams dang / /drang srong dag ni zhi ba rnams/ /thams cad gzugs ni bzang por gyur/ /rigs midang snyan ldan de dag kun/ /drang srong rnga bong de la sani/ /brgya byin lhan cig 'khod nas 1 su/ /'khor kun rangs te thal 1/sbyar gyur/ /bsam pa gcig tu smras pa ni/ /nam mkha' 'di la rgyu skar ni/ /gang zhig dang por rgyu bar byed/ /kha zas su ni ci za shod/ /mi rnams kyi ni las ci sgrub/ /yun 19ni ji srid rgyu bar byed/ /drang srong de dag thams cad la/ /rnga bong gis 2 66—507

ni ji0)skad smras/ /ji ltar nga yis brjod pa bzhin/ /'dir ni khyed kyisalgedad pa phul/ /rgyu skar 'di la ngas mchog phyin(mi/ /de ni khyod la brjod par spyuge / /go rims 'ushes pa nga bdag bzhin/ /gling bzhi'i sems can phan pa'i phyir / /lo skor yang ni shes par bya/ /dang por nyi ma gang yin pa/ /ngas byas pa ni nga yi mig /bu drug g.yonyecan sems rangs pa/ /de ni nga yis dang por brjod / /de yi phyir na smin drug ni/ /rgyu skar tshogs ni thams cad du/ /nang gi gtso bor 'gyur bar shog /zla ba nya dang nyi ma yi/ /nyin mtshan de dag mnyam par gnas/ /mtshan mo gzhan ri tshoni mun khyab dang / /chu lha yang ni gnas par 'gyur/ /'gro ba bzod pa bgrang sa1ba dang / /bra nye gnas bzhin 'di ltar bshad/ /mon sran bcu drug brgyar bsgyur te/ /skyes bu dang ni brgyad pa gcig49tsho/ /brgyad pa phrag ni bcu drug la/ /cha ni gcig 7tu 'gyur ba yinam/ /cha ni drug cu tham hu7pa la/ /yud tsam cig ni de yin no/ /de tsam yud tsam sum cu /tsho la/ /'dir ni 'jig rten gnas pa yin/ /ri rab g.yas nas bskor tsho/rteba'i tshe/ /yud tsam sum cus 8'gro bar byed/ /'dir ni mon sran mtshod ma za/ / bya ba nyung ngu bsgrub par gyis/tso /rgyal po nad pas 'gro ba kun / /zhag bcu tham pa thar bar gyis/rte/ /rtag tu dad pas hunyamatshon chas bsrungs/)ske/ /mchog sbyin khyod kyis bu skye gang / / tshor ba5) dbang po thul ba dang ske/ /chos kyi blo gros nab du so la/ /mngal du nying mtshams sbyor bar 'gyur/ /'dir ni gre la bya ba mang / /chu smad bra nye gsum pa yin/ /me bzhi snar ma gro bzhin ni ni/ /nor rgyad byed par 'gyur ba yin/ /snrubs dang skag rtedang nam gru ni/ /lam zhu chodag gi ni rgyu skar yin/ /khrums stod dang ni snron dang ni/ /66wa 508

kyis 'gro/ /dug dang sha ni zas yin no/ /khyod la 3)spyod par byed pa yisathu/ /gang dag mi rnams skye 'gyur ba/ /de dag phyug cing chos dang ldan/ /zhag lnga nad pa myur du gsos/ /de 'dir khyod kyis bstan par gyis/ /byi bzhin nam grus mngal du 'jug / /'chi ba snrubs dang mchu bzhin te/ /rgyal dang lha mtshams khrums stod 'phel/ /dmag 'gro bag ma gtong ba yiri / /gnas nas 'gro bar byed pa dang / /nyo tshong dang ni bzo ra byed pa/ /de 'dra ba yi bya ba spongs / /sa ri mon gru 6de dag 'dir/ /rgyad byed dgra 'dir gzhom par bya/ /me bzhi las kyi rgyu skar yin/ /che chung thams cad 'dir gyis shig /mgo dang nag pa gro bzhin te/ /de dag phun sum tshogs par byed/ /rtsi byed na yang de dag sten / /der 7byin gos rgyan sna tshogs sgrogs/ /nab ni/so dang ni sa ga dang ske/ /mon gre bde bar byed pa ste/ /de dag la ni lam du 'jug /snron tsho ni sgrub pa nyu byed pa yin/ /skag ces bya ba khrums smad ni/ /drag po'i las dag byed pa yin/ /chu stod chu smad tha skar dang / /bra nye khrums stod khrums 11smad mdza' / /dbos 12ni skal ba 1 bzang po sbyin/ /brtson pa dang ni bzhon 9pa dang ske/ /mal dang khri ni bsham pa yang / /'di la bya ba de 'jug go/ /yang smras pa/ 'gro ba bzhi dang ldan par ni/ /mgo la khyod ni gnas par 'gyur/ /mi yi las bya myur du sgrubs/ /yud tsam sum cur nyunye'agro bar gyis/ /zhag brgyad nad pa myur du gsos/ /khyod zas tshon sha zla ba'i lha/ /der ni skyes tshadagu gang dag skye/ /dpa' zhing 'byor bar 'gyur ba yin/ /khyab 'jug bden 'di shin tu bsrungs1 / /de byed ji bzhin nga yis bshad/ /gro bzhin sna tha skar mngal du 'jug /mchu 19gnyis gre dbo 'chi bar byed/ /snron gyi tshe ni bya ba 66wa 514

'phel / /skag dang gzhan bcas thob par byed/ /lam ring rtsod 1dang gnas nas 'gro/ /bya ba de 'dra spang bar gyis/ /nab so rgyad par byed pa ste/ /mon gre sa ga bzhin du shes/ / gsang ba'i naganas bzhin brtsam ripar gyis/ /brdzun rigayo dmangs kyis 'joms par byed/ /nag pa las kyi rgyu 5skar te/ /'di la che56)chung thams cad rtsom / /lag ni phun sum tshogs par byed/ /mon gru 87sa ri gzhan thob byed/ /'dir ni 9sman dang sbyin 'dul bzhin / /rgyan dang gos kyang thob par byed/ /rgyal dang lha mtshams 1 khrums stod 12bde/ /de dag lam du shin tu 'phrod/ /snrubs dang nam gru namachu sgrub byed/ /'di la gtum po'i tshalas kyang bya/ /me bzhi dgra zin bra nye dang / /snar ma dbyer med chu gnyis bzhin/ /skal bzang bag ma gtong dang bzhonas/ /mal kun 'dir ni byed du chug /lag lha drag mos de tshe smras/ /tshes lnga la ni khyod gnas te/ /yud tsam bco lnga khyod 'gro byed/ /khyod kyi zas ni mar sar 17te/ /drag cing mi bzad 1 snang byed sgrub/ /nad pa yang ni zhag bcu yin/ /khyod la spyad 18pas mi gang skye/ /srid pa gsum du mi zad 'gyur/ /nor tshol byed cing chom pos 'chil/ /khyod kyi sbyor bas de yin no/ /mon gru musnrubs 2 la mngal du 'jug /chu dang nam grus 'phel bar 'gyur/ /dbo 2 yi tshe na 'chi bar byed/ /chu gnyis bra 2)nye ji bzhin no/ /skye dang 'jig dang 'phel ba yi / /byed pa de ni spong sdebar gyis/ /lha mtshams dang ni khrums stod der ga/ /byed pa bstan nas rgyad par byed/ /sa ri las kyi 20rgyu skar yin/ /byed pa chung ngu thams cad 'jug /sa ga dang ni mon gre dang / /nab 2 so phun sum tshogs par byed/ /khrums rtesmad par ni bde byed yin/ /snron dang skag ni lam na mnyam/ /gre ni 66wa 515

de phyir nyin mo tshes bcu bzhir/ /yud tsam mtshan mo bcu drug ste/ /smin drug gis ni mtshan mo 'thob3)/ /snrubs kyang nyi ma'i mdun na ste/ /grib tshod gom pa brgyad yin zhing / /nyi ma yongs su 'khor bar byed/ /lho phyogs nyi mar kha bltas tsho 'khor/ /de bzhin dgun zla ra ba yid/ /zla 'dir khyim gzhur shes par bya/ /mar gyi ngo yi tshes gcig la'ang / /lag ni sgrub par byed pa yin/ /tshes gnyis la ni nab so ste/ /tshes gsum rgyal du shes par gyis/ /'dir tshes bzhi la'ang skag yin te/ /mchu yang tshes ni lnga la 'gro/ /tshes drug la yang gre yin te/ /tshes bdun la yang dbo 4yin bshad/ /tshes brgyad la ni me bzhi yin / /tshes dgu la ni nag pa gnas/ /tshes bcu la ni sa ri 'gro/ /tshes bcu gcig la sa ga 'gro/ /tshes bcu gnyis la'ang 5lha mtshams te/ /tshes bcu gsum la smon yin no/ /tshes bcu bzhi la'ang snrubs yin te/ /tshes bco lnga la'ang rigachu stod bshad/ /yar gyi ngo yi tshes gcig la/ /chu smad kyang ni rung ba yin / /tshes gnyis byi bzhin gro bzhin te/ /tshes gsum la ni mon gru 'gro/ /tshes bzhir mon gre9)'gro rung ste/ /tshes lnga la ni khrums stod yin/ /tshes drug la yang khrums smad yin/ /tshes bdun la ni nam gru 'gro/ /tshes brgyad la ni tha skar rung / /tshes dgur gshin rje'i lha mo yin/ /tshes bcur smin drug 'gror rung ste/ /tshes bcu gcig la'ang snar ma yin/ /tshes bcu gnyis la'ang mgo yin te/ /tshes bcu gsum la lag kyang 'gro/ /tshes bcu bzhi la nab 3)so ste/ /zla ba nya la rgyal yang yin/ /zla ba nya ba 'di la yang / /'dir ni rang bzhin brjod par bya/ / lho yi 7phyogs su phyin nas kyang / /nyi ma yongs su 'khor bar byed/ /nyin par bcu gsum shes par gyis/ /mtshan mo bcu bdun 'gro 66—529

zla ra ba mar gyi ngo'i/ /dang po tshes gcig lha mtshams sgrub/ /tshes gnyis la ni snron yin te/ /tshes gsum la ni snrubs yin no/ /tshes bzhi la ni chu stod yin/ /tshes lnga la ni chu smad yin/ /tshes drug la ni byi bzhin yin/ /tshes bdun la ni gro bzhin yin/ /tshes brgyad la ni mon gru tsho1 ste/ /tshes dgu la ni mon gre yin/ /tshes bcu la ni khrums 5stod yin/ /tshes bcu gcig la khrums gesmad yin/ /tshes bcu gnyis la nam gru ste/ /tshes bcu gsum la tha skar yin/ /tshes bcu bzhi la bra nye yin/ /tshes bco lnga la smin drug ste/ /de ni zla phyed zla ba yar/ /tshes gcig la ni snar ma sgrub/ /tshes gnyis la ni mgo yin te/ /tshes gsum la ni lag yin no/ /tshes bzhi la ni nab la so ste/ /tshes lnga la ni rgyal yin no/ /tshes drug la ni skag yin te/ /tshes bdun la ni mchu yin no/ /tshes brgyad sal ni gre yin te/ /tshes dgu la ni dbo yin no/ /tshes bcu la ni me bzhi ste/ /tshes bcu gcig la nag pa yin/ /tshes bcu gnyis la sa ri ste/ /tshes bcu gsum la sa ga yin/ /tshes bcu bzhi la lha mtshams tege/ /tshes 57)bco lnga la snron yin no/ /dbyar zla ra ba'i rim brjod bya/ /byang phyogs kha bltas pe nyi ma 'khor / /'phel byed nyin par bcu drug tu/ /shes bya mtshan mo'ang bcu bzhi yin / /sa gas mtshan mo 'thob ḍapar byed/ /nyi ma'i mdun hu )na mgo yin no/ /grib tshod gom pa bzhi yin te11/ /de kyi ni yongs su 'khor bar byed/ /der zhing gza' sna lhag nyi ma'i bu/ /'jam por byed pa'i gza' yin no/ /sbyor ba'i khyim yin nyin par 'gro/ /brgyad pa yin par brjod pa 8yin/ /dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig la/ /snrubs ni sgrub par byed pa yin/ /tshes gnyis bol ni chu stod yin/ /tshes gsum la ni chu smad yin/ /tshes bzhi la ni byi bzhin te/ /66—534

tshes ༅lnga la ni gro bzhin no/ /tshes drug la ni mon gru geste/ /tshes bdun la ni mon gre yin/ /tshes brgyad la gyini khrums stod yin/ /tshes dgu la ni khrums smad yin/ /tshes bcu la ni nam gru ste/ /tshes bcu gcig la tha skar yin/ /tshes bcu gnyis la bra nye ste/ /tshes bcu gsum la smin drug yin/ /tshes bcu bzhi la snar ma ste/ /tshes bco lnga la mgo yin no/ /de ni zla ba phyed yin te/ /zla ba yar gyi tshes gcig la/ /lag ni sgrub par byed pa yin/ /tshes gnyis la ni nabate④so yin/ /tshes gsum la ni rgyal yin no/ /tshes bzhi la ni skag yin nol/ /tshes lnga la ni mchu yin no/ /tshes drug la ni gre yin no/ /tshes bdun la ni dbo yin te/ /tshes brgyad la ni me bzhi yin/ /tshes dgu la ni nag pa ste/ /tshes bcu la ni sa ri yin/ /tshes bcu gcig la sa ga ste/ /tshes bcu gnyis la lha mtshams yin/ /tshes bcu gsum la snron yin te/ /tshes bcu bzhi la snrubs yin no/ /zla nya'i zla bar chu stod yin/ /bdag gis dbyar 'bring rim brjod bya//byang phyogs bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor bltas she/ /nyi ma yongs su 'khor bar byed/ /nyin par yud tsam bcu bdun te/ /mtshan mo yang ni bcu gsum yin/ /snron gyis kyang rinani mtshan mo 'thobaci / / nyin par 3)bcas na nab 9so yin/ /grib tshod gom pa gnyis yin te/ /nyi ma yongs su 'khor bar byed/ /zla ba zhes bya zhing yin te/ /lag dang yang dag ldan hu )pa yin/ /'di khyim sbal pa zhes bya ba//zla ba dgu par bshad pa yin/ /dbyar zla tha chungs 31mar ngo yi/ /tshes gcig la ni chu smad sgrub/ /tshes gnyis byi bzhin gro bzhin te/ /tshes gsum la ni mon gru / yin/ /tshes bzhi la ni mon gre ste/ /tshes lnga la ni khrums stod yin/ /tshes drug la ni khrums smad yin/ /tshes nyurtabadun la ni nam gru ste/ /tshes brgyad la ni 66—535

tha skar yin/ /tshes dgu la ni bra nye ste/ /tshes bcu la ni smin drug yin/ /tshes bcu gcig la snar ma yin/ /tshes bcu gnyis la mgo yin no/ /tshes bcu gsum la lag yin no/ /tshes bcu bzhi la nab0)so yin/ /tshes bco lnga la rgyal yin te/ /de ni zla ba phyed yin no/ /zla ba yar ga gyi tshes gcig la/ /skag ni sgrub par byed pa yin/ /tshes gnyis la ni mchu yin no/ /tshes gsum la ni gre yin te/ /tshes bzhi la ni dbo yin no/ /tshes lnga la ni me bzhi ste/ /tshes drug la ni nag pa yin/ /tshes bdun la ni sa ri ste(mi/ /tshes brgyad la ni sa ga yin/ /tshes dgu la ni lha mtshams te / /tshes bcu la ni snron yin no/ /tshes bcu gcig la snrubs yin te/ /tshes bcu gnyis la chu stod yin/ /tshes bcu gsum la chu 45rismad yin/ /tshes bcu bzhi la byi bzhin te/ /zla ba rangs la gro bzhin no / /bdag gis dbyar tha'i rim 6)brjod bya/ /de bzhin byang gi phyogs su ni/ /nyi ma gdong phyed bltas 7༄te 'khor/ /nyin par bco brgyad thob nas kyang / /mtshan mo yang ni bcu gnyis te/ /chu stod kyis ni mtshan mo 'thobame/ /nyi ma'i mdun ༄9non mchu yin no/ /grib tshod gom pa phyed yin te/ /nyi ma yongs su 'khor bar byed/ /'dir zhing nyi ma ldan pa yin/ /sas hu shākyang gzer ni gtong bar byed/ /'dir khyim seng ger shes par gyis/ /zla77ba bcu po bshad pa yin / /ston zla ra ba mar gyi ngo'i/ /dang por tshes gcig mon gru hu sgrub/ /tshes gnyis 12la ni mon gre ste/ /tshes gsum la ni khrums stod yin/ /tshes bzhi la ni khrums smad yin/ /tshes lnga la ni nam gru ste/ /tshes drug la ni tha skar yin//tshes bdun la ni bra nye ste/ /tshes brgyad gel ni smin drug yin/ /tshes dgu la ni snar ma stobe/ /tshes bcu la ni mgo yin no/ /tshes bcu gcig la lag yin te/ /66wa 536
