tshes bcu gnyis la nab so yin/ /tshes bcu gsum la rgyal yin te/ /tshes bcu bzhi la skag yin no/ /tshes bco lnga la mchu yin te/ /de ni zla ba phyed yin no/ /zla ba yar gyi tshes gcig la/ /gre ni sgrub par byed pa ste/ /tshes gnyis la ni dbo yin no/ /tshes gsum la ni me bzhi ste/ /tshes bzhi la ni nag pa yin/ /tshes lnga la ni sa ri ste/ /tshes drug la ni sa ga yin/ /tshes bdun la ni lha mtshams te/ /tshes brgyad la ni snron yin no/ /tshes dgu la ni snrubs yin te/ /tshes bcu la ni chu stod yin/ /tshes bcu gcig la chu smad yin/ /gro bzhin byi nyubazhin tshes bcu gnyis/ /tshes bcu gsum la mon gru tsho ste/ /tshes bcu bzhi la mon gre yin/ /zla ba nya ba'i zla rangs la/ /khrums stod ces ni bya ba yin/ /bdag gis ston zla ra rim brjod/ /lho phyogs nyi ma'i 'khor lo ldog /nyin par yang ni bcu bdun te / /mtshan mo yang ni bcu gsum yin/ /gro bzhin gyis kyang mtshan mo 'thob④/ /nyi ma'i mdun na gre yin te/ /grib tshod dag kyang gom pa gnyis/ /nyi ma yongs su 'khor bar byed/ /zla bu gza' lhag ces bya ba/ /der ni zhing la yang dag gnas/ /der khyim bu mo bzhag pa ste/ /zla ba bcu gcig bdag gis dubashad/ /ston zla 'bring po'i zhimar gyi ngo'i/ /dang por7tshes gcig khrums smad sgrub/ /tshes gnyis la ni nam gru ste/ /tshes gsum la ni tha skar yin/ /tshes bzhi la ni bra nye ste/ /tshes lnga la ni smin drug yin/ /tshes drug la ni snar ma ste/ /tshes bdun la ni mgo yin no/ /tshes brgyad la ni lag yin te/ /tshes dgu la ni nab so yin/ /tshes bcu la ni rgyal yin te/ /tshes bcu gcig la skag yin no/ /tshes bcu gnyis la mchu yin te/ /tshes bcu gsum la gre yin no/ /tshes bcu bzhi la dbo yin te/ /tshes bco lnga la me bzhi 66—537

yin / /de ni zla ba phyed yin te/ /zla yar tshes gcig nag pa sgrub/ /tshes gnyis la ni sa ri ste/ /tshes gsum la ni sa ga yin/ /tshes bzhi la ni lha mtshams 41)te/ /tshes lnga la ni snron yin no/ /tshes drug la ni snrubs yin te/ /tshes bdun la ni chu stod yin/ /tshes brgyad la ni chu smad yin/ /tshes dgur byi bzhin gro bzhin te/ /tshes bcu la ni mon grupha yin/ /tshes bcu gcig la mon gre yin/ /tshes bcu gnyis la khrums stod yin/ /tshes bcu gsum la khrums smad yin/ /tshes bcu bzhi la nam gru ste/ /zla rangs nya tshe tha skar yin/ /de ni zla ba phyed yin te/ /ston zla 'bring po'i ngo la ni/ /lo skor sa bdag gis brjod par bya/ / lho yi 4phyogs su kha bltas rigete/ /nyi ma yongs su 'khor bar byed / /nyin par bcu drug 'gro byed cing / /mtshan mo yang ni bcu bzhi yin/ /khrums stod kyis ni mtshan mo 'thobane / /nyi ma'i mdun na nag pa yin/ /grib thotshod dag ni gom bzhi ste/ /nyi ma ri yongs su 'khor bar byed/ /lha min bla ma pa ba sangs/ /gza' ni zhing la rnam par gzhag /'dir khyim srang zhes bya ba bzhag /zla ba bcu gnyis bshad pa yin/ /yongs su 'khor ba de yis ni/ /lo ni de ltar 'gro bar byed/ /mig stong yang dang yang du ni/ /'dus te chos kyi phyogs la ltos/ /khyod ni shes rab gzhis 'oyin na/ /chos ma yin pa'ang bzlog 1 par gyis/ /chos gnas tshul khrims phun sum tshogs/ /thos phyug mkhas pa bsam gtan pa/ /de dag khyod kyis chos gos dang / / bza' btung 3 nyarnams kyis rjes su srungs/ /yang dag gnas te brgyarwa byin gyis/ /rnga bong la ni thal sbyar nas/ /rab tu smras pa bdag cag gis/ /bya ba yang ni bsgo nyu bar gyis / /smras pa/ lha yi 1 bla ma khyod kyis su/ /rtag par tshangs par spyod pa 66wa 538

srungs / /rigatshanya)sngags sman dang gsang sngags rnams/ /thams cad la ni bya ba sgrubs / /las kun drang srong zla ba dang / /zla ba chung dang zhag dang bzhin/ / bzo yi〈khulas kyi mtha' kun la/ /gtso bo yin par bkod pa yin/ /drag po dung gi sna can dang / /dgon pa dang ni lci ba ste/ /gnod sbyin bzhi po de dag ni / /mchod snisbyin rib mar gtso bor bkod kyi/ /rgya mtsho chu lha 'jog po dang / /rin chen skyong dang ring du 'gro/ /sa yid tshes 37dang zla srungs nadang / /gnas thar byed pa rgya mtsho ni/ /gtso bor 9gzhag ste 3 ma dros dang / /khab kyis 11lus 'bigs hu chu lhas byin/ /ri dgas 'khrugs 3 pa klu de bzhi/ /klu rnams kyi 1 ni gtso bor bkodam/ /khyod ni dge ba rab skyed 7pa/ /ne tso yi ni khyab byed pa//mkhas pa zhing gi gtso bo ste/ /de 'dra ba ni ji lta bu/ /khyod ni snying po kho nas kyang ske/ /me yi rtse hu mo'i gtso bo ste/ /khyod ni rlung dmar 'gul g.yo 3 ba/ /rlung yang ba yi gtso bo yin/ /rdo rje'i mig dang seng ge'i mig /legs mthong lag na mdung gsum thogs/ /lha mo bzhi po de dag ni/ /grong khyer gtso bor bkod 37pa yin/ /gong ma'i char skyes rtsibs mu khyud/ /'khor lo spen pa gnod sbyin bzhi/ /de dag rin chen brtags pa la/ /nyo tshong byed pa'i gtso bor bkodadu 1ske/ /phyogs mtshams su ni bzhi yin te/ /bsrung ba'i phyir ni yang dag gnas / /yul 'khor grong khyer thams cad du/ /bsrung 22ba'i phyir ni 'byung po bkod / /drang srong dag ni thams cad dang / /lha yi tshogs dang klu rnams dang ske/ /lha ma yin dang mi rnams kyi/ /bar 2 yang rjes su yi rang byed/ /lung bstan rab tu rgyal ba mchog / thub pa 24yi ni gtso bo ste lha/ /khyod ni skye dang 'gag pa dang / /zas dang ro dang me tog mchog /khyod ni dri 'phel byed pa 66wa 539

ste / /shu dag rdzogs byed 'bras bu'i mchog /khyod ni lam bde skyed pa ste/ /rnam nyu)par 'tshetshan/las rgyal ba'i gtso no/ /dga' bo dang ni nye dga' gnyis/ /ri bo rnams kyi gtso bor bkod/ /nor rgyas bu dang thang shing zhing / /lci mchog mig dmar smugs byed skem/ /khyod ni dbyangs can chu yi gtso/ /khyod ni grubasnyidang yid 'phrog pa/ /zla ba 'phrog par byed pa ste/ /bcud kyi ④len gyi gtsosnyibo yin/ /gza' dang rgyu skar dus kyang yin/ /khyim rnamasadzothams cad rnam par gzhag /rgyal po chen po bzhi yang ni/ /skal ldan rgyur sheni rnam par gzhag /lus ngan gnod sbyin rnams kyi gtso/ /grul bum rnams kyi 'phags skyes po/ /klu rnams kyi ni mig mi bzang / /dri za rnams kyi yul 'khor srung / /thams cad kyi gling chen po bzhi/ /gling gzhan brgyad khri ④thams cad du/ /drang srong rnga bong gis gang yongs su skyong ba ma bkod par btang skyeba'i gnas ci yang med do31/ /der 32lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang legs so zhes bya ba byas par gyur to/ /drang 3nyesrong rnga bong gi bya ba de la yang dag par rjes su yi skorang bar gyur to/ /bya ba de ni mchod pa dang / rim gro bya bar so sor gnas par gyur to/ /de'i rjes la shin tu yun ring zhig na drang srong thub pa lam zhes bya ba byung ste/ des kyang skar ma'i dpyad rab tu byas so/ /zhag gis mi thub pa dang / shol yod pa yang bshad do/ /yang de'i tshe drang srong thub pa'i gnas rten ga la bar klu thams cad 'dus te/ de dag drang srong skar ma la dga' ba mchog tu bla ma la gus pa dang gces gepar byed pa skyes te/ de la mchod pa'i las bya ba'i phyir ci nus su 66wa 540

brtson par gyur to/ /'phags pa 'dus pa chen po'i sde theg pa chen po'i mdo las nyi ma'i snying po'i le'u bcu gcig pa rdzogs te// rgyu skar gyi sbyor ba rnam par gzhag pa'i le'u ste bdun pa 42rdzogs so// //'phags pa shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i sde nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba'i mdo/bam po bcu gcig pa/ rgya mtshos smras pa/ nam mkha' la ni rgyu skar tshogs/ /ji ltar bzhag pa bzhin du ni/ /khyod kyis sne sngon gyi tshe rabs dran/ /mkhas khyod srid gsum kun gyi gtsoge/ /khyod kyi snying rje byams pa dper/ /shes gsal 'gro la snying brtse bzhin/ /kun dpal 'di nas khyod kyis ni/ /lag 'gro thams cad thar bar gyis/ /srid gsum tshul brtulas5)mtshungs med khyod/ /lag 'gro de kun tshim byed khyod/ /khyod ni drang srong kun gyi bla/ /mi rnams kyis ni mchod par 'os/ /'gro ba kun dpal khyod la ni/ /lha dang lag ne 'gro gnod sbyin tshogs/ /rten gyi yul rnams thams cad pa/ /lag 'gro myur du thar bar gyis/ /de nas drang srong skar ma la dga' ba dkon mchog gsum la mchog tu yid dang ba 3bskyed par 'dod nas de lta bu'i klu'i tshogs thams cad la shin tu rigs pa'i tshig rin snyan pa dag gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /yon tan de 'dras bdag la med/ /drang srong rnga bong bdag ma yin/ /khyed cag 'di nas thar byed par/ /bdag gis 1 snanas pa ma yin no/ /gang gis bskal pa du mar ni/ /dka' thub dka' ba bzod pa 11spyad/ /khyod cag thar bar byed pa yi/2—/ /drang srong gzhan de blta bar gyis/ /rtag tu brtson zhing sbyin pa byin/ /mkhas shing glang chen rta dang ni/ /shing rta bu dang chung ma dang / /nor gyis 66—541

sems can phan pa 17byas/ /rkang lag mgo dang rna ba dang / /mig dang pagasam mipa khrag dang ni/ /bu bran bran mo bza' btung mang / /mal cha kha zas sngon chad btang / /snying rje dang ni byams pa yis/ /khyed cag thar byed srid gsum na / /mtshungs med bsam gtan dga' 'byung ba/ /de ni drang srong rnga bong ste/ /kun tu brtse zhing byang chub sems/ /sngon chad rig byed pha rol phyin/ /sems can mang po sdug bsngal gyis/ /nyam thag pa ni thar bar byas/ /sems can gegacig gi 5ched du yang / /sngon gyi tshe rabs de bskal par/ /dmyal bar 'gro bzod de yi dgas/ /de ni 'jig rten sangs rgyas byung / /sems can sdug bsngal nyam 6thag kun/ /sdug bsngal mthar mdzad rnga bong yin/ /sems can sman 7phyir brtson 'grus dang / /snying rje brtan stan)pos de srid 'khor/ /rnga bong de ni skyes pa na/ /rgyal sras bu ram shing ba yi/ /rigs su zas gtsang gi ni sras / /des ni btsas nyam thag tu khyab/ /srid gsum bde 'byung 'jig rten dpal / /yid bde rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /lha dang klu yi 1 ribu rnams dang / /'byung po gnod sbyin rgyal pos khyab/ /der ni mchod phyir thams cad lhags/ / de yis gom nyu1pa bdun bor te/ /ri dang rgya mtshor bcas pa yi sa ni thams cad 'khrugs par gyur12/ /'gro ba rga nyurtend sdug bsngal dang / /'chi bas gzir las ngas 14bsgral zhing / /zhi ba bde ba mya ngan med/ /skam la dgod ces shāka sras gsungs/ /me tog dri dang rin chen dag /lha klu rnams kyis gtor gyur cing / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams 8sna tshogs kyis/ /sras po la ni bstod 7gyur pa/ /bskal pa mang po du mar yang / /sngon chad khyod kyis dul ba dang / /sbyin dang bsam gtan dgyes la brtenahurte/ /sems can kun ched 66—542

sdug bsngal bzod/ /'di la skye ba 'di yang ni/ /thams cad kyi ni tha ma lags / /sdug bsngal thams cad zhi mdzad par/ /ring por 1mi thogs khyod 'tshang rgya/ /des kyang dpa' bo brtanatshan par gyur/ /mtshungs pa med de bud med tshogs/ /drug khri77tham pa spangs nas su/ /spyod pa rab bstan la lo drug spyad(ge / /g.yo sgyu can ni sder bcas pa'i/ /bdud ni gcig pus 6bcom nas kyang ske/ /byang chub zhi mchog gzhal med brnyes/ /mya ngan med lam don dam gzigs / /byams dang ye shes thugs rje yis/ /sems can kun dang mi mnyam zhing ske/ /'byung po dag ni thams cad la/ /de ni byams pa'i thugs mnyam pa/ /sems can gang la'ang mtho (7)mi 'tshamadun / /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las / /thar bar mdzad cing de yang ni/ /rnam bcings btson 49cir thar mdzad 1 pa / /ma ga dhā 1ston de gnas shing / /'gro ba'i nang na chos kyang ston/ /de la khyod kyis gsol ba thob/ /byams pa'i yid kyis rnam par ltos/ /drang srong mchog gi thad du deng hurte/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las/ /khyed cag yongs su thar bar byed/ /rang nyid kyang ni 'dong bar 3)gyis/ /dga' mchog bde ba 'dodam rnams kyis/ /phyin cad 'amakha' lding thams cad las/ /'jigs pa khyed la mi 'byung ngo / /rtag bde sdug bsngal 'bral dgar nya gyis/ /btson 3nyer 'di ni0)g.yo sgyu can/ /bdud ni khyed la rnam par 'tshe/ /ji ltar nga yis bshad pa bzhin/ /thams cad kyang ni gzung bar gyis/ /yang de'i tshe drang srong thub pa'i gnas rten du klu dang / klu chen po pho dang / mo dang /khye'u dang / bu mo gang dag thams cad 'dus pa de dag thams cad kyis thal mo rab tu sbyar te 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jig rten thams cad las khyad par du 66wa 543

'phags pa/ chos thams cad kyi dbang gi nya1pha rol tu phyin pa/ sems can thams cad kyi bsdug bsngal sel bar mdzad pa/ bde ba thams cad sbyin par mdzad paX/ dga' ba thams cad skyed par mdzad pa/ shes rab thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ rtag tu byams pa'i thugs dang ldan pa/ thugs rje thams cad kyis khyab pa/ phrin calas thams cad sgrub par mdzad pa/ lam thams cad ston pa/ yang dag pa'i mig gsung ba/ lha dang klu rnams kyis mchod pa la phyag 'tshal lor/ /srid pa gsum gyi gyedagra bcom pa/ mchod pa thams cad 'os pa / bdag cag thams cad sdug bsngal gyi btson riger 'dir 'phangs lags na 'di nas bdag cag thar bar mdzad par gsol/ klu de dag dang lhan cig bdag cag gnas par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis klu de dag thams cad sngon gyi lus kyi gzugs ji lta ba bzhin du bkod de/ gnas de nas 'gro bar ma 9nus so/ /de dag thams cad kyis nyu ridrang srong skar ma la dga' ba la smras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa de ni bden te/ sems can thams cad la bde bar bzhed pa rnam par mi 'tshe 11ba'i chos nyid yin no/ /de la bdag cag skyabs su nye bar gnas so/ /'di nas myur du bzhud cig /bdud kyi 'ching ba 'di las bdag cag thar bar mdzod cig /skar ma la dga' bas 'di skad ces smras so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa drang srong sems can thams cad hu la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir snying rje chen po'i rgyu 'thun pa thams cad mkhyen pa thub pa des byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rnam par ldog nyu par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi lam rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir dang / rgyu dang 'bras bu'i sems can yang dag par bstan pa'i 〉phyir 66—544

zhes bya ba nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyi bar du thob par bya ba'i phyir mang por ma byung ba la dmigs pa dang / nyan thos dang thun mong tib sems can la dmigs pa'i gnas pa mchog bstan na)to/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po slob dpon la rag risalas pa rnams la rgyu las yang dag par byung 5ba dang / so sor brtags 6)pa la dmigs pa tshangs pa'i gnas pa bstan to/ /da rtso)ltar de bzhin gshegs pa de ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed grangs med pa dpag tu med pa rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed na theg pa bla na med pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgralam ba'i phyir dang / bdud bzhi gdul 9ba'i phyir dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyun mi gcadam pa'i phyir chos kyi chus khrus mdzad do/ /da ltar shin tu kun tu rtog pa'i57nyon mongs pa'i tshogs kyi sems can gyi khams la dmigs pa med pa/ kun nas ldang ba med pa/ rgyu ba med pa/ gzhi 32med pa/ mtshan nyid med pa/ mtshan ma med pa/ chags pa med pa/ rnam par gzhag pa med pa / rdul med pa/ mun pa med pa/ snang ba med pa/ gzung ba med pa/gsal byed med pa/ spyod pa med pa/ tha mi dad pa nyid ces bya ba nas phung po dang ske/ khams dang / skye mched dang / 'byung ba chen po thams cad dang /mig gi rang bzhin tshor ba po med pa'i sred pa zhes bya ba'i bar nas/ yid kyi rang bzhin tshor ba po med pa'i sred pa'i bar la smon pa med pa dang / mngon par 'du byed pa med pa dang / 'jug pa med pa'i chos kyi dbyings dang /yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / 'gag pa med pa dang / de bzhin nyid 'dres pa 66wa 545

med pa dang / gang 'jug pa med pa'i chos kyi dbyings don dam pa stong pa nyid dang ske/ phyir mi ldog pa'i chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyis sgrol ba/ phyadamanyu)pa'i ye shes kyi spyod pa dang ldan pa/ yang dag par dmigs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'di nani byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi spyod pa dag la yongs su sbyang ba (byas pa/ sems nam mkha' dang mnyam zhing mtshungs pa/ ma chags pa'i ye shes mnyam pa nyid thob pa/ lta ba thams cad kyi bag chags kyi nyon mongs pa yang dag par bcom pa rnams la tshangs pa'i gnas pa dmigs pa med pa ston to/ /kye drang srong skar ma la rtsonodaga' bas bstan pa 'di bshad pa na yang klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho dang / klu'i rgyal po lus 'bigs pa'i khab ces bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po zla ba la rtsub rigepa zhes bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po rin chen skyong zhes bya ba de dag byang chub kyi spyod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba sngon bsags pa'i smon lam yang dag par rjes su dran pas de dag snang ba dang / rnam par bsgyings pa dang ldan pa'i gzungs thob par gyur ribato/ /de'i tshe klu gzhan brgyad cu 7rtsa bzhi ni byang chub kyi spyod pa'i dge ba'i gnyertsa ba sngon bsags pa'i smon lam yang dag par rjes su dran pas byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' skar ma la dga' ba la de dag gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyod bzhud la snying rje chen po thob pa gang gis 'dir bdag cag bdud kyi 'ching sherab 'di las yongs su thar bar bgyid 1 pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po thob pa de la bdag cag gi tshig gis gsol ba thob shig11 /de bzhin du bya'o zhes smras nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skar ma la dga' ba nyi drang srong gi cha byad kyis 66—546

'khor drang srong stong phrag mang po dang 17de nas rdzu 'phrul gyis na/song ngo / /'phags pa 'dus pa chen po'i sde /theg pa chen po'i mdo las nyi ma'i snying po'i le'u bcu gcig pa 4rilas 5)brgyad pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das la klu thams cad skyabs su nye bar gnas pa bdud sdig can gyis thos te/ shas cher 'khrugs shing skrag la rgya shug gi 'dab ma bzhin du lus rab tu 'dar zhing 5)lus rngul nas lag pa gnyis bsgreng ste 7'di skad ces smras so/ /lag 'gro rnams ni skyabs su dong 8/ /skye dgu thams cad rmongs gyur cing / /'chi ri9med lam la gzhog byed pa/ /mi zad 1 g.yo sgyu 11can la ltos / /de'i tshe na bdud kyi bu mo 3 mun bral ma zhes bya ba des 'di skad ces smras so/ /sems can gang dag thos tsam gyis/ /dge sbyong la ni skyabs su mchis12 / /gang dag de yi nyanatshig thos shing / /de mthong ba lta smos 35ci 'tshal/ /brtson 'grus sna tshogs sbyor ba yis/ /khyod kyis sayun ni ring du gzigs/ /bka' mchid sna tshogs lhan cig mdzad/ / de yi sgyu nya ni ma bslabs nya rmesam/ /bdud kyis slar smras pa/ dge sbyong gau 19tam brtan pa yin/ /rang bzhin mkhas pa chen po ste/ /stong pa'i chos la yang dag zhugs/ /rgal nas skye dgu sgral〈skrebar byed/ /mun bral mas smras pa/ stong pa la ni gang zhugs pa/ /bdud rnams bye bas mi bskyod na de/ /byang grol bde ba sbyin bgyid na pa/ /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /mtshan nyid ma mchis ldan pa yi byu/ /de bzhin nyid la gang rten cing / /ye shes kyi ni pha rol phyin/ /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchis / /sgyu de bdag gis bslab par bgyi/ /sems can thams cad rnam par 66wa 547

dgrol / /chos rnams kun la dbang sgyur 517ba'i/ /bla med sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /bdud kyi bu mo lnga brgya snyed bdud kyi gnas der 'khod nas byang chub tu smon lam btab par gyur rten/ bdud sdig can shas cher 'khrugs shing dngangs te rmongs rinas stobs kyi shugs kyis 'chag saratswazhugs te/ bdud kyi stobs kyi shugs kyi 55 cho 'phrul gyis byin gyis 56)brlab pa de lta bu byin gyis brlabs so / /gang gis drang srong skar ma la dga' ba de nas song nas ring po nam lon par drang srong thub pa'i gnas rten der bdud kyi gnas de nas nam mkha' las rdo'i char pa me rab tu 'bar ba'i char mngon par rab tu dbab par brtsams te/ klu thams cad thal bar rlag ⑨par 'dod na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mthus der me tog gi char rnam pa sna tshogs rab tu bab ste7/ klu thams cad rab tu dga' bar gyur to/ /dga' khyab mas smras pa/ kye bdud kyi bu mo dag khyed 1 ltos shig /'dzam bu'i gling der dge sbyong gi 32ta ma la klu gang dag skyabs su dong ba de dag thams cad kyang 'di nya sdug bsngal mang pos gnod par byed na gang dag 'dir 'khod nas dge sbyong gau nyu ta ma la skyabs su dong ba rang gi bu mo khyed la lta smos lokyang ci dgos/ bdud kyi bu mos 'di skad ces smras so/ /sangs rgyas skyeskyabs su sems can su 'gro ba/ /bdud rnams bye bas gsadarwartepar mi nus te/ /tshul khrims nyams shing blo ni 'khrugs zin kyang / /de ni nges par skye ba'i pha rol 'gro/ /ston pa la ni me tog gcig gtor zhing / /byang chub smon lam brtan po bskyed sna ripas na/ /de ni bdud rnams du mas gsad hu'emi nus/ /nem nur med par 'jig rten sangs rgyas 'gyur/ / de yis bslab sum̐ byepa'i gzhi 21ni gcig blangs shing / /tshig gi don gcig tsam yang nyan byed la(rte/ /66wa 548

byang chub phyir ni sems kyang bskyed pa de/ /sems can kha lo sgyur 'gyur nem nur med/ /yab klu tshogs 'di mthong ste sangs rgyas kyis/ /der ni ①me tog char pa sna tshogs 'bebs/ /sangs rgyas yul gcig gis ni khyod la bsngos ge/ /der ni ci yang nus par ma gyur tong bye/ /gang gis sems can de dag sdig zad cing ske/ /bdag cag gi ni las kyi sgrib 'byang ba/ /ched du lung bstan pa ni der nyan pa'i/ /rig pa gcig kyang der ni ston pas gsungs/ /de nas bdud sdig can shas bacher 'khrugs shing gshe ste/ sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde ba skyes nas mya ngan gyi khang par gcig pu 'dug go/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skar ma la dga' ba bcom ldan 'das kyi 2tshangs pa'i gnas pa dmigs pa med pa'i gtam gyi tha mar mjug 6thogs su bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa der phyin te 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das ga la ba zhes bya ba nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skar ma la dga' bas 'di skad ces gsol to zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bzhi pa rab kyi mtha' gnas yid la bgyid pa'i gzungs 7 sngags bshad par gsol/ gzungs gesngags kyi gzhi de dag 9gis ni sngon bdag cag gnyis bram ze'i khye'u gnyis su gyur pa na lus kyi slad du rgyal po rgyal gyi lha la nongs pa bgyis pas 'gum pa la thug ste btson sna rar stsal nas/ zla ba phyed zas dang bral zhing bcing ba hu1lngas bcings nas de bzhin gshegs pa man dā 32ra ba'i bsung tsho/snyel yid la gzhan mi sems par gsol ba btab pa lags so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa man dā nyuster ba'i bsung bebadag cag la thugs brtse bas rang gi husteganas kyi shul kur nyu tshobazhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 66—549

'phrul lung bstan pa de lta bus bzhi pa rab kyi mtha' gnas yid la bgyid pa'i gzungs 1)sngags bstan te rje / sangs rgyas kyi mthus brtsonas ra der bdag cag gi rna lam du don dang bcas/ tshig 'bru dang bcas par grags so/ /gsang sngags yid la bgyid pa de dag gis bdag cag dga' ba dang dad pa yang dag par bskyed nas de'i tshe bdag cag gi mthong ba'i chos la myong bar 'gyur ba thams cad dang / skyes nas myong bar 'gyur ba dang / lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba thams cad dang / las kyi sgrib pa thams cad dang / nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / chos kyi sgrib pa dang / sems can gyi sgrib pa dang /sbyin pa'i sgrib pa zhes bgyi ba nas shes rab kyi sgrib pa zhes bya ba'i bar dang /nye bar spyod pa dang / longs paspyod kyi sgrib pa dang / tshe'i 'du byed bas pa'i sgrib pa dang / bsams 6bzhin du srid par skye ba'i sgrib pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa rnams su 'gro ba'i sgrib ༅pa yongs su bas shing / der bdag cag bzhi pa rab kyi mtha' gnas yid la bgyid pa'i gzungs sngags thos pa tsam gyis na mod la mgrin pa 'ching ba lnga las grol te/ btson ④ra nas rdzu 'phrul gyi yul thob par gyur cing / de nas nam mkha' la chas hu snanas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa man dā hunyar ba'i bsung 1rtegi thad du nye bar ྅rtephyin to/ /de nas shi 'phos nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing ri bo'i 'od ces bgyi bar skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sprin gyi mdog gi thad du rab tu byung nas zhes bgyi ba nas slan chad bskal pa dpag tu ma mchis par sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong nya pa rnams su bdag cag ma skyes so zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /de bzhin du da ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed 8thams cad du 'di dang 'og min 66—550

la thug pa'i bar gyis thams cad sems can mi dang mi ma lags pa dpag tu ma mchis pas khyab ste/ de dag ni las kyi sgrib pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i tsho sgrib pa dang / chos kyi sgrib pa dang / sems can gyi sgrib pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis rinazin to zhes bgyi ba nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa rnams su las yongs su ma dag pa dag gis bsgribs 0te mchis par sami nus pa lags so zhes bgyi ba'i bar du'o/ /sems can gyi las kyi gzungs sngags thos ma thag tu sems can rnams kyi mthong ba'i chos la myong bar 'gyur ba dang /5 lan grangs gzhan la myong bar 'gyur ba dang / las kyi sgrib pa thams cad dang / nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / chos kyi sgrib pa dang / sems can gyi sgrib pa dang / sbyin pa'i sgrib pa zhes bgyi bam67nas shes rab kyi sgrib pa zhes bya ba'i 7bar dang / nye bar spyod pa dang / longs spyod kyi sgrib pa dang / dge ba na bcu'i las kyi lam gyi sgrib pa tshemachis pa thams cad dang / thos ma thag tu skye ba'i sgrib pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dag tu 'gro ba'i sgrib pa mchis pa thams cad yongs su bas par 'gyur ba dang / chos bstan pa des sems can rnams bzod pa dang ting nge 'dzin rnam pa sna tshogs thob par 'gyur ba dang / ji srid 'tsho 1 ba'i mtha'i 11bar du der 'chi ba'i hu dus bgyis nas sems can rnams ji ltar bsam pa bzhin du srid par skye ba len par rngo thogs 12par 'gyur ba dang / tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ba dang / rtag par rgyun du brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang ske/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag par len pa dang / log par mi ltung ba'i chos can rnams su 'gyur ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug la mngon par brtson pa dang / bsdu 1 ba'i dngos po bzhi la mngon par brtson pa dang /66—551

chos nyan pa dang / dge 'dun la rim gro bgyi ba dang / bsam gtan gyis rnam par rol pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / tshangs pa'i gnas pa sgom pa la mngon par brtson par 'gyur ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad du bla na med pa'i yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar du chos nyu)de dag dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur bar bcom ldan 'das da nasems can thams cad la thugs brtse du ba'i slad du btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bzhi pa rab kyi mtha' gnas yid la bgyid pa'i gzungs sngags de legs par bshad par gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu gang khyod skye bo mang po la phan pa'i phyir zhugs pa legs so legs so zhes bya ba nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa can su la la theg pa gsum las theg pa gang yang rung bas srid pa'i rgya mtsho las rgal bar 'dod pa ni myur du theg pa de yongs su rdzogs par bya bar 'dod pa yin la/ sdug bsngal thams cad 'joms par 'dod pa yin/thos pa thams cad kun tu 'dzin par 'dod pa yin/ lus dang / ngag dang /yid kyi gnas ngan len thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'dod pa yin/bstan pa bsrung 4bar 'dod pa yin/ snyan pa 'dod pa dang / rnyed pa dzwa'adod pa yin/ bza' ba 6dang btung 7)ba mang po 'dod pa dang / dbang phyug 'dod pa dang / gzugs 'dod pa dang / stobs 'dod pa dang /'khor 'dod pa dang / nor dang 'bru 'dod pa dang / thu bo 'dod pa dang /mi dang mi ma yin thams cad kyis mchod par 'os par 'dod pa yin/ rtag tu lus 'dod pa yin/ rtag tu lus dang / ngag dang yid kyis kun tu 66—552

gnod ①par 'dod pa yin zhing myur du bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang ske/ gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang /tshangs pa'i gnas pa dang / gzungasamasadang / bzod pa rnam pa sna tshogs bsgrub ②par 'dod pa yin no/ /de ltar yang las kyi sgrib pa cadang / nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa shas phyecher 'phangs pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis zhes bya ba nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par 'gro ba'i sgrib pa rnams kyis bsams 6bzhin du srid par skye ba blangs pa de'i bar gyis 77myur du dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam pa sna tshogs de lta bu de dag sgrub par mi nus te/ las kyi sgrib pa de lta bu de dag gis zin pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag de khrus byas te gos gtsang nam bgos shing / kha zas gtsang ma dang mal gtsang 3)ma der skyil mo krung 1 tshodam 'chags 11pas kyangal rung ste/ rjes su 'thun pa'i tshes brgyad la /lhasangs rgyas kyi sku'i gzugs yid la byed pas gzhan yid la mi sems par zhes bya ba nas las gzhan mi byed cing sems rnam par g.yengs pa ma yin pa'i bar gyis re shig tsomatshan gcig gam zhes bya ba nas mtshan bdun gyi bar du gnas par byed na des rang gi sku byad 15du sangs rgyas mthong ngo zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /gal te sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gzugs chung ngur rtog par byed na chung ngu kho nar mthong ngo / /yang na tshad med par rtog par 7byed na gzugs kyi sku tshad med pa yang dag par rjes su mthong ngo ske/ /des mtshan thog thag mtshan sum cu 3 tshom gnyis mthong ngo / /mtshan gang las kha dog sngon po'i 'od 'phro ba'i mtshan gcig po de nyid la yid kyis 1 /rjes su bltas /rtenas gsang sngags 'di dag brjod do/ /tarya thā/ bi 5 dzim bhu bi 21dzi ma bha/ ud pā da/ bya ya/ bi dzi ma bha/ sna ba ba 22ra a nu da ta thā tā bhū 2366wa 553

ta ko ṭi bi dzim 1nobha swā hā/ ji srid du des pakha dog sngon po'i 'od 'phro ba rnam par spel nas de dag byung ste/ rang gi mgo'i spyi bor zhugs pa de srid du des mtshan gcig la rnam par mi g.yeng ba'i yid kyi 45rjes su bltas nas5getshig 'di dag brjod cing mi skrag par bya/ mi dngang bar 65bya'o/ /rang gi lus la meramatsho dzornam par blta bar bya ste/ ji lta zhe na/ des kha dog sngon po'i 'od 'phro ba rang gi lus kyi yan lag dang nying lag thams cad du 'gro ba mthong nas rang gi lus thams cad rab tu 'bar bar mthong ngo zhes bya ba nas thal ba bzhin du mthong ngo zhes bya ba'i bar dang / phyogs bzhir rlung gis ma lus par khyer ④ba stong pa bzhin du mthong ngo zhes bya ba'i bar du ste/ phyogs thams cad du de la gzugs snang ba gang yang mi 'byung ba 'di 49)ni de'i thams cad sgrub pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu su la la sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa de lta bu'i bzhi pa rab kyi mtha' gnas yid la byed pa'i gzungs sngags shin tu bsgoms zhing 7mchod sbyin legs par byas la shin tu yid la byas na de'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad dang / nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / chos kyi sgrib pa zhes bya ba nas ma lus pa'i bar du yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /mtshams med pa'i las rnams dang / dam pa'i chos spangs pa rnams dang / 'phags pa la skur 11pa 'debs pa rnams ni ma gtogs so / /de 'dod na de ltar nyin mtshan gcig gis sangs rgyas kyi gsung thams cad dang / phyi rol pa'i bstan bcos 12thams cad dang / rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad dang / gzhan yang gang dag snyan dngags su byas pa rnams des the tshom 1 med par shin tu kun tu 1 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de nyin mtshan gcig gis bsam gtan bzhi dang / gong ma rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / tshangs pa'i 66wa 554

gnas pa bzhi ༅)dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms (gepar 'jug pa bzhi bsgom ri )par 'dod na 45des shin tu bsgoms 5pa yin no/ /de 'dod na skad cig gcig gis sems can thams cad kyi dus gsum gyi 'gro ba'i 'chi 'pho dang / skye ba dang sems kyi spyod pa rab tu shes par 'gyur ro/ /de 'dod na skad cig ri gcig gis nam mkha' thams cad rang gi lus sam(be/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'am/ brgya byin gyi bar ram/ tshangs pa'i bar ram / sred med kyi bu'i bar ram/ dbang phyug chen po'i bar ram/ rgyal chen bzhi'i bar ram/ 'khor los sgyur na ba'i bar ram/ chu'i bar ram/me'i bar ram/ sa'i bar gyis gang bar byed do/ /de 'dod na skad cig gcig gis nam mkha' thams cad me tog gi bar dang / rin po che'i phreng ba dang ske/ spos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang /ras bcos bu dang / chos gos dang / rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs kyi bar dag gis gang bar byed do/ /sus bzhi pa rab kyi mtha' gnas yid la byed pa sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa de lta bu shin tu bsgoms pa yin zhing shin tu 'dres 9 par byas la shin tu yid la byas pa yin pa de'i las tshad med pa de lta bu ma lus par byang bar 'gyur ro/ /de de ltar bsod nams dang / stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang /ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang / bzod pa dang / rnam par rol pa dang ske/ mngon par shes pa tshad med par 'gyur ro/ /des de ltar gang yang rung ba dag 1 7yongs su rdzogs par byas na myur du 'khor ba las rnam par thar bar 'gyur te/ mtshams med pa byed pa dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba dang /'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa rnams 11ni ma gtogs 12so/ / de lta nya yin 66wa 555

yang mtshams ha med pa byed pa dang / dam pa'i chos spong ba dang / 'phags pa la skur ②pa 'debs pa de yang bdun phrag bdun du bzhi pa rab kyi mtha' ⑧gnas yid la byed pa sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa 'di 'dir ji ltar bstan dupa bzhin sgom par byed na bdun phrag bdun po de 'das nas las kyi sgrib pa sum chalam zad cing lhag ma skyon med par ma lus par byang bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa rab kyi mtha' gnas yid la byed pa sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa sgom pa de lta bu de ni de ltar don che ba yin no/ /su la la bzhi pa rab kyi mtha' gnas yid la byed pa sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa 'di desaXltar thos pa tsam rna lam du thos na9)/ de la mi'am mi ma yin pa'i bar de nye bar brtags nas dad pa dang / dga' ba dang /mchog tu dga' ba skye'o/ /de btson tshor ra'i 'ching ba dam po las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /gang su dag sdug bsngal bar gyur pa'i sems can thams cad kyang sdug bsngal dag las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /longs spyod kyi sdug bsngal dang / chad pa dang / brdeg pa dang / g.yang spus dang / me dang /chu dang / dug dang / dgra thams cad dang / 'byung po thams cad dang /nad kyi 'jigs pa dang / gnas kyi 'jigs pa dang / rgyal po'i 'jigs pa dang zhes bya ba nas bran gyi 'jigs pa zhes bya ba'i bar dang / ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i 'jigs pa zhes bya ba'i bar las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /bde 'gror 'gro ba'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /su sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa de lta bu thos pa tsam rna lam du grags na de la nye bar brtags nas dad pa skyes tebla/ de ltar don che zhing phan yon che ba yin na su ji ltar bstan pa bzhin de bzhin du bsgomadzam pa lta 12smos kyang ci dgos/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na sngon yongs su 66—556

sbyang ba byas pa dkrigs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu 7rtsa drug ni sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin de thob du dpar gyur to/ /ji ltar sngar bshad pa bzhin du yon tan de dag dang yang ldan par gyur to/ /de'i tshe srog chags khrag khrig phrag brgyad cum )rtsa bzhi ni sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /de'i tshe sems can dpag yas pa kha cig ni mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor dang 'bras bu dang po la gnas par gyur to/ /kha cig cing)ni dgra bcom pa nyid kyi bar thob par gyur to/ /de'i tshe sems can dpag yas pa ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sngon ma bskyedapo)pa'i sems bskyed do/ /mun bral ma la sogs pa'i bdud kyi bu mo lnga brgya po de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi mthus bdud kyi gnas su 'khod rme bzhin sems yongs su sbyang ba'i 7sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i lung bstan pa 'di thams cad thos so/ /thos nas kyang bud med kyi dngos po mi snang bar gyur te skyes pa nyid thob bo/ /gang dag sngon yongs su sbyang ba 8byas pa de dag thams cad sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan par gyur to/ /ji skad bshad pa bzhin du yon tan de dag dang ldan par gyur to/ /de dag thams cad tshangs pa chen po'i cha byad du bdag nyid mngon par sprul nas tshangs pa chen po 9tshore re yang bye 13 ba brgya stong phrag mang pos71yongs nyi su bskor 1/cing bye ba brgya stong 1 phrag mang pos mdun gyis bltas skote/ sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa bye ba brgya phrag mang pos yongs su bskor nas de dag bdud kyi gnas bsam gyis mi khyab pa bkod pa nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du babs temi/ bcom ldan 'das de la lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dag 66—557

dang ske/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag dang / rin po che'i ras bcos bu dang / chos gos sna tshogs gtor cing mngon par gtor te/bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 17te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /'phags pa 'dus pa chen po nyi ma'i snying po'i le'u bcu gcig pa las sangs rgyas ②rjes su dran pa'i le'u ste dgu pa rdzogs sos// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skar ma la dga' ba la 'di skad ces bka'5bstsal to/ /rigs kyi bu lag 'gro'i tshogs thams cad kyi zhal ta byos shig ces bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa dang ske/ nyon mongs pa med pa'i sems kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyisasredus lags kyis 6gshegs shigaci /bcom ldan 'das gang khyod kyis mdzad pa mdzod cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu gang de bzhin gshegs pas lag 'gro'i las bstan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su 'byang ba lung bstan pa bshad pa rab tu bstan pa'i dus yin no/ /yang de'i tshe lha thams nasacad ces bya ba nas grul bum 9 thams cad ces bya ba'i bar dag me tog dang / spos dang / rin po che dang / ras bcos bu dang / chos gos dang ske/ rgyan dang / spud pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan gyi char pa dag rab tu 'bebs / shing sil snyan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi rol mo'i sgra 'byin pa la mi dang mi ma nyu1yin pa thams cad kyis bsngags pa'i yon tan gyis bstod 12nas bcom ldan 'das gdan las mngon par bzhengs te ri'i 66wa 558

rgyal po ri rab ga la bar byang phyogs su nye bar gshegs so/ /'dod pa na spyod pa dang / gzugs na spyod pa'i lha thams cad kyis kyang gang bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gyis mdun du bdar ga17cing byang chub nasems dpa'i dge 'dun gyis yongs su bskor te ri rab kyi rtse mor gshegs par bzhed par shes so//de ltar rig nas mi mjed gekyi bdag po tshangs pas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir rin po che sna bdun las byas pa ras bcos bu sna tshogs dang / lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i me tog bkram pa'i them skas sprul nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi them skas las gshegs par gsol/ lha'i bu gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi them skas tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i phye ma sna tshogs bkram pa dag sprul nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gi them skas rnams las gshegs par gsol/ lha'i bu 'phrul dgas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir lha rdzas kyi gser gyi them skas tsan dan sa mchog sna tshogs bkram 4pa sprul nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gi them skas 5rilas gshegs par gsol/ lha'i bu yongs su dga' ldan gyis dzibacom ldan 'das kyi phyir lha rdzas kyi bee drurya'i dumathem skas dus ri3kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i tsan dan gyi phye ma sna tshogs bkram pa sprul nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi shethem skas las gshegs par gsol/ lha'i bu rab 'thab 1 bral gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir lha rdzas kyi bai drurya'i them skas lha rdzas 31kyi phye ma sna tshogs bkram pa sprul nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 12'das bdag gi them skas las gshegs par gsol/ lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya nyidabyin gyis kyang bcom ldan 66—559

'das kyi phyir mu tig dmar po'i them skas lha rdzas kyi tsan dan gyi phye ma sna tshogs dang ske/ rin po che'i dra ba sna tshogs kyis yongs su khebs01pa sprul nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gi them skas las ②gshegs par gsol / rgyal po chen po gubazhis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir lha rdzas kyi rin po che 4rdo'i snying po las byas pa lha rdzas kyi ras bcos bu sna tshogs kyis rab tu khebs pa'i them skas de nyid sprul nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag 5gi 6them skas las ri rab kyi rtse mor gshegs par gsol/lha ma yin gyi dbang po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi phyir lha rdzas kyi spug gi them skas rinalha rdzas kyi dun gser gyi phye ma sna tshogs kyis yongs su spukhebs pa de nyid du 1 sprul nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gi them skas las ri rab kyi rtse mor gshegs par gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de dag la thugs brtse 31nas bdag nyid 'dun pas bdag dang 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas kyi sku drug 1 sprul nas sangs rgyas bdun po de dag lha'i dbang po dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po thams cad kyi mdun du nyan thos kyis nyunyemadun du bdar nyu cing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyis yongs su bskor nas bcom ldan 'das bkod pa chen po de lta bus ri rab kyi rtse mor gshegs so/ /sangs rgyas bdun po de dag mchog tu lhan ne lhang nger ri rab kyi rtse mo na bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi sku re re las 'od zer 'di lta bu byung ste/ dper na zla ba dang nyi ma bye skab phrag stong shar ba bzhin no/ /klu gang dag drang srong thub pa'i gnas rten du lhags pa tshade dag thams cad kyis de mthong nas ltad mor gyur te gcig la gcig dris pa/ snang ba chen po'i nang na rten nyu pa ri rab 66—560

kyi rtse mo la gnas pa bdun po de dag gartsogyo)las 'ongs/ dga' bo dang nye dga' gnyis kyisa'i1smras pa/ ri rab rtse la lha rnams lhan cig tshangs pa'i mdun min 'don pa 'di gnas pa/ kun mchog lha yi tshadabang phyug shin tu mkhas pa rnams kyi rig pa'i pha rol phyin/ /bdag cag la ni brtse rabs 'dir gnas dpal gyi gzi brjid kyis ni longs spyod byed/ / 'ching ba phyi rnams las thar bar byed kyis tso)kun kyang de la mgo bos phyag 'tshol cig /ma dros pas 'di skad ces smras so/ /de 'di ma yin 'di bdud sdig can 'gro gtso 'dod pa'i dbang phyug rdzu 'phrul can/ /khyed la snying brtse na ba yis bu dang skye bos yongs bskor tsho'adi ni gnas pa yis/ /'di ni gang zhig la la 'dod khams sdug bsngal bkres shing skom pa'i nad kyis 'jigathe dī /sems can de yang rab tu thar byed khyed cag myur du sdug bsngal rnams las thar bar byed/ / sa yi humadabang phyug gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /de lta nyugem yin 'dir rgyal lha dbang 'thab bral dga' ldan 'phrul dga' gzhan 'phrul ba/ /de dag khyed nyisal snying brtse 'ab yis ri la gnas shing klu yi tshogs la lta/ /bdag cag yongs su skyobs zhes kun gyis gsang mthor 8de dag la ni 'o dod bos/ /de dag rtag tu bde dang ldan pas khyed cag btson 8ra dag nas zhi bar byed/ /rgya mtshos smras pa/ de dag ma yin 'di ni lha dbang brgya byin tshogs bcas gzi brjid hu — lhang nge ba/ /de ni gling bzhi'i nang na chos dang ldan pa su yod brtse 32ba'i yid kyis blta/ /khyed cag thams cad byams pa'i yid du gyis la khro ba myur du dor bar gyis/ /de yis myur du lag 'gro thar〈rtebyed 'di nas 'jigs pa kun nas rmethar bar tsho nyabyed/ /shin tu brtan gyis (1smras pa/ de lta ma yin 'di kun gzugs brten ni/lha tshogs bsam 66—561

gtan bde ldan gzi brjid 1)can/ /sems can rnams kyi ched du drang srong 'dir 'dzegs 'khod nas brtse gebs phyogs rnams su/ /myur du srog chags rnams kyi 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi byed chos chu'i char pa 'bebs/ /lha yi yid kyis thams cad de la phyag 'tshol ('di nas bdag cag thar bar byed/ /klu lus 'bigs pa'i khab kyis 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di ni gzugs na brten ñtsa pa'i lha min bzhi po 'di kun bdud kyi 'byor pa yin/ /lus ngan skye'asnimachog bdud rtsi'i skom dang rgyu bar btags 46)pa 'di dag gnas pa nirmu/ /gnod sbyin sde dang bcas pas yongs bskor 8phyogs bzhi skyong byed sdig pa'i skye bo sgrol(9)/ /de dag gis ni bdag cag sems can lkugazhan mthong nyu1'di nas kyi myur du thar bar byed/ /klu rin chen skyong gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /de dag ma yin de nyugeni mgo bregs ngur smrig mgos can 'khod gepar snang ba yin/ /de dag la ni kun lta mthal mo sbyar 'khod skar ma'i nang na zla ba bzhin/ /bdun po de dag cher bsgrubs sna cibartul zhugs brtan pa mgo bregs dag gis mthong ba yin/ /ngur smrig gos bgos mtshan gyis rab brgyan 3she'agro ba kun gyis mchod par 'os par mthong / /klu lus 'bigs 17pa'i khab 2 cikyis 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di ni bdag nyid kyis kyang 'jig rten 'dren pa yin te nga la de ltar snang / /sems can rnams kyi mnyam gnyen 'gro ba skyob 3nepa sdug bsngal rgyasho rtematsho sel byed pa/ /gang dag lhan cig snang ba drang srong gzhan rnams kyang ni de yis sprul pa yin/ /bdag cag la ni brtse bas 'dir gnas khyed cag sdug bsngal rnams las thar bar byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ri rab kyi rtse mo de la bzhugs ma thag tu nirteri rab dpag tshad brgyad cu 24rtsa bzhir rduge'akhor brgya stong yod par gyur to/ /de 66wa 562

nas 'dod pa na spyod pa dang / gzugs na spyod pa'i lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi steng ①du lha rdzas kyi rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i khang pa brtsegs ( snapa 'og min gyi lha'i gnas la thugs —pa'i bar man chadas /sna tshogs pa/ blta na sdug pa/ dpag tshad brgya stong du mar 5spras pa de srid cig sprul te/ de ni bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las bya ba'i phyir lha rdzas kyi ras bcos bu dang /chos gos dang / rgyan dang / sbud nepa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang ske/ ba dan dang / spos dang / me tog sna tshogs kyis shin tu brgyan47par sprul pa yin no/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya 8 byin la bos te bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed ni nga tshodang ske/ sangs rgyas rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / nyan thos chen po rnams dang / drang srong rnams dang / bdud rnams dang / dbang che nya rdzobar grags pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa rnams kyis shin tu longs spyad 31zin to/ /de bzhin du da ltar ri rab 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis shin tu longs spyad /nyezin te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang / lha dbang che bar grags pa rnams kyis shin turwa longs spyad 0zin to/ /ri rab kyi rtse mo na gnas pa'i 'byung mipo khyed la phan pa dang bde bar gyur cig /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gal te bdag cag 34la thugs brtse tsho/rtebar mdzad na btsun pa bcom ldan 'das/bcom ldan 'das la phyag bgyi ba dang / bsnyen bkur bgyi ba dang / ri rab la longs spyad 38par bgyi ba'i slad du sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed 'di thams 66wa 563

cad na gal te yang gang su dag bdud dam/ brgya byin nam/ tshangs pa'am/lha'i dbang po'am/ klu'i dbang po'am/ gnod sbyin gyi dbang po'am dri za'i 1tshodabang po'am/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po'am/ nam mkha' lding gi dbang po'am / mi'am ci'i dbang po'am/ lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po'am sems can dbang che bar grags pa/ dbang che bar grags pa lha'i drang srong gi bar zhes bgyi ba nas mi'i drang srong gi bar de dag thams cad 'dir lhags par gyur na 'dir bdag cag la shas cher phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur lags so/ /der bcom ldan 'das bzhugs nas tshon 'dzum pa mdzad de/ de'i zhal gyi sgo nas 'od zer kha dog sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang /le brgan dang / shel gyi kha dog lta bu rnam pa ri —— sna tshogs byung ngo / /'od zer de dag gshegs nas bdud kyi gnas bye ba phrag brgya dang / brgya byin gyi gnas bye ba phrag brgya dang / tshangs pa'i gnas zhes bya ba nas lha'i dbang po thams cad kyi gnas dang / lha ma yin gyi gnas dang / drang srong gi gnas bye ba phrag brgya'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di ji snyed pa ge thams cad du 'od zer de dag zhugasalgesol/ /de dang de dag tu sems can dbang che bar grags pa dbang che bar grags pa bdud dam zhes bya ba nas drang srongapo)rnams zhes bya ba'i bar kyedu ming du btags 58)pa de dang de dag thams cad la shesarab tu go bar mdzad nas bdud ces bya ba nas drang srong zhes bya ba'i bar de dang de dag de nas chas te bcom ldan 'das ga la ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku drug po de dag ga la bar skad cig thang cig yud tsam cig gis 'dir ri rab kyi rtse mor 'khod do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 1 sprul pa dag rgyun bcad nas bka' stsal pa/ nga'i sangs rgyas kyi 66wa 564

zhing 'di na ①ri'i rgyal po ri rab bye ba phrag brgya ji snyed yod pa thams cad kyi nang na ri rab 'di ni mchog dang phul yin par ngas bshad de/ ri rab 'di ni 'dus pa chen po thams cad kyis longs spyod pa yin zhing ri rab thams cad kyi rgyal po yin no/ /de thos nas brgya /byin kau shi ka dang zhes bya ba nas mi mjed kyi bdag po 3)tshangs pa zhes bya ba'i bar mchog tu yid bde ba dang rangs pa skyes snyenoso / /bcom ldan 'das kyi mthus klu'i rgyal po chen po bzhi po de dag drang srong thub pa'i gnas rten 467de nas song ste/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho ni 'di nas lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du mjug sku/mas 'dug nas ri rab kyi rtse mo'i bar du de'i mgo bzhag ste 8bcom ldan 'das 'ba' zhig 9 la lta'o zhes bya ba nas klu'i rgyal po rin chen skyong zhes bya ba nub phyogs kyi zhes bya sna ba'i bar dang /klu'i rgyal po lus 'bigs /tshomapa'i khab ni byang phyogs kyi zhes bya ba'i bar dang /klu'i rgyal po zla ba la rtsub nyurtepa ni shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du mjug nyinam bzhag nas zhes bya ba nas ri rab kyi rtse mo'i bar du de'i mgo bzhag ste bcom ldan 'das 'ba' zhig sil lta'o zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /klu lhag ma khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dpag tu med pa de dag ni de nas 'dong bar ma mnus so/ /de dag thams cad kyis gsang bstod mide 'di skad ces smras hu 7so/ /btson ra 'di nas bdag cag yongs su bskyab par gsol/ yongs su thar bar nyusnyemadzad par gsol / klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' gnyis bcom ldan 'das ri rab kyi rtsepha/mo nas 'dir gshegs shing gnas rten 'dir bzhugs nas klu rnams la chos ston par 'gyur ro snyam ste/ de dag gnyi gas tri rdzoganas rten nas ri rab kyi rtse mo'i bar du de srid kyi rang gi lus sprul to/ /de nas brgya 31byin 'di snyam du 66wa 565

sems te/ klu de dag ni lus rtsub cing 'dus te reg na gdug7pa yin pas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi mthil midag ral bar ①gyur na mi rung ngo snyam nas / des lag 'gro'i 4lus lha rdzas gekyi ras bcos 4)bu dag gis yongs su g.yogs shing 7rimago la tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po dang ta ma la'i lo ma'i phye mas yongs su g.yogs te lha rdzas kyi me tog dag mngon par gtor to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis drang srong thub pa'i gnas rten de rgyarasngon)dpag tshad bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu 9 rtsa bzhi par sprul to/ /mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas de'i dbus su lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i ras bcos bu dang / rgyan dang ske/ nor bu dang / rin po che rnams kyi gdan dag btingatshwanye ngo / /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das ri rab kyi rtse mo la bzhugs nas kun shes kau ḍi n+ya la bka' stsal pa/ ci nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed thams cad du chud pa thams cad kyis thos par de la sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi cho 'phrul gyi byin gyis rlabs kyi hurtestobs de lta bus chos ston te —snye/ kau ḍi n+ya skogang mig gi skye ba dang / gnas pa dang ske/ 'byung ba dang / nye bar len pa la mngon par zhen pa 'di ni sdug bsngal gyi 7skye ba'o/ /'di ni nad dang srid pa'i yan lag rnams kyisnyiganas pa'ol/ /'di ni rga shi'i 'byung ba'o/ /kau ḍi rgyarwa tshogang rna ba dang / sna dang /lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi skye ba dang / gnas pa dang / 'byung ba dang /nye bar len pa la mngon par zhen pa 'di ni sdug bsngal gyi skye ba'o/ /'di ni nad dang / srid pa'i yan lag rnams kyi tsho/sheganas pa'o/ / 'di ni rga shi'i 'byung ba'o/ /1/kau ḍi n+ya rmo )gang mig gi 'gog pa dang / nye bar zhi ba dang /nub 21pa dang / nye bar len pa nye bar zhi ba 'di ni sdug bsngal gyi 'gog pa'o/ /66wa 566

'di ni srid 3)pa'i yan lag rnams kyi nye bar zhi ༷ ba'o/ /'di ni rga shi'i nub pa'o / /kau ḍi rgyashegang rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi 'gog pa dang / nye bar zhi ba dang / nub pa dang / nye bar len pa rnam par zhi ba 'di ni sdug bsngal gyi 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni srid pa'i yan lag rnams kyi nye bar zhi ba'o/ /'di ni rga shi'i nub pa'o/ /chos gang gis nga lha dang bcas pa dang / tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang / dge sbyong dang / bram zer bcas pa dang / lha dang mir bcas pa'i skye dgu'i 'jig rten na phul yin par grags pa dang / byams pa chen pos mchog yin par grags pa dang / snying rje chen pos dam pa yin par grags pa dang / 'khor ba'i pha rol tu phyin pas bla na med par grags pa dang / sbyin pa dang / dul ba ri dang / yang dag par sdom pa rnams kyis rgyasems can thams cad la sems snyoms 6)par grags pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa dang ⑦/ dul ba dang / yang dag par sdom pa dang / tshangs pa'i gnas pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su bsgom popa'i rgyu 'thun pa'i chos de ni ngas sems can thams cad la rgya cher bstan ri(7to/ /gsal hu3 bar mdzad do/ /ston pa thugs brtse 11ba can phan par bzhed pas gang nyan thos hu rnams la mdzad pa ni ngas mdzad zin te/ da (lhakhyed cag gis bya ba yin no/ /rga shi'i mthar dbyung 14ba'i phyir dgon pa rnams dang / shing drung dang ske/ dur khrod dang / ri dang / ri khrod dang / bas mtha'i gnas mal de dag tu phyis 'gyod pa can du gyur na mi rung gis sgoms nyisashig /rtsol cig /nged kyis rjes su bstan pa ni 'di yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sachos kyi rnam 1 tshogangs 'di bshad pa na/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed 18'di'i gling bzhi 66—567

pa bye ba phrag brgya zhucigang yin pa thams cad du gling bzhi pa re rer yang sems can dkrigasams pa bye ba brgya stong phrag mang po de dag gis ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam pa sna tshogs bskyed do / /kha cig ni ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang / bzod pa rnams la rnam par gnas par gyur to/ /de bzhin du chos rnamasasrel chos kyi mig bskyed rinasado/ /kha cig ni sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba'i las kyi sgrib pa rnams byang ngo 6)zhes bya ba nas kha cig ni sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i 57rabar dang / kha cigamatsho8)gnod sbyin dbul po nyid kyi phyo)bar dang / kha cig ni nya mi dbul po nyid du 'gro ba'i las kyi sgrib pa rnams yongs su byang〈mengo / /nad kyis / btab pa rnams ni nad med par gyur to/ /sems can rnams btsonatshwa ra nas yongs su thar bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ dge ba sna tshogs dri ma med pa'i gser can spyod pa rnam dag thugs 8rjes phyug /lha dang shed las skyes dang lag 'gro'i dam pa nyon mongs rtog pa sel mdzad pa/ /tshul khrims thos rig gsum 8po phun sum tshogs pa sems can thams cad 'dzudarwanyepa'o/ /lag 'gro'i tshogs rab thar mdzad thugs rje brtan 3 po sngon gyi dam bcas dgongs par mdzodahunye/ /gzhan sems sems can slad du sdug bsngal ji ltar gtar (6ba bzhin/ /lag 'gro'i skad cig mtha' yas 'dir rmongs sdug bsngal sna tshogs thebasazhu )/ /dgra yis phyag bgyis brtson brtan skye ba'i dgon pa las grol ba/ /ye shes chab kyis〈spelag 'gro thams cad tshim par mdzad du gsol/ /'phags pa 'dus pa chen po theg pa sa chen po'i mdo nyi ma'i snying po'i le'u bcu gcig pa las ri rab la gshegs pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //66wa 568

'phags pa shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i sde nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba'i mdo/bam po bcu gnyis pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das me tog dang / rin po che dang ske/ chos gos dag gi char rabatu/tu 'bebs shing / sil snyan dang / phegasherdob pa dang / gshedabyangs dag gi rol mo'i sgra 'byin pa'i lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin thams cad sdod pas ri rab kyi rtse mo nas gshegs te / bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gyis mdun du bdar rigacing byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyis yongs su bskor nas drang srong thub pa'i gnas rten gyi dbus su gdan btingasnyib nyid la bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i las bya ba'i phyir steng57gi nam mkha' la lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / mi'am ci thams cad kyis rgyan spyidang / phye ma sna tshogs dang / me tog sna tshogs dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi char rab (8)tu phab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das la klu de dag gis kyang me tog sna tshogs dang / dri sna tshogs dang / rin po che sna tshogs dang / ras gos dang / ras bcos bu dang ske/ chos gos dang / rgyan sna tshogs kyis mchod pa byas nas lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal ga97nas spyan sngar chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'khod rga )/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das sug las gang dag gis sems can rnams klu'i skye hu1gnas su skye lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ klu'i bdag po las kyi sgrib pa bcus sems can 'byung po rnams myur du klu'i skye gnas su skye'o1rte/ /bcu gang zhe na/ sems can 66—569

gang dag pha rol tu phyin pa drug la mngon par brtson zhing bla na med pa'i theg 3)pa yongs su tshol ba'i sems dang ldan pa dag yin la myur du 'dod pa rnams la nyes dmigs su lta ba ma yin zhing shinamu tu sbyin pa la mngon par brtsonamadul lag pa brkyang ba dag yod de/ de dag smon lam gyi dbang gis klu rnams kyi nang du skye'o / /yang sems can gang dag bla na med pa'i theg pa yongs su tshol ba'i sems dang ldan zhing sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mngon par brtson pa dag yod de / de dag gis tshul khrims thams cad rdzogs par skyon med par bsrungadzagebar ni ma skyonas so/ /de dag sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas kyi 'jigs pas skrag nas rang gi smon lam gyis klu rnams kyi nang du skye'o/ /yang sems can gang dag bla na med pa'i theg pa yongs su tshol bar byed cing shin tu nga rgyal gyis khengs pa dag yod de/ de dag nga rgyal gyi 2)mthus rang gi smon lam gyis klu rnams kyi nang du skye'o/ /yang sems can gang dag bla na med pa'i theg pa'i spyod pa la mngon par brtson pa dag yod de/ de dag shin tu khro ba mang zhing sems can gzhan rnams la rabartsotshetu sdang ste/ de dag sha khonamasal rtenas31pas 'chi ba'i dus tha mar klu rnams kyi nang du smon lam 'debs te/ de dag smon lam gyis der skye'o/ /yang sems can gang dag nyan thos kyi theg pa dang yang dag par ldan zhing snod du gyur pa'i sbyin gnas yongs su btsalarwarteb dang mchod pa'i sems dang ldan pa dag yod de/ de dag rang gi smon lam gyis lha klu rnams kyi nang du skye'o / /yang sems can gang dag ser sna can dang nga rgyal gyi skyon dang ldan pa dag yod de/ de dag las des klu rnams kyi nang du skye'o/ /yang sems can gang dag nga rgyal la mngon par dga' zhing mu cor ⑩smra la 35brdzun du smra ba dag 66—570

yod de/ de dag las des7klu rnams kyi nang du skye'o/ /yang sems can gang dag sangs rgyas la gces par byed pa ma yin pa khumang ba dag yin zhing ③/chos dang / dge 'dun dang / bslab pa dang / mkhan po dang / slobs)dpon dang / bla ma'i gnas lta bu dang / pha gsem rnams la gces9)par byed pa ma yin pa mang ba dag yin pa yod do④/ /de'i tshe de dag nga rgyal gyi rgyu dang /lus dang / ngag dang / yid chung ngus 'khrul pas klu rnams kyi nang du skye'o/ /yang sems can gang dag nga rgyal dang / gti mug gis zil gyis non53)cing ma dul la skyon med pa ma yin par spyod pa dag yod de/ de dag klu rnams kyi nang du skye'o/ /yang sems can gang dag nga rgyal dang / phra ma smra ba dang / tshig rtsub po smra ba la goms pa dag yod de/ de dag 'chisko9)ba'i dus byas nas klu rnams kyi nang du skye ste bcu po de dag yin no/ /chos gzhan gsum dang ldan na klu rnams kyitshwanyenang du skye'o/ /gsum gang zhe na/ sems can gang dag lus dang rka/ ngag dang / yid kyi nyes par spyod pa 12shin tu dam po dag gis sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du skyes pa dag yod de/ de dag de nas shi 'phos nas nyes par spyod pa'i lhag ma chung ngus klu rnams kyi nang du skye'o/ /de bzhin du dud 'gro rnams dang / de bzhin du yi dgas rnams nas hurtezhes bya ba'i bar du ste / chos gsum po de dag gis sems can rnams klu rnams kyi nang du skye'o/ /rgya mtshos kyang gsol pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das de de bzhin no/ /btsun pa bde bar gshegs pa de de bzhin te/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das 'di na 0klu gang dag longs spyod pa dang / nye bar spyod pa'i dpal dang ldan pa lha dang 'dra ba dag mchis pa nas mi masmad rims dang 'dra ba dag tsomachis pa'i bar 66—571

dang ske/ yi dgas dang 'dra ba dag mchis pa'i bar dang / gang dag dud 'gro'i skye gnas pa dang 'dra ba dag mchis pa'i bar nas ⑨klu gang dag sems can dmyalamacho ba dang 'dra ba dag gi bar mchis lags te/ de dag sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong bar 'gyur lags so/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po'i bu pad ma'i gdong zhes bya bas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag su gakhulas gang gis klu'i rigs su skyes nas gzugs mchog tu lham me zhing lus kyisasnyireg pa gang chungasazad ci reg kyang kun tu tshig cing 'bar ba lags/ bdag dus thams cad du mchil lham bor nas gcer ④bur rgyu bar bgyid lags/ bdag gi pha ma de ni dpal phun sum 48)tshogs pa'i meches khyad par du 'phags pa myong ste/ dper na gling bzhi pa'i 'khor los sgyur 7ba'i rgyal po bzhin lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kye lag 'gro sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus bskal pa sum curwatertsa gcig nyi 'das pa de'i tshe de'i dus na/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba'i bar gtsug torasngortecan zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung mungo / /de'i tshe rgyal po me tog bral zhes bya ba zhig byung ste/ rgyal po me tog bral des kyang de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug tor tunyecan nyan thos dang /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun brgya stong phrag mang po'i 'khor dang ldan pa de la zla ba gsum du yo byad thams cad phul nas rtag tu chos mnyan te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab botso/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i gtsug lag khang yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa zhig kyang brtsigs so/ /rgyal po me tog bral de'i bu srid sgrub bcas zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de shin turwarte'akhor bas skrag nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du rab tu byung ste pa'i dge 'dun 66—572

gyi kun dga'i ra btude rjes su skyong zhing 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyishenyan thos kyi dge slong gang dag gnasalgepa dang / de na gang dag bza' bsredang / btungakyi ba dngasnyi/ mal cha la longs spyod par byed pa thams cad lasheme tog bral gyi7bu dge slong srid sgrubs1)bcas de' )phrag dog byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge slong de dag kyang gnas de nas dong ngo71) de yang yid 6)mchog tu dga' nas bdag nyid kyis kyang longs spyod par mi byed/gzhan dag la yang mi ster ro zhes bya ba nas dge slong hunyede ya nga 'chi skoba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal ba chen po rnams kyi nang du skyes so zhes bya ba'i bar du'o / /de lo khrag khrig brgya stong phrag mang por sems can dmyal ba chen po'i nang du skyes nas btsos so/ /de de nas shi 'phos nas yi dgas rnams kyi nang du skyes te/ lo brgya stong phrag mang por der sdug bsngal myong ngo / / phyis yang sems can dmyal ba dang yi dgas rnams kyi nang du sdug bsngal myong ngo / /lag 'gro 'khor bas skrag pa'i sems dang ldan pa'i 3)srid (3sgrub bcas zhes bya ba rab tu byung ste/ de nas shi 'phos nas de ltar yun ring lha'epor ngan song gsum du sdug bsngal myong ba de gzhan zhig yin par khyod sems na/ du rigazhan yin paradza 1blta bar mi bya ste/ de tsho )ltar las kyi sgrib pa dam pos zin pa yang khyod 3lhayin no//'di phan chad bskal pa sum cus stertsa gcig tu khyod du nyertag par ngan song gsum gyi nang du skyes so/ /de'i las kyi sgrib pa lhag ma lus pa des 'dir klu rnams kyi nang du skyes pa ni gzhan ma yin gyi du 9khyod yin te/ sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba de lta bu myong ngo / /gang khyod 'di nas shi 'phos nas phyis kyang sems can dmyal ba dang ske/ dud 'gro dngas / yi dgas rnams kyi nang du rtag tu sdug bsngal gyis 66—573

gzir 1)bar 'gyur ba 'di ni gnas yod do/ /klu'i bu de mchog tu yid mi dga' nas rab tu ngu zhing bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshalakunas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das byis pa ji lta ba dang /rmongasam ripa ji lta ba dang / mi gsal ba dang / mi〈pemakhas pa ji lta ba bzhin dusanongs pa so sor 'chags lags so nongs pa so sor 'chags ༅lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gi0)bsam pas sdom pa gzung〈kyebar bgyi'o/ /bdag de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge bsnyen lags te/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs pa lags so/ /bdag bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /khyod lhag pa'i bsam pas nga la skyabs su song bas khyod kyi ngan song thams cad yongs su zad do/ /'di nas shi 'phos nas khyod kyis byams pa'i tshe na mi'i rnyed 9pa thob par 'gyur te/ byams pa'i thad hu) du rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur zhing dgra bcom pa nyid kyi bar du mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na gang gis 11rigatsug tor nyurtecan 'khor dang bcas pa la zla ba gsum du hunyeyo byad thams cad kyis rim gro byas pa dang / de'i phyir dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs par byas pa'i rgyal po me tog bral zhes bya ba gzhan zhig yin par khyod sems na de gzhan yin par yang mi blta ste/ de ni klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho 'di yin no/ /'di ni bskal pa sum cu 8rtsa gcig tu nam yang ngan 'gror ma skyes so/ /lha'i dpal dang skal ba 8bzang po phun sum tshogs pa shin tu rgya chen po myong ngo / /'di ni bla na med pa'i theg pa'i phyir smon lam gyi dbang gis 'dir klu 8rnams kyi nang du skyes te/ 'dir dpal 66—574

dang skal ba ①bzang po de lta bu myong ngo / /de skad ces thos nas klu thams cad skyo zhing mchog tu yid mi bde nas bcom ldan 'das la mchog tu gus pa skyes shing nye bar rtog pas gces ②par byed par gyur ri to/ /de'i nang na klu gzhan mig med pa long ba 'bras bu nyam gechung ba zhes bya ba zhig yod de45)/ des gsang bstod yinas 'o dod bos te gsol pa/ sems can rnams la thugs brtse rtso/bdag cag yongs su bskyab paras3shegasol/ /yun ring bdag gi lus la sdug bsngal tshor ba rab mi bzad33/ /srin bu sbal pa skye bo srog chags sna tshogs 'tshal bar bgyid/ /bza' ba btung hu )ba ma mchis chab tshan nang na bdag gnas lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'khor ba 'jig 37rgyal bstan tsho/rtepa la/ /sngon ni〈nyedage sbyong khyod gyur to/ /mkhas shing gtsang 3 7sbra spyod lam ldan/ /dben7pa dag tu'ang sdig pa byed/ /lhan cig gnas pa dag kyang mang ske/ /khyod bdag ston pa 'dra bar gyur7/ /dgra bcom rdzu 1 'phrul chen po yang ske/ /khyod la slob ma dzo/shernams kyis brjod/ /rnyed 19dang bkur sti byung ba ni/ /khyod gcig bu yis longs spyad ( )cing / /khyod kyis dge slong des pa mthong / /de dag la ni mi snyan brjod/ /lhan cig gnas de mi dgar gnas/ /khyod ni tshe rabs stong dag tu/ /nged kyi zas su gyur cig ces/ /de lta bu yi 37sems bskyed du do/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa des/ /'dir yang khyod ni lag 'gror skyes( nye / /khyod rang gi yang lhan cig gnas/ /phyi phyir za bar byed pa yin/ /chu tshan du rtenang na gnas pa dang / /long bar de yis gyur pa yin/ /kun tu 'bar ba'i lcags dang zangs/ /phyis kyang dmyal bar za bar 'gyur/ /stobs med yid ni mi dga' bas/ /klu dbang kun gyi nang na ngu / /nyes pa rdugaso sor 66—575

bshags shi)byas na/ /sdug bsngal rnams las yongs su grol/ /de nas bcom ldan gser 'dra ba'i/ /phyag gi mthil7gyi dkyil 'khor reg /spyod parashedaka' ba dgongs 4)mdzad nas/ /ston pas 'di skad bka' stsal to⑤/ /rgyal posngo0mig bzangs mnong byung ste/ /sngon tshe bden pa gang gis ngasal/ /bram ze long ba'i don du ni/ /mig dag gnyis gnyephyung bar gyur/ /bden pa'i tshig de kho na yis/ /khyod kyis dri med mig thob shog /nga yi77legs par spyod pas khyodarka/ /sngon gyi las de hu byang bar 8shog /tabya thā/ tsakṣu kha ba/ ra sa na kha ba/ge karma kha ba/ salgenan dza na/ bi ra dza/ ba tsor an ta/ dzñā ma/ni sa ra ṇa tro 17ya/ a he tsanatshwa)dra ḍa〈rtene kri mi shud dhe/ pha la shud dhe/ a dze ta dze/ ta le tan na ta le/ ba se dha sa ke(gle/ ba sa zhurtete/ rū ra ti(rte/ ma hā rū ra bi/ tri rad na bra te 39swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bden pa'i tshig de bshad pa na klu 'bras bu nyam (gechung ba'i mig yongs su dag par gyur to/ /klu gzhan stong phrag lnga bcu rtsa gsum gyi mig kyang yongs su dag par gyur to/ /gzhan gnod sbyin ('dang / grul bum dang / yi dgas dang / sha za dang /mi khrag khrig phrag tri brgyad cu (3rtsa bzhi ni sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa zad cing mig yongs su dag par gyur to/ /de nas lha'i bu mtshams bzangs5)thal mo rab tu sbyar ba byas nas smras pa/ 'jig rten 'dren pa rnams kyi stobs la ltos/ /rab tu lam med rnams la mig kyang byin/ /gal te ston pa 'jig rten mi 'byung na / /su yang 'gro bar sha'i mig phyis mi 'thob/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kau ḍi n+ya la bka' stsal pa/ kau ḍi n+ya khyod kyis gsang sngags chen po'i gzhi'i sdoX gzungs sngags mig sgrub pa 'di zung shig(1 /66wa 576

da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na su la la sems can rnams kyi sngon gyi las kyi lhag ma dang / khams kun tu 'khrugs pa dang / gsang sngags dang / sman dang ske/ dug gi sbyor bas long bar 'gyur ba dang / chungashezad mthong bar yang 'gyur ba des mig sgrub pa'i gzungs sngags〈kye'adi rang gis bklag〈kyepar bya'o/ /rang gi las so sor bshagasalgepar bya'o/ /des sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems kyis sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgomakhezhing las gzhan mi byed par zhag bdun phrag bdun du rang gi mig la byabs na mig yongs su dag par 'gyur ro / /yang sems can gang dag mtshams med pa'i las lhag ma lus pas long bar gyur mecing dam pa'i chos spong ba'i lhag ma lus pa dang / 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa'i lhag ma lus pa dang / chos kyi sbyin pa'i sgrib pa'i lhag ma lus pa dang / glegs bam du bris pa rnam par 'jig pa'i lhag ma lus pa dang /gzhan ⑦gyi mig rnam par 'jig pa'i las kyi lhag mas long bar gyur pa de dag gis gzungs sngags 'di yi ger 'driraphubacug ste/ yang dang yang du klog tu gzhug go/ /las kyi sgrib pa bshags par bya'o/ /gzhan yang rgya mchosare bisheb dang ske/ shing mngar dang / sman ka tsa dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / rusarwa1 sbal gyi snying rnying pa sbrang rtsi dang lhan cig btag 3)cing btsos la gsang sngags 'di dag lan stong rtsa brgyad mngon par brjod cing mig gi phyi rol du bsku nyebar bya'o / /zhag bdun phrag bdun du las gzhan mi byed par sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgomasazhing sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs kyang byas na de'i las kyi sgrib pa ma lus par byang bar 'gyur zhing de'i mig yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang dge slong rnams kyi gnas dge 'dun gyi kun dga' snyir ba tsobyas na yang 66—577

de'i las kyi sgrib par byang bar 'gyur ro/ /phyis kyang 'khor bar mig ma tshang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i klu'i 'khor des 'di skad ces gsol to/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa dus gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phan par 17mdzad pa nad las rab tu thar bar mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo//de nas de'i tshe klu tshon rtsi sngon pos gsang bstod du de 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sdig pa thams cad sbyong ba du )khyod/ /khyod ni dka'asemadzad dpal kun ldan/ /khyod kyis 5)las kyang rab tu mkhyen/ /srog chags kun gyi rgyal po khyod/ /bdag ni chu dang rnam bral zhing / /tsha ba'i klung gis kun gdungs pa'i/ /'brog dgon pa na gnas pa lags/ /dri mi skye)zhim pa'i gnas na gnas/ /lo ni bye ba phrag stong du/ /zhag gcig bdag la bde chum mchis/ /rtag par 'khor dang lhan cig tu/ /bdag ni gzhan gyis bza' ba lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sems can gang50dag sdig byas nas/ — /phyis kyang bdag nyid bsod nams sgrub49ri/ /lus kyis gaṇḍi nyi )brdungs nas su/ /dge slong dge 'dun tshim byed na'ang / /las kyi lhag ma de yis su/ /gang dang 3glegang du skyes par ni12/ /sdug bsngal ci 'dra 'byung 'gyur zhing / /bza' btungatsodag dang yang dag ldan/ /yang na klu yi skyesaganas su/ /lus kyis skye bar 'gyur ba yin//de yi mgo yi klad pa nyunyeder/ /nor bu'i rgyal po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /kun tu chu 'byung zhes bya ba/ /chu sbyin byed pa'i klur 'gyur ro/ /gang na klu ni gnas byed pa / /de nas chu ni 'bab par 'gyur/ /sa 'am nam mkha' la yang rung / /gang dang gang du 'gro ba der/ /sems ni bskyed tsom thag tu yang / /chu ni 7'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /yang na sems can gang dag gis/ / mi yi7)66—578

dngos po thob nas su/ /sdig pa rnam pa sna tshogs byas/ /dge 'dun rim gro mi byed na/ /de dag sdug bsngal sna tshogs ni/ /ngan song gsum du myong nas kyang ske/ /de nyid klu yi skye gnas su/ /skye ba thob par 'gyur ba yin/ /de las kun tu chu mi 'byung / /mgo la nor bu rin chen med/ /stong pa skom pa'i gnas dag tu/ /chu med par ni gnas par 'gyur/ /sngon 'das dus na khyod kyis ni/ /rgyal ba skar rgyal bstan pa la/ /dge slong dgon pa par gyur te/ /phrag dog ser snas gang ba yin/ /dge slong blo 37bur 'ongs mthong nas/ /khro gnyer can gyi bzhin byas nas/ /de dag la ni sbyin gtong ri byed/ /de la yang ni mngon sum gshe/ /der ni gang dag chur yang ni/ /myur du mi gtsang balleyis bkang ske/ /'chagashes gnas khang dag gi gnas/ /dri nga ba yis bkang bar gyur⑤/ /dge slong des pa 'gro ba na/ /brgyad bkag 6)gis ni gshe bar gyuram / /dge slong des pa gzhan dag kyang / /rgyang rin ring bar ni yongs su spangs / / de phyir phragashedog ser sna'i rgyus3 )/ /ma chod par ni khyod gyur nas/ /dge sbyong su zhig la la mthong / /myur du khros nas gshe bar 'gyur/ /sbyin pa po la khro bas thonagashe/ /ngo tsha khrel yod rnam par spangs/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa des/ /sems can dmyal bar so sor skyes/ /lus ni bye bas sems dmyal du / /sdug bsngal mang po nyams su myong / /yi dgas rnams su dus ring por /sdug bsngal rab tu mi bzadatshwa myong / /khyod ni klu yi skye gnas su/ / skyes nas nyusnyeshin tu sdug bsngal gyur/ /stong pa 'brog nyanadagon rdzong rnams su/ /chu dang bral bar gnas pa yin/ /sems can dmyal ba rnams su khyod/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba phyi phyir myong / /shin tu yun ring yi dgas dang / /dud 'gror sdug bsngal 66—579

tshor ba myong / /su zhig tha ma'i dus tshe gnod sems byung / /rtag tu phrag dog ser sna khros pa la/ /bsam gtan mi skyob sangs rgyas mchod pa min/ /tshul khrims mi skyob dgon par gnas pa min/ /yang de'i tshe0klu'i 'khor de'i nang na klu yi dgas lta bu bye ba phrag nyi shu rtsa drug sngon gyi tshe rabs rjes su dran par gyur te/ skad po cher rab tu ngu zhing 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag yongs su bskyab tu gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa bdag cag yongs su bskyab natu gsol/ sngon gyi rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bdag cag gis 'dra mtshungs par las kyi sgrib pa de lta bu7'phangs lags so/ /de ltar yun ring por ngan song gsum du sdug bsngal myong lags so/ /da ltar yang klu yi dgas lta bu rnams kyi nang du rtag tu ④sdug bsngal de lta bus gzir lags te/ dper na klu yi dgas lta bu tshon rtsi sngon po bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyod kyis 'uchu longs la de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs kyi drung du chag chag thob shig ri dang / des ni khyed kyi sdug bsngal thams cad yongs su zad par 'gyur ro/ /de nas klu yi dgas lta bu de dag thams cad kyis lag pa gnyis kyis chu blangs pa dang / lag na chu 'dug pa de rab tu 'bar ro/ /de nas me'i phung po shing ta la drug srid du 'phags te/ lan bdun gyi bar du de bzhin rnam/ /klu'i tshogs de mchog tu yid mi dga' nas mchi ma dag phyung ngo / /thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor thoXde yang yid kun tu mi dga' nas de bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ci 'dra ba yi las byas pa/ /de 'dra ba yi 'bras bu 'thob/ /dge ba yin na bzang po ste/ /sdig pa byed pa'ang sdig to'o3 ril/ /de nas yi dgas lta bu'i klu/ /khyedarwatekun 'di skad tshig sgros shig /66wa 580

bden pa gang gis ston pa ni/ /sems can kun la thugs snyoms pa/ /bden pa'i tshig de kho na yis/ /nged kyi chu ni ma 'bar cig /klu thams cad kyis 'di tsho)skad ces smras so/ /lan brgyad pa la lag pa gnyis kyis chu blangs te bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la gtor nas nyes pa la nyes paratshwa so sor bshags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sdig pa'i las kyi sgrib pa yi/ /lhag ma lus pa yongs su zad/ /byams pa'i tshe na khyed cag ni/ /mi yi srid pa thob par 'gyur/ /byams pa yi ni bstan pa la/ /myur du rab tu 'byung ba thob(gu/ /rnal 'byor la ni mngon ④brtson dang / /myur du dgra bcom thob par 'gyur/ /yang de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyilamathus klu'i tshogs de ji ltar lhags pa bzhin de dag thams cad kyis sngon gyi tshe rabs dang / bdag gi las dang / 'gro ba dang ske/ skye ba rjes su dran te'u/ 'khor de'i nang nas klu brgya stong phrag mang po rang gis57nyes par byas pa'i sdig pa'i las kyis rab tu ngus nas kha cig 3)gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bstanam1)pa la bdag cag khyim na gnas par57gyur te/ nye du dang 'grogs pa'i rkyen dang /chos ma nyan (nyepa'i rkyen gyis dge slong rnams dang lhan cig tu dge 'dun gyi mngonatshwanyedu gyur pa bsngos pa'i me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / khu ba dang / bza' ba tsodang / btung ⑩ba longs spyad (rtelags so zhes bya ba nas kha cig gis gsol pa/ bdag cag gis phyogs bzhi pa la bsngos the pa longs spyad (rtelags so zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /kha cig gis 'di skad ces03 gsol to/ /bdag cag gis rang gis bsngos pa longs spyod (1lags so zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /kha cig gis gsol pa/ bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs kyi 66—581

zhes bya ba'i bar dang / bdag cag gtsug tor hu)can gyi zhes bya ba'i bar dang /bdag cag 'khor ba 'jig gi zhes bya ba'i bar dang / bdag cag gser thub kyi zhes bya ba'i bar du'o/ /klu kha cig gis tshoge'adi skad ces gsol to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srung gi bstan pa la bdag cag khyim na gnas par gyur te/nye du dang 'grogs pa'i rkyen dang / chos ma nyan pa'i rkyen gyis de bzhin du bsngos pa'i dge 'dun gyi me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / khu ba dang /bza' ba dang / btung ba dge slong rnams la stsal pa de bdag cag gis longs spyad byulags so/ /sdig pa'i las des riXkyang sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du sdug bsngal mi bzad ⑥pa chen po rnam pa sna tshogs rab tu mi bzadapa⑦pa mang po yang dang yang nyams su myong lags so/ /dud 'gro dang yi dgas rnams kyi nang du dus yun ring por rtag tu sdug bsngal gyis gzir lags so/ /las kyi lhag ma des bdag cag klu'i skye gnas dman pa 'dir skyes nas chab bskol ba kun tu tsha ba'i nang du btsos lags so/ /bye ma kun tu tsha ba'i sa)nang du bsregs lags so//bdag cag gi kha'i sgor kha zas stsal spub yang lcags kyi thu lum du gyur lags so/ /de bzhin du khar btungatshwa skub stsal ba yang lcags dang zangs su gyur lags so/ /gang dang gang du mchis pa thams cad du hu1sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba de lta bu myong lags na bdag cag yongs su bskyab nyurtetu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kye lag 'gro dag khyed kyis dge 'dun gyi longs spyod pa de ni 'os pa ma yin te/ mtshams med pa dang nye ba yin no/ /rnam par ma smin par gang gis kyang myur du bshags par nyunyemi nus so/ /kye lag 'gro dag de lta yin yang ji srid 'tsho'i sabar du skyabs gsum du li'agro ba la 'khod cig dang / de 66—582

lta na khyed la phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyu des de bzhin gshegs pas khyed 'dod pa bzhin 'khor bar gzhog par mdzad do/ /de dag thams cad gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la yang bkod par gyur to3)/ /yang 'khoraphagede'i nang na klu mo long ma zhig yod de / de'i kha srin bus gang zhing gcin rul pa lta bu'i rnag dri nga ba zag go/ /smad kyi mtshan ma la yang de bzhin no/ /de'i lus thams cad rul cing rnagasre'adzag pa phol mig dang srin bus gang ba la sha sbrang dang ske/ sbrang bu mchu rings rgyadang / sbrang bu gdug pa rnams kyis za bar byed do / /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs rje chen pos gzigs te/ bka' stsal7pa/ sring mo khyod kyis lus la sdig pa'i las ni ci byas/ ji lta bu zhig /des gsol pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gi 9)tshor ba sdug bsngal lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gi tshor ba tsha ba lags te/gang nas klu'i skye duganas dman pa 'dir skyes pa'i dgung lo stong phrag sum cu 17rtsa drug bdag gis mngon par 'tshal lags so/ /bdag gi hu7sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba de lta bu ni gdugs zhag gcig kyang rgyun ma chad lags so/ /bka' stsal pa / sngon gyi las ci zhig byas/ des gsol pa/ 'di nas bskal pa dgu bcu 32rtsa gcig pa la rgyal ba rnam par gzigs kyi bstan pa la mi'i rgyud kyi bud med du gyur lags tehunye/ bdag der 'dod pa'i 3)dregs pas myos nas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ba dang lhan cig tu 8dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang na dge 'dun gyi mal cha'i steng du yang dang yang 'khrig pa dang ldan pa'i chos 'dod pa dag so so yang dag par myong lags te/ nor gyi slad du ma skrag lags so / /bcom ldan 'das de tshun chad bdag rtag tu lha dang mi'i rnyed pa dang bral 66—583

lags so/ /rtag tu ngan song gsum gyi tshor ba mi bzad7pas rab tu gzir lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ sring mo gang gi tshe 'dir bskal pa chen po 'jig par gyur pa de'i tshe khyod gegang du songashe/ des gsol pa/ sngon gyi las la rtenaphupa'i rlung 5)chen po de dag gis59)'phangs nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa gzhan dag tu 'phangs lags so/ /yang gang gi tshe der 'jigashepar gyur nas de nas yang 'dir ⑧'phangs lags na/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen pos bdag yongs su bskyab tu gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa bdag yongs su bskyab tu gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi7phyag gnyi gsatshwaste rma rtsi spos dang sbyar ba'i chu bzhes te bden pa brjod hunyepar mdzad do/ /bden pa gang gis sngon thi ba'i phyir nga'i lus chags pa med par yongs su btang5)ba'i bden pa des khyod kyi nad de dag zhi bar gyur cig /klu mo de'i khar blugs shing lus la gtor bas nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur te/ gsum la skyabs〈nyesu nye bar gnas par gyur to/ /yang de nyid na klu gzhan zhig lus dri nga zhing srin bus gang la srin bu ser skyas gang nas de las rnag khrag tsha zhing gor7gor po zag pa/ smra mi nus pa/ mchog tu skyon du bgrang 8ba zhig yod do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis klu de gzigs nas bka' stsal tshapa/ lag 'gro khyod kyis sngon mi dge ba'i las ci zhig byas/ klu des kha'i sgo phye nas srin bu'i rigs dang /rnag khrag dang / mes gang ba'i kha'i sgo sbyang brims hurtete smra ma nus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis skyor chu zhig bzhes te bka' stsal pa/ ri bong gyur te drang srong phyir/ /rang gisasngo me yi nang bor ba/ /bden pa'i tshig de kho na yis//klu ni smra bar nus par shog /skyor chu de klu'i khar blugs nas de'i kha'i nang du me 66—584

rab tu zhi zhing srin bu dang rnag khrag kha'i phyi rol du byung ngo / /klu de kha yongs su dag par gyur nasatu'adi skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba 'od srung gi bstan pa la bdag zhing par gyur lags so/ /bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi7nyan thos gzhan zhig la skyed du stsolalo cig dang / ston gyi 4)dus su khyod la dbul7lo zhes gser lnga bcu zhig gsol ba btab lags so/ /des bdag la 'gron bu brgyad cu'i7rin bcu 3)zhig stsal7te/ lnga bcur ma stsal lags so/ /bdag gis ⑩dge slong de la khro bas zil gyis non nas 'gron 31bu brgyad cu'i rin bcu blangs te/ de la slar yang ma stsal lags so/ /gzhan yang dus gzhan zhig na dge slong rnams kyi kun dga'adzwa ra ba der bdag mchis nas der dge 'dun gyi mngon 8du gyur pa bsngos 8pa a mra'i 7'bras bu bcu gsum pa pho 7longs spyad 3)lags so/ /sug las kyi sgrib pa'i lhag ma de kho nas de nas shi 'phos nas 'brog dgon pa skam po 'dir nyi tshe ba'i sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du skyes te/ rtag tu bdag gi lus hu3srin bu dag dang rnag khrag brdus pas gang lags so/ /bkres pa dang skom pas kun tu du stogazir nas sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong bulags so/ /yang mi dge ba'i las kyi rgyu des bdag 'di nas shi 'phos nas yang sems can dmyal ba chen po rnams kyi nang du skyes lags so / /dge slong de yang khro ba dang ser sna'i rgyu des 'chi (rnyeba'i dus bgyis nas 'dir klu rnams kyi nang du bdag gi mchan rme :khung du skyes te/ dus rtag tu bdag la g.yo bar bgyid do/ /de rtag tu khro bas zil gyis non nas dbugs tsha bas bdag gi lus la yongs su gang bar bgyid do/ /rgyu des rtag par rgyun tu bdag gi lus srin bu dag dang rnag khrag gis du lhagang lags na de bzhin gshegs 66—585
