zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄tshon /rgya gar skad du/ ārya ta ri thā ga ta garbha nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo//'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas lo bcu bzhes pa dang shin tu tsha ba'i dus kyi tshe rgyal po'i khab na bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la rin po che'i gdugs kyi khang bzangs tsan dan ri gyi snying po'i khang pa brtsegs pa na/ slobalgepa dang mi slob pa'i nyan thos kyi dge slong 'bum du tshang ba'i tshedage slong gi dge 'dun chen po phal cher dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang dang ldan par gyur pa/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba/cang shes pa/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/11—678

bdag gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ sems can7thams cad kyisasridabang gi dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa lteng ①rgyas 'od srung 4)dang /tshe dang ldan pa chu klungasnyi'od srung dang / tshe dang ldan pa ga lngarnyu'od srung dang7/tshe dang ldan pa kā tyā'i nibu chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa gsus po che dang /tshe dang ldan pa bskushel dang / tshe dang ldan pa nam gru dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor dang / tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang po dang / tshe dang ldan pa ngag dbang dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa mod migal gyi bu chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa cang shes kau ḍi n+ya hukyedang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka dang / tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcanatshwanyezin dang / tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo dang / tshe dang ldan pa nye dga' dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang /de dag la5nyesogs pa dge slong 'bum du tshang ba dang thabs cig 8tu bzhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing tha dad pa nas 'dus pa gang gā'i 7klung drug cu'i 8bye ma snyed thams cad kyang hurteskye ba gcig gis thogs pa mngon par shes pa chen po dang / stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa thob pa/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag mang po la bsnyen thabakur byas pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba/ gang dag gi ming thos pa tsam gyis 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med grangs med pa'i sems can bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur pasanyu)sha stag la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos kyi blo gros dang /66—679

seng ge'i7blo gros dang / stag gi blo gros dang / don gyi blo gros dang / rin po che'i blo gros dang / rab mchog blo gros dang / zla 'od dang / rin chen zla 'od dang / zla ba ②nya ba'i 'od dang / rnam par gnon pa chen po dang /rnam par gnon pa dpag medashedang / rnam par gnon pa mtha' yas dang /'jig rten gsum rnam par gnon rjodang / mi g.yo ba'i ⑥gnas rnam par gnonakhudang / mthu chen thob dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang /spos kyi glang po dang / spos dga' dang / spos dga'i dpal dang / dpal gyi snying po dang / nyi ma'i snying po dang / tog dang / tog chen po dang / tog dri ma med pa dang / rin chen mtha' yas dbyugashegu dang / rin chen dbyugashegu 'dor dang / rin chen dri med dbyug7 gu dang / mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po dang / rtag tu rab dga' dang / lag na rin po che dang / nam mkha'i mdzod dang / ri bo dang / 8ri rab dang / ri bo chen po dang / yon tan rin chen7snang dang / gzungs kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal po dang / sa 'dzin dang / sems can thams cad kyi nad sel dang / rab tu yid dga' dang /yid skyo dang / skyo med dang / 'od byed dang / tsan dan dang / g.yo bzlog dang ske/ dpag med mngon bsgrags7dbyangs dang / byang chub kun nas bslang dang ske/ mthong ba don yod dang / chos thams cad la dbang bsgyur ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / de dag la7sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gā'i klung drug cu'i bye ma snyed dang yang thabs cig⑩go/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /66wa 680

nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phyeshechen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa dpag tu med pa dang yang thabs cigashego/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor gcing mdun rjogyis bltas te/rgyal po dang / blon po chen po dang / tshong dpon dang / khyim bdag dang /blon po dang / grong rdal ba dang / yul gyi mi rnams kyis bste stang du byas/bla mar byas/ rim gro byas shing mchod do/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das bshos gsol ba'i 'og tu tsan dan gyi snying po'i khang pa brtsegs pa de nyid kyi nang du yang dag 'jog la zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ tsan dan gyi snying po'i khang pa brtsegasalgepa de las pad ma 'dabatum bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum yod pa/ tshad shing rta'i phang lo tsam pa/ kha dog dngarwa)ldan pa kha ma byi7ba bye ba khraganyekhrig phrag 'bum byung bar gyur te⑩/ de dag steng gi nam mkha'i bar snang la mngon par 'phags nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di khebasalgepar gyur te/ 'di lta ste dper na rin po che'i bla re bzhin du kun tu gnas par gyur to/ /pad mo'i snying po re re la yang57de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku skyil mo krung7bcas te bzhugs shing 'od zer 'bum dag rab tu 'gyed par kun tu snang la/ pad ma de dag thams cad kyang〈nyeshin tu kha bye bar gyur to/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs5nyekyis pad ma de dag gi 'dab tsom de dag thams cad kyang bumog mog po dang / nog ( nyenog po dang /dri nga ba dang / smad par 'os pa dang / mngon par dga' bar 'gyur ba ma yin par gyur to/ /'on kyang pad ma'i snying po de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams skyil mo krung bcas te bzhugs shing 'od zer 'bum dag rab tu 'gyed 66wa 681

par kun tu snang ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku pad ma'i snying po la bzhugasatupa de dag gis kyang thams cad dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di khyab par gyur te/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di shin tu mdzes par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad dang / 'khor bzhi yang shin tu ngo mtshar du gyur cing dga' bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi7rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa de mthong nas the tsomadzabadu gyur te/ gang pad ma bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum 'di dag gi 'dab ma rnams 'di ltar kha dog ngan cing chu ba rnams kyang kha dog ngan la smad pa'i 'os su gyur7te/ mngon par dga' bar 'gyur ba ma yin pa dang / pad ma'i snying po de dag la yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku re re skyil mo krung labacas te bzhugs shing 'od zer 'bum dag rab tu 'gyed pas shin tu mdzes par kun tu snang ba 'di'i rgyu ni gang yin/ burkyen ni gang yin snyam mo/ /de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang / 'khor bzhi po the tshom ⑦du gyur pa rnams 'dong bar bya ba'i mtshan ma byas so/ /de'i tshe tsan dan gyi snying po'i mkhang pa brtsegs pa der byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i blo gros zhes yi)bya ba 'dus par gyur te 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pomo rdo rje'i blo gros la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis chos can gyi gtam las rtsoms te7de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la yongs su zhu bar spobs par gyis7shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i blo gros bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang bas lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang /66—682

byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / 'khor bzhi po dag gi the tshom ①gyi zug rngu rig nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad pad ma kha dog ngan cing dri mi bda'5mib 'di lta bu bye ba khrag khrig⑧'bum 'di dag gis khebs pa dang de dag gi dbus〈pen yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku skyil mo krung bcas shing bzhugs te/ 'od zer 'bum7dag rab tu 'gyed par kun tu gda' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku de dag mthong nas kyang srog chags bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal ba'i rgyu ni gang lags/ rkyen ni gang lags/ de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' ⑦rdo rje'i ①blo gros kyis tshigs su bcad ⑨pa 'di dag gsol to/ /sangs rgyas stong phrag bye ba mi g.yo bar/ /pad ma dag gi dbus na bzhugs par ni/ /khyod kyis 'di 'dra'i rdzu 'phrul ston mdzadamanyapa/ /bdag gis sngon chad nam yangatso'adi ma mthong / /'od zer stong rnams rab tu 'gyed mdzad cing / /sangs rgyas zhing 'di thams cad khengs par mdzad/ /ngo mtshar chos kyi rnams la rol mdzad pa'i/ /'dren pa rnams kyis 8bar chad ma mchis mdzod / /'dab ma dag dang chu ba smad 'os la/ /kha dog ngan pa'i pad ma rnams dbus der/ /de dag rin chen rang bzhin 'drar bzhugs pa/ / ci yisaslad du rdzu 'phrul 'di dag sprul/ /bdag gis sangs rgyas gang gā'i bye 8snyed mthong ske/ /de yi rdzu 'phrul khyad 'phags bdag mthong ste/ /de ring gda' 8ba'i rnam sprul ci 'dra ba/ /sngon chad nam5) yang 'di 'dra 'di ma mthong / /rkang gnyis gtso bo lhas ni bstan du gsol/ /rgyu gang rkyen gang lags pa bshad du gsol / /'jig rten don mdzad thugs brtse gsung du gsol/ /lus can kun 66—683

gyi the tshom dgumanyedu gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis7byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i7blo gros la sogs pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i mdo shin tu rgyas pa yod de/ de rab tu bstan pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pas snang ba'i mtshan ma 'di lta bu 'di byas so/ /de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shigasnyedang ngas bshad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i blo gros dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs des bcom ldan 'das la legs sokyizhes gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pas sprul pa'i pad ma kha dog ngan pa/ dri nga ba/ smad par 'os pa mngon par dga' bar〈'gyur ba ma yin pa 'di dag dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs mdzes pa/ gzugs bzang ba/ blta na sdug pa dag pad ma'isnyisnying po 'di dag la skyil mo krung7bcas shing 'khod de/ 'od zer 'bum dag rab tu 'gyed cing 'khod pa de dag kyang rig nas lha dang mi rnams phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa'i las kyang byed pa de bzhin du rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis kyang rang gi shes rab dang ske/ ye shes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mig gis sems can srog chags su gyur pa/ 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug dang / sred pa dang ske/ ma rig pa'i nyon mongs pa bye ba phrag 'bum gyi sbubs su gyur pa thams cad dang / rigs kyi bu dag sems can nyon mongs pa'i sbubs su gyur pa de 66—684

dag gi nang na nga ①'dra bar ye shes ②dang ldan pa/ mig dang ldan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa mang po 'khod cing skyil mo krung nibacas nas mi g.yo bar 'khod pa mthong ste/ nyon mongs pa thams cad kyis nyon mongs pa can du gyur pa de dag gi nang na de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid mi g.yo zhing srid pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyis ma gos pa dag mthong nas de bzhin gshegs pasnyide dag ni nga7dang 'dra'o zhes smra'o⑦/ /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i mig ni de ltar mdzes pa yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mig des sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can du mthong ngo / /rigs kyi bu dag 'di lta ste dper na7skyes bu lha'i mig can la la zhig gis lha'i mig gis 'di ltar kha dog ngan cing 'di ltar dri nga ba'i pad ma kha ma bye 7zhing ma gyes5) pa dag la bltas te/de'i dbus na pad ma'i snying po la de bzhin gshegs pa skyil mo krungarwatebacas shing 'dug par rig nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs blta bar 'dod de de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs de yang dag par sbyang ba'i phyir pad ma'i 'dab ma kha dog ngan cing dri nga ba smad par 'os pa de dag 'gyed 1)cing sel ba de bzhin tunyedu rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin gshegs pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi mig gis sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying por mthong nas sems can de dag gi 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug dang / sridamoskyepa dang / ma rig pa'i nyon mongs pa'i sbubs dbye ba'i7phyir chos stonam te⑩/ de sgrubasngo)pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni yang dag pa nyid du gnas so/ /rigs kyi bu dag 'di ni chos rnams kyi chos nyid de/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung /ma byung yang rung / sems can 'di dag ni rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying 66wa 685

po can0)yin na/ rigs kyi bu dag smad par 'os pa'i nyon mongs pa'i sbubs rnams kyis g.yogs pas de dag gi nyon mongs pa'i sbubs gzhig pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i〈ye shes kyang yongs su sbyang ba'i〈phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams la chos ston te/ bya ba 'di la yang mos par byed do/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos de dag la mngon par brtson par gnas pa de dag gang gi tshe nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad las yongs su grol bar gyur pasnyide'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes7bya ba'i grangs su 'gro ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bya ba thams cad kyang byed do/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /ji ltar pad ma smad par 'os gyur pa / /de yi 'dab ma sbubs gyur ma gyes la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ma gos de('u/ /mi 'ga' la las lha yi mig gis mthongashe/ /de ni de yi 'dab ma 'byed pa na/ /dbus na rgyal ba'i lus ni mthong gyur nas/ /rgyal ba nye ba'i nyon mongs phyis mi 'gyur/ /de ni 'jig rten kun tu rgyal bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin ngas kyang srog chags thams cad kyi/ /dkyil der gnas pa'i rgyal ba rnams kyi lus/ /ji ltar smad 'os pad ma'i sbubs 'dra ba'i/ /nyon mongs stong phrag bye bas khebs par mthong / /ngasnyiyang de dag gis7ni gsal ba'i phyir / /mkhas pa rnams la rtag tu chos ston totu) / /sems can 'di dag sangs rgyas 'gyur bya zhes/ /rgyal ba'i phyir ni nyon mongs rnam par sbyongarwate/ /nga yi sangs rgyas mig ni de 'dra ste/ /de yisasnyurgyal ba'i lus su gnas pa yi/ /66—686

sems can 'di dag thams cad mthong gyur te/ /de dag rnam par sbyang phyir chos smra'o/ /rigs kyi bu dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ dper na sbrang tshang zlum po shing gi yal ga la 'phyang ba/ bung ba 'bum gyis kun tu bsrungs shing sbrang rtsis yongs su gang ba zhig yod la/ de nas sbrang rtsi zhu)'dod pa'i mi zhig gis srog chags kyi rnam pa bung ba ②de dag thabs mkhas pas bskrad na sbrang rtsi des sbrang rtsi'i bya ba byed do/ /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang sbrang tshang dang 'dra ste/ de la sangs rgyas nyidabanyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa bye ba phrag 'bum gyis kun tu bsrungs pa7de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong bas rig go/ /rigs kyi bu dag ji ltar sbrang tshang gidzagenang na sbrang rtsi bung ba ༅bye ba phrag 'bum gyis kun tu bsrungs ⑦pa yod par skyes bu mkhas pa zhig gis shes par rig pa de bzhin du sems can thams cad la yang sangs rgyas nyid nyon mongs pa7dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa bye ba phrag 'bum gyis kun tu bsrungasalgepa yod par de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong bas rig ste / rigs ⑩kyi bu dag de la de bzhin gshegs pa yang thabs la mkhas pas bung ba hunyebasal tunyeb de hunyebazhin du sems can de dag gi 'dod chags dang /zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / nga rgyal dang / rgyags pa dang / 'chab pa dang ne/ khro ba dang / gnod sems dang / phrag dog dang / ser sna lacasogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams bsalacanas ji ltar sems can de dag la yang nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa de dag gis nye ba'i nyon mongs pa can du mi 'gyur ba dang / gnod par mi 'gyur ba de lta de ltar chos ston to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba de rnam 66—687

par sbyangs nas 'jig rten na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bya ba byed de/ rigs kyi bu dag nga'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i mig yongs su dag pa des ngas sems can thams cad de ltar mthong ngo / /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /ji ltar 'di na sbrang tshang yod ①pa la/ /bung bas kun tu bsrungs7shing sbas gyur pa/ /mi gang sbrang rtsi 'dod pas de mthong nas/ /de ni bung bsherab tu skyodasapar byed/ /de bzhin 'dir yang sbrang tshang lta bu ni/ /srid pa gsum gyi sems can thams cad do/ /de dag nyon mongs bye ba mang ba ste/ /nyon mongs dbus na de bzhin gshegs 'dug mthong ske/ /nga yang sangs rgyas rnam par sbyang don du/ / bung ba0skyod pa lta bur nyon mongs selo7/ /gang gis nyon mongs bye bas gnod 'gyur ba/ /chos rnams 'dir ni thabs kyis rab ston te/ /de dag ji ltar de bzhin gshegs gyur la/ /'jig rten kunakhutu rtag tu bya byed cing / /spobs ldan ji ltar sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi yi/ /snod 'dra'i chos ston 'gyur bar bya phyir ro/ /rigs kyi bu dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste dper na 'bras sā lu'am/ nas sam/ ci tsitu'am/'bru rnams ni snying po phub ma nas yongs su bsrungs pa yin te/ tsorang gi phub ma nas ma phyung gi bar du bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / myang ba'i bya ba mi byed kyi/ rigs kyi bu dag skyes pa dang / bud med gang dag bza' ba dang /bca' ba la sogs pa zas skom gyi bya ba 'dod pa de dag gis brngas shing brdungasatshwanyete / phub ma'i sbubs dang phyi shun sel to/ /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin du7de bzhin gshegs pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan gyis sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa nyid/ sangs rgyas nyid/ rang byung nyid/ nyon mongs 66—688

pa'i sbubs kyi shun pas dkris shing gnas7par mthong ngo / /rigs kyi bu dag de la de bzhin gshegs pa yang nyon mongs pa'i sbubs kyi ②shun pa bsal ①ba dang rka/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid yongs su sbyang ba dang / sems can 'di dag ji ltar nyon mongs pa'i sbubs kyi shun pa thams cad las grol te/ 'jig rten du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro bar 'gyur snyam nas sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /ji ltar 'bru 'am sā lu'i 'bras kyang rung / /ci tsesa'am ni 'on te nas kyang rung / /ji srid bar du de dag phub ⑥bcas pa/ /de srid bar du bya ba mi byed de/ /de dag gis ni brdungs nas phub bsal na/ /bya ba rnam pa mang po dag kyang byed/ /snying po phub ma ldan pa de dag ni/ /sems can rnams la bya ba mi byed do/ /de bzhin sems can kun gyi sangs rgyas sag/ /nyon mongs7rnams kyis khebs par ngas mthong nas/ /ngas ni de dag rnam par sbyang ba dang / /sangs rgyas myur thob bya phyir chos ston to/ /sems can kun la nga 'dra'i chos nyid ni/ /nyon mongs brgyasheyis dkris7) nas gang yod pa/ /de ni rnam sbyang thams cad ji lta bur/ /rgyal bar myur 'gyur bya phyir chos ston to/ /rigs kyi bu dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste dper na/ rul pa dang / nyal nyil7gyi gnas bshang gcirwanyedri mi zhim pas kun tu gang ba zhig tu mi gzhan gseb lam nas song ba zhig gichagaser gyi gar bu zlum po zhig lhung bar gyur la/ bshang gci7dri nga bas kun du gang ba rul pa dang / nyal nyil gyi gnas der mi gtsang ba gzhan dang snyigazhan hu)gyis brnan rdu 3pas bltar mi snang bar gyur cing /66—689

der des77lo bcu'am/ nyi shu'am/ sum cu'amanya/ bzhi bcu 'am/ lo lnga bcu 'am/ lo brgya 'am/ lo stong du mi gtsang bas7chud mi za ba'i chos can de sems can gang la yang phan par mi byed do/ /rigs kyi bu dag de nas lhas lha'i mig gis gser gyi gar bu zlum posnyide la slebaltas nas mi zhig la kye mi khyod song la 'di ni rin po che'i mchog gser rul pa dang nyal nyil gyi rnam pas non pa de byi dor gyis la/ gser gyis gser gyi bya ba gyis7shig ces bsgoshen rigs kyi bu dag rul pa dang / nyal nyil gyi rnam pa zhes bya ba de ni nyon mongs pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyi tshigatshwa )bla dgas57so/ /gser gyi gar5)bu zhes bya ba de ni chud mi za ba'i chos can gyi tshig bla dgas5)so/ /lhas lha'i mig ces bya ba de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mitshig bla dgas78so/ /rigs kyi bu dag de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang sems can thams cad la7de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid chud mi za ba yod pa'i nyon mongs pa rul pa dang /'dam rdzab lta bu rnams bsal ba'i phyir sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /ji ltar mi yi gser gyi gar nyu 7bu ni/ /nyal nyil rnam pa'i nang du lhung gyur la/ /der de lo ni mi nyung ba zhig tu/ /de7)ltar gnas kyang mi 'jig5)chos can no/ /lha yis lha yi mig gis de mthong nas/ /rnam par sbyang phyir gzhan la smras pa ni/ /'di ni ri — ririn chen mchog gi gser yod pa/ /rnam par sbyongs la des 27ni bya ba gyis / /de bzhin ngas0)ni sems can thams cad kyang / /nyon mongs rnams kyis du nyeyun ring rtag non mthong / /de dag gis ni blo stebur nyon mongs shes(nye/ /66wa 690

rang bzhin sbyang phyir thabs kyis chos ston to/ /rigs kyi bu dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ dper na dbul po zhig gi khyim gyi nang gi mdzod kyi 'og gi sa la gter chen po dbyigatudang / gser gyis rab tu gang bshemadzod kyi tshad 0tsam zhig mi bdun srid kyi sas g.yogs pa'i 'og na yod la/ gter chen po de mi dbul po de la 'di skad du kye mi nga ni gter chen po ste/ sasalgegayogs cing76 'dug go zhes mi smra ste 'di lta ste/ gter chen po ni sems kyi ngo bo nyid kyis sems can ma yin pa'o/ /mi dbul po khyim gyi bdag po de ni dbul ba'i sems kyis rjes su sems shing de nyid kyi steng snun rnam par rgyu yang sa'i 'og na gter chen po yod pa de ma thos mi shes ma mthong ngo / /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi mngon par zhen pa'i yid la byed byedarnyupa khyim lta bur gyur pa'i 'og na de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang ske/ ma 'dres pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi mdzod kyi gter chen po yod kyang sems can de dag gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang ske/ reg ⑨pa la chags pas sdug bsngal bas (ste 'khor ba na 'khor tenyanya/chos kyi gter chen po de ma thos pas thob par ma gyur cing yongs su sbyang ba'i phyir brtson par yang mi byed do/ /rigs kyi bu dag de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten du byung ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i nang du 'di lta bu'i chos kyi gter chen po yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /de dag kyang chos kyi gter chen po de la mos nas rko tu ste/ de'i phyir 'jig rten na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams zhesatsobya ste/ chos kyi gter chen po lta bur gyur nas/ sems can rnams la sngon ma byung ba'i gtan 66—691

tshigs kyi rnam pa dang / dpe dang byed7pa'i gtan tshigs dang / bya ba rnams ston pa gter chen po'i mdzod kyi sbyin bdag chags pa7med pa'i spobs pa dang ldan zhing stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos mang po'i mdzod du gyur pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu dag de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mig shin tu yongs su dag pas sems can thams cad de lta bur mthong nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes dang / stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i mdzod yongs su sbyang ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams la chos ston to/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcadaphupa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /ji ltar dbul po'i khyim gyi 'og logs na/ /dbyig dang gser gyis gang ba'i gter yod pa/ /de la g.yo ba'am rlom sems yod min te/ /nga ni khyod kyi yin zhes de mi smra/ /de yi tshe na sems can khyim bdag de/ /dbul bar gyur la rnam par mi shes shing / /sus kyang de la bsnyad pa med pas na/ /dbul po de ni de yi steng na 'dug /de ltar ngas ni sangs rgyas mig gis su/ /sems can de dag thams cad dbul 'dra la/ /de dag rnams la gter chen yod pa dang / /g.yo ba med cing bde gshegs lus su mthong ske/ /ngas ni de mthong byang chub sems dpa' la/ /khyod kyis nga yi ye shes mdzod zungs(nyal/ /dbul ba med cing 'jig rten mgon gyur dang / /bla med chos gter 'gyur bar gyis shigashebastan/ /gang dag ngas bstan pa la mos gyur lob / /sems can de dag kun la gter yod do/ /gang dag mos nas bdag nyid rtsol byed pa/ /de dag myur du byang chub mchog thobashe'agyur/ /rigs kyi 66—692

bu dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ dper na shing a mra'i 'bras bu'am/ 'dzam bu'itu'abras bu'am/ ta la'i 'bras bu'am/ spa'i 'bras bu yang rung ste/ phyi shunakhugyi sbubs kyi nang nasamyu gu'i sa bon chud mi za ba'i chos can yod pa gang gis sa la btabakun shing gi rgyal posrechen por 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa yang 'jig rten na gnas pa/ 'dod chags dang /zhe snang dang / gti mug dang / sred pa dang / ma rig pa'i nyon mongs pa'i phyi shun gyi sbubs kyis 6kun tu dkris ⑦par mthong ngo / /de la 'dod chags dang ske/ zhe snang dang / gti mug dang / sred pa dang / ma rig pa'i nyon mongs pa'i sbubs kyi nang na snying por gyur pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid de ni sems can zhes bya ba'i ming du chags so/ /de la gang bsalasnyibar gyur pa de ni mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ ma rig pa'i nyon mongs pa'i sbubs yongs su sbyangs pa'i7phyir sems can gyi khams kyi ye shes chen po'i tshogs su gyur pa gang yin pa de ni rnyed pa'o/ /sems can gyi khams kyi ye shes chen po'i tshogs dam pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa ji lta ba de bzhin du smra bar lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyisalgemathong nas de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba'i 'du shes su byed do/ /rigs kyi bu dag de la de bzhin gshegs pas de ltar mthong nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes khonganyedu chud par bya ba'i phyir don de nye bar ston to/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /ji ltar spa yi 'bras bu thams cad ni/ /nang na spa yi myu gutsoyod pa ste/ /tatsolasnyidang ni 'dzam bu kun la'ang yod/ /nang na yod pa'i 'bras bu bskyed na skye/ /de bzhin chos kyi 66—693

dbang phyug 'dren 2)pa yang / /sems can thams cad spa yi sa bon 'dra/ /de kun nang na bde gshegs lus yod paral/ /zag med sangs rgyas mig ni dam pas thob ri/ /sbubs bshig tshorim gyur de ni sems can brjod/ /mi shes nangasan gnas kyang rlom sems med/ /ting 'dzin thob ste gnas nas rab zhi ste/ /de la g.yo ba ci yang yod ma yin/ /dper na sdong chen sa bon las byung ltar/ /sems can 'di dag ji ltar 'tshang rgya zhing / /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten skyabs 'gyur zhes/ /yongs su spang ba'i don du chos gtam smra/ /rigs kyi bu dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste dper na skyes bu dbul po zhig la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 7༄gzugs rin po che sna bdun las byas pa/ lag mthil ④tsam zhig yod la/ de nas skyes bu dbul po des de bzhin gshegs pa'i skushegazugs de khyer te 'brog dgon nyu — pa las shin tu 'da' bar 'dong bar hunyegyur nas jirwartenas kyang de gzhan gyis hu mi tshor zhing rkun pos mi khyer ‘/stebar bya ba'i phyir des de ras rul pa/ dri mi zhim pa'i dum bu du mas dkrisatswate de nas skyes bu de 'brog dgon pa de nyid du nyes pa gang gis kyang 'chi ba'i dus byas par ma gyur la/de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i skusnyigazugs rin po che las byas pa ras rul pa'i dum bus dkris sna tshopa yang rdog lam 13de na 'phyan zhing 'dug pa dang / 'dronatshwa)po rnams kyis ma shes nas/ 'goms〈nye shing 'goms shing dong la/ ras rul pa dri mi zhim pa'i dum bu'i thum bu kun tu 'dril ba 'di gang nas rlung gis bdas zhes smad pa'i dngos por yang ston pa dang / 'brog du nyen gnas pa'i lhas lha'i mig gis rnam par bltas (nyenas mi gzhan dag gcigadza nyel bstan te/ kye skyes bu dag ras kyi dum bu 'di yi5 rtethum bu 'di'i nang na de bzhin gshegs pa'i 66wa 694

skushegazugs rin po che las byas pa/ 'jig rten thams cad kyis5gephyag bya bar 'os pa yod kyis nibye shig ④ces bsgo'o/ /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa yang sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa'i dkri bas dkris 'a)te / smad pa'i 'os su gyur cing yun ring por 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa na rtag tu 'khyam par mthong ste/ rigs kyi bu dag tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba rnams kyang rung ste/ sems can nyon mongs pa sna tshogs kyi dkrig7)bas dkris par gyur pa rnams kyisanang na yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i lus nga ci 'dra ba yod pa mthong ngo / /rigs kyi bu dag de la de bzhin gshegs pa ni ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mthong ba nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang bral zhing yongs su dag par gyur la/ ji ltar da nyu )ltar nga 37bzhin du 'jig rten thams cad kyis phyaganyebya ba'i 'os su 'gyur snyam nas/ nyon mongs pa'i dkri nyugebs dkrisalgepa las thar par bya ba'itsophyir byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la chos ston to/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad 7pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /ji ltar dri nga smad pa'i 'os rnams kyis/ /yongs su dkris tsho/ 7pa bde bar gshegs kyi gzugs/ /rin chen byas pa ras dum dkris pa de/ /lam gyi bar na bor te 'khyam〈'egyur pa/ /lha yi mig gis de ni mthong nas su/ /lha des gzhan zhig la ni rab smras pa/ /'di na tri )de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen yod / /ras dumadza skyethum bu 'di ni myur du phye/ /de bzhin nga yi lha mig 'di 'dra ba / /des ni sems can 'di dag thams cad kyang / /nyon mongs dkri bas dkris nas rab sdug bsngal/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mi du )rtag gtses 3snemathong ske/ /ngas ni nyon mongs dkris pa'i nang dag na/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni mnyam 66wa 695

par bzhaganyegyur la/ /de ni g.yo ba med cing mi 'gyur yang / /de yongs thar byed gang yang med par mthong / /ngas mthong de nas skul ma btab pa ni/ /byang chub mchog tu gang dag zhugs pa nyon/ /de ltar sems can chos nyid 'di 'drar5mirtag /'di na yongs su dkris pa'i rgyalakhub bzhugs/ /bde bar gshegs kyitswaye shes yongs bkrol nasaX/ /gang tshe nyon mongs thams cad rab zhi ba/ /de tshe 'di ni sangs rgyas ming thob ste/ /lha dang mi rnams sems ni rab tu dga'/ /rigs kyi bu dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste dper na bud med mgon med par gyur pa/ mdog ngan pa/ dri mi zhim pa/ smad par 'os pa/'jigs su rung ba/ blta na mi sdug pa/ 'dre mo 'dra ba zhig mgon med pa'i khang par zhugs nas gnas so/ /de der gnas pa dang sbrum par gyur te/gang gis gdon mi za bar 'khor los sgyurarkuba'i rgyal srid byed7par 'gyur ba'i sems can de 'dra ba zhig ⑩de'i mngal du zhugs kyang bud med de'i mngal na 'dug pa'i sems can de la bdag gi mngal du zhugs pa'i sems can 'di ci 'dra ba zhig snyam du yang de yid la mi byed/ bdag gi mngal du zhugs sam/ma zhugs snyam du yang de de na yid la mi byed kyi/ gzhan du na de dbul ba'i semasadzarmedang / zhum pa dang / dman pa dang / kho ru chung ba snyam pa'i sems rjes su sems shing mdog ngan pa dang / dri mi zhim pa nyid kyis mgon med pa'i khang pa na gnas te dus 'da' bar byed do/ /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang mgon med par gyur cing 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gtsesarwanyepar gyur la/ srid par skye ba'i gnas mgon med pa'i khang pa na gnas so/ /de 7na sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs bzhugs te/66—696

khong na yod kyang sems can de dag gis khong du ma chud do/ /rigs kyi bu dag de la de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems can dag bdag nyid la khyad du mi gsad par bya ba'i phyir rigs kyi bu dag khyed bdag nyid sro shi bar ma byed par khyed brtson 'grus brtan par gyis shig dang / khyed la de bzhin gshegs pa zhugs pa yod pa dus shig na 'byung bar 'gyur te/ khyed byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro bar 'gyur gyi sems can zhes bya bar ni ma yin no/ /der yang sangs rgyas zhes7bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'i/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya bar ni ma yin no zhes chos ston to/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /ji ltar bud med mgon med gyur pa zhig /kha dog ngan cing gzugs ni mi sdug la/ /byis pa yin te mgon med khang par gnas / /re zhig desalgen de ni der sbrum gyur/ /de yi mngal du gang zhig nges par ni/ /'khor los sgyurasriba'i rgyal po che ba nyid/ /rin chen rnams kyisnyi'aphags pa gling bzhi yi/ /bdag po byed par 'gyur ba de 'dra zhugs/ /bud med byis pa de ni 'di lta bur/ /mngal du zhugs sam ma zhugs mi shes la/ /mgon med khang pa7na ni gnas byed7de/ /dbul ba khyasnyam du sems shing dus 'da' byed/ /de bzhin ngas ni sems can thams cad kyang / /mgon med gyur la sdug bsngal chos kyis nyen/ /khams gsum pa yi bde ba chung la gnas/ /nang na chos nyid mngal gnas 'dra yod mthong / /de 'dra mthong nas71byang chub sems dpa' la/ /'jig rten phan par byed pa mngal gnas na/ /sems can kun gyis chos nyid ma shes kyisatunye/ /bdag dman 8'du shes ma skyed cig ces bstan/ /khyed cag brtson 'grus brtsam 8pa brtan gyis dang / /rang 66—697

lus ring por mi thogs rgyal bar 'gyur/ /dus shig byang chub snying po thob gyur nas / /srog chags stong phrag bye ba grol byed 'gyur/ /rigs kyi bu dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste dper na spra tshil las rta'i gzugs sam/ glang po che'i gzugs sam / bud med kyi gzugs sam/ skyes pa'i gzugs dganyebyas te/ 'jim pa'i nang du bcug nasalgegayogs la bzhu ste/ zagasalgepar byas la gser bzhu ste / zhu bar gyur pas bkang nas rim gyis grangs par7gyur pa na/ mnyam par gnas par gyur pa'i gzugs de dag thams cad phyi rol gyi 'jim pa gnagakyicing kha dog mi sdug kyang nang gi rnams ni gser las byas pa dag go/ /de nas mgar ༅ba'am/ mgar ba'i slob ma zhig gis de las gzugs gang dang gang dag grangs par7gyur pa mthong ba de dang de dag gi phyir rim gyis7'jim pa tho bas bskogs man de nas skad cig de la nang na gser las byas pa'i gzugs yod pa dag yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa yang (1de bzhin gshegs pa'i mig gis ⑩sems can thams cad 'jim pa'i gzugs lta bu yin la/ phyi rol gyi nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i sbubs kyi nang gi sbu gu sangs rgyas kyi chos kyis gang ste/zag pa med pa'i ye shes rin po che'i nang na de bzhin gshegs pa mdzes par 'dugasngo pa mthong ngo / /rigs kyi bu dag de la de bzhin gshegs pas sems can thams cad de ltar mthong nas byang chub sems dpa'i nang du song ste/ 'di lta bu'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di dag yang spudag par rab tu ston to/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag zhi zhing bsil bar gyur pa de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes rin po che7yongs su sbyang ba'itsophyir de 66—698

bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rdo rje'i tho bas phyi rol gyi nyon mongs pa thams cad 'gogs so/ /rigs kyi bu dag mgaratub zhes bya ba de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshig bla dgasasheso/ /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyisabasangs rgyas kyi mig gis sems can thams cad de ltar mthong nas nyon mongs pa de dag las thar bar byas te/sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la rab tu dgoda'agepa'i phyir chos ston to/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /ji ltar gzugs ni phyi rol 'jim pas g.yogs/ /nang ni sbu gu yod cing gsog yin pa//rin chen bzhus pas rab tu bkang na ni/ /brgya stong phrag ni mang por 'gyur ba yin/ /mgar bas shin tu grangs paratsho)gyur shes nas/ /'di ltar rin chen las ni byas pa 'di/ /rnam dag gzugs 'gyur las gang bya snyam ste/ /gzugs la g.yogs pa'i 'jim pa 'gogs par byed/ /de bzhin ngas ni sems can thams cad kyang / /gser gzugs 'jim pas g.yogs pa7'dra ba ste/ /phyi rol shun pa nyon mongs sbubs yin la/ /nang na sangs rgyas ye shes yod par mthong ske/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' gang dag ni/ /zhi zhing shin tu bsil bar gyur pa dag /gang gis de dag nyon mongs ma lus 'byin⑧/ /chos kyisalgelag chas de la 'gogs par byed/ /rin chen gzugs ni blta na sdug pa ltar/ /rgyal sras gang zhig 'dir ni dag gyur pa/ /stobs bcu dag gis lus rnams yongs gang ste/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten 'di na mchod par 'gyur/ /ngas ni srog chags thams cad de ltar mthong / /byang chub sems dpa'ang ngas ni de ltar mthong / /de ltar dag pa bde bar gshegs 'gyur te/ /bde gshegs 66—699

dag ni sangs rgyas tshul ston to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i blo gros la bka' stsal pa/ rdo rje'i blo gros rigs kyi bu'4 / rigs kyi bu mo khyim pa'am rab tu byung ba yang rung ste gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang ske/ klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / glegs bam du byas te 'jog pa dang / gzhanashedag la yang rgya cher 'chad pa dang / yang dag par rab tu ston pa de bsod nams mang du skyed par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje'i7blo gros yang byang chub sems dpa' gzhan gang zhig de bzhin gshegs ༷pa'i ye shes bsgrubalgepa'i phyir brtson par gyur la/ 'jig rten gyi khams re rer yang sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa'i phyir rdzu 'phrul bsgrubs nas 'di lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs bskyed pa des sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag gang gā'i klung gi bye ma bas kyang mang ba rnams su gang gā'i klung gi bye ma bas kyang mang ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang bcas pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa bzhugs shing gnas pa'i ⑦de bzhin gshegs pa re re la yang khang pa brtsegs pa dus su bde ba/ rgyar dpag tshad tsam la 'phang du dpag tshad bcu pa / rin po che thams cad las byas pa/ lha'i dri zhim posnyedang ldan pa/ me tog sil ma sna tshogs bkram pa/ longs spyod kha na ma tho ba med pa thams cad dang ldan pa 'bum phrag gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed nyin re zhing7phul te/bskal pa 'bum du tshang ba'i5)bar du 'di lta bu'i mchod pa byed pa bas rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gzhan57zhig byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ de bzhin 66—700

gshegs pa'i snying po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las dpe ①gcig tsam lus la 'chang ngam/ glegs bam du gnas par byed na/ rdo rje'i blo gros de'i bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa de la bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa snga mas brgya'ikhucha dang / stong gi cha dang / 'bum gyi cha dang / grangs dang / cha dang ske/ bgrang7ba dang / dper yang nye bar mi 'gro ste/ rgyur yang mi bzod do/ /rdo rje'i blo gros yang byang chubasresems dpa' gangasnyisangs rgyas kyi0chos yongs su tshol bas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag las de bzhin gshegs pa re re la yang bskal pa 'bum tshang gi bar du shing man dā ra ba'i me tog khal bzhi pa 'bum 'thor la/ rdo rje'i blo gros dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma zhig gis byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas thal mo lan cig0sbyar te rjes su yi ⑨rang ngo zhes tshig gcig smras na/ rdo rje'i blo gros bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba dang / dge ba mngon par 'du bya ba de la me tog dang ske/ me tog phreng phul ba dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bzhag pa'i bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba dang / dge ba mngon par 'du bya ba snga ma des brgya'i7cha dang / stong gi cha dang / 'bum gyi cha dang / grangs dang /cha dang / bgrang ba dang / dper yang nye bar mi 'gro ste rgyur7yang mi bzod do/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /sems can la la gang zhig byang chub la/ /mos pa bskyed nas 'di nyan 'dzin pa'am/ /yi ger 'dridza8'am glegs bam bzhagashebyed cing / /gus dang bcas pas tshigs bcad gcig ⑩bshad dam/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 66—701

snying po0)'di thos nas/ /gang zhig byang chub mchog 'di tshol byed na/ /bsod nams phung po ji tsam skyed 'gyur ba/ /de yi phan yon 'dir ni mnyan par gyis//rdzu 'phrul stobs mchog 'di la gnas nas su/ /dpa' bo bskal pa ②dag ni stong bar du/ /phyogs bcu rnams su mi yi gtso bo dag /nyan thos bcas pa rnams la bstimachibastang byed/ /ji ltar gang gā'i stong〈pemang bye ba bas/ /de bas lhag pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /gzhal med khang mchog rin chen las byas pa/ /'jig rten slob dpon re re la yang phul/ /de dag 'phang du dpag tshad bcu yod la/ /chu dang rgyar geni dpag tshad gcig yod pa/ /spos dang bdug pa dag dang rab ldan la/ /de na rin chen las byas khri bshams shing / /dar dang bcos pu'i ras ni brgya bting57ba'i/ /khri dag dang ni khri stan⑧gzhan rnams kyang ske/ /ji ltar gang gā'i klung bzhin dpag med pa/ /rgyal ba gcig la dbul ba7byas gyur la/ /rgyal ba gang dag 'jig rten khams7 bzhugs pa/ /ji ltar gang gā'i bye ma bas mang ba/ /rgyal ba de dag rnams la de ltar phul/ /kun la gus par mchod pa byed pa bas/ /mkhas pa gang zhig mdo sde 'di thos nas/ / dpe gcig 37tsam zhig yang dag 'dzin byed dam/ /bzung nas mi 'ga' zhig la 'chad byed na/ /de ni de bas bsod nams phung po mang / /dpa' bos bzung ba'i bsod nams 'di la ni/ /cha dang dper hunyeyang de ni nyer mi 'gro/ /srog chags dag ni kun gyi skyabs 'gyur zhing / /de ni myur du byang chub mchog 'tshang rgya / /de bzhin gshegs kyi snying po 'dra yod pa/ /sems can dag ni 8kun gyi chos nyid 'di/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa gang sems pa'i/ /de ni rang byung sangs rgyas myur du 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i blo gros rnam grangs 'dis kyang 'di 66—702

ltar chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes bsgrub hu)par 'gyur ba'i gces spras ⑧byed par rig par bya'o/ /rdo rje'i blo gros sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa grangs med pa shin tu rgyas pa/ tshad med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/mtshungs pa med pa/ brjod du med pa de'i pha rol bas kyang ches pha rol du gyur pa de'i tshe de'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo7sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rtag tu 'od zer gtong zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ngo / /rdo rje'i blo gros ci'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa de rtag tu 'od zer gtong zhes bya zhe na/ rdo rje'i blo gros bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rtag tu 'od zer gtong de byang chub sems dpar gyur pa gon ma'i mngal du zhugs ma thag tu de ma'i mngal na 'dug bzhin du lus las 'od byung ste/ shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams 'bum phrag sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed dag snang bas rtag tu khyab par gyur to/ /de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / shar lho dang / lho nub dang /nub byang dang / byang shar dang / 'og dang / steng gi phyogs dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'bum phrag sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed dag snang bas rtag tu khyab par gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' de'i lus kyi 'od dga' bar 'gyur ba sdug pa/ mchog tu dga' bar byed pa/ mgu bar 'gyur bas 'jig rten gyi khams 'bum phrag de snyed snang bas rtag tu khyab 66—703

par gyur to/ /rdo rje'i blo gros byang chub sems dpa'atuma'i mngal na gnas pa de'i 'od kyis ②'jig rten gyi khams 'bum de dag tu sems can gang dag la reg par gyur pa de dag thams cad gzi brjidashedang ldan pa dang / kha dog dang ldan pa dang / dran pa dang ldan pa dang / blo gros dang ldan pa dang /rtogs pa dang ldan pa dang / spobs pa dang ldan par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'bum de dag na sems can gang dag sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / lha ma yin rnams kyi nang du skyes par gyur pa de dag thams cad byang chub sems dpa' de'i 'od kyis reg pa tsam gyis rang gi 'gro ba dag nas shi 'phos te lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du skyes so/ /de dag reg pa tsam gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /yang phyir mi ldog pa gang dag la 'od des reg pa de dag reg ma thag tu de dag thams cad mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /yon tan lnga brgya pa'i le'u zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyang thob bo / /byang chub sems dpa' ma'i mngal na gnas pa de'i lus kyi 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams 'bum gang dag la reg par gyur pa de dag thams cad bai drurya slelas grub par yongs su gnas par gyur teyi/ gser gyi skud pas mig mngasasheris su bris par gyur la mig mangs sheris thams cadashekyang rin po che'i shing ljon pa me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / dri dang / kha dog dang ldan pa rnams 'thon par gyur to/ /rin po che'i shing de dag rlung gis bskyod cing rlung gis bskul na 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi sgra dang / chos kyi sgra dang /dge 'dun gyi sgra dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sgra dang / byang chub sems 66—704

dpa'i stobs dang / dbang po dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / rnam parashethar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i sgra snyan pa yid du 'ong ba 'di lta bu〈'di dag byung ngo / /rin po che'i shing ljon pa'i sgra des kyang 'jig rten gyi khams 'bum de dag thams cad na sems can rnams dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba thob nas gnas so/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad na yang sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / lha ma yin gyi ris rnams med par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' ma'i mngal na gnas pa de yang sems can de dag thams cad la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhin du snang bar gyur to/ /mngal na gnas pa nyid la nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du thal mo sbyar ba'i las byas so/ /rdo rje'i blo gros de ltar byang chub sems dpa' de btsas pa dang / mngon par byung ba dang / byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du byang chub sems dpa' de'i lus las7'od rtag tu byung bar gyur to/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas kyang bcom ldan 'das de'i lus las 'od rtag tu byung bar gyur to/ /tshul de bzhin du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus kyi bar du bcom ldan 'das de'i lus kyi 'od de rtag tu byung bar gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de yongs su mya ngan las 'das te/ ring bsrelasnyimachod rten na gnas pa'i tshe'ang lus kyi 'od de rtag tu byung bar gyur tedu/ rdo rje'i blo gros de'i phyir bcom ldan 'das de rtag tu 'od zer gtong ba zhes bya bar lha dang mi rnams kyisakyimatshan gsol to/ /rdo rje'i blo gros yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rtag tu 'od zer 66—705

gtong ba de dang po7mngon par rdzogs paratshalasangs rgyas pa'i bstan pa la7byang chub sems dpa' 'od zer mtha' yas zhes bya ba g.yog stong dang ldan pa zhig byung ste/ rdo rje'i blo gros byang chub sems dpa' 'od zer mtha' yas des bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rtag tu 'od zer gtong de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las btsams te yongs su dris so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rtag tu 'od zer gtong ba des byang chub sems dpa' de dag rjes su gzung ④ba dang /yongs su gzung 47ba'i phyir stan gcig la 'dug bzhin du bskal pa chen po lnga brgyar nade bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yang dag par rab tu bshad de/ des de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di tshig rnam par shes par bya bas chos bsgrub myenapa dang / nges pa'i tshig dang /dpe ri 'bum phrag du mas byang chub sems dpa' de dag la yang dag par rab tu bshad pas tho phyogs bcu rnams su sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su yang tshegs nyu1chung dus go bar gyur to/ /rdo rje'i blo gros de la byang chub sems dpa' gang dag gis nyugede bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di tha na de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po tunyezhes bya ba'i ming thos pa de dag thams cad mthar gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin nas yon tan bkod pa de 'dra ba nyid du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzhi ni ma gtogs 6so/ /rdo rje'i blo gros de'i tshe de'i dus na byang chub 66—706

sems dpa' 'od zer mtha' yas zhes 3)bya bar gyur pa de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du khyod sems na⑧de de ltar mi bltadzageste/ rdo rje'i blo gros khyod nyid de'i tshe de'i dus na byang chub sems dpa' 'od zer mtha' yas zhes gebya bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i bstan pa la gang dag da dung du geyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par sangs ma rgyas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi po de dag gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal dang / mthu chen thob pa du dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang /rdo rje'i blo gros khyod nyid de bzhi po'o/ /rdo rje'i (peblo gros de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos pa tsam gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la sangs rgyas kyi ye shes sgrub ni pas don che ba yin no/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /'das pa'i dus ni bskal pa 9)mtha' yas na/ /bcom ldanatshwa )'od zer gtong zhes bya ba byung / /de yi lus las 'di 'dra'i 'od byung bas/ /zhing rnams bye ba stong dag snang bar gyur/ /rgyal ba dang por mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas rig /byang chub sems dpa' 'od zer mtha' yas kyis11/ /de tshe bde gshegs rgyal dbang de la zhus/ /mdo 'di rtag tu yang dag rab tu bshad//gang gis rgyal de'i bstan (selas mdo sde 'di/ /'dren pa las ni mngon sum thos7gyur pa/ /de kun myur du byang chub dam pa 'thobatso/ /byang chub sems dpa' bzhi ni ma gtogs te/ /mthu chen thob dang spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gsum pa ste/ /rdo rje'i blo gros khyod nyid bzhi pa yin/ /de tshe de dag gis ni mdo 'di thos/ /byang chub sems 66—707

dpa' 'od zer mtha' yas pa/ /de tshe gang gisanyergyal la zhus byung ste/ /de yi dbang byas bde gshegs sras po ni/ /de tshe rdo rje'i blo gros khyodakhunyid yin/ /nga yang sngon gyi spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ /bde bar gshegs pa seng ge'i rgyal mtshan las / /mdo sde 'di yi ming ni thos par gyur/ /gus par byas te thos nas thal mo sbyar/ / nga ni〈khulegs par byas pa'i las de yisadu/ /byang chub dam pa myur du thob par gyur/ /de bas byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyis/ /rtag tu mdo mchog 'di ni gzung ⑧bar bya/ /rdo rje'i blo gros ⑥rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo las kyi sgrib pas bsgribs pa gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan tam/ lung nod dam/ kha tonashedu byed dam/ston kyang rung / chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan pa dang / lung nod pa dang /kha ton byed pa dang / rab tu 'chad pa dang / yi ger 'dri'ub de dag las tshegs nyu)chung ngus chos de dag kyang mngon sum du 'gyur/ las kyi sgrib pa de yang tsobyang bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang las kyi sgrib pas bsgribs tunyepar mi 'gyur zhing chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la brtson par bgyid pa de dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ji snyed cig〈rtelas mang du thos pas chos bstan pa'i slad du nges par 'byung bar 'gyur lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang dag sangs rgyas brgya'i chos bstan pa kun tu gzung 8ba'i phyir nges par 'byung ba de dag kyang yod do/ /kun dga' bo rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang dag sangs rgyas nyis brgyachadang / sum brgya dang / bzhi 66—708

brgya dang / lnga brgya dang / stong dang / nyis stong dang / sum stong dang /bzhi stong dang / lnga stong dang / drug stong dang / bdun stong dang / brgyad stong dang / dgu stong dang / khri dang / sangs rgyas 'bum nas/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum gyi bar dag gi7chos ston pa kun tu gzung ba'i phyir nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ba dag kyang yod do/ /kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa dang / glegs bam du byas te/ 'chang ba des 'di snyam du bdag gis deng nyid bla na med pakhuyang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bo snyam du sems bskyedashepar bya ste/ de ni ji ltar da ltar ngasnyibazhin du lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis phyag bya ba'i 'os dang / mchod pa'i 'os yin no/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /byang chub sems dpasalgemado sde 'di thos nas/ /bdag gis7byang chub dam pa thobalgepar bsam/ /gang gi ④lag na mdo sde 'di yod pa/ /de ni dmakhyaltar 'jig rten phyag bya'i 'os/ /de ni 'jig rten mgon po rnam par 'dren/ /khrid byed rnam par khrid byed bsngags 3 )pa'i 'os/ /gang gi〈nyelag na mdo sde 'di yod pa/ /de ni de〈nyeltar chos kyi rgyal zhes bya/ /gang gi5)lag na mdo sde 'di yod pa/ /mi yi khyu mchog chos kyi sgron ma 'dzin/ /de ni nyi zla lta bur bltahūba'i 'os8/ /'jig rten mgon po lta bur phyag bya'i gnas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i blo gros dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs de dag 66—709

dang ske/ nyan thos chen po de dag dang / 'khor bzhi po7dang / lha dang / mi dang —/ lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te②/bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstodakyido// //'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs sobu// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad ⑥kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab nga/ske// //bsdur mchan/678 stimatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈co 〉〉tā/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bzangs can/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉bzang tsanda/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉bslob/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉tshangs pa'i/679 )7〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 can/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉kyi/ ni〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉steng /bos〈〈g.yung 〉〉 chang nga / ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rlung / 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉ga ya/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gā yul/ 〈〈pe〉〉gā lā/ ⑦〈〈co 〉〉 dang / ⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉ka cu'i/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉kā cu'i/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉ba ku/ hu )〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sngo/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉di rgyas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉di n+ya/ 8〈〈g.yung 〉〉can/ hunye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉las/ ④〈〈li 〉〉gcig ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gāng ga'i/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉bcu'i/( 7〈〈co 〉〉skye ba/ 8〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉snyen/ tunye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉'gyur ba/68 ①〈〈co 〉〉ge/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉ba'/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 pa/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉 pa/ ge〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 pa/ du〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ba/ ⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉gnan/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉 pa/ ⑧⑨⑩〈〈pe 〉〉dbyu/ (7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉mkha'/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉/ri bo dang / hunye〈〈g.yung 〉〉 chen/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ba/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉par sgrags/ ⑩〈〈khu 〉〉slang / hu 〉〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sgyur/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉las/3tshe〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉bcu'i/ sti 〈〈li 〉〉gcig66wa 710

gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa 17ma mdzad na/ de bzhin gshegs pa la su yang ②zhu ba 'di lta bu zhu bar mi 'gyur ro/ /khyad par sems de'i phyir khyod legs par rab tu50nyon la yid la zung shigasredang ngas khyod la bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chubasnyisems dpa' khyad par sems kyis bcom ༅ldan 'das kyi ⑦ltar nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpas chos gcig gang spang bar bya ba'isnyichos gcig po gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/'dod chags kyi chos te/ rigs kyi bu 'di ni spang bar bya ba'i chos gcig go/ /yang spang bar bya ba'i chos gcig ste/ 'di ltar zhe sdang gi chos te/ 'di ni spang bar bya ba'i chos gcig go1)/ /yang spang bar bya ba'i chos gcig ste0/'di ltar gti mug gi chos te/ 'di ni spang bar bya ba'i chos gcig go/ /yang spang bar bya ba'i chos gcig ste/ 'di ltar bdag tu 'dzin pa ste/ 'di ni spang bar bya ba'i chos gcig go/ /yang spang bar bya ba'i chos gcig ste/ 'di ltar le lo ste/ 'di ni spang bar bya ba'i chos gcig go/ /yang spang bar bya ba'i chos gcig (1ste/ 'di ltar rmugs pa dang gnyid de/ 'di ni spang bar bya ba'i chos gcig go/ /yang spang bar bya ba'i chos gcig ste/ 'di ltar sred pa ste/'di ni spang bar bya ba'i chos gcig go/ /rigs kyi bu yang byang chub sems dpa' spang bar bya ba'i chos gcig ste/ 'di ltar ma rig pa〈rteste/ rigs kyi bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpas hunyespang bar bya ba'i chos gcig go/ /rigs kyi bu gang byang chub sems dpas 34rtag par rgyun du mngon par bsrung7bar bya ba'i chos gcig po de gang zhe na/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpasalgegang bdag 66wa 722

mi 'dod pa de gzhan dag la mi bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'atugang la la zhig chos gcig po de srungasnyen/ des de bzhin gshegs pa'i bslab pa'i gzhishethams cad bsrungasalgepar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu gang bdag gi mesrog phangs par 'dzin pa de ⑥srog mi gcod do/ /gang bdag gi nor phangs par 'dzin7pa de ma byin par mi len to/ /gang bdag gi chung ma phangs7par 'dzin pa de gzhan gyi chung ma'i gan du mi 'gro'o/ /rigs kyi bu de la sogs te/ gang la la zhig 'di snyamanyedu de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' bzhin du bya'o snyam du sems patshwa)des chos gcig po 'di bsrungakhebar bya'o zhes bshad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu gang la la bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba de dag 8thams cad ni rang gi bde ba'i rgyur don du gnyer gyi/ su yangakhebadag sdug bsngal ba mi 'dod de /nye/'gro ba ni bde ba 'dod ces bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /gang khyed cag mi 'dod pa de gzhan dag la ma byed cig ces nga smra'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni gang byang chub sems dpas〈nyertag par rgyun du mngon par bsrung bar bya ba'i chos gcig go/ /rigs kyi bu gang de bzhin gshegs pas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i chos gcig po de gang yin zhes de skad7zer ba ni rigs kyi bumanye gang de bzhin gshegs pas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i chos gcig po de༄)gang yang med do/ /rigs kyi bu gang la chos gang yang rtogs rdunyepa med pa de de bzhin gshegs pasamanyemangon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu yang de bzhin gshegs pas chos thams cad ma skyes par thugs su chud do/ /de bzhin gshegs pas chos thams cad 'gags〈 gepa med par thugs su chud do/ /rigs 66—723

kyi bu yang de bzhin gshegs pas chos thams cad mtha' gnyis las grol bar thugs su chud do/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pas chos thams cad ma byunganyebar thugs su chud do/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pas las bdag gir bya bar thugs su chud do/ /de bzhin gshegs pas chos thams cad rgyu dang rkyen las rirag las par thugs su chud do/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pas rgyu dang rkyen ni glog ri dang 'dra bar thugs su chud do/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rgyu dang rkyen med pa salas skye ba med par thugs su chud do/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pas rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po'i chos nyid thugs su chud do/ /ci'i phyir yongs su rtog pa dag rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po zhes smra zhe na/rigs kyi bu 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes la dusogs pa rinegang dag ci 'byung ba'i mngal de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gang gi tshe ye shes de'i 7cirang bzhin la yongs su rtog pa de'i tshe shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i⑧mngal du chud pa yin te/ de'i tshe rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i ming 'thob 9bo/ /rigs kyi bu yang de bzhin gshegs pas chos thams cad sgyu ma dang smig rgyu nyu chodang 'dra bar thugs su chud do/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rang bzhin gyis rnam par grol ba'i rang girwamachos nyid thugs su chud do/ /rnam par grol ba 12gang yin pa de rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po'i tunyechos nyid do/ /rigs kyi bu yang de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi sgo gcig thugs su chud de(ste/rigs kyi bu gang la 'gro ba med pa dang / 'ong ba med pa dang / rgyu med pa dang ske/ rkyen med pa dang / 'chi 'pho med pa dang / skye ba med pa dang /blang ba med pa dang / dor ba med pa dang / 'grib pa med pa dang / 'phel 66—724

ba med pa dang / rigs kyi bu gang rang bzhin gyis rang bzhin med de/ gang la dper bya bar mi nus pa dang / gang yi ge dang nges pa'i tshig gis brjod par mi nus pa'i chos kyi sgo gcig po de de bzhin gshegs pas thugs su chud do/ /bkod pa'i rgyal po bstan pa yi ge med pa'i za ma togaturnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i mig la rdul ②phya rabakhuji snyed snang bar 'gyur ba de snyed kyi7sems can rnams kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de snyed gcig gis dgra bcom pa nyidarnyumangon du byas so/ /de bas ches mang ba'i sems can dag sems can dmyal ba nas shi 'phos nas lha dang mir skyes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' du ma ni sa thob par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' du ma ni ting nge 'dzin brgya stong mngon du gyur to/ /mang du ci dgos7te gtam 'di ni su la yangasadon med par ma gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcanamaguzin la bka' stsal pa/ sgra gcan〈spe zin khyod nga'i chos kyi tshul 'di gzung tu bar spro bar gyis shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ma thag tu sangs rgyas kyi mthus 'khor de nas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag dgu stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi tshul 'di bdag cag gis gzungakhebar bgyi'o/ /slad ma'i tshe slad ma'i dus na byang chub sems dpa'i snod du 'tshal bar bgyis〈snyel/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed du yang dag par bshad par bgyi'o/ /rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis gang dag 'di lta 66—725

bu'i chos kyi snod du gyur pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'otshi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de la gzigs nas bka' stsal pa/grogs po dag shin tu rgyas pa bsdus pa'ikhuyi ge med pa'i za ma tog rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan pa de dag ni dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ngu dang ldan par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nga la skyes bu dam pa de dag gis bkur stir zhubyas/ bla mar byas/ btsun par byas pa'i phyir ro/ /rigs kyi bu de dag ni nga'i byang chub phrag pa la thogs par 'gyur ro/ /de dag gi spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa rgyun mi 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /de dag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing shin tu yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe na yangaphude bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gyis yongs su bskor 2cing byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis mdun gyis bltas nas mdun na bzhugs par gyur te mthong bar 'gyur ro/ / nga yang〈pebyang chub sems dpa' 'di dag nyid dang thabs cig 98)tu ri'i rgyal po bya rgod kyi phung po la gnas par mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de dag gi chos kyi mdzod mi zad par 'gyur ro / /de dag tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /ngan song rnams su skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu nga tshini 'jig rten thams cad dang mi 'thunatshwakye pa'i tshig 'di smra ste/ rigs kyi bu dag 11gal te mtshamasaspyo med pa lnga byed par 'gyur la/chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lus la btags 32sam/ yi ger 'dri 0'am/ klog gam/kun chub par byed na de ni ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung bar 'gro bar ngas ma mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang 66—726
