༄ga /'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/1)༄7gi /rgya gar skad du/ ārya ā kābasha gandha nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa7dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das ri kha la ti ④ka na gnas thub pa'i drang srong rnams kyi gnas nas/ nyan thos chen po bgrang 5)ba las 'das pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang 57thabs cig 5kyego/ /'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gā'ipo)klung gi bye ma snyed dpag tu med/ grangs med pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang77yang thabs cigarwa1tu bzhugs tehurte/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal gyi dam tshig lung bstan pa'i mthar phyin ma thag tu yang hunyede'i tshe na nub phyogs (snyen brgya byin thogs pa'i nor bu rin po che 'bum phrag du mas bskor 8cing mdun du bdar 66wa 731

ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che snang ste/ yang nor bu rin po che de'i 'od kyis stong gsum gyi7stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi7khams 'di na gzugs su snang ba thams cad ma lus par mi snang bar gyur te②/ de bzhin gshegs pa ma gtogasadzagepar gang lha dang / mi rnams dang / gnyan thos rnams dang / gang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / gang sa dang / chu dang / me dang /rlung rnams kyi gzugs su snang ba'i 'byung ba chen po ji snyed pa'i 'byung ba chen po snang ba de dag thams cad ma lus par spangs par gyur cing nor bu rin po che snang ngo / /lhag ma dag kyang mtha' yas mu med pa brjod du med pa nam mkha'aphubazhin du snang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyang shin tu lham me/ lhan ne/ lhang nger gyur to/ /sems can gang dag der 'dus pa de dag kyang bdag kyang mi mthong ngo / /gcig gis gcig kyang mi mthong ngo / /de dag la 'byung ba chen po'i gzugs su snang ba thams cad 'gags nas yang mig tu snang bar ma gyur to//bdag bdag gi lus kyi gzugs dang / mtshanashedang / dbyibs7dang /rig ⑨pa yang mi dmigs par gyur te/ gang dang gang gis brtags pa de dang de dag stong par mthong ngo / /nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yang mi mthong /skar ma'i gzugs dang / sa'i khams dang / chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang ske/ rlung gi khams kyang mig lamatshwanyedu snang bar ma gyur to/ /sgra dag kyang rna lam du gragatsobar ma gyur to/ /drirwanyedag kyang snachal bro bar ma gyur to/ /sems dang sems las byung78ba rnams la yang ngar 'dzin pa dang / nga yir 'dzin pa dang / skye mched drug gi 'du shes mi 'byung bar gyur to/ /yang 'byung ba7)chen po dag kyang mi dmigs par gyur te/ phyogs gang dang gang du 66—732

brtags pa de dang / de'i phyogs thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ①mtshan dang / kha dog dang / dbyibs dang / gzugs su mthong bar gyur to//rgyang ma ②nas kyang brgya byin thogs pa'i nor bu ①rin po ches bskor ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che snang ba las gzhan chung zad kyang mi snang bar gyur to / /gang de na byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu la gnas pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob pame/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa/ srid pa tha ma pa de dag gis ltas7de mthong nas 'jigs par mi byed/ dngangasalgepar mi byed/skrag par mi byed de/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis yang dag pa'i mtha' dang ske/ de bzhin nyid dang / stong pa nyid dang ldan par rtogasalgepas de'i phyir de dag 'jigs par mi byed/ dngangs71par mi byed/ skrag par mi byed do/ /gang lhag ma byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po7dag dang / nyan thos dag dang / lha dag dang / klu dgarwanyedang / gnod sbyin dag dang / dri za dag dang / lha ma yin dag dang / nam mkha' lding dgacadang / mi'am ci dag dang / lto7'phyes chen po dag dang / grul bum dang / yi dgas dang /sha za dang / srul po dang / lus srul po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa 'dus pa de dag ma lus par 'jigs par gyur/ dngangasatshwanyepar gyur/ skyo bar gyur〈rtenas / tshu rol dang pha rol la rmongs shing sems 'khrugs nas de dag gcig gis gcig kyang mi mthong / de na 'di ci zhig /'di ji lta bu zhig /'di ci'i rang bzhin zhes dri ba yang gang yang mi snang ngo / /yang de'i tshe na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshangs pa'i gzer bu chen po zhes bya bas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de gsol pa/ chos 66—733

kun gyi ni rang bzhin la/ /gang zag gang dag ma 'tshal ba/ /gzugs phung la ni gnas gyur nas/ /dbang po drug la rmongs par gyur/ /phung po gcig ni mi mthong zhing / /gzugs kyi phung la rtogate①bgyid de/ /'dishel gang zag kha cig ni / /sangs rgyas chos la the tshom51'tshal/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di dag la / /chos kyi de bzhin mtshan nyid gsungs/ /de dag tshu rol pha rol la /bzod pa'i nam mkha'i mtshan 'tshal to/ /'di ni mnyam bzhagasredapa' ba ste/ /brjod du med pa'i gnas lags so/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen che/ / spyi bo52la ni mchis par gda'/ /nor bu rin chen brgya byin thogs/ /gang dag la ni rgyang nas gda'/ /sems can de dag skal ba57che/ /dpa' 'gro'i pha rol shin tu phyin/ /ston pa lta bar mchis pa rnams/ /de dag thams cad shes rab che / /de ring 'dir ni zab mo'i gtam/ /mchi phyabar 'gyur ba gdon mi 'tshal / /bcom ldan gegang dag 'dir phyin pa'i/ /sems can dag la dbugs dbyung mdzod/ /sems can yongs smin bgyi slad du/ /'di ni dpa' bo'i spyod yul lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ji skad smras papo)de bzhin te/ /gang na kun gzhi hu )thos gyur cing / /shes rab kyis ni sems can gnas/ /de ni ting 'dzin spyod yul lo/ /de ni nam mkha'i snying po yi / /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul te/ /snang ba med cing spros hu7med pa'i/ /ting nge 'dzin ni de yis bstan/ /lta ba gnyis la gang chags pa/ /phyi5)phyir zhing ni rmongs par 'gyur/ /rtag dang chad la chags pa ni/ /pha rol tshu rol shin tu rmongs/ /lta ba gnyis po 'di dag las/ /rab tu grol bar su 'dod pa / /brjod du nyunyemed pa bsgomachapar gyis/ /de ni myur du sa 'thob78'gyur/ /66wa 734

kye grogs po dag gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po las thog ma pa la de nyid brjod du yod pa'i 'du shes kyi tshul gyis dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug brjod par bya ste/ 'di lta ste/ ci nas kyangashe'abyung ba chen po rnams kyi rang bzhin skye zhing 'jig pa shes par byas nas/de'i 'og tu gzodakhuchos thams cad brjod du med pa'i ngo bo nyid mi skye mi 'gag pa / mi dmigs pa cung zad kyang med pa'i 'du byed thams cad bsgomasapar bya ste / ci nas kyang rtag ④pa dang chad pa spangs par ⑤'gyur ba dang / mi 'jigs / mi dngangs⑥/ mi skrag par 'gyur ba dang / chos thams cad la chags par dmigs pa'i sems su ma gyur par byas na de myur du pha rol tu7)phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs shing / phyin cadangoshekyang chad pa dang rtag pa la mi gnas par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal nas/ 'khor der lhags pa thams cad kyang sngon spugazugs kyi snang ba ji ltar mthong ba dang / thos pa dang ske/ rtogs pa dang / shes pa de bzhin du 'khor der mthong bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag g.yas pa brkyang ste 'di skad ces bka' stsal to / /nam mkha'i snying po zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho dang mtshungs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' bslab pa ri rab dang mtshungs pa/ ye shes nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa/ brtson 'grus rlung dang mtshungs pa/ bzod pa rdo rje dang mtshungs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ni rgyal mtshan gyi mchog lta bu mya ngan las 'da' ba'itshwanye gnas su 'gro ba rnams kyi ni ded dpon lta bu/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi ni gter lta bu / sdug bsngal ba thams cad kyi ni bum pa bzang po lta bu/ mun par bcug 66—735

pa rnams kyi ni nyi ma lta bu/ lam stor7ba rnams kyi ni7zla ba lta bu/ 'jigs pa rnams kyi ni ri rab lta bu/ nyon mongs pa'i⑧nad kyis yongs su gdungs pa rnams kyi ④ni sman bcud kyis len pa lta bu/ dge ba'i rtsa ba chad de lhung ⑤ba rnams kyi ni 'khar ⑥ba lta bu/ phreng bas 'tsho ba rnams kyi ni me tog lta bu/sdom pa spyod pa rnams kyi ni ④me long lta bu/ ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa rnams kyi7ni gos lta bu/ mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gro ba7rnams kyi ni stegs lta bu/ pha rol du 'gro ba rnams kyi ni gru lta bu/ mtho ris su 'gro ba rnams kyi ni them skas lta bu/ tshig ngan pa dang skur pas (tegadungs pa rnams kyi ni gdugs lta bu/ pha rol gyi rgol bsnyernams kyi7ni seng ge lta bu/ chararnyupa rnams kyi7ni chu lta bu/ bdud kyi dgra rnams kyi ni go cha lta bu/ bslab pa 'khrul pa rnams kyi ni mig 'byed pa lta bu/ dge ba'i rtsa ba'i lo tog thams cad kyi ni sa lta bu/ nad pa rnams kyi ni sman pa lta bu/ bkres pa rnams kyi ni 'bru lta bu/ skom pa rnams kyi ni7chu shel lta bu/ ngal ba rnams kyi ni mal lta bu/ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa rnams kyi ni me shel lta bu/ byang chub kyi lam du zhugs pa rnams kyi ni shing rta lta bu/ skyed7mos tshal na rtse ba rnams kyi ni rdzing bu lta bu/byang chub kyi phyogs la brtson pa rnams kyi ni phreng ba lta bu de tshur 'ong ste/ rigs kyi bu de pha rol tu phyin pa rnams kyi ni 'bras bu lta bu/ rigs kyi bu de sa bcu dang ldan pa rnams kyi ni nor bu yid bzhin lta bu/ rigs kyi bu de dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge༄ge'adzin dang ldan pa rnams kyi ni shing yongs 'du7dang 'dra ba/gcod pa'i phyir lta ba ngan pa'i sbyor ba thams cad kyi ni 6)mtshon lta bu/'joms pa'i phyir bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi 66—736

ni rdo rje lta bu/ bdud rnams kyis7ni thub par dka'akhub/ thabs dang ldan pa rnams la ni tshes7grangs/ ye shes kyi ni 'byed pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi ni gnas/ rang rgyal ba rnams kyi ni phreng ba dang mtshungs pa/ nyan thos thams cad kyi ni gos dang mtshungs pa/ lha rnams kyi ni mig lta bu/ mi rnams kyi ni lam lta bu/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa rnams kyi ni skyabs/ yi dgasakyirnams kyi ni rten/ sems can dmyal ba pa rnams kyi ni mgon/ sbyin gnas kyi sems can thams cad kyi ni busnod du ⑨gyur pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ni shing rta lta bu/ rigs kyi bu de dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ni blon po lta bu/ chos kyi grong khyer gyi ⑦ni sgo srungs yin te/rigs kyi bu de lasangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco ⑨brgyad kyi bar gyis ni brgyan pa thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang ni ldan/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin gshegs pa ma gtogs par sems can thams cad kyis mchod pa'i dam pa thams cad kyis mchod par bya ba yin gyis/ da khyed 'dir lhags pa thams cad kyis7bsu bar gyis shig /mchod pa dang bkur ste thams cad kyis de la ci nus par rin po che'i gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang ske/ me tog dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / lha'i gos dang rka/ rgyan dang / snod sna tshogs kyis bkur ster gyis0)shig /rim gror gyis shig /bsti〈nyestang gyis〈nyeshig /mchod par gyis shig /lam byi dor gyis shig /brgyan7par gyis shig /bstod pa sna tshogs kyis bstod par gyis shig /khyed thams cad kyang7de lta bu'i yon tan thobalgepa dang / snod du gyur par 66—737

ring porapha'o)mi thogs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'khor lhags pa ma lus pa mtha' dag stan las langs nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po phyogs gang logs na snang ba'i phyogs de logs su mngon⑧du phyogs nas thal mo sbyar te/ snying ni rab tu dga'/ bzhin ni rab tu 'dzum/ mig kyang rab tu dang bas lta gzhing 'dug par gyur pa dang / 'khor de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / nyan thos chen po dang / lha'i dbang po dang / klu'i dbang po dang / gnod sbyin gyi dbang po dang / dri za'i dbang po dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po dang / nam mkha' lding gi dbang po dang ske/ mi'am ci'i dbang po dang / lto 'phyeshechen po'i dbang po dang / drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa de dag thams cad 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ bdag cag gis rigs kyi bu 'di la bkod pa'i mchog ji lta bu zhig gis bkural ste bya snyam mo/ /de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying pos sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed 'di thams cad ma lus par rin po che sna bdun las byasam④shing / ri dang / 'brog dang /ri skam dang / phug dang / grog po dang / g.yang sa dang / rtswa dang /rtsig spupa dang / bong ba dang / gsog ma dang / dri nga ba lasngo )sogs pa med la lag mthil lta bur mnyam par sprul to/ /desarwadzodapal dri za'i skad du brjod pa'i glu dbyangs dang / shing thams cad kyang rin po che sna bdun las byas te/ dri zhim pa dang / 'dab ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bur tunyeldan par sprul to / /shing ljon pa dang / rtswa hunyedang / skam shing dang / 'dabasnyam sa la rten 8pa thams cad kyang rin po che sna bdun las byas pa sprul to/ /mi mjed kyi 66wa 738

'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad na yang nad ni rab tu zhi/ sems can dmyal ba pa dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas pa dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa rnams kyi sdug bsngal thams cad kyang rab tu zhi/ sems can dag gis kyang zas dang ske/ skomanyedang / gos dang / chos gos dang / rgyan dag thobalgepar gyur to/ /de'i tshe gang dag mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i sems can de dag thams cad kyang bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur te/gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa blta na sdug pa/ kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan zhing yan lag thams cad ni yongs su rdzogs/ rdul med pa rab rib dang bral ④ba'i snang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od kyis ni mdzes par byas/nyon mongs pa rnams dang ni bral/ sems ni rab tu zhi/ dge ba thams cad la ni sems mos/ dkon mchog gsum la ni sems rab tu dad par gyur nas 'khor der lhags pa'i sems canasare re'i lag pa gnyis ka na yang nor bu rin po che thogs par mthong bar sprul nas nor bu rin po che de re re las kyang so so dang 'tsham pa'i 'od zer gyi snang ba byung bar gyur te/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di thams cad ma lus par snang ba chen po des khyab par gyur to/ /nor bu rin po che de dag las kyang rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs byung bar gyur to/ /nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyi char yang mngon par bab par gyur to/ /gos bzang po sna tshogs kyi char dang / rgyan sna tshogs kyi char dang / me tog sna tshogs kyi char dang / spos sna tshogs kyi char dang / phreng ba sna tshogs kyi char dang ske/ gdugs〈sna tshogs kyi char dang / snod sna tshogs kyi char dang /'bras bu sna tshogs kyi char yang bab par gyur to/ /lha'i gos dang / chos gos 66—739

dang /① gser gyi skud pa dang / mu tig gi⑧so mo do dang / me tog pad ma dang ske/ ud pa la dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po dang / u ra ga sa la byu1dang / tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po dang / shing tasnyim la'i 'dab0ma dang ske/ tsan dan sa mchog pa'i bye mas lam der bkram par mngon par sprul to / /lam de'i g.yas g.yon gnyi gar7rnam par rgyal byed kyi khang pa dang 'dra ba / rin po che sna bdun gyi khang bzangs kyangasnyimangon par sprul te⑨/ khang pa de na 'dod pa'i dbang phyug gi chung ma dam pa dang / slas dang 'dra ba dang /yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i sil snyan sgrogs shingalo )rtse dga' zhing dga' dgur7spyod pa de 'dra ba dag der sprul to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i steng gi nam mkha' la lha'i hustenor bu rin po che las byas pa'i tshangs pa chen po'i gdugs lta bu'i hunyedapag tshad brgya tsam la rin po che'i dra ba'i skud pa dang / mu tig gihūrgyan phreng gis legs par brgyan pa mngon par sprul te/ rgyan de dag las kyang lha las 'das pa'i sil snyan yan lag lnga dang ldan pa'i glu'i dbyangs kyi sgra 'byung ngo ske/ /rtswa nyusnyedang / shing dang / 'dabatsom dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu la 3 7sogs pa gang ci yang rung ste sa la rten hunyepa de dag thams cad las kyang lha las 'das pa'i yan lag lnga〈cadang ldan pa'i sil snyana' )las bstod pa'i sgra 'byung bar grag ste/ sgra de gang gi rnar thos pa'i sems can de dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /de nas 'khor de dag thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po'i bkod pa chen po 2nyede mthong ste/ shin tu ngo mtshar dang rmad du byung ba'i chos thob nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 66wa 740

skyes bu dam pa de'i stanatuji lta bur bsham7snyam mo/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rin po che las byas pa'i nime tog pad ma sdong 0bu ni dngul/ lo ma ni gser/ snying po ni rin po che rdo'i snying po/ ze ba ni nor bu rin po che tshangs pa'i 'od zer las byas pa/ rgyar ni rgyang grags gcig tsam yod pa/ me tog pad ma'i ze ba'i stan rnam pa 'bum phrag du mas yongs su bskor cing mdun dudu bdar duba'i pad ma byung nas pad ma'i steng de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po skyilashemo krung7bcas te 'dug par snang ngo / /de'ishespyi bo la yang nor bu rin po che 'dug par snang ngo / /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po'i g.yog byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa brgya byin thogs pa'i nor bu rin po ches7brgyan pa 'bum phrag mang po rnams kyang rang rang gi pad ma'i ze ba'i stan la 'khod par snang ngo / /de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi rgyal po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen rnams/ /gang dag sngon du 'ongs57pa ni/ /gus dang ldan pas phyag byas te/ /phyi nas stan la 'dug byed na/ /skyes bu dam pa 'di 'ongs na8/ /bkod chen dag kyang bstan7gyur na/ /ston la phyag kyang ma btsal bar/ /stan la 'dug pa7lta bur snang / /sman gyi rgyal pos smras pa/skyes bu dam pa 'di nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas chos la rab gnas mthong / /rtog pa kun la mi gnas pas/ /sems can du ni mi mthongasnyingo / /byang chub sems dpa' byams pas smras pa/ yang dag mtha' la gnas pa'i phyir/ /de ltar 66—741

sems can mi mthong na/ /bkod pa chemanyu7'di ci phyir bstanas/ /the tsomashegyur pa bshad par comadzod/ /sman gyi rgyal pos smras pa/ kun tu rtog5⑧pa'i spyod yul can/ /byis pas don dam mi shes te/ /sems can yongs smin bya ba'i phyir / /'di ni dpa' bo'i thabs yin no/ /don dam gyis ni sdug bsngal ba/ /de dag rab tu dgrolasngonaba'i phyir/ /mkhas pas kun rdzobartsomabaden pa yisani/ /'di 'dra ba yi ⑨bkod pa bstan/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sman gyi rgyal po la legs so zhes bya ba byin te legs so legs so/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod kyis ji skad smras pa de bzhin te/byis pa so so'i skye bo sems can thams cad ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang rgyun du zhugs pa tshigacig gi /rkyaspyod yul dang / sbyor ba dang / rnam par grol ba mi shes so/ /yongs su brtag pa bzung na gal te sems can thams cad rgyun du zhugs par gyur na yang de dag gis lan cigatshwa)phyir 'ong ba gcig gi spyod yul dang / sbyor ba dang / rnam par grol ba mi shes so/ /de bzhin du lan cig 1 phyir 'ong ba rnams kyis kyang phyir mi 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba rnams kyis kyang dgra bcom pa dang / dgra bcom pa rnams kyis kyang rang sangs rgyas kyi mimi shes te/ gal te sems can thams cad bse tsharu lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas su gyur kyang de dag thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' 7mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa gcig gi 1 spyod yul dang / rnam par grol ba dang / don dam pa la brtag nya8pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i sbyor ba mi shes so/ /yongs su brtag pa bzung na gal te sems hu can thams cad du ) mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur kyang de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' so so 66—742

rig pa thob pa/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa gcig gi spyod yul dang ske/ mos pa dang / don dam pa'i bden pa la brtag pa'i byin gyis brlabs7mi shes so/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i〈snying po 'di yang mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thobasi0 so sor rig pa thobadu/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob nas bskal pa dpag tu med pa las7'das te/ ji ltar da ltar nga'i 'dus pa chen po nas3)'khod pa'i sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal shes nas ji ltar 'di na sems can kha cig bkod pa chen po 'di'i 3)phyir 'ong zhing ting nge 'dzin dang / bkod pa chen po blta niba'i phyir 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa la gnas par 'gyur ba dang ske/ ji ltar rigs kyi bu de 'di nyid du mi snang bar gyur nas nub phyogs nas 'dirakyi'ong zhing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams dang thun mong ma tshiyin pa/ mtha' yas pa'i nam mkha' mtha' 37yas skye 32mched kyi mngon par shes pa dang / ting nge 'dzin kyang bstan3)/ sems can thams cad kyang skyo bar byas nas de'i 'og tu sems can dpag tu med pa yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir kun rdzob kyi bden pas bsgrub sapa'i bkod pa chen po yang bstan/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bkod pa chen po yang bstan pa bzhin no/ /gal te rigs kyi bu de don dam pa'i bden pa mi skye ba'i bkod pa ston du zin na lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten rmongs par 'gyur/ bslad 8par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sa brgyad pa la gnas pa'i bar du yang bslad par 'gyur bas 'di'i spyod yul dang /sbyor ba'i mtshan ma ston par mi nus te/ de ltar chos zab mo'i yon tan la gnas so/ /rigs kyi bu de ni thabs shes pa la gnas so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos 66—743

rgya mtsho thams cad la gnas sel/ /the tshomasamed do/ /ye shes gzhan la ragashem las pa la mkhas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rgyal mtshan gyi mchog rgyal po la 'os pa dang 'dra'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po de ni sems can thams cad mtho ris dang thar par skye bar stonakyipa'o / /sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi nyon mongs pa'i nad las yongs su thar bar byed pa'o/ /lus kyi dug 'byung ba chen po'ishend gso bar byed pa'o/ /sems can gang dag lta ba ngan pas sdug bsngal bar gyur pa'i 'khor ba'i 'brog bslad ⑧nas mtho ris dang thar par gnas pa'i thabs mi shes pa de dag kyang gal te byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i ming rjod ⑨par byed(spre/phyag 'tshal bar byed/ dri 'bul/ a ga ru'i bdug pas bdugatsa)par byed na/rigs kyi bu de ni de dag gi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal btsodang / de dag gi nyon mongs pa dang ldan pa'i lta ba tunyesems dang 'brel pa ci 'dra ba dang /sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed7pa ci7'dra ba la yang rtog cing sems sbyong bakheji lta bur bya ba'i rigs〈 7pa dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas la bskyedarwanyepa'am/ chos la bskyed7)pa'am/ dge 'dun la bskyedamanye pa'am/ bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po sbyin pa'i rang bzhin nam/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin nam/ bsgom5)pa'i rang bzhin yang rung ste/ de dag thams cad mi lam na yang〈 nyerung / sadamanyepa'i tshe yang rung ste/ de bzhin du thabs mkhas pas mngon sum du lam drang po'i thabs kyis ston te/ thabs des lta ba ngan pa dang / byed pa dang /smon lam ngan pa'i bsam pa dang / skyabs ngan pa dang / ngan par 'jug pa'i sems las myur du thar bar byed do/ ci nas kyang de'i tsolus dang /66—744

ngag dang / yid kyi sbyor ba drang por 'gyur ba dang / smon lam drang po dang /dge ba'i bshesasheganyen drang po dang / bstan⑧par 'gyur ba dang / myur du dri mi zhim pa dang / nyon mongs pa dang / sdig pa'i lta ba las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ba dang / de dag gi ngan song du 'gro ba'i sdig pa'i lam thams cad smon lam gyi dbang dang / legs par spyad pa'i las kyis myur du byang bar 'gyur ba dang / de dag myur du bdag gi50sems la dbang thob par 'gyur bsnyidang ske/ zab mo'i bzod pa la gnas par 'gyur ba'i thabs ston to/ /gang yang sems can lus la nad sna tshogs kyis gzirasnyib dang / gang yang sems g.yengs pa dang / gang dag gi mig gi bar chad byas pa dang / lce bcings pa ⑦dang / gang dag gi yan lag gang yang rung ba zhig nyams par gyur na/gal te de dag gi nad rab tu zhi bar bya bsnyedang / nad med pa thob par bya ba'i phyir snying thag pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po'i ming nas rjod ⑨par byed cing a ga ru dang / rgya spos kyis bdugs tshunas/ skyes bu dam pa nam mkha'i snying po la phyag 'tshal hunyanas/rigs kyi bu de ni de dgarwartegi rmi lam na bram ze'i gzugs kyis 3)mdun du 'dug gam / brgya byin gyi gzugs sam/ dpal gyi gzugs sam/ dbyangs can gyi gzugs sam/ rgyal rigs kyi gzugs sam/ blon po'i gzugs sam/dpa' bo'i gzugs sam/ sman pa'i gzugs sam/ pa'i gzugs sam/ma'i gzugs sam/ khye'u'ichagazugs sam/ bu mo'i gzugs kyis rmi lam na nad pa'i mdun du 'dug ste de'i nad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir sman dang yo byad du gyur pa thams cad de bzhin du ston cing nad pa'i sbyor ba gcig gis nad thams 66—745

cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du gang zhal ta dang / longs spyod 'dod patudang ne/ gang kha ton dang / thos par 'dod pa7dang / gang dben par 'dod pa dang / gang bsam gtan la bsam gtan byed pa dang / shes rab 'dod pa dang / gang yang grags par〈'dod pa dang / gang bzo sbyong bar 'dod pa dang / gang dbang phyug 'dod pa dang / gang gzugs 'dod pa dang ske/ gang nor 'dod pa dang / gang dam pa 'dod pa dang / gang rigs 'dod pa dang / gang bu 'dod pa dang / gang g.yog 'dod pa dang / gang yon tan 'dod pa dang / gang sbyin pa 'dod pa dang / gang tshul khrims 'dod pa nas/ gang shes rab kyi bar du 'dod pa dang / gang tshig 'jam po 'dod pa dang / gang sems can rnams dang 'thun ④par 'dod pa dang /gang sdig pa las thar bar bya bar 'dod pa dang / gang sbyin pa la gzhog par 'dod pa nas/ shes rab la gzhog pa'i bar du 'dod pa dang / tshe ring bar 'dod pa dang / longs spyod 'dod pa dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa dang /sems can ser sna can rnams gtong ba la gzhog par 'dod pa dang / tshul khrims 'chal rigapa dag tshul khrims la gzhog par 'dod pa dang / le lo can dag brtson 'grus la gzhog par 'u'adod na/ de dag la rigs kyi bu 'di ni thabs ston par byed do/ /gang snying rje chen po dang ma bral zhing bdag la lta zhing sems can thams cad la btang ༅snyoms su byed la/ bdag gis thabs gang gis sems can 'di dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la sems bzhag du pa dang / thabs mkhas pa la dgod pa dang / tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi nas snying rje chen po'i bar la dgod par bya snyam du sems pa des byang 66wa 746

chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la phyag bya'o/ /dgon pa'am/ dbye'am/bla gab med par a ga ru dang / rgya spos dang / dus kyi7rjes su 'brang bas bdug⑧par bya'o/ /thal mo sbyar te phyogs mtshams7kun tu yan lag lngas phyag 'tshal nas sngags kyi tshig 'di bzlas par bya'o/ /tarya thā/ su sri sha /su sri sha /kā ru ṇi gdu /tsa ra tsa ra/ bi tsa ra/ si phyetsa ra/ kā ru ṇi ka /mur mur / be ga budha ri/ ma tsa me/ bhu dza pā ⑦da/ ma hā ⑤kā ru ṇi kāspu/ tsi na ta ma ṇi pu rā ya/ kā ru ṇi ka /sarba sha mesba hunyamā ya/ armāshrīdzñā dhā ri/ sbu gung sbu gung / ru ti bi be ka gung grisbyi bi be ka 3)gung / pū rakheya kā ru ṇi ka /pū rā yan tu ma ma/ a sha sarba 8pan tha tsami/ a sho ka ga ti swā hā/ sngags 'di lan du mar bzlas te nyal bar bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu de ni de la mi'i tunyegazugs sam/ ri dgas〈nyekyi gzugs sam/ bya'i gzugs sam/ bdag nyid du ston pa'am/ de'i bsod nams kyi skal pa 3)ji lta bu de 'dra ba'i gzugs sam / tshig gis de la tshul gcig pa de 'dra ba'i thabs ston par byed de/thabs gcig po des sems can khrag khrig brgya phrag stong (kye du ma dag yongs su smin par byed nus so/ /gang theg pa la mi gnas pa dang / gang stonyan thos kyi theg pa la gnas pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi 2)theg pa la gnas pa'i sems can dag des thang cigatso yud tsam dang ldan pa'i shes rab dang / thabs chung buzad kyis kyang bla na med pa'i theg pa chen po la phyir mi ldog par gzhog pa nas(nye/ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang / bzod pa sna tshogs dang / sa bcu la gzhog pa'i bar du nus te/ des ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po de ni thabs dang / ye shes dang / snying rje chen po bsam 66—747

gyis mi khyab pa dang ldanatuno/ /rigs kyi bu nam mkha'i tshad ni la las gzungashenus kyi/ rigs kyi bu de'i thabs dang / ye shes dang / byams pa chen po dang ske/ snying rje chen po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs bskyedasnyepa dang /sems can yongs su smin par byed pa'i tshad gzung bar duni mi nus te/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po de ni yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan no/ /rigs kyi bu sems can gang g.yo med pa/ sgyukyimed pa/ yang dag pa'i nan tan dang ldan pa/ lta ba drang po dang ldan pa/ gzhan mi smod pa/ bdag mi stod pa/ phrag dog dang ser sna spangs pa/ tshul 'chos pa med pa/ lhag pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa de dag la ni rigs kyi bu 'di snying brtse bar byed de/ thabs dang / ye shes dang /brtson 'grus dang / rtul ba'i nithabs kyang ston cing sems can de thabs dang ske/ ye shes dang / brtson 'grus dang / rtul7ba des de 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal las yongs su thar ba dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems skye bar byed do/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyang byang chub tu sngo bar byed de/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las kyang7phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /mthu dang / brtson 'grus dang / rtul ba chen po des pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir spro ba dang / rtul ba chen por 'gyur/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po de ni yon tan gyi chos dang rtul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa sems can thams cad yongs su smin par byed pa'o/ /66—748

de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu 'di ci'i slad du yan lag gi dam pa mgo botul yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'chang zhing de shin tu lham me// lhang nger gda' la/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dag la de ltar ma lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po 'di ni snying rje chen po dang ldan pa/ sems can la phan pa'i phyir zhugs pa/ sdug bsngal chen posalas thar bar byed pa ste/sems can gang dag ltung ba'i rtsa ba byung ba/ ngan song du 'gro ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sprug par byed pa/ 'jig par byed pa'i sems can de dag la rigs kyi bu 'di ni sman du gyur pa'o/ /ma rig pa'i mun pa mun nag dang /lta ba ngan pa'i sdug bsngal bar gyur pa ⑤rnams la ni 'di nyi ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /ltung ba'i rtsa ba 'chags su 'jug pa'o/ /de dag gi snying la the tshomakhuyod pa dang 'bral bar byed pa'o/ /gang dag gi snying gi snod chag⑧par gyur pa / ltung bar gyur pa phas7pham pa'itshwa) sems can dge ba'i chos thams cad zhig par gyur pa/ ngan song du 'gro ba/ mgon med pa/ rten med pa/mkhas pa thams cad kyis spangs pa rnams la ni rigs kyi bu 'di khar (nyab dang mtshungs pa'o/ /lam ston pa'o/ /sdig pa thams cad dang / dri mi zhim pa thams cad ston par byed pa 'khru bar byed pa'o/ /'gro ba ngan pa'i lam las zlog7par byed pa'o/ /shing rta dang mtshungs pa'o/ /mtho ris dang thar pa la 'jog par byed pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni sems can gang dgatsosems shin tu 'dod par 'jug pa dang / gang dag shin tu khro ba dang / gnod sems 66—749

dang ske/ gnong ba 'chab pa medang / ser snas〈sems 'khrugs par gyur pa dang ske/ gang dag shin tu gti mug gis mun par song ba dang / rgyu med par smra ba dang / 'jig rtenasapha rol gyis mi 'jigasasrepar ltasnyib dang / gang dag nor sogs ⑥pas chog mi shes pa dang / gang dag mi dge ba'i chos bcu'i bar dang rtag tu shin tu ldan pa'i sems can de dag gi ngan song gi sgo gcod7par byed pa nas shing rta dang mtshungs pa'i bar du yin te/ sems can rnams mtho ris dang thar pa la gzhog par byed pa'o/ /de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ma gtogs par nirigs kyi bu 'di ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis mchod par bya ba yin rnal/ /byang chub sems dpa' byams pas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ltung ba'i rtsa ba gang dang ldan na sems can rnams dge ba'i rtsa ba sprug7par bgyid cing ngan song du mchi5glebar 'gyur ba dang / ltung ba'i dngos por 'gyur zhing lha dang mi'i bde ba thams cad las phas hu)pham pa de la rigs kyi bu 'di 1snyematho skoris dang thar pa'i bde bas tshim par bgyid pa'i ltung ba'i rtsa ba de dag gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu rgyal rigs rgyal thabs spyi bo nas dbang bskur 8ba'i ltung ba'i rtsa ba ni lnga ste/ ltung ba'i rtsa ba de7dang ldan na rgyal rigs rgyal thabs spyi bo hu stanas dbang bskur yiba'i sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sprug par 'gyur/ ltung ba'i dngos por 'gyur/ lha dang mi'i bde ba thams cad las phas 3)pham par 'gyur/ ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /lnga gang zhe na/ rigs kyi bu rgyal rigs rgyal thabs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba mchod rten gyi rdzas 'phrog par byed/ dge 'dun gyi'am/ phyogs bzhi'i dge 66—750

'dun la phul ba 'phrogatupar byed dam/ 'phrog tu 'jug par byed pa 'di ni ltung ba'i rtsa ba dang po'o/ /gang yang chos spong bar byed de/ nyan thos kyi nges par 'byung ba bshad pa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi nges par 'byung ba bshad pa'amanyaske/ theg pa chen po'i nges par 'byung ba bshad pa spong bar byed/ 'gog par byed/ sbed ⑧par byed pa 'di ni ltung ba'i rtsa ba gnyis pa'o/ /gang yang nga'i7phyir skra7dang kha spu bregs nas/ gos ngur smrig bgos pa bslab pa 'dzin kyang rung / bslab pa mi 'dzin kyang rung / tshul khrims 'chal kyang rung ske/ tshul khrims dang ldan yang rung ste de'i gos ngur smrig dag 'phrog cing khyim par byed dam/ lus la chad pas gcod par byed dam/ btsonasherar 'jug par byed/ srog dang 'bral bar byed pa 'di ni ltung ba'i rtsa ba gsum pa'o / /yang rgyal rigs gang gis ched du bsams te'uma'i srog gcod/ pha dang bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i srog gcod par byed/ dge 'dun 'dus pa 'byed par byed/ ched du bsams khanas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la ngan sems kyis khrag 'byinatshwanyepar byed na/ mtshams med pa'i las lnga po 'di dag las las gang yang rung ba zhig 'byung bar byed pa 'di ni ltung ba'i rtsa ba bzhi pa'o/ /yang rgyal rigs gang rgyu med par smra bar 'gyur(rte/ 'jig rten pha rol yal bar 'dor bar byed/ mi dge ba'i las kyi lam bcu blangs zhing tunye'ajug par byed/sems can mang po gzhan dag kyang mi dge ba'i las kyi lam bcu yang dag par 'dzinachadu 'jug /'dul bar byed/ 'jug par byed/ 'jog par byed pa 'di ni ltung ba'i rtsa ba lnga pa ste/ rigs kyi bu gang yang rgyal rigs rgyal thabs spyi 66—751

bo nas dbang bskuratub la ltung ba'i rtsa ba 'di lnga las ltung ba'i rtsa ba gang yang rung ba zhig byung na/ rgyal rigs rgyal thabs spyi bo nas dbang bskur7ba de sngonasridage ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa de thams cad sprugs par 'gyur/ lhung ba'i dngos por 'gyur zhing / lha dang mi'i bde ba thams cad las pas pham par 'gyur / ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po kla klo'i yul de lta bu gzhan dag tu skye zhing 'byung bar ston teX/ la lar ni dge sbyong gi gzugs dang / cha lugs dang / spyod lam dang / la lar ni bram ze'i gzugs dang / cha lugs dang / spyod lam ston to/ /gang dang gang gis bdag gi skye ba 'byung bar ston pa de dang deshedag tu rgyal rigs de 'dra ba dag la chos 'chad par byed de/ sngon ma byung ba/ sngan⑧cad ma byung ba/thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshad pa zab mo zab pa'i mdo sde dang / gzungs dang /bzod pa dang / sa dag 'chad par byed/ ston par byed de/ de'i phyir rgyal rigs rgyal thabs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba de sngon gyi sdig pa mi dge ba'i las la ngo tsha bar byed/ dmodatshwakye par byed/ 'chags par byed/ gtong bar byed / spong bar byed cing / de sbyin pa dang / dul ba dang / sdom pa dang /rtul ba'i spro ba chen po la gnas shing mtho lho)ris la gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /byams pa blon po'i ltung ba'i rtsa ba yang lnga ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ gang yang blon po mchod rten gyi rdzas 'phrog par byed dam/ phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi rdzas 'phrog par byed pa 'di ni ltung ba'i rtsa ba dang po'o/ /gang yang grong 'joms par byed pa dang / ljongs 'jomasalgepa dang / grong khyer 'joms par byed pa 'di ni ltung ba'i rtsa ba gnyis pa'o/ /yang blon po gang chos spong bar byed de/66—752

nyan thos kyi nges par 'byung ba bshad pa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi nges par 'byung ba bshad pa'am/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i nges par 'byung ba bshad pa spong bar byed/ 'gog par byed/ sbed par byed pa 'di ni ltung ba'i rtsa ba gsum pa'o/ /yang blon po gang bcom ldan 'das kyi7phyir rab tu byung ba la gtsesabar byed na/ bslabalgepa 'dzin kyang rung / mi 'dzin kyang rung / tshul khrims dang ldan yang rung / mi ldan yang rung ste/ de dag gisnyigos ngur smrig dag 'phrog par byed/ khyim par byed dam/ lus la chad pas gcodapo)dam/btsonakhurar 'jug par byed dam/ srog gcod par byed pa 'di ni blon po'i nyung ba'i rtsa ba bzhi pa'o/ /yang blon po gang mtshams med pa lngashelas mtshams med pa gang yangalte rung ba'i las byed cing sogs57pa 'di ni ltung ba'i rtsa ba lnga pa ste / rigs kyi bu blon po gang la ltung ba'i rtsa ba lnga po 'di dag las ltung ba'i rtsa ba gang yang rung ba zhig byung na/ blon po de sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa thams cad sprugasalgepar 'gyur/ ltung ba'i dngos por 'gyur/ lha dang mi'i bde ba thams cad las phas7)pham par 'gyur/ sems can dmyal ba la gzhol bar 'gyur te/ de dag gi don gyi phyir byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po kla klo'i yul de lta bu gzhan dag tu gnas shing skye ba 'byung ba yang ston te/ yil lar ni dge sbyong gi gzugs dang / cha lugs dang / spyod lam gyisasnyisems can rnams la chos 'chad/ la lar ni bu mo'i bar gyi gzugs kyis chos 'chad de / gang dang gang dag tu skye bar 'byung bar ston pa de dang ⑩de dag tu yang blon po de dag la chos 'chad de sngon ma byung ba/ sngan tunyechad ma byung ba/thams cad mkhyen pas〈nyebashad pa/ zab mo zab pa'i mdo sde dang / gzungs 66—753

dang ske/ bzod pa dang / sa dag 'chad par byed/ ston par byed de/ de'i phyir blon po de sngon byas pa'i mi dge ba'i sdig pa'i las la ngo tsha bar byed/ smod par byed/ las kyi sgrib pa de yang 'chags par byed/ gtong bar byed/spong bar byed do/ /de sbyin pa dang / dul ba dang / sdom pa la rtulatuba'i nan tan la gnas shing mtho ris la gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu nyan thos rnams kyi ltung ba'i rtsa ba ni lnga'o/ /lnga gang zhe na/ srog gcod pa dang /ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / brdzun⑧du smra ba dang /gang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'joms shingasakhrag 'byin par byed pa ste/ lnga po de dag go/ /gang nga'i nyan thos ltung ba'i rtsa ba lnga po de dag las ltung ba'i rtsashebal)gang yang rung ba zhig byung na/ rtag tu ji ltar bshad pa bzhin du de dag gi don gyi phyir byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po de lta bu'i yul gzhan dag tu skye ba 'byung bar ston cing la lar ni dge sbyong gi gzugs dang / cha lugs dang ske/ spyod lam gyis 'chad de/ snga ma bzhin gyi bar du mtho ris la gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa'i rigs kyi bu las dang po pa dag gi ltung ba'i rtsa ba ni brgyad de/ ltung ba'i rtsa ba de dag gis 'khrul par gyur pa 2theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa las dang po pa dag ni sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed ⑨pa thams cad sprugs〈kye par 'gyur/ ltung ba'i dngos 37por 'gyur zhing lha dang / mi dang theg pa chen po'i bde ba las pas thegepham par 'gyur/ ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen〈nyedang bral 7zhing 'khor ba na yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /brgyad gang zhe na / sems can gang dag sngon ngan par spyad pa'i rgyus nyon mongs pa snyigs ma 66—754

lnga dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir ②skyes nas de dag dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ngu dang ldan pa las dge ba'i bshesasheganyen la brten5kyete/ theg pa chen po shin tu zab pa 'di nyan cing rigs kyi bu de dag blo chung ngu zin gyis kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de dag gi nang nas byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa dedzageshin tu zab pa'i stong pa dang ldan pa'i mdo sdeba'adi nyan par byed/ lung sbyin par byed/ klog par byed de/de dag ji ltar thos pa dang / de dag ji ltar kun chub par byed pa de7bzhin du sems can gzhan sngon gyi blo dang 'dra ba dag gi mdun du don dang bcas/tshig 'bru dang bcas par rgya cher dran par byed/ ston par byed pa dang /dka' ba ma byas pa'i byis pa so so'i skye bo de dag thos nas 'jigs par 'gyur/dngangasalgepar 'gyur/ skrag par 'gyur te(8)/ skrag pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las ldog cing nyan thos kyi theg pa la sems smon par 'gyur ba de ni byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa'i lhung ba'i rtsa ba dang po ste/rigs kyi bu ltung ba'i rtsa ba des dge ba'i rtsa ba sngon bskyed7pa thams cad sprugs hu )par 'gyur/ ltung ba'i dngos por 'gyur/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i bde ba las phasarwatepham par 'gyur/ de'i byang chub kyi sems bslus shing ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de bas na 'di lta ste/ dper na rgya mtsho chen po bags kyis gzhol ba de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems can 3)pha rol dang /gang zag pha rol gyisngo bsam pa dang / bag la nyal thog mar shes par bya ste/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rim gyis 8chos bshad par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po yang de dag gi 66—755

phyir de lta bu'i yul gzhan dag tu skye ①zhing 'byung bar ston te/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa de lta bu'i⑧ltung ba'i rtsa ba byung bar gyur la ngan song gis gu'ajigs skrag nas/ de dag gal te byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i ming thos nas ltung ba de dag bshags pa'i phyir mthong bar 'dod na/ des tho rangs kyi thun la a ga ru'am/ rgya spos sam/ bdug pas bdugs honas thal mo sbyar te byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i ming brjod par bya'o/ /de'i skal bstoji lta ba bzhin du rigs kyi bu des sems can de mthong nas de ltar 'di lta bu'i gzugs su ston tedu/ la la'i mdun du ni tha mal par 'dug ste chos 'chad dol/ /la la'i mdun du ni bram ze'i gzugs kyis / la la'i mdun du ni khubu mo'i gzugs kyi7bar du 'dug ste/ byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa de'i ltung ba'i rtsa ba ji ltar byung ba de dag 'chags kyi su 'jug go/ /bla na med pa theg pa chen po'i spyod pa zab pa thabs mkhas pa yang de la ston par byed do/ /ting nge 'dzin dang / bzod pa dang /gzungs dang / sa'i bar du yang 'jog par byed7do/ /de'i phyir ngan song thams cad las yongs su thar cing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las kyang phyir mi ldog nyu1par 'gyur te/ de pha rol tu phyin pa drug la rdo rje bzhin du mthu che zhing rtul ba brtan hu par 'gyur/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar yang 'gyur rol/ /gal te des bdag nyid mdun du mngon sum du ma bstan na byang chub sems dpa' des skya rengs 3nye'abyung ba'i dus kyi tshe langs te/ skya rengs la gsol ba gdabalgepar bya ste/ 'di skad du brjod par bya'o/ /skya rengs skya 66—756

rengs ①thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ skya rengs lakhyod 'dzam bu'i nigling 'dir shar ma thag tu bdag la thugs rjes dgab par mdzod cig /nam mkha'i snying po thugs rje chen po la bdag gi tshig gis gsungs te/ ci nas kyang de dag gi rmi lam du ston cing de'i slad du bdag ltung ba'i rtsa ba 'chags par 'gyur ba dang / 'phags pa'i theg pa chen po las thabs dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi mig chen po thob par 'gyur bar mdzod ces byas te⑤/ des de'i tshe mal du gnyid log par bya'o/ /skya rengs shar ma thag tu yang byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa lhung ba byung ba de'i mi lam du ston par byed de/ ye shes kyi thabs chen pos de'i ltung ba'i rtsa ba yang 'chags su 'jug go/ /thabs dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyang ston par byed de/de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa de de nyid du byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po la yang shin tu gnas par 'gyur/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug kyang myur du yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa dag la la zhig la khyod kyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod mi nus/ khyod bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mi nus kyisal/ khyod myur du nyan thos kyi theg pa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la sems bskyed7cig dang / de'i phyir khyod myur du 'khor ba las nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes ji ltar sngar bshad pa'i bar du de skad zer na de ni byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa'i ltung ba'i rtsa ba gnyis pa'o/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa la la zhig la kye khyod kyitshwa)so sor thar pa'i 'dul 66—757

ba dang / tshul khrims dang / legs par spyad pas ci zhig bya/ khyod myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed7cing / theg pa chen po lhogs shig /de'i phyir nyon mongs pa'i rkyen gyis khyod kyi lus dang /ngag dang / yid kyis〈mi dge ba'i las gang chung༄zad bsgrubasalgepa de dag de'i phyir dag cing rnam par smin par 'gyur ba med do zhes ji ltar sngar bshad pa bzhin gyi bar du de skad zer na/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa'i ltung ba'i rtsa ba gsum pa'o/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa la la zhig la/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis nyan thos kyi theg pa'i gtam spongs shig /ma nyan cig /ma klog cig /gzhan la ma ston cig /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis nyan thos kyi theg pa'i gtam spong ⑤bar gyis shig /khyod ni de'i phyir 'bras bu chen po 'thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /khyod ni de'i phyir nyon mongs pa rnams mthar5yi'abyin par byed〈peri nus kyisaspu/ khyod theg pa chen po'i gtam la dad par gyis shig /theg spupa chen po nyon cig /khyod theg pa chen po lhogs shig /gzhan la ston cig dang 8de'i phyir khyod ngan 'gro dang / ngan song gi lam thams cad du 'gro bar mi 'gyur zhing / myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes de skad smras nas/ gal te de de'i tshig 31bzhin du byed cing lta ba'i rnam pa de lta bu len nyurtepar byed na gnyi ga yang nyanyeltung ba'i rtsa bar 'gyur te/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa'i ltung ba'i rtsa ba bzhi pa'o/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' las dang po ba dag lce 3steganyis par 'gyur te/ gzhan du sems la gzhan du ston cing theg pa chen po 'di yang sgra grags pa dang / tshigs su bcad77pa 66—758

dang ske/ rnyed pa dang / bkur ste'i phyir 'don par byed/ kha ton byed/'dzin par byed/ klog par byed/ 'chad nyu1par byed/ pha rol la yang thos pa tsam ston par byed cing bdag ni theg pa chen po pa yin gyi/ gzhan ni ma yin no zhes de skad zer zhing rnyed pa dang bkur sti'i phyir gzhan la phrag dog tu byed la/pha rol gang las〈nye bar spyod pa dang yongs su spyod pa thob par 'gyur ba la de'i rkyen gyis de dag 'khrug dupar 'gyur/ de dag gi ④ming brjod par byas tedzagesmod par byed/ brnyas par byed/ ngan du rjod 6)par byed/ bdag stod tso)par byed cing de dag phrag dog gi rgyus bdag ⑧mi'i chos bla ma dang ldan par 'chad par byed de/ de'i phyir dngos po des lhung bar 'gyur6)/ theg pa chen po'i bde ba las phas huX pham par gyur nyunyanas de'i phyir yang theg pa chen po las lci ba chen po'i ltung ba 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de'i phyir ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /dper na mi la la zhig rin po che'i gling du 'gro 'dod de/ rgya mtsho chen por gru las song ba las rgya mtsho chen por gru nyid zhig par gyur pa de bzhin dul/ byang chub sems dpa' las dang po 32yang theg pa chen po'i rgya mtsho rgal bar 'dod pa las phrag dog gi phyir brdzun /snyedu smras nas de'i rkyen gyis de dag dad pa'i gru zhig cing shes rab kyi srog dang bral ba 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' lasamunadang po pa phrag dog gi phyir brdzun midu smras pa'i rkyen gyis ltung ba lci ba chen po 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa'i ltung ba'i rtsa ba lnga pa'o/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu ma 'ongs pa'i dus na las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa'am/ rab tu byung ba dag zab pa nyid la tsho stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i mdo sde gzungs dang /66wa 759

bzod pa dang / ting ngeshe'adzin dang / sas brgyan⑧pa'i skyes bu rig pa chen po dang ldan pa/ tshegasakhuchung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod yul gyi theg pa chen po'i mdo sde de klog par byed/ 'don par byed/ kha ton byed / bklagasalgenas gzhan la rgya cher ston par byed/ de bdag gis chos 'di dag rang gis ①blos rtogs nas nga dusnying rje ba'i phyir de ltar khyod la ston gyisal / khyod kyis ci nas kyang chos zab mo 'di la mngon sum du 'gyur ba de ltar sgoms7shig dang / da ltar gyi ngashebazhin du khyed kyang ye shes mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes smra zhing / chos 'di lta bu zab mo zab pa dag mngon par ni ma byas kyi/ bklags7 pa tsam gyis bstan57to zhes ni mi zer bar rnyed pa dang bkur sti'i phyir bdag 'tshong bar7byed de/ de'i rkyen gyis dus gsum gyis 8de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag dang / 'phags pa'i gang zag dag gi spyan sngar nyes pa dang bcas par 'gyur/ ltung ba rtsi ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ lha dang mi rnams theg pa chen pos bslus par 'gyur te/ de ni de'i nyan thos kyi theg par yang mi 'gyur na theg pa chen po lta ci smos/ theg pa chen po la 'jug pa'i rtogasalgepa'i khyad par lta ci smos/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub lta ci smos0/ 'di lta ste/ dper na mi zhig 'brog dgon pa chen por song ba las bkres pa dang skom〈nyepas nyen cing ngal bar gyur nas de ()'bras bu chen po dang ldan pa'i shing gi drung du zas kyi phyir 'dug nas/des shing 'bras bu chen po dang ldan pa nyedri dang ldan pa ro dang ldan pa bor te dug gi shing ro med pa la 'dzegs nas dug gi 'bras bu za'o/ /zos nas 'chi 66wa 760

ba'i dus byed de/ gang zag de yang dpe〈de dang 'dra bar brjod do/ /de bas na mir larnyed pa shin tu dkon pa rnyed nas dge ba'i bshes zhuganyen la gnas te theg pa chen po la 'jug par 'dod pa las rnyed pa dang / bkur ste dang / grags pa'i phyir bdag la bstodabya/ gzhan la smod par byed pas lhung ba'i lci ba de 'dra ba byung bar gyur nas ltung ba'i rtsa ba de'i phyir shes pa thams cad kyis shin tu smad cing ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur te/ gang zag de 'dra ba ni rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangasasnyerigs thams cad kyis mi bsten⑥par bya'o/ /gang de sten par byed pa de ni shes pa thams cad kyi 'das pa dang bcas pa yin te/ de yang byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa'i ltung ba'i rtsa ba drug pa'o/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu ma 'ongs pa'i dus na rgyal rigs rnams kyikhumadun na 'don gyi phyag dar ba'am/ blon po'i phyag dar ba'am/ dpa' bo'i phyag dar ba'am/ sman pa'i phyag dar ba/blun pa mkhas pas snyems pa/ nor che ba/ longs7spyod che ba dag 'byung ste/de dag sbyin pa'i bsod nams kyi dngos po rnam pa mang po dag byed par snang ste/de dag gtong bas rgyags shing dregs nas snyems pa dang rgyags pas rgyal rigs dag kyang 'byed par byed/ dge sbyong dag kyang rgyal rigs dang 'byed par byed cing ske/ de dag rgyal rigs la brten nas dge sbyong dag kyang chad pas gcod7par byed de/ nor gyi7chad pas 'phrog par byed pas gnod pa de'i phyir dge slong dechadag gis gang zag gi yang rung / dge 'dun gyi yang rung / phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi7yang rung / mchod rten gyi yang rung ste/ phrogasalgenas de dag la skyes su 'bul bar byed/ phyag dar ba de dag kyang rgyal rigs la 66—761

'bul bar byed de/ de gnyi gnyeltung ba'i rtsa bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ni lhung ba'i rtsa ba bdun pa'o/ /gzhan⑧yang rgyal rigs kyi phyag dar ba de dge sbyong dang bcas te nyes par 'gyur/ chos de lta bu dag kyang chos ma yin par 'dogasani / chos ma yin par ni chos su 'dogs te chos spangasadu/ mdo sde dang7'dul ba'i bslab pa la mi bltadzo/ nag po bstan pa la mi bltas/ chen po bstan pa la mi bltaX/ byams pa dang / snying rje chen po dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bslab pa dang / thabs kyi bslabasngo) pa dang / gang yang mdo sde gzhan hu1dag lasatshwanyebaslab pa bshad pa de yang spangs nas dge slong dag gtse tunyeba'i phyir de 'dra ba'i chos dang mi ldan pa'i bya ba 'cha' bar byed de(nye/bya ba 'cha' ba de dag gis dge slong dag gtse bar 'gyur/ zhi gnas dang lhag mimathong la sbyor ba'i yid la byed pa gtong bar 'gyur/ bsam gtan pa de dag gnod sems mang bar 'gyur bas de'i phyir dge slong dag gi nyon mongs pa ma zhi ba zhi bar mi byed/ srab mor mi 'gyur te/ de'i tshe dge slong dag bsam pa nyams par 'gyur/ tshul khrims nyams par 'gyur/ spyod pa〈nyenyams pa dang ske/ lta ba nyams par 'gyur te/ de'i phyir lhod par 'gyur/ phal cher lhod par 'gyur/ tshul khrims nyams par 'gyur/ dge sbyong ma yin na dge sbyong du khas 'chetherte/ tshangs par spyod pa ma yin na tshangs par spyod par7khas 'che zhing bong bu dang mtshungs pa dang chos shin tu gsal bar 'chad par 'gyur te / de dag la rgyal rigs 'khor dang bcas pas shin tu bkur sti byas pa dang /rim gro byas 2 )pa dang / mchod pa byas par 'gyur/ de dag gis du nyedage slong spong ba la brtson pa rnams kyi bsngags (nyepa ma yin pa khyim pa la brjod pa dang /66—762

rgyal rigs 'khor dang bcas pa de yang dge slong spong ba la brtson pa de dag la zhe snang zhing 'phya bar 'gyur te/ gang de na dge slong spong ba la brtson pa rnams kyi phan pa dang longs spyod du bya ba de kha ton la brtson pa'i dge slong la 'bul bar byed pas de gnyi ga ①cing ba'i rtsa bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/dge slong bsam gtan pa ni zhing dam pa yin gyi/ kha ton pa dang zhal ta la gnas pa ni ma yin pa'i phyir te/ dge slong bsam gtan pa dag ni ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang / bzod pa dang / sa dag la snod du gyur pa②/sbyin gnas dam pa ①snod dam par gyur pa/ 'jig rten gyi snang bar byed pa/lam ston par byed pa/ las kyi zhing dang nyon mongs pa'i zhing las sems can rnams sgrol bar byed pa④/ mya ngan las 'da' b.rasa'agro ba'i lam la gzhog par byed pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu de ni tshegs tham byung meb/ 'jigasalgepa dang bral ⑨ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa rnams kyi ltung ba'i rtsa ba brgyad pa ste/ ltung ba'i rtsa ba de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed huX pa thams cad sprugs (nyapar 'gyur/ ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur/ ltung ba'i dngos por 'gyur/ lha dang mi'i bde ba thams cad las phas 8pham par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' bslus par 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu de 'dra ba dag gi phyir byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po ni de lta bu dag gi yul du skye zhing 'byung bar 'gyur te/ la lar hunyeni dge sbyong gi gzugs dang / cha lugs dang / spyod lam gyisashel lar ni bram ze'i gzugs dang / cha lugs dang spyod lam nas dud 'gro'i mtshan ma dang ske/ spyod lam gyi bar du gzugs sna tshogs ston te/ rgya cher ji ltar dpa' 66—763

bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin las 'byung ba bzhin du bklaganyepar bya ste/ de dang de dag tu sems can de ②dang de dag la ji ltar 'thun ⑧pa bzhin du chos 'chad par byed de/ sngon ma byung ba/ sngan chad ma byung ba thams cad mkhyen pas bshad pa'i mdo sde dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / bzod pa dang sa 'chad de / de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa thabs mi shes pa ltung ba byung ba dag ngo tsha bar byed/ ltung ba des 'jigs par byed/ dngangasalgepar byedagra / skrag par byed/ ltung ba de dag 'chags par byed/ gtong bar byed/spong bar byed do/ /gal te sems can de dag byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i ming thos nas mthong bar 'dod cing ngan song du ltung bas 'jigs te/ ltung ba'i rtsa ba bshags par 'dod na/ gal te de dag byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la phyag 'tshal zhing de'i ming nas brjod na rigs kyi bu de dag gi skal ba ⑦ji lta ba bzhin du sems can de'i mdun du tha mal pa'i tshul du 'dug pa'amanya/ bram ze'i gzugs nas bu mo'ishegazugs kyi bar gyis byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa de'i mdun du 'dug ste/ ltung ba'i rtsa ba de ji ltar byung ba de 'chags su 'jug go/ /de'i thabs mkhas pa zab mo dang / bla na med pa'i theg pa chen po la spyod pa yang ston/ sa7dang sa dag tu yang ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang bzod pa la gzhog par byed de/rim7gyis lam yan lag brgyad pa'i bar gyis gzhog par byed dos/ /de nas de dag ngan song gi 'jigs pa chen po las shin tu thar bar byed de7bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la 'jog par byed do/ /de ltar de glog dang mtshungs pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi spyod pa 66wa 764

la mthu che zhing rtul bar 'gyur ro/ /de bas na myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tunyemangon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te de dag la mngon sum du bdag ston par mi byed na/ gang de la gsol bar byed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa nyes pa dang bcas pa tho rangs kyi thun la langs te kha shar phyogs su bstan te 'dug 'kho/ lha'i bu skyasarengs dul gsol ba gdab par bya ba 'di skad du brjod do/ /skya rengs skya rengs thugs rje chen po can/ bskal pa7chen po can khyod 'dzam bu'i7gling du shar ma thag tu bdag la thugs rjephudagab par mdzod cig /byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po thugs rje chen po can la bdag gi tshig gis 7sgron te/bdag gi rmi lam du yang de ston par 'gyur zhing bdag gis thabs des lhung ba bshags par 'gyur ba dang / 'phags pa'i theg pa chen po la thabs dang ye shes thob par mdzod cig ces smras nas des de'i tshe mal du gnyid log par bya ste/skya rengasalge 'dzam bu'i7gling 'dir shar ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po 'dir 'ong bar 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa de'i rmi lam na tha mal par mdun du 'dug ste/ ltung ba'i rtsa ba de yang 'chags su 'jug /ye shes dang thabs chen pos thabs dang ye shes la mkhas pa gang dag gis byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa de de nyid du byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob par 'gyur ba dang / theg pa chen po la shin tu brtan por gnas par 'gyur ba dang / de myur du pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang / ring po (nyemi thogs par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 66wa 765

'gyur ba de lta bu'i thabs dang shes rab kyang de la ston to/ /de bsashen rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po 'di ni shin tu dpa' ba las byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che yan lag gi dam pa mgo bo gel 'dug par snang ngo / /de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po (1nam mkha'i snying po ni yon tan bsam gyis7mi khyab pa dang ldan rnam/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang sems can gang byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i ming thos sam/ gzugs 'drirasnyi'ajug gam/ de la mchod pa byed dam / rim gro byed/ bstirnyastang byed/ bkur sti byed/ mchod pa byed cing /me tog dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan rnam pa du ma dag gisakhubakur ster byed/ phyag 'tshal bar byed/ bdag gi srog kyang de la 'bul bar byed na sems can de dag ni mes 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur/ chus ma yin/ mtshon gyis ma yin / dug gis 'chi bar mi byed de/ de dag tshe zad pa ma gtogs par mi 'am mi ma yin pa sus kyang de dag gi srog dbrog⑧par mi nus/ dus ma yin par mi 'chiX9ri/ nad bu can du mi 'gyur/ bkresalgepa dang skom pas 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur/ rgyal po'i chad pas chod par mi 'gyur/ 'chi ba'i dus la bab kyi bar du ltung ba'i rtsa ba 'byung bar mi 'gyur te(spe/ de dag mig gis gzugs mi mthong / rna thertebs sgra mi thos/ snas dri mi tshor/ lcesarwanyero mi myong ske/ lus kyis reg bya mi shes shing / da dung du dbugs phra mo 'byung ba dang 'jug par pobyed/ da dung du de'i lus la tshe dang / drod dang / rnam par shes pa 'jug par 'gyur bsto de'i tshe/ de dag la byang chub sems dpa' nam 66—766

mkha'i snying po tha mal par ston par byed de/ sems can gang sngon bram ze la gus par gyur pa ①de dag gi rnam par shes pa la ni rigs kyi bu de ⑤bram ze'i gzugs su ston to/ /gang 'dod pa'i dbang phyug la gus pa de dag la ni 'dod pa'i dbang phyug gi⑧bar du ston pa nas/ gang sred med kyi bu la gus pa dang /gang dbang phyug chen po la gus pa dang / brgya byin la gus pa dang / 'khor los sgyur ba la gus pa dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / yul 'khor srung dang ske/ 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang rnam thos kyi bu la gus pa dang ske/ gang dag lha dang / ri dang / shing dang / chu mig dang / mtshe'u dang ske/ lteng ka sna tshogs la gus pa'i bar du gang dang gang gi7skyabs su song ba'i sems can de dag la de lta de ltar sems canabade dag gi mdun du bstan nas / gang0gi bsam pa ci 'dra ba bzhin du de'i gzugs kyis 'di skad ces smra'o⑨ske/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dag la/ /gang dag shes rab kyis mthong ba / /'khor ba'i srid pa sgrol0 )ba'i phyir/ /'khor ba na ni de kun shes/ /sems can de dag gis chos 'di dag rnam par shes pas shes par byas nas mtho ris la gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang dag sangs rgyas la mngon par dad pa de dag gi mdun du 'dug stonye/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs bstan〈rtenas 'di skad ces smra'o/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bden pa yis/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho gang sgrol btunye/ /ye shes de la myur du reg /sdug bsngal kun las 'grol 0bar 'gyur / /de'i7tshe sems can de dag sangs rgyas yid la byed pa'i sgras dga' zhing rangs nas 'chi ba'i dus byas te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rtog pa med pa7yongs su dag pa/ gang na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugasarwanyepa/ 'tsho 66—767

ba / gzhesalgepa/ chos kyang ston pakhuder skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du chos dang / dge 'dun la brjod par bya'o/ /de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po ni yon tan gyi chos bsam gyis7mi khyab pa dang ldan no//gang yang ting nge 'dzin rnam pasnyisna tshogs la sems kyis shin tu dbang bya bar 'dod na/ des tho rangs kyi thun la byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la phyag 'tshal te mchod pa ci nus kyis bya'o/ /sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems nye bar gzhag ⑤ste du'adi skad ces brjod do/ /dgongs shig ⑦dgongs shig /nam mkha'i snying po thugs rje chen po brnyes pa/ bdag la dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor stsol cig /'di lta ste/ u mu ra ṇa khe/bakṣa masani le/ sa mu dra/ a ba da re na/ na ya na ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā/a nu pa ma dzam bha smṛ ⑨ti/ a kra dzam bha smṛ ⑩ti/ badzra dzam bha smṛ ⑩ti/ ko ṣaḥsngo ti/ a nu pa ma :sngo ti/ 67ta ko ṭi smṛ ti swā hā/ de la dran pa dang ting nge 'dzin la 'jug pa sbyin par byed do/ /gang yang sangs rgyas kyi bka' yang rung / nyan thos kyis bshad pa yang rung ste/ bstan bcos sna tshogs klog par 'dod na/ des khrus byas te skya rengs 'byung ba'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la phyag bya'o/ /mchod pa ci nus kyis bya'o/ /sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems su bya'o/ /'di skad kyang 8brjod par bya'ol/ /dgongs shig dgongs shig /mkhas pa chen po sems can thams cad kyi nang na bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rigs kyi bu nam mkha'i snying po gang zag gi mchog /dran pa dang ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor bdag la stsol cig /'di lta ste / i rmā0) la dza/ bi ṣan du ṣa dza/ bi ya ba na dzam/ bi bakṣi sake me/66—768

pā sha la dza si/ dhi'i⑧na sha ra be/ shas kuṇḍi/ hu ma hu ma/ ma hā kā ru ṇisaka swā hā/ gang rgya mtsho chen por 'jug 'dod pa dang / gang khung du 'jug 'dod pa dngakyi/ gang bcudakyidam pa spyod par 'dod par gyur pa dang /gang btsonakhurar bcug pa dang / gang mdza'aphub dang bral ba dang / gang mi mdza'7ba dang phrad pa dang / gang dag mes 'jigs pa dang / chu dang /mtshon dang / dug dang / byad stems dang / stag dang / seng ge dang /dug drag po dang / rkun po dang / g.yon can gyis〈spe'ajigs par 'gyur ba dang ske/ gang dam du bcings pa dang / gang chad pas bcad pa dang / gang gsad pa la thug pa dang / gang nad kyis btab 8pa dang7/ nad kyis 'jigs pa dang / gang dag chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / mal cha dang ske/ stan dang / na ba'i gsos sman dang / yo byad kyis phongs pa de dag gal te byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i ming nas brjod cing /mchod pa ci nus kyis byed la sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems kyis gzhog cingacha'adi skad du yang smra ste/ dgongs shig dgongs shig /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa grags pa chen po nam mkha'i snying po 'gro ba'i don bzhed pa/thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bdag la gzigs shig /bdag 'dinyelta bu las rab tu thar par mdzod cig /skal ba stsol cig /mthu chen po bdag7ni sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag go/ /shin tu dbul7lo/ /bdag ni khyod la brten7nas zhi ba dang bde bzhu / tshe 'di dang tshe rabs gzhan du thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po gzugs tha mal pa nas bu mo'i gzugs kyi bar gyis sems can de dag gi mdun du 'dug ste/66—769

dbugs 'byin par byed do/ /gang dag ci las 'jigs pa de dag de las rab tu thar bar byed do①/ /gang dag dbul ba7gos med pa nas gang dag yo byad kyis brel ba dag gi ②bar du de dag la de lta de ltar bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed ༈/ /yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs pa'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po'i bu la la zhig gnas chen po'i dbang bskurabab thob par sems pa0de gal te byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i mingakyibarjod cing phyag 'tshal la / mchod pa dang rim gro byed pa lasasogs te/ bram ze'i gnas chen po dang ske/ khyim bdag gi gnas chen po dang / bzo'i gnas chen po dang / thos pa'i gnas chen po dang / sgom pa'i gnas chen po dang / gang mos pa'i gnas chen po'i bar du 'dod pa de dag gal te byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i ming thos nas phyag 'tshal bar byed/ khrus byas te gos gtsang ma bgos nas tho rangs kyi thun la byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i ④snying po la skyabs su song nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di skad du rjod ⑩ par byed de/ nam mkha'i snying po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bdag la skal ba stsol spre)cig /bsam pa dang / sems pa thams cad dang / bsam pa yid bzhin du rab tu rdzogs par hurtemadzod cig /gang sems shing gang gsol ba thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyod kyis mdzod cig ces brjod na/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying pos lha'i rna ba'i khams rnam par dag pa/ mi'i las 'das pas sgra de thos nas sems can de dag la bdag ci rigs par ston te/ de dag la de〈nyeltar thabs kyang ston to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po de ni de lta bu'i thabs kyi yon tan gyi chos dang ldan no/ /blo rgya 66—770

mtsho chen po dang ldan no/ /rigs kyi bu rgya mtsho chen po'i chu'i thigs7pa ni la la zhig gis tshad bzung〈bar nus srid kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po thabs dang ye shes la mkhas pa dang / thabs kyis sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i tshad ni gzungasami nus so/ /rigs kyi bu phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' samatha' yas mu med pa thams cad kyi tshad ni la las gzungasnyibar nus srid kyi/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir rnam pa sna tshogs su sprul par byed pa ni tshad gzung mi nus te④/ la lar ni sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi gzugs su sprul par byed do/ /la lar ni bram ze'i gzugs su byed cing / sems can ji lta bus 'dul ba de lta bu'i gzugs kyi bar du sprul par byed de①/ de dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa rnams kyi nang du ni dud 'gro'i gzugs su sprul par byed do/ /sems can dmyal ba pa rnams kyi nang du ni sems can dmyal ba huX pa'i gzugs su sprul par byed pa nas gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa rnams la gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi gzugs kyi bar du sprul par byed do/ /kha cig la ni mngon sum du sprul pa sprul par byed/ kha cig77la ni mi lam du sprul par byed/ kha cig la ni sdig hunyepa'i las sprug hunyepa'i phyir/ngan song las bsgral ba'i phyir/ mtho ris la dgod pa'i phyir/ sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir/ 'chi 'pho'i dus kyi tshe rnam par shes pa tha ma rgyu ba'i tshe/gzugs sna tshogs su sprul par byed demi/ de dag la thog mar skyabs su song zhing mthong ste/ bde ba thob nas mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du gnas pa'i bde ba thob pa'i 8bar du 'gyur bas de'i phyir sus kyang de'i sprul pa 7thams cad kyi 66—771

tshad gzung ①bar mi nus so/ /de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen posrinam mkha'i snying po 'di ni thabs dang ye shes kyi yon tan gyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan no/ /sangs rgyas kyi yon tan chen po dang ldan no / /de bas na rigs kyi bu de'i yan lag gi mchog mgo bo la yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'dug par snang ngo / /de nas de'i tshe 'khor 'dusalgepa thams cad kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la ngo mtshar thob/ rmad༄du byung ba thob/ bla ma la bkur0ste dang / bste stang du bya ba thob par gyurashenas thams cad kyis thal mo sbyar te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la mchod pa dang / bkur sti sna tshogs kyis bkur stir byed/ me tog dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang /byug pa dang / mar me dang / bdug pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang ske/ ba dan dang / chos gos dang / rgyan dang / gos dang / bstod pa dang ske/ glu dang / sil snyan dag gis byamachod pa7byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po des kyang de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das la phul lo / /phul nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal7nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nyon mongs pa can snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir sems can ma rig pa'i mun pa chen pos rmongs pa rnams la sangs rgyas kyi don bgyi bar ji ltar rngo thogs tho)lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'di lta ste/ rigs kyi bu nam mkha'algeni ma bcings pa tsham grol ba/ nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa/ ma rmongs pa/rang bzhin gyis dag pa'o/ /nam mkha' la rlung gi rkyen gyis rdul 'thul zhing 66—772

rlung gis dkrugs7pas yongs su ma dag pa'i mtshan⑧du snang ste/ chus ni zhi bar byed cing dri ma med la yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ ci /de la skar ma dang /gza'akhudang / nyi ma dang / zla ba'i bye brag mi mngon na ni skad cig dang /thang cig0dang / yud tsam dngas/ nyin mo dang / mtshan mo dang / dus dang / lo rnams kyi bgrang ba yang mi mngon no/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi dbang du song ba'i sems ni rang bzhin gyis dang ba'i yongs su dag pa yin mod kyi/ sems can rnams kyi blocabur du byung ba'i nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams kyis dusems nye bar nyon mongs par byas te/ de dag gi phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po chu dang mtshungs pas chos 'chad par mdzad do/ /sems nyon mongs pa can du gyur pa'i sems can rnams kyi ⑨sems yongs su sbyong bar7) mdzad pas yongs su dag pa dang / de dag gi sems dri ma med par 'gyur te/ de'i phyir sems can de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyi ma shar nas ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis tshim par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mngonaspyotedu 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhagarwa)pa bzhi nas 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i bar la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcu7brgyad kyi bar la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad snying rje nyid la shin tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de dag las kyang 'jig rten du dgra bcom pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'ichasangs rgyas 66—773

rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi ①bu 'di ji snyam du sems / nam mkha' mig la gnas sam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ma lags so/ /ci mig gi rnam par shes pa la gnas sam/ bcom ldan 'das dekhum lags so/ /ci mig gis tshikun du reg pa la gnas sam/ bcom ldan 'das de ma lags so/ /gang yang nang du mig gis kun du reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba gsum 'byung ba de la nam mkha' gnas sam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ma lags so/ /de bzhin du rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus la yang brjod par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ji snyam du sems/ nam mkha' yid la gnas pa nas yid kyis kun du reg⑧pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba gsum 'byung ba de la nam mkha' gnas sam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ma lags so/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ji snyam du sems/ sems can nam mkha' la gnas sam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ma lags so/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ji snyamasnyedu sems / nam mkha' sems can la gnas sam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ma lags so/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gcig la gcig mi rten to/ /gcig la gcig spyod yul ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni rtog pa ma mchis pa/ stong pa nyid dang ⑦/ sgro ma btags0)pa/ yang dag pa'i mtha' de bzhin nyidashedu rtogs par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i snying po ni 'di lta ste/ rang gi mtshan nyid tha mi dad pa/ mi rtog pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa / mi g.yo ba/ gsob lags te/ myu gu ma mchis pa/ sa bon ma mchis pa/66—774

'bras bu ma mchis pa/ rnam par smin pa ma mchis pa/ yi ge ma mchis pa/rlom7sems ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos chos thams cad la de ltar rtogs na50mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das/bya ba rā dza/ man ta lngardzogeya/ dzi na dza ya/ dza na ni ma )mu ni ha ra/ a na ya pha la/ gu ṇa garbha/ ni ya ma su ri55nyenā ya/ bu pa sha /sha ta sha pa/ sha ma sha na/ ta tha ka ri rim/ sha me ༅gu/ mā tu shi ṣa/ sha ma tse ta nā 5snyeya/ kle shān ta saṃ sho ṣa ṇi swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ legs so legs sol/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis mig las rgyal bar byed pa seng ge'ilo ci'agros kyi phyir bsgyings pa'i gzungs 'dis sems can dag 'chi ba'i tshe/ tha ma'i rnam par shes pa la nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / las kyi sgrib pa dang / chos kyi sgrib pa yod pa sprug pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par gtong nus sol/ /khyod ni 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med/ grangs med par 'gro ba dang /sems can rnams la snying rje'i dbang gis grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang du gzugs dang ske/ cha lugs dang / spyod lam sna tshogs kyis theg pa chen po'i mdo sde sna tshogs 'chad pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang / rgyal rigs gdol pa nas dge sbyong gdol 31pa'i bar du sdig pa'i chos las spang 32ba dang ske/ thams cad dge ba'i chos la gzhag par nus so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di bstan pa'i tshe lha dang mi'i skye dgu dpag tu med/ grangs med kyi pa dag gis ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang / bzod pa sna tshogs thob par 66—775

gyur to/ /gzhan dag kyang sa bcu la ye shes skyes par gyur to/ /srog chags khri ni mi skye ba'i chos la7bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /sems can rnams kyi rtsod pa gang / /ci yang rung ste de dag gi/ /gzhi rtsa spangs nas lta kun gyi/ /gzhi rtsa myur du 'gyur ba yin②/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad cesakhubaka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag dang /④ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dang / lha dang /mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs tedu/bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs skras7ske// // rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya pra bha dang / ban de ratna rakṣi tas zhus shing bsgyur te gtan la phab pa la

cad la khyab par byed do/ /gnyis po gang zhe na/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems dang / bsngo ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thabs mkhas pa ①ni pha rol gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la yikhurang bar byed do/ /yi rigerang bar byas nas sems can thams cad la bsngo0ste/ de thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems des sbyin par byed pa dang / sbyin pa'i bdag po dag zil gyis gnon to/ /gang len par byed pa de dag kyang zilasnyigyis gnon to / /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas pa ni phyogs bcu na shing las byung ba'i me tog gang ci yod pa phra mo yongs su ma blangs pa'i rnams dang / phyogs bcu na gang spos kyi shing yod pa rlung gis khyer ba yongs su ma blangs pa (rme bdag po med pa de dag kyang sangs rgyas thams cad la dbul ⑨zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sngo ⑩bar byed do/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas parwateni phyogs bcu nas 32sems can gang ji snyed bde ba'i tshor ba myong ba de thams cad la bsams te/ la/ rjes su yi rang bar byed do/ /rjes su yi rangs minas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sngo 8bar byed do/ /gang yang phyogs bcu na sems can sdug bsngal ba'i tshor ba myong ba de thams cad ni 'chags su 'jug ste/ gang sems can de dag gi sdug bsngal ni bdag la shog shig 8de dag ni bde bar gyur cig ces de lta bu'i go cha 1 tshogyon zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang byang chub tu sngo tunyebar byed do/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa gcig la phyag 'tshal na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal ba de ltar 'dzin te/ de ni 'di ltar slob bo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 66—788

kyi chos kyi dbyings gcig go/ /tshul khrims gcig go/ /ting nge 'dzin gcig go / /shes rab gcig go/ /dgongs pa gcig go/ /rnam par grol ba gcig go / /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba gcig go zhes de ltar slobatucing de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa gcig la phyag 'tshal na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal bar 'dzin to/ /de thabs mkhas pa de sangs rgyas gcig la bkur ster ②byas nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad la bkur ster ①byed de'u/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas de dag la mchod par 'gyur ba ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad kyang yongs su len to/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas pa ni nam zhig shes rab rmongs pa can du red na yang de ni bdag la yi mi gsodasnyikyi gzengs stod par byed do/ /chung ngu na rtsa ba bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig kha ton du 'don na yang rtsa ba bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig gi ⑦don gang yin pa gsung rab tu gtogs pa thams cad kyi don yangasnyede yin no zhes de de ltar slob cing des tshigs su bcad pa de kha ton du byas nas sems can gang ji snyed dag gis bdag gi rtsa ba bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di thos pa de thams cad sangs rgyas kyi spobs pa thob par shog shigasheces de ltar ma zhum pa'i sems kyis smon lam 'debs te/ de dge ba'i rtsa ba des sems can thams cad kyi thos pa mtha' med pa dpe med pa zil gyis gnon cing sangs rgyas kyi spobs pa yang len par byed do/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas pa ni nams7zhig gal te brgya la dbul por gyur na/ de'i tshe na de chung ngu na gzhan gyi las kyang byas nas zas gzar bu gang thogs te sems ma zhum pas dge 'dun nam gang zag la sbyin par byed do/ /— 66—789

byin nas kyang 'di ltar slob ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sems che ba'i phyir sbyin pa che bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs kyis0)bdag gi⑧sbyin pa chung ngu zin kyang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems ni dpag tu med pa'o snyam nas de thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems kyis zas gzar bu gang po sbyin par byed cing dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sems can thams cad 'di lta ste/ dper na da ltar gyi de bzhin gshegs pa phyag na rin chen bzhin du shog shig gces zas gzar bu gang po de nyid kyis sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang / tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang / bsgomasrepa'i rang bzhin gyis bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po mngon par byed do/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas pa ni nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas rnams dang lhan cig tu gnas kyang de dag la 'dod par mi byed dol/ /gal te yang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dag la bkur ste byas pa mthong na de rgyu gnyis kyis bdag nyid khong du chud par byed do/ /rgyu gnyis po gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' las ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'byung ske/ sangs rgyas las ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams 'byung bas de dag la bkur sti 5byas na bdag nyid la thog ma kho nar bkur ster byas pa yin gyi/de dag la ni ma yin pa dang / de dag ni bdag gi pa'i byung nor la spyod mod kyi/de la bdag gis ge'adod par mi bya/ phrag dog tu mi bya snyam du sems pa'oni / /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas pa ni sbyin pa sbyin ⑨pa na pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /ji ltar yongs su rdzogs par byed ce na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' gang gi tshe slong ba mthong na de ser sna'i sems tshar gcod par byed/ gtong ba chen po 'phel bar byed 66wa 790

de / de ni de'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang tshul khrims yang dag par blangs nas tshul khrims dang ldan pa la sbyin par byed pa dang / gang ngang7)tshul ngan pa can de dag tshul khrims la 'jog par byed cing sbyin pa yang sbyin ②par byed pa de ni de'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang byams par sems pa dadang ske/ sems ma 'khrugs pa dang / phan par sems pa ri )dang / sems rtse gcig par gyur nas sbyin pa sbyin 5)par byed pa de ni de'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / myang bar bya ba de dag la lus dang / ngag dang sems 'jog cing 'gro ba dang 'ong bar byed pa de ni de'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /sbyin pa byin nas gang rtse gcig pa dang /dbugs phyin par mi 'dzin pa de ni de'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gal te sbyin pa de byin nas chos nyid la brten te 7)'di sus byin/ 'di sus zos / su la rnam par smin na par 'gyur zhes des de ltar brtags na/ gang gis sbyin pa dang / gang la sbyin pa dang / gang la rnam par smin pa myong bar 'gyur ba'i chos gang yang ma spu dmigs pa de ni de'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o / /rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas pa sbyin pa sbyinatshwa )par byed pa na pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' ye shes blas 1nya'adi skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de 'dra bar thabs mkhas te/ sbyin pa gang gis sems can gzhan dag 'khor ba yongs su len par bgyid pa'i sbyin pa de nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams len par bgyid pa ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de de 66—791
